kirjeldus_et:
Loengukursuses esitatakse süstemaatiline sissejuhatus kvantväljateooriasse. Lähtudes variatsioon- ja sümmeetriaprintsiipidest tuuakse sisse klassikalisi välju kirjeldavad nn. kanoonilised suurused, millele operaatorväärtuse omistamise abil kvantiseeritakse vabad väljad (skalaarne, spiinor- ja vektorväli). Vastastikmõjuvad väljad kvantiseeritakse interaktsiooniesituses. Käsitletakse ka häiritusarvutust, normaal- ja kronoloogilisi korrutisi, Wick?i teoreemi, hajumismaatriksit, footoni hajumist elektronil jms.
Aine on vajalik fundamentaalfüüsika suuna magistrantidele.
kirjeldus_en: In this lecture series we give a systematic introduction to quantum field theory. On the basis of the variation and symmetry priciples we introduce classical fields describing so-called canonical quantities whose operator valued description allow to quantise free fields (scalar, spinor and vector fields). The interacting fields are quantised in the interaction picture. We also deal with perturbative calculations, normal and time ordered products, Wick's theorem, the scattering matrix, the scattering of the photon with the electron etc. The subject is necessary for master students of physics.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, the student:
- 1. knows the special features of second quantisation.
- 2. is able to calculate with secondary quantised fields.
- 3. knows Feynman rules and is able to calculate with them.
- 4. is able to apply perturbation theory for the calculation of simple processes.

kirjeldus_en: For Students Gives General Practical Knowledge in Ethiopathogenesis, Diagnosis, Treatment and Prevention of Endocrine Diseases.
opitulemused_en:
- Students that have passed this course:
- - have acquired knowledge of the  epidemiology, etiology, pathogenesis and clinical symptoms of the most common endocrine diseases
- - are aware of and can interpret the instrumental and laboratory research methods used in diagnosing and monitoring endocrine diseases; know the principles of treating and monitoring the most common endocrine diseases
- - know how to interview and examine a patient with an endocrine disease (or suspected)
- - are able to independently interview and physically study a diabetic patient (assessment of diabetic neuropathy); can make research-based decisions regarding the alteration of the treatment of a diabetic patient; know how to examine and monitor a patient for complications caused by diabetes
- - are familiar with the different groups and know the major side effects of medication used in the treatment of diabetes
- - recognize a patient with endocrine disease that needs emergency care and can administer treatment in case of emergency (acute complications of diabetes, adrenal insufficiency)

kirjeldus_et: Tsükli vältel õpitakse tundma laboratoorse meditsiini põhimõisteid ja sagedasemate laboratoorsete uuringute kasutusvõimalusi. Tehakse praktilisi töid vere- ja uriini preparaate mikroskopeerides, glükoosi ainevahetuse interpreteerimisel. Harjutatakse laboratoorsete tulemuste seostamist teiste haige ja terve inimese seisundi kliiniliste näitajatega. Tegemist on ühe osaga diagnostika aluste kursusest.
kirjeldus_en: During the class the students explore basic concepts of laboratory medicine and possibilities to use most frequent lab investigations. They perform practical exercises by microscopy of the blood and urine sediment specimens, by interpreting changes in glucose metabolism. They practice how to couple laboratory results with other clinical indicators of the status of the ill and healthy individual. The class is a part of the course of Fundamentals of  the diagnostics.
opitulemused_en:
- The students who have successfully passed the class
- 1.	know the basic concepts of laboratory medicine,
- 2.	can instruct a patient before the lab tests in order to minimize the effect of preanalytical factors to the results,
- 3.	are able to interprete major deviations in most frequent hematological investigations,
- 4.	are able to assay the level of glucose in blood and comment the results,
- 5.	know critical values of the vital laboratory parameters,
- 6.	can make decisions on reference change values, taking into consideration biological variantion of the corresponding analyte.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus koosneb kolmest suuremast osast.

1. Esimeses osas tutvume lause- ja predikaatarvutuse tuletussüsteemidega. Käsitleme nii loomulikku tuletust kui ka Hilberti-tüüpi tuletust.

2. Teises osas teeme sissejuhatuse loogilisse programmeerimisesse. Uurime selle teoreetilist alust, resolutsioonimeetodit, ja praktilist realisatsiooni, programmeerimiskeelt Prolog.

3. Kolmandas osas vaatleme olulisemaid mitteklassikalisi loogikaid, mida programmide töö analüüsimisel ning nende korrektsuse tõestamisel vaja läheb.
kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of three main parts.

1. In the first part, we will study proof systems of propositional and predicate logic. We cover both natural deduction and Hilbert-style systems.

2. In the second part, we will introduce logical programming. We will study both its theoretical basis, the resolution method, and its practical realization, the programming language Prolog.

3. In the third part, we look at the most important non-classical logics, which are used to analyse the working of programs and to prove their correctness.

Kuulajate teadvuses püütakse eelkõige tekitada füüsikalisi protsesse peegeldavaid kujutluspilte. Matemaatiliste meetodite rakendamise kohta füüsikas tuuakse markantseid näiteid (diferentseerimine, integreerimine, kompleksarvud). Käsitluse üldist matemaatilist rangust ei taotleta.
kirjeldus_en: The course is targeted to the quick and efficient introduction of the main principles of the current physics (matter and field, fermions and bosons, absolute speed, energy minimum, etc.), whereas the previous knowledge in physics is not required. The main goal is to create the mental constructs to envision physical processes. In most important cases, the examples are illustrated considering the application of the mathematical methods in physics. It is also important to note that the absolute mathematic formalness is not pursued.

- Upon completion of the course, a student will be able to:

- II.	Implement SLAM on simulated exteroceptive and proprioceptive data

- IV.	Implement a control strategy for lateral position control
- V.	Describe challenges in behavior modelling in autonomous driving
- VI.	Understand the pros and cons of different exteroceptive sensing systems used in autonomous driving
- VII.	Understand the steps involved in employing a sensing system

The student must follow the internal rules applicable at the place of practice.

After completing his/her practice, two reports have to be submitted to the Programme management:
- one assessment by the supervisor, describing the student's tasks and his/her performance, mentioning whether the student had the necessary theoretical background and whether he/she was able to apply them in practice, whether the student was able to integrate in a team and work with the others etc. This report has to be signed digitally and send to the programme's secretariat or signed and sent in sealed envelope to the School of Law in Tallinn).
- one self-assessment by the student, explaining where the practice was done, what legal tasks were performed during the practice, what were the benefits of the practice, reflecting on his/her learning achievements (to submit by e-mail to the secretariat of the programme).

There is no specific template for the reports, but please turn to the Programme Director for advice.

The Programme Director will evaluate the reports and decide upon awarding the corresponding 6 ECTS, either as practice in international law (P2OG.02.215) or practice in human rights (P2OG.02.216). If necessary, a meeting to discuss the practice results is organised.

kirjeldus_et:
Hägus loogika on kujunenud tõhusaks vahendiks probleemide lahendamisel erinevates valdkondades. Selle sünergiline kasutamine koos neuroarvutustega ja evolutsiooniliste tehnikatega võimaldab luua töökindlaid intelligentseid süsteeme. Sellist erinevate meetodite kombinatsiooni tuntakse ka kui ligikaudseid arvutusmeetodeid. Käesolev kursus tutvustab erinevaid ligikaudsete arvutusmeetodeid nt nn klassikalised hägusloogika süsteemid, hägusad neurosüsteemid, granulaarne arvutamine. Granulaarne arvutamine on uus neuroarvutuste paradigma, mis võimaldab luua täpsemaid ja
paremini tõlgendatavaid mudeleid. Kursuse käigus võrreldakse ka üksikute ja kombineeritud tehnikate
kasutamise tulemusi praktilistes olukordades.
kirjeldus_en:
Fuzzy logic has proved to be a straightforward though powerful tool for solving problems in several fields. In particular, its synergic use with  neurocomputing and evolutionary computing has allowed to build robust intelligent systems. Such ensemble of techniques is referred to as Soft Computing. This course introduces soft computing methods, ranging from the classical notions behind the fuzzy logic to
neuro-fuzzy systems, including some of the latest advancements in the field. One of these is granular
computing, meant as a new neurocomputing paradigm allowing more accurate and transparent (or interpretable) models. The course also comprises the practical application of the single or combined techniques to several classes of problems, such as control, prediction, classification. The course is self-contained, though it may be regarded as a complement of the Neural Networks course.

kirjeldus_et:
Ravimpreparaatides sisalduvate abiainete ülesandeks on farmakoloogiliselt aktiivsete ainete sobivasse ravimvormi viimise kõrval ka patsientidele manustatavate preparaatide tootmise võimalikuks tegemine või lihtsustamine. Ravimpreparaatide biofarmatseutilised omadused sõltuvad suurel määral kasutatavatest abiainetest. Abiaineid ei käsitleta enam inertsete inaktiivsete ingredientidena, nende iseloomustamisel lähtutakse füüsikaliste ja keemiliste omaduste detailse tundmise kõrval ka nende ohutusest, funktsionaalsusest ning regulatoorsest staatusest.
Käesoleva õppeaine ülesehitus järgib "Handbook of Pharmaceutical Excipients" toodud süsteemi. Abiainete klassifikatsioon järgib omakorda EP ravimvormide klassifikatsiooni.
kirjeldus_en:
Pharmaceutical formulations contain both pharmacologically active compounds and excipients added to aid. The formulation and manufacture of the subsequent dosage form for administration to patients. The biopharmaceutical properties of the final dosage form are highly dependent on the excipients chosen, no longer can excipients be regarded simply as inert or inactive ingredients, and a detailed knowledge not only physical and chemical properties but also of the safety, functionality and regulatory status of the excipients is essential for formulators.
In present course the teaching follows the system deseribed in the Handbook of Pharmaceutical Excipients. The classification of excipients follows the EP classification of dosage forms.

- The student who graduated the course:
- - knows the most important physicochemical properties of the excipients using in the design of pharmaceutical preparations
- - knows the methods for the determination of the functionality of excipients
- - understands the correlations between the quality of excipients and final medicinal products
- - understands the incompatibilities between active substances and excipients

kirjeldus_et: The basic course discusses the creation, legal nature and legal foundations of the EU, the interactions of the EU with international and regional organizations, relationship between the EU law and national law, institutions of the EU and the representation of Estonia therein, the decision making and law making procedures of the EU and Estonia's participation thereof, the implementation of the EU law in Member States including Estonia and the problems that might arise, the responsibility of a Member State in case of being in breach with the EU law, the judicial system of the EU and actions and procedure in the European Court of Justice, the fundamental rights and freedoms in the EU law, the general principles of EU law.
kirjeldus_en: The basic course discusses the creation, legal nature and legal foundations of the EU, the interactions of the EU with international and regional organizations, relationship between the EU law and national law, institutions of the EU and the representation of Estonia therein, the decision making and law making procedures of the EU and Estonia's participation thereof, the implementation of the EU law in Member States including Estonia and the problems that might arise, the responsibility of a Member State in case of being in breach with the EU law, the judicial system of the EU and actions and procedure in the European Court of Justice, the fundamental rights and freedoms in the EU law, the general principles of EU law.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course is able to:
- - Explain the central principles of European Union Law
- - Describe the sources of European Union law
- - Understand the relation between European Union and national legal systems
- - Identify the subjects of European Union Law
- - Find and apply the substantial regulation of the main branches of European Union law
- - Solve hypothetical cases  of EU law
- - Identify collisions between the national and the EU law and find the best way to solve the problem
- - Understand and distinguish between different actions in the COJEU incl. preliminary rulings, judicial review of EU acts (action to annul and others), infringement procedure. Able to pick the right action in order to solve the practical case. Understand the procedural aspects and interpretation methods of the COJEU
- - By passing the course the students will build up a ground for working with the acquis and an understanding of the legal nature of the EU. They also expand the sense of orientation in the information about the EU and the legal literature about EU, especially in the sources of the EU law.

During this introductory entrepreneurship course, the student gets acquainted with the ideas of entrepreneurial life style. Concepts, like an entrepreneur, entrepreneurship, failure, entrepreneurial team, and other will be introduced and experienced.
Creation of the business ideas, entrepreneurial processes, evaluation and feedback of developed ideas will be the central focus of this course. Also, teams will perform a small customer survey and conduct interviews with entrepreneurs.
FInally, each team will get a chance to present their ideas to real entrepreneurs and practitioners.

During the practical part both theoretical and practical experience on the specific field will be obtained as at least one-month full job in particular enterprise. Obtained theoretical and practical experience will be summarized in written report. The project has to be defended in open discussion of seminar classes.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has passed the subject:
- 1. has acquired professional practical work experience
- 2. can work in a team
- 3. Adapts to the daily work routine
- 4. has an overview of a specific company, its working environment, market potential, career opportunities in this company, practical aspects of managing this company in general
- 5. is able to give an overview of his / her role in the given company: goals of the internship, specific tasks of the intern, work results
- 6. is able to analyze what teaching at university he / she has used in practice, what has been useful and what would need to be changed / supplemented in the study process
- 7. is able to analyze how internship experience has supplemented his / her university education
- 8. is able to make periodic self-reflections on the set goals and set goals for a new reflection period

Praktiliste tööde käigus teostatakse analüüsid keskkonna objektidelt toodud proovidega ning saadud tulemuste põhjal esitatakse uuritava objekti keskkonnaseisundi iseloomustus koos teostatud mõõtmiste mõõtemääramatuse hinnanguga.
kirjeldus_en: Course "Environment and Measurement" is providing an overview of methods applied for the characterization of environmental objects. Practical works are designed for developing skills in integrated analysis of environmental samples of air, water or soil according to the proposed program. On the basis of gathered data the assessment of environmental status of the object under investigation will be reported and characterization of precision and validation of data will be presented.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, student:
- - analyses the role of oxygen in natural and technological processes for the biodegradation of organic matter
- - evaluates the importance of nutrients in water chemistry
- - analysis experimentally biodegradation parameters BOD and COD
- - knows the specificity of environmental samples
- - calculates concentrations and dilutions, compiles calibration graphs for chemical analysis of the samples.
- In addition, the student participates in discussions, expresses himself or herself orally and in writing, thinks creatively, practices cooperation and time planning, and manual skills.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Lab-reports are accepted and confirmed

- individual written examination 70%
- group -work examination 30%.

kirjeldus_en: The aims of the matter are to explain the biochemical, patophysiological and technical background of common laboratory investigations (clinical chemistry and laboratory haematology), to teach students the proper use of the tests and to interpret the test results. Unique feature of the undergraduate curriculum: development to a subject taught throughout four years (III - IV) of clinical studies. The speciality of laboratory medicine is an interdisciplinary laboratory profession which communicates basic and clinical sciences in the fields of clinical chemistry and laboratory haematology. The cycle is part of the basic course in internal medicine.
opitulemused_en:
- Students successfully completed the cycle:
- 1. know how to interpret the major abnormalities in the results of  enzyme, hemostasis, plasma proteins, and in concentrations of therapeutic  drugs.
- 2.  can determine,  using laboratory methods of the primary  healt care, the serum values Hb  and the D-dimers.
- 3. In the event of anemia, the student knows the morphological classification of anemias and is able to use laboratory tests to distinguish between the causes. They know  different characteristics in anemic red blood cell morphology.
- 4. know modern concept of  blood coagulation and the main investigation techniques: the prothrombin and activated partial thrombin-time,  D-dimers in diagnostcs  and in monitoring.
- 5. Recognises typical changes of plasma protein fractions, will be able to distinguish between mono- and polyclonal gammopathy.
- 6. Is aware of the indications to request concentrations of drugs and knows TDM list of drugs, recommended by the WHO,  as well as features of TDM in children, the elderly and request the anticonvulsant asseys.

Antakse ülevaade mikrobioota seosest krooniliste mitteinfektsioossete haigustega (allergia, autism, diabeet, metaboolne sündroom) ja bariaatrilise kirurgia mõju mikrobiootale ning üldtervisele. kirjeldus_en: The course contains lectures about formation and composition of microbiota, and the relationships between microbiota of different organs (intestinal tract, mouth, urinary tract, genital tract) and diseases. Association between intestinal microbiota and non-infectious diseases (allergy, autism, diabetes, metabolic syndrome), impact of bariatric surgery on microbiota and health. Cross-talk between microbiota and host, diagnosis and prognosis via microbiota testing, factors influencing the microbiota (antibiotics, pets, pro- and prebiotics, functional food).

kirjeldus_et: Tegemist on geneetikakursuse järgmise astmega, mis hõlmab erinevate bioloogiliste süsteemide molekulaargeneetikat ja genoomiuuringuid. Käsitletakse bakterite ja viiruste geneetikat, transponeeruvaid geneetilisi elemente, mitokondrite ja kloroplastide geneetikat, põhilisi molekulaargeneetika meetodeid, geeniekspressiooni mehhanisme prokarüootides ja eukarüootides ning kaasaegseid molekulaargeneetika rakendusi. Antakse ülevaade organismi arengu, immuunsüsteemi kujunemise, vähitekke ning käitumise geneetilisest tagapõhjast. Tutvustatakse populatsiooni- ja evolutsioonigeneetika põhimehhanisme
kirjeldus_en: More advanced topics in molecular genetics and genomics are covered including the genetics of bacteria and viruses, transposable genetic elements, cytoplasmatic inheritance, basic techniques of molecular genetics,  regulation of gene expression in prokaryotes and eukaryotes, and applications of molecular genetics. The course also introduces the genetic bases of development, immunity, behavioral traits and cancer. Finally, the concepts of population and evolutionary genetics are introduced.

opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course, the student:
- Explains the molecular genetic basis of viruses, bacteria, mitochondria and chloroplasts, and their specific characteristics.
- Describes and compares gene regulation mechanisms in prokaryotic and eukaryotic organisms and explains their roles in development, immune system function, behaviour, and cancer.
- Is familiar with and describes the main molecular genetic methods, including genomics and molecular diagnostic techniques, and explains their applications.
- Explains and analyses the basic principles of population genetics and evolution and relates genetic knowledge to biological diversity and speciation.
- Applies acquired genetic knowledge and appropriate terminology in subsequent courses in biology and life sciences.

nimi_en: Ideological and Legal Foundations of State Until the Early 19th Century
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb Euroopa riikluse kujunemist alates antiikajast, vaadeldes nii kreeka linnriikide, Rooma impeeriumi kui ka uusaegse suveräänse riigi arengut poliitilise mõtte ajaloo perspektiivist. Seminarides arutatakse võtmetekste, mis käsitlevad monarhia, vabariigi, segavalitsuse ja türannia küsimusi, ideid ideaalsest riigist, arusaamu riigi tekkimisest ja funktsioonidest, seaduste päritolu ja eri tüübid, vastuhakuõigus, suveräänsuse idee, loomuõigus, loomuseadus ja lepinguteooria ning küsimus Euroopa tsivilisatsiooni eelistest ja puudustest.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an insight into the development of European statehood from the antiquity, paying attention to the formation and development of the Greek polis, the Roman empire and modern sovereign state from the point of view of the history of political thought. In the seminars, the ideas about different state forms, the ideal state, the formation and functions of state, the origins and system of laws, the right of resistance, sovereignty, natural law and contract theory, and European civilisation will be discussed.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- - acquires systematic understanding of the ideas related to the formation and development of the state

kirjeldus_en: During the course, Estonian contemporary theatre is studied according to problem based learning (PBL) method. As a result of PBL group work, students write a group report on one theatre institution. During the studies the students read articles on contemporary Estonian theatre, watch video recordings, analyze statistics and repertory data. During the course, each group submits presentations on current work. As a summary of the course, the groups will write a joint paper.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Student analysis at least one of the innovative practices in Estonian contemporary theatre and at least one of significant concepts 
2. interprets at least one critical discussions related to Estonian theatre 
3. knows in general the Estonian theatre institutional system and has a deepened understanding of functioning of at least one Estonian theatre institution (it's structure, marketing strategies, repertoire principles, audiences, target groups). 
4. makes connections between innovative practices, theoretical concepts and practical functioning of a theatre institution. 
5. implements acquired knowledge by problem based learning method implemented in teams

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus lahkab põhjalikult intellektuaalomandi olemust, selle loomise, kaitse ja kommertsialiseerimisega seotud probleemistikku. Kursus koosneb järgmistest põhiosadest:
1.	Intellektuaalomandi olemus
2.	Tööstusomand ja selle varaliste õiguste kuuluvus 
3.	Autoriõigused
4.	Intellektuaalomandi kaitse seadusandlik raamistik
5.	Patendiuuringud, patenditaotluste kirjutamise printsiibid
6.	Turu-uuringud
7.	Intellektuaalomandi kommertsialiseerimise meetodid: litsentseerimine, spin-off firmade loomine
kirjeldus_en:
The course discusses in detail the meaning of intellectual property, the problems related to its creation, protection and commercialization. The course consists of the following main stages:
1.	Meaning of intellectual property
2.	Industrial property and the ownership rights
3.	Author's rights
4.	Legislative framework of the protection of intellectual property
5.	Patent search, the principles of writing patent proposals
6.	Market search
7.	The methods of IP commercialization: licensing, creation of spin-offs
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. To obtain knowledge about the meaning of intellectual property, industial property and author's rights. 2. To get information about regulations of IP management. 3. To understand the need to carry out patent and market searches.
hindamise_meetod:
The goal of this Intellectual Property (IP) course is to provide you with elementary skills needed to identify, evaluate and protect IP.
 As a creator or holder of the IP rights, it is not only a privilege but also a responsibility to make the most out of those rights. It's your opportunity to facilitate positive change (including wealth) with your knowledge in you, your family, institution and society!
By the end of this course you will have the elementary skills and knowledge to conduct an IP audit for yourself and your lab. To conclude this course, you will present a written summary of the audit.

kirjeldus_et: Virtuaalreaalsus (VR) on muutmas meie töö- ja mänguharjumusi. Suurimaks trendiks on metaversum, mis võib asendada Interneti selle praegusel kujul. Käesolev kursus valmistab tudengeid ette metaversumite loomiseks ning õpetab praktiliselt virtuaalreaalsuse rakendusi looma. Kursus katab VR elamuste sisuloome, optimeerimise, interaktsiionid, parimad arenduspraktikad ja tiimi põhise VR rakenduste loomise. Aines avastatakse ja kogetakse mängudisaini ja töökeskkondade piire ning julgustatakse tudengeid oma virtuaalreaalsuse ideid ellu viima ja ise aine projekti raames metaversumit looma.
kirjeldus_en: Virtual reality (VR) is already transforming the way we play and the way we work. The metaverse is knocking on the door and might replace the Internet as we know it. This class is preparing students to be active citizens of a potential metaverse with a very hands-on focus on virtual reality. We are covering content creation and optimization, interaction with several new modalities, best development practices, and team based VR development. We will explore and experience the fluent borders between game design and work environments and encourage students to actively shape our idea of a metaverse in extensive hands-on  project work.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of this course, the participant should be able to:
- -Understand, read, and critically reflect on the history, role,  and use of virtual reality
- -Design, build, and implement medium scale virtual reality applications in a small team
- -Critically reflect and enhance existing virtual reality applications, applying and deriving best practices
- -Understand and apply a variety of virtual reality concepts like locomotion and human interaction with a virtual world and assess its impact on comfort, personal space, and health
- -Understand, practice, and enhance graphics and visual design
- -Understand and use different forms of lighting and animations to enhance virtual reality scenes
- -Optimize assets and applications to fit device and computational constraints of the target devices
- -Practice embedding the use and projection of 360 degree mono and stereoscopic video material in VR
- -Modify the location and spatiality of audio signals and adjust audio for the use in virtual reality
- -Use virtual environments both for game as well as work environment and simulation design
- -Explore ways of multi-user, interaction, and multi-player implementations for virtual reality

kirjeldus_en:
Viruses and virology. Viruses with single-stranded DNA genomes (geminiviruses and parvoviruses)
and viruses with small double-stranded DNA genomes (polyomaviruses and papillomaviruses). Adenoviruses. Alpha-, beta- and gamma herpesviiruses. Viruses with large DNA genomes - baculoviruses, phycodnaviruses and minivirus. Poxviruses. Viruses with positive-starnd RNA genomes - picornaviruses, togaviruses, flaviviruses, hepatitis C virus and coronaviruses. Viruses of plants and insects with RNA genome. Viruses with double-stranded RNA genome: LA virus and reoviruses. Viruses with negative strand RNA genome - rhabdoviruses, paramyxoviruses, filoviruses, orthomyxoviruses, bunyaviruses and arenaviruses. Retroviruses, HIV. Pararetroviruses. Subviral pathogens - viroids, virophages and prions
opitulemused_en:
- After the course the students are expected:
- - to know the main groups of viruses
- - to understand the reasons behind genetic diversity of viruses and the consequences of such diversity
- - to understand the role of viruses in biological processes
- - to know the main properties of type members of different viral families - structures of corresponding virions and genomes, basic principles of their infectious cycles
- - to have understanding of scientific basis of vial pathogenesis and host anti-viral defenses
- - to be able to understand everyday information about viruses, for example to be able critically analyze the true and false information available in mass media including internet

Kursuse läbimise eelduseks on osalemine hackathon'ide tegevustes kokku vähemalt viie päeva ulatuses, mis võib olla tehtud ühe või kahe semestri jooksul.

Hackathon on lühiajaline koostööüritus, kus tarkvara- või riistvaraarendusega tegelevad osalejad — sealhulgas programmeerijad, graafilised disainerid, kasutajaliidese disainerid ja projektijuhid — töötavad intensiivselt koos tarkvara-, riistvara- või kombineeritud lahenduse loomisel. 

Arendatava projekti tüübile piiranguid ei ole. Hackathon'id võivad olla keskendunud näiteks kasutatavale programmeerimiskeelele, operatsioonisüsteemile, rakendusele, API-le või temaatilisele valdkonnale.

Kursusel arvesse minemiseks peab iga hackathon kestma vähemalt ühe päeva ning õppija kogu osalus peab kokku moodustama vähemalt 5 päeva.

On soovituslik, et vähemalt üks valitud sündmustest oleks 2-päevane hackathon, et pakkuda mitmekülgsemat projektiarenduskogemust.

Huviline peaks hackathon'i käigus panustama kasutuskõlbliku prototüübi loomisesse, mida saab hiljem kursuse hindamisel demonstreerida.
kirjeldus_en:
The prerequisite for passing the course is participation in hackathon activities totalling at least five days, completed within one or two semesters.

A hackathon is an event in which computer programmers and others involved in software or hardware development—such as graphic designers, interface designers, and project managers—collaborate intensively on creating software, hardware, or combined solutions. 

There is no restriction on the type of project that can be developed. Hackathons may have a specific focus, which can include the programming language used, the operating system, an application, an API, or a thematic domain.

Hackathons must be at least 1 day long to be eligible for the course, and the student’s cumulative participation across events must total a minimum of 5 days.

It is recommended that at least one of the events be a 2-day hackathon to provide a more in-depth project experience.

The goal of participation is to contribute to a usable prototype that can later be demonstrated during course evaluation.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Participation and domain skills.

Student knows how to take on a suitable role in a software or hardware hackathon (e.g., developer, designer, analyst, electronics builder, tester) and has the capacity to apply their technical or domain skills to support the team’s goals.

Collaboration skills.

Student understands how to contribute to teamwork, communicate effectively, fulfil agreed tasks, and collaborate with participants in different technical and non-technical roles.

Problem-solving and prototyping.

Student has the capacity to contribute to understanding the problem and shaping a feasible solution, and knows how to participate in the development of a prototype—whether software, hardware, or a combination of both.

Self-management and adaptability.

Student is capable of functioning in fast-paced, time-limited development environments, adapting to unexpected challenges, and reflecting on their learning process and areas for improvement.

Presentation skills.

Student knows how to contribute to preparing and/or delivering a clear and concise presentation, pitch, or demo of the team’s software or hardware solution.

Hackathon on lühiajaline koostööüritus, kus tarkvara- või riistvaraarendusega tegelevad osalejad — sealhulgas programmeerijad, graafilised disainerid, kasutajaliidese disainerid ja projektijuhid — töötavad intensiivselt koos tarkvara-, riistvara- või kombineeritud lahenduse loomisel. 

Arendatava projekti tüübile piiranguid ei ole. Hackathon'id võivad olla keskendunud näiteks kasutatavale programmeerimiskeelele, operatsioonisüsteemile, rakendusele, API-le või temaatilisele valdkonnale.

Kursusel arvesse minemiseks peab iga hackathon kestma vähemalt ühe päeva ning õppija kogu osalus peab kokku moodustama vähemalt 5 päeva.

On soovituslik, et vähemalt üks valitud sündmustest oleks 2-päevane hackathon, et pakkuda mitmekülgsemat projektiarenduskogemust.

Huviline peaks hackathon'i käigus panustama kasutuskõlbliku prototüübi loomisesse, mida saab hiljem kursuse hindamisel demonstreerida. | Hindamise eeltingimused: Hindamise pääsemise eelduseks on vähemalt kolmest hackathon'ist osavõtmine.

Student needs to take part in at least 3 hackathons. | Hindamise meetod: Aruande esitamine. Submit a written report.

kirjeldus_et: Võrreldes absolutismieelse Rootsi ajaga ei toonud Vene tsaaride poliitilise ülemvõimu kehtestamine (1710) Eesti- ja Liivimaa ühiskonnaelu üldises plaanis kaasa suuremaid muutusi. Ka asehalduskord 18. sajandi viimasel veerandil ei mõjutanud veel oluliselt rahvastiku enamuse igapäevaelu. Kuigi eesti talurahvale isikliku vabaduse andmine algas juba 1816./19. aastatel, jäävad siinset ühiskonnaelu ulatuslikumalt moderniseerinud protsessid 19. sajandi teise poolde - talurahva omavalitsuse ümberkorraldamine, talude päriseksostmine, rahvuslik liikumine, tööstuslik pööre ja linnastumine. Loengukursuses käsitletakse Eesti ajaloo võimukorralduse, asustuse ja rahvastiku, majanduse, õiguse, kultuuri ja rahvaliikumiste teemasid. Eesti ajalugu käsitletakse võrdlevalt naabermaadega ja ülejäänud kaugema Euroopaga. Kursus koosneb loengutest, seminarist ja iseseisvast tööst kirjandusega.
kirjeldus_en: Compared to the pre-absolutist Swedish era, the implementation of the political supremacy of the Russian tsars (1710) did not bring along any major changes in the social life of the provinces Estland and Livland. Also the period of the so-called regency in the late eighteenth century had no visible effects on the everyday life of the majority of the population. Although the abolition of serfdom began in 1816/19 already, the major modernizing processes occurred in the latter half of the nineteenth century - peasant self-government, the buying of peasant farmsteads, national movement, industrialization and urbanization. The course deals with themes like governance and power, settlement and population, economy, legal history, culture and popular movements. Problems of Estonian history are studied on the broader background of European history. The course consists of lectures and independent reading.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student acquires basic knowledge about the main themes, problems and developments of Estonian history from the period 1710-1900.

kirjeldus_et:
Kurusus on osa Tartu Ülikooli arheoloogia, geneetika ja lingvistika sidusuuringute kolleegiumi tööst, mille eesmärgiks on korraldada transdistsiplinaarset teadustööd, kus etnogeneesi uurimisel põimuvad arheoloogia, geneetika ja lingvistika.  

Kursuse raames antakse ülevaade etnogeneesi uurimise teoreetilistest lähenemistest, põhilistest allikatest, meetoditest erinevates teadusharudes, võtmemõistetest ja olulisematest näitejuhtudest ning teemakohasest kriitikast. Varasemate etnogeneesiteooriate tutvustamise kõrval keskendutakse uutele lähenemistele nii soome-ugri kui ka indoeuroopa etnogeneesi uurimisel arheoloogias, keeleteaduses ja geneetikas. Spetsiifiliste teemade puhul kaasatakse ka külalislektoreid.
kirjeldus_en:
This course is part of the scientific work conducted by the Collegium for Transdisciplinary Studies in Archaeology, Genetics and Linguistics, University of Tartu. The aim of the Collegium is to conduct state-of-art research in which the fields of archaeology, genetics and linguistics cooperate to study ethnogenesis.

This course intends to give an overview of theoretical frameworks, main sources, methods, key concepts, essential case studies and relevant critiques in ethnogenetic studies. In addition to the introduction of previous theories, the main focus is on new approaches to the studies of both Finno-Ugric and Indo-European ethnic history. Guest lecturers are invited to cover specific topics.
opitulemused_en: - As a result of the course a student is aware of the main schools of thoughts and history of the ethnogenetic studies. kirjeldus_et: Väliskaubanduse üldteooria osas esitatakse erinevad mudelid, millega on põhjendatud riikide vahelist kaubandust. Algul käsitletakse klassikalisi kaubandusteooriaid, seejärel järgneb ülevaade uusklassikalistest teooriatest (Heckscher-Ohlini teooria). Seejärel pööratakse suurt tähelepanu kaasaegsetele väliskaubandusteooriatele.  Välismajanduse monetaarne teooria annab ülevaate maksebilansi olemusest ja koostisosadest ning selle seostest vahetuskursi, hindade ja sissetulekute taseme ning kapitali liikumisega. Lisaks sellele selgitatakse raha- ja maksupoliitika mõju majanduse tasakaalule ning tutvustatakse rahvusvaheliste finantsorganisatsioonida tegevust.
kirjeldus_en: First half of the course is going to present different models explaining foreign trade. Classical theories of trade (theory of absolute and comparative advantage) are starting point. Following part of the course deals with the neoclassical theories of trade. Special emphases is given to the Hecksher Ohlin theory. International trade will be concluded by the analyses of the new trade theories (Linder model, economies of scale and product differentiation as the bases for trade etc.). International monetary theory gives understanding about the formation of balance of payment an its components. Afterwards links between exchange rate regimes, price and income level changes on the balance of payment will be analysed.  In addition also impact of monetary and fiscal policy on the external and internal balance of economy will be given.
opitulemused_en:
- Has knowledge about the basics of global economy,
- understands the mechanisms of the international trade and monetary system
- can assess the impact of the globalization process on different economic fields,
- can see the interconnections between the general tendencies of global economy and the development possibilities of the Estonian economy,
- has developed business skills for coping in an integrating world,
- can assess the impacts of Estonia's possible development scenarios on his/her own field of activities,
- is aware of possibilities for changing the development strategy for a small country.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb kõigepealt ühiskondlike  ja sellest tulenevate kultuuriliste muutuste iseloomu. Sellele taustale visandatakse uue kirjanduse olulisemad üldised tunnused nii luules kui proosas. Edaspidi käsitletakse mitmete prosaistide ja luuletajate loomingut ning osutatakse selle autori temaatilistele ja stilististele eripäradele. Kõik autorikäsitlused proovitakse taaskord siduda üldiste muutustega eesti nüüdiskirjanduse laiemat konteksti silmas pidades.
kirjeldus_en: The course concerns itself first and foremost with the nature of social change and its cultural implications.  The most significant general features of the new literature (poetry and prose) are situated in the context of these social and cultural changes.  This in turn serves as the basis for examining the works of several prose writers and poets, attending to the thematic and stylistic specificity of each author. Finally, all treatments of individual authors are relate back to general changes, in view of the broader context of contemporary Estonian literature.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of the course the student:
- - Comprehends the fundamental change that has taken place in the poetics of contemporary Estonian literature as compared to literature of previous eras
- - Knows the historical and cultural background of this breakthrough, its central authors, works, and poetics
- - Shows mastery of the basic concepts and vocabulary required  for the analysis of modernist- postmodernist contemprary literature
- - Has read those texts considered most important or of central signifcance when viewed from the perspective of contemporary literature.

The basis of pulmonary function testing is given for measurement of lung volumes and flows, airways resistance, lung diffusing capacity, ventilation-perfusion relationship and noninvasive monitoring of airway inflammation by analysis of exhaled breath condensate.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab põhjalikud teadmised kromatograafias ja massispektromeetrias. Kursus koosneb loengutest, seminaridest ja praktilistest töödest. Käsitlusele tulevad teemad hõlmavad: 
1. Kromatograafia põhialused. Kromatograafiline protsess, selle matemaatiline modelleerimine.
2. Vedelkromatograafia meetodid: statsionaarsed faasid (RP, NP, IE jne), mobiilsed faasid, seadmed, detektorid, praktilised rakendused. 
3. Meetodi väljatöötamine vedelikkromatograafias. 
4. Massispektromeetria - ionisatsiooniallikad, kõrge ja madala resolutsiooniga massianalüsaatorid. 
5. Massispektromeetrite kui vedelikkromatograafia detektorite eripära (ionisatsiooni efektiivsus, maatriksifektid). 6. Praktilised aspektid: proovi ettevalmistamine. 
7. Kõrglahutusega massispektromeetria ja isotoopide suhte massispektromeetria.
kirjeldus_en:
Advanced course in chromatography and mass spectrometry. The course contains lectures, seminars and practical works. The topics covered include: 
1. General topics of chromatography. The chromatographic process, its mathematical modeling.
2. Liquid chromatography methods: stationary phases (RP, NP, IE, etc), mobile phases, equipment, detectors, practical applications. 
3. Method development in liquid chromatography. 
4. Mass spectrometry - ionization sources, high and low resolution mass analyzers. 
5. Specifics of mass spectrometers as liquid chromatography detectors (ionization efficiency, matrix effects). 
6. Practical aspects: sample preparation. 
7. High-resolution mass spectrometry and isotope ratio mass spectrometry.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who successfully passed the course is fluent in the following aspects of Liquid Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry:
- 1. General topics of chromatography. The chromatographic process, its mathematical modelling.
- 2. Liquid chromatography methods: stationary phases (RP, NP, IE, etc.), mobile phases, equipment, detectors, practical applications.
- 3. Method development in liquid chromatography.
- 4. Mass spectrometry - ionization sources, high and low resolution mass analyzers.
- 5. Specifics of mass spectrometers as liquid chromatography detectors (ionization efficiency, matrix effects).
- 6. Practical aspects: sample preparation.
- 7. High-resolution mass spectrometry and isotope ratio mass spectrometry.

Every question has been assigned a weight and they will be separately evaluated using a ten-point system. For estimation of knowledge of concepts their understanding, ability of construction of conclusions and knowledge of the facts is considered. The resulting scores are summed (using the weights) and the sum is normalized to 100.

kirjeldus_en: The scope of this course covers the presentation of foundational principles and concepts central to succession law; intestate succession, inheritance under will, and inheritance by contract, under both Estonian law as well as the succession laws and institutions of other European countries. The course will also explore the actual process of effecting succession, and the practice of notaries and the courts in implementing the law
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- - understand the basic principles of succession law and the foundations of different systems involving succession and inheritance.
- be capable of independently finding necessary texts or other information and analyzing same.
- be able to explain his/her viewpoint on issues related to succession law, and critically assess the viewpoints of others.
- be capable of resolving cases implicating succession issues, and critically evaluating the role of notaries and the courts in succession matters.
- be competent to utilize the skills and knowledge acquired in this course in further studies and related work.

kirjeldus_et: Käsitletakse majanduspoliitika eesmärke ja vahendeid teooria erinevate suundade seisukohalt. Normatiivse lähenemise raames tuginetakse turutõrgete teooriale ja otsitakse vastust küsimusele - kuidas peaks majanduspoliitikat ühiskonna huvides tegema. Positivistlikku suunda käsitletakse poliitika majandusliku teooria (Public Choice) alusel, mis otsib vastust küsimusele - kuidas majanduspoliitikat tegelikult tehakse. Käsitletakse ka nn demokraatliku majanduspoliitika teooriat, mis püüab integreerida positivistlikku ja normatiivset suunda ning avada teadusliku poliitikanõustamise probleeme ja võimalusi.
kirjeldus_en: Objectives and instruments of economic policy are considered from different theory approaches. In the framework of normative theory there are based on the theory of market failures and searched answer for the question: how should be economic policy done in favor of society's interests. Positive approach is treated on the base of Public Choice Theory, which searches answer for the question: how is economic policy done in reality. Also there will be considered the theory of democratic economic policy, which tries to integrate normative and positive approach and open opportunities and problems of scientific policy advisory.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students manage to distinguish between practice and theory of economic policy and its main domains, including micro and macro level of economic policy, order, structural and process policy and normative and positive economic policy theory approach;  they know possible objectives of economic policy and problems of connection and choice between them; know main financial and legal instruments of economic policy, including role of public sector; can differentiate between market failures and possible welfare losses caused by them and know economic policy remedies against those welfare losses; understand reasons and consequences of state failures; can evaluate static and dynamic effectiveness of economic policy measures; can explain real economic policy as the result of cooperation action of policy subjects and connect problem of state failure with public and political institutions.

Sellel kursusel käsitletakse selliseid teemasid nagu videomängude eluiga ja neid mõjutavad tegurid, turustamine, mängude žanrid, riistvara, dematerialiseerimine ja muud. Kursusel käsitletakse konsooli-, arvuti-, virtuaalreaalsust ja mobiilimänge - nende arengut, riistvara, uuendusi ja näiteid.
kirjeldus_en: This course is an introduction to video game evolution, where the students will get insight into different aspects of video game growth and changes throughout history. Topics, such as video game lifespan and its affecting factors, commercialization, marketing, game genres, hardware, dematerialization and others will be covered during this course. The course looks into console, computer, virtual reality and mobile games - their evolution, hardware, innovations and examples.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing this course, the student:
- * Has acquired solid understanding about video games and their design, which can motivate them to further delve into the game development field.
- * Can pinpoint the exact events that led to changes in modern video games and their business.
- * Is familiar with important historical video game hardware and technologies.
- * Knows about, can explain, analyze and discuss influential changes and key events in the evolution of video games, their design, game controllers, market and business practices.

kirjeldus_et:
Aines kaetakse järgmiseid teemasid: 
- klientide probleemide avastamine
- toote või teenuse väärtuspakkumise defineerimine
- väärtuspakkumise valideerimine
- tootevisiooni põhjal algse prototüübi loomine
- klientide ligi meelitamine ning nõudluse tekitamine
- ärimudeli loomine ja täpsustamine
kirjeldus_en:
The course covers the following topics:
- Discovering new ideas and problems
- Defining a problem as a "value proposition" for a product/service
- Developing the value proposition and translating into a product-service vision
- Attracting customers and creating demand with your initial prototype 
- Market-testing and articulating a business model
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of this course, a student will be able to:
- 1.	Discovering new ideas and problems, synthesising and to analyzing a problem, eventually solving the problem  by means of a software product or service.
- 2.	2.	Explain why the new ideas and problem fit in with earlier problems and solutions, or not
- 3.	Imagine and articulate how the identified problem can be solved with a new software product or service
- 4.	Define who are the potential users and customers of the  new software product or service
- 5.	Formulate and validate the product /service vision and a business model
- 6.	Translate the vision into an initial prototype using an agile development method
- 7.	Apply a "customer development framework" to incrementally refine an initial product or service
- 8. Market-test the  business model to improve upon how to take into account requirements of suppliers and other partners.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
Students will meet for seminars and achieve the following milestones:
1. Define an initial "value proposition" of a software product or service
2. Develop a prototype of the envisioned product/service
3. Provide evidence that the initial prototype has been validated with prospective customers and that customer feedback has been documented and taken into account
4. Define a business plan for the product
Each milestone will be given a grade by the seminar coordinator based on the milestone's deliverables and an oral presentation. The points accumulated from the milestones will add up to a score between 0 and 100. This score will be translated into a grade between A and F using the standard university scale.
To pass the course, the student must score at least 51 points.

Reflections and milestones will be given points. The points accumulated from the milestones will add up to a score between 0 and 100. This score will be translated into a grade between A and F using the standard university scale.
To pass the course, the student must score at least 51 points.

Arutletakse kunsti, võimu ja religiooni suhete üle, vaadeldakse erinevate seisuste eneserepresentatsiooni võimalusi ja vahendeid. Arendatakse visuaalsete allikate kriitilise tõlgendamise oskusi.
kirjeldus_en: The course presents an in-depth analysis of Estonian art and architecture from ca 1525 to ca 1750. The students will learn to recognize different types of sacral and secular buildings and artworks as well as the works of most important master artisans. They will learn about the connections between art, power and religion. The course develops a critical use of visual sources.

Antakse lihtsustatud ülevaade vajalikest matemaatilisest tööriistadest ja lineaarsete süsteemide kirjeldamisest olekuvõrrandite abil; käsitletakse stabiilsust, jälgitavust ja juhitavust. kirjeldus_en: The course gives an introductory theoretical and practical knowledge about behavior, modeling, and characterization of dynamic systems. Simplified overview of the required mathematical tools is covered. The characterization methods of linear systems (state-space equations, transfer functions) are studied; stability, observability and controllability are discussed. Theory and practice of control methods (for example PID control) are studied. Students will learn to analyze simpler control systems in practice. Familiarization with Kalman filtering.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course successfully, the student will
- *	have an overview and be able to describe dynamic systems behavior
- *	know the common principles of modern control systems
- *	be able to use software for simulation of control systems
- *	be able to create, analyze and tune PID control systems
- * is familiar with state space models, adding feedback and controlling them
- * knows the main principles of Kalman filtering and has applied in a laboratory setting

Õpitakse tundma üksikuid asjaõigusi nagu omand, servituudid, reaalkoormatised, hoonestusõigus, ostueesõigus ja pandiõigused. Õppetöö käigus õpitakse tundma valdkonna kohtupraktika põhimõttelise tähtsusega lahendeid. Ainekursuse raames omandatakse kaasuste lahendamise metoodika.
kirjeldus_en: Within the course in property law the general principles of real rights, as well as differences between real rights in movables and real rights in immovable property are dealt with. Students are further taught individual real rights such as right of ownership, servitudes, real encumbrances, right of superficies, right of pre-emption and right of security. In the course of the studies the cases of principal importance are learned. Within the frames of the course the methodology of solving case analyses is acquired.
opitulemused_en:
- Students successfully completing this course should be able to:
- - explain the nature and essence of institutions and principles  central to property law and their relation to other parts of  private law.
- - understand overall relationships between laws pertaining to property, personal property, and real property, and their application.
- - apply the norms and concepts of property law to resolution of disputes before various institutions (and arriving at the correct legal conclusion).
- - access and utilize relevant scholarly publications and court precedents in the  resolution of presented cases.
- - employ several methods for construing the content and public policy goals of various provisions of property law.
- - prepare reasoned analysis and proposed solutions to cases presented in the classroom and resolved pursuant to the methodology provided.

kirjeldus_en: The Course gives the students basic knowledge on different aspects of clinical infectious diseases, including diagnostics, treatment and prophylaxis together with elementary skills to handle patients with major infectious syndromes.
opitulemused_en:
- After the Course the student:
- 1. Knows biological etiological factors leading to pathological processes and their mechanisms of development.
- 2. Knows functional changes of the organism and their manifestations during infectious diseases.
- 3. Knows main possibilities of examination of infectious patient and diagnosis of infectious disease.
- 4. Knows principles of antibiotic treatment and immunopropylaxis.
- 5. Knows epidemiology of infectious diseases, risk factors and their management.
- 6. Is able to take history of infectious diseases.
- 7. Is able to examine the infectious patient, choose optimal diagnostic methods.
- 8. Is able to interpret the results of main diagnostic methods.
- 9. Is able to plan treatment strategies for major infectious syndromes.

kirjeldus_en: The course comprises direct practice of applied sport and performance psychology. Practical experience is gained by working under supervision of a professional sport psychologist in the areas of performance enhancement,  performance restoration, psychoeducational or exercise psychology.

opitulemused_en:
- Students will be able to
- 1. develop a professional relationship with a client
- 2. involve client's significant others in sport- and performance psychology interventions
- 3. use appropriate psychological assessment methods in sport and performance context, and identify client's intervention needs
- 4. formulate client's psychological difficulties, challenges, and resources
- 5. plan a sport or performance psychological intervention based on client's needs and results of psychological assessment
- 6. conduct an individual sport or performance psychological intervention, including intervention assessment
- 7. conduct a psychoeducational group intervention in the context of sport or performance psychology, including intervention assessment
- 8. describe guidelines, regulations and laws governing the work of a sport and performance psychologist

Iga loengu aluseks on üks või kaks eesti või maailmakirjanduse klassikasse kuuluvat teost, millele toetudes antakse ülevaade valitud teema käsitlusviisidest, kultuurilisest tähtsusest  ning teema vahendamise narratiivsetest, tropoloogilistest ja žanrilistest omapäradest. Küsitakse, miks üks või teine teema kerkib esile just sel ajajärgul ja miks mõni teine samal ajal kaob? Miks osutub mõni teema antud antud hetkel (või konkreetse kirjaniku jaoks) aktuaalseks ja kuidas kirjanduses käsitletakse ühiskonnaelu keskseid teemasid?
kirjeldus_en: The course focuses on a selection of central themes in world literature and Estonian literature (such as, e.g., art, beauty, nature, the quest, family, love, woman, illness, the fool etc.). Each theme is introduced with the help of one one work of world literature of Estonian literature.

Analüüsitakse erinevate keemiliste elementide ja ühendite leviku- ja migratsioonimehhanisme looduslikes protsessides, tutvustatakse isotoopgeokeemia aluseid ning isotoopdateerimise meetodeid geoloogias. kirjeldus_en: The geochemical nature of geological processes and the behavior of chemical elements in these processes are explained. Mechanisms of the distribution and migration of various chemical elements and compounds in natural processes are analyzed. The course introduces the basics of isotope geochemistry and methods of isotope dating in geology. The theoretical and practical parts of the course provide the necessary knowledge and skills needed for professional geological work.

kirjeldus_en: During the course the goals and terminology of pharmacology, the main mechanisms of pharmacokinetics, drug absorption, distribution, biotransformation and excretion are explained. The mechanisms, connected with the response to drugs, pharmacodynamis, pharmacokinetics, principles of therapeutic use and side-effects of the main groups of drugs are explained. Also the dangerous side-effects of drugs and allergic reactions are taught.

Student knows pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, adverse effects, and indications the main medicines. Student knows the medicines acting on the vegetative nervous system, gastrointestinal tract and respiratory system, cardiovascular system, metabolism, central nervous system.

Kultuurikorralduse praktika toimub professionaalses kultuuriorganisatsioonis. Vähemalt 4 (nelja) nädala jooksul peab üliõpilane töötama organisatsioonis, vaatlema ja osalema,  analüüsima kogetut ning võtma osa organisatsiooni igapäevatööst. 
Praktika üldiseks eesmärgiks on rakendada praktikasse üliõpilase poolt omandatud teoreetilisi teadmisi, sh seoses kultuuriorganisatsiooni tegevuse analüüsi ja korraldustööga. 
Korraldustöö praktika sooritamine toimub vastavalt praktika juhendile, mis on leitav õppeaine Moodle keskkonnas. Praktika lõpeb kaitsmisega. Erandkorras võib kaitsmine toimuda ka veebi teel (selle eelduseks on mõjuv põhjus ja kokkulepe õppejõuga). Veebi teel kaitsmise jooksul peab tudeng tagama ühenduse, kus ta osaleb kõnes nii heli kui ka pildiga.
kirjeldus_en:
The 15 EAP practice takes place in a cultural organization. Within at least 4 weeks the students should work in the organization, observe, analyse and take part in organization's everyday work.
The general goal is to put into practice the theoretical knowledge student has gained from curricula so far and use those skills to analyse a cultural organization and its obligations and use the knowledge in real life practice. 
Activities must be planned according to the guidelines (located in Moodle). The course ends with a defence. In exceptional cases the defence can also take place as a video call (if there is a relevant cause and it is permitted by the responsible teacher). In case of a video call, it is obligatory to participate actively, using the audio and video connection.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Passing the course involves implementing theoretical and practical knowledge and skills that are relevant in terms of every-day work of a cultural organisation, including preparing and executing events and activities.
- 2. Student can analyse the role and current situation of the organisation, including business model and other relevant factors.
- 3. As a team member, student has been an active contributor in the process of organising a cultural event, including its main stages: ideation, planning, executing and follow-up activities.

kirjeldus_en:
The course provides an intensive overview of the system of the law of obligations, general principles in the law of obligations, including the bases for obligations, content and performance of obligations, breach and liability for breach of obligations, system of remedies, compensation of damages, personal securities, assignment of obligations, third persons in obligations, plurality of persons in obligations and change of parties.
 In the course of lectures European model laws, CFR and CISG will be touched. Students must have understanding and knowledge in important Supreme Court rulings and EC decisions. Special kind of contracts and extracontractual relations will be not covered.

-	understand the basic principles and main institutes of the law of obligations, 
-	solve simple cases in contract law disputes, 
-	know the relationship between the general and special part of the law of obligations and the specifics of the application of the norms.

Riigiteaduste bakalaureuseõppekava valikmooduli aine. Riigiteaduste bakalaureuseõppekava ja avaliku halduse erialamooduli valinud tudengit  praktika kestus on neli nädalat. Praktikat võib sooritada nii keskvalitsuse kui kohaliku omavalitsuse asutustes. Kokkuleppel praktika ülikoolipoolse juhendajaga võib praktikat sooritada erandkorras ka mitteriiklikes organisatsioonides, rahvusvahelistes organisatsioonides või diplomaatilistes esindustes. Välismaal läbitav praktika kuulub arvestamisele samade kriteeriumide järgi. Praktikana läheb arvesse täiskohaga töötamine, 8 tundi päevas, 5 päeva nädalas. Organisatsioonipoolne juhendaja vastutab praktika sisulise poole eest ning temal palutakse täita pärast praktika lõppu hindamisleht. Hindamisleht asub Skytte instituudi kodulehel http://skytte.ut.ee/et/oppimine/praktika-7. Hindamislehe edastamise eest praktika organisatsioonipoolsele juhendajale vastutab praktikant. 

Enne praktikale minekut peab praktikant teavitama ülikoolipoolset juhendajat praktika toimumise kohast, praktika juhendajast, praktikandi töökohustustest ning praktika kestvusest. Ülikoolipoolseks juhendajaks on üldjuhul vastava õppekava programmijuht. Tema käest saab üliõpilane soovi korral ka ülikoolipoolse soovituskirja. Iga üliõpilane vastutab praktikakoha leidmise eest ise.

Internship can take place at state institution or at local government. Internship in non-governmental, international or diplomatic institutions requires an agreement from supervisor from Skytte institute.

kirjeldus_et: Kursuses antakse alusteadmised klassikalisest ja molekulaargeneetikast.Kursus algab ülevaaega geneetika kui teaduse kujunemisest ja geneetika tänapäevastest rakendustest; samuti käsitletakse geneetilise materjali pärandumist rakutasemel. Järgneb klassikalise geneetika osa, kus käsitletakse pärilikkuse üldprintsiipe (Mendeli seadused), medelismi edasiarendusi, kromosoome kui pärilikkuse kandjaid ning Mendeli seadusi lähtudes kromosoomiteooriast, erinevusi kromosoomide arvus ja struktuuris, geenide aheldumist, ristsiiret ning klassikalisi kromosoomide kaardistamise meetodeid eukarüootidel. Käsitletakse ka kvantitatiivsete tunnuste pärandumise põhimõtteid. Ainekursuse molekulaargeneetika osas käsitletakse DNA ja kromosoomide struktuuri ja antakse alusteadmised sellistest rakulistest põhiprotsessidest nagu DNA replikatsioon, transkriptsioon, translatsioon ja mutatsioonide teke.
kirjeldus_en: The subject gives basic knowledge in classical genetics and core concepts of  molecular genetics. At the beginning of the course the science of genetics and its applications and basic features of cellular reproduction are introduced. The next part of the course deals with concepts of classical genetics such as the basic principles of inheritance (Mendel's principles), extensions of mendelism, the chromosomal basis of Mendelism, variation in chromosome number and structure, and linkage, crossing over and chromosome mapping in eukaryotes. Additionally, the concept of quantitative genetics is introduced. The topics of molecular genetics cover  structure of DNA and chromosomes and basic cellular processes including DNA replication, transcription, translation, and mutation.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, the students are expected:
- To acquire basic knowledge in genetics.
- To be able to use the acquired knowledge and skills in other disciplines in biology.
- To understand principles of cellular reproduction of living organisms.
- To be able to analyze, using the Estonian language, orally and in writing the problems related to genetics and participate in relevant discussions.

kirjeldus_en: The presentation gives an overview of legal framework on measurements (Metrology Act with supportive legislation) and legal acts implementation of which is based on measurements (various normative limits, requested values etc). The presentation addresses also connections with the respective EU legislative acts and possibilities for assurance of reliability of measurements and analyses (assessment of competence of measurers, interlaboratory comparisons).
opitulemused_en:
- Student has systemic understanding of: 
-- interrelations between measurements and legislation (especially EU legislation). 
-- legal and technical measures for ensuring reliability of measurement results. 
-- trends in legislation related to measurements (new monitored substances, lower detection limits, etc.) 
Student is able 
-- explain the main concepts of metrology, legal metrology, law and legal systems.
-- describe the infrastructure and main documents related to measurement system.
-- in real life situations identify the aspects related to measurements and law and apply the
knowledge learned on the course to take a correct action in these situations.
-- describe the metrology system of your home country and distinguish differences between
different metrology systems.
-- design and create a presentation for your knowledge or scientific work in a clear and
 efficient manner.

kirjeldus_et:
Ainekava jaguneb kolmeks mooduliks.
1. Erialane eesti keel: suulise ja kirjaliku teksti eripära; erialakeel; infootsing; erialateksti lugemine
2. Akadeemiline tekst: kirjutamisprotsessi kavandamine (eeltöö, kavand, mustand, tagasiside, puhtand); akadeemilise teksti lugemine; refereerimine ja tsiteerimine, viitamine ja viitehaldus, teksti viimistlemine (lõigu ülesehitus, lausestus, sõnavalik)
3. Akadeemiline ettekanne: slaidiesitluse või vaatmiku kavandamine, koostamine ja esitamine

Moodulite sisu kohandatakse õpetatava rühma järgi.

Õppetöö hõlmab nii individuaalset kui ka rühmatööd, mille käigus annab üliõpilane kaasõppijatele tagasisidet ja teeb saadud tagasiside põhjal oma tekstis muudatusi.
kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of three modules:
1. Estonian for special purposes: characteristics of spoken and written text; specialty language; information retrieval; reading specialty texts
2. Academic text: planning the writing process (preparation, outline, rough draft, feedback, final draft); reading academic texts; summarizing and citing, referencing and reference management, revising the text (structure of the paragraph, phrasing, word choice)
3. Academic presentation: designing, compiling and presenting a slide show or a poster. 

The content of the modules is customized according to the study group.

The course includes individual and group work, during which students give feedback to their partners and make changes in their texts based on the feedback received.

opitulemused_en:

- * understands the principles of naming of organic compounds and is able to apply them,

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab põhjaliku ülevaate kolmest põhilisest geneetilise informatsiooni ülekande protsessist: replikatsioon, transkriptsioon ning translatsioon. 
Käsitletavad teemad: makromolekulide (nukleiinhapped ja valgu) ruumilist struktuuri määravad tegurid, nukleiinhappe sünteesi mehhanism, replikatsioonil osalevad valgud, replikatsiooni alustamine ja lõpetamine, transkriptsiooni toimumine ja regulatsioon bakterites, transkriptsiooni toimumine ja regulatsioon eukarüootides, RNA protsessimine, geneetiline kood, valgu biosünteesi pre-ribosomaalne etapp, valgu biosünteesi ribosomaalne etapp bakterites ja eukarüootides, regulatsioon translatsiooni tasemel, regulatoorsed RNA molekulid.
Lisaks antakse ülevaade põhilistest molekulaarbioloogias kasutatavatest meetoditest.
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides a comprehensive overview of the three main processes of genetic information transfer: replication, transcription, and translation. 
Topics covered include factors that determine the structure of macromolecules (nucleic acids and proteins); the mechanism of nucleic acid synthesis; proteins involved in replication; the initiation and termination of replication; transcription and its regulation in bacteria; transcription and its regulation in eukaryotes; RNA processing; the genetic code; the pre-ribosomal stage of protein biosynthesis; the ribosomal stage of protein biosynthesis in bacteria and eukaryotes; regulation at the translation level; and regulatory RNA molecules. 
In addition, the course provides an overview of basic methods used in molecular biology.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, the student will:
- - understand the three basic processes of genetic information transfer: replication, transcription, and translation
- - explain the relationships between the structure and function of macromolecules (nucleic acids, proteins)
- - describe how gene expression is regulated at the transcriptional and post-transcriptional level
- - be familiar with the basic methods used in molecular biology and understands how these methods work
- - be able to use correctly the terminology in Estonian

Käesolev kursus aitab doktorandil kujundada nii teoreetilisi teadmisi kui ka praktilisi oskusi, mida alustav ettevõtja vajab uute ideede elluviimiseks või kuidas uued ideed jõuavad tegutsevasse ettevõttesse või avalikku sektorisse. Kursus on suunatud doktorantidele erinevatel erialadel, alates infotehnoloogiast, füüsikast, keemiast, bioloogiast, meditsiinist kuni kunstide, filoloogia, filosoofia, ajaloo, semiootika ja sotsiaalteadusteni. Doktorantidel on võimalus teha koostööd teiste erialade tudengite ja teadlastega.
Kursuse läbimiseks on erinevaid võimalusi:
1. Osaledes kogu auditoorses töös, sh sTARTUp Lab-i (Ideelabori) (praktikumi) üritustel, läbides õppematerjali ning ja tehes kodutöö (moodles) üksi või meeskonnaga.
2. Osaledes auditoorses töös, sh iseseisvalt (konsulteerides õppejõuga) läbides õppematerjali ning arendades oma äriideed, ja tehes kodutöö (praktikumi) moodles üksi või meeskonnaga.
3. Osaledes (võimalik osaliselt) auditoorses töös või e-õppena, sh iseseisvalt (konsulteerides õppejõuga) läbides õppematerjali ning arendades oma äriideed, ja tehes kodutöö (praktikumi) moodles üksi või meeskonnaga.
Kursus on üles ehitatud kahe-osalisena (kumbki osa 3 EAP):
1. Kursuse esimene sisaldab sissejuhatust ettevõtlusse ja äriidee ja -võimaluste hindamisse. Juhtumi-uuringuks kogutav info aitab arendada oma äriideed, kaardistada ja analüüsida valdkonda. 
2. Õppuri äriideel ja teadmusvaldkonnal põhineva äriplaani ja/või ettevõtlusvõimalus(t)e hindamise projekt. Ettevõtlusvõimaluse hindamise projekti edasiarenduseks, aga ka erivormiks, nt teadusprojektile, on teostatavus-tasuvus-analüüsi (TTA) projekt.
Moodles on kättesaadavad, lisaks õpimaterjalidele, videoloengud ja illustreeriv materjal, ettevõtjate esinemised ja intervjuud ettevõtjatega videosalvestiste näol.
kirjeldus_en:
This course helps the doctoral student develop both the theoretical knowledge and the practical skills needed by a startup entrepreneur to implement new ideas or how new ideas reach the operating company or the public sector. The course is aimed at doctoral students in a variety of disciplines, ranging from information technology, physics, chemistry, biology, medicine to the arts, philology, philosophy, history, semiotics, and social sciences. Doctoral students have the opportunity to collaborate with students and researchers from other disciplines.
There are different ways to take the course:
1. Participating in all classroom work, including sTARTUp Lab (Practice Lab) events, completing tutorials, and doing homework alone or with a team.
2. Participating in classroom work, including independently (in consultation with a lecturer), completing study material and developing student's own business idea, and doing homework (practicum) by designing alone or with a team.
3. Participating (possibly partially) in classroom work or e-learning, including independently (in consultation with a lecturer), completing study material and developing one's own business idea, and doing homework (practicum) by designing alone or with a team.
The course is structured in two parts (3 ECTS each):
1. In the first part of the course, a student will get an introduction to entrepreneurship and an assessment of the business idea and opportunity. The information collected for the case study will help to develop own business idea, map and analyze the field.
2. Project to evaluate the business idea (plan) and / or business opportunity(ies) based on own business idea and knowledge. A feasibility study is a further development of the business opportunity project, but also a specific form, such as a research project.
In addition to study materials, video lectures and illustrations, business presentations and interviews with entrepreneurs in the form of video recordings are available at Moodle.
opitulemused_en:
- A. KNOWLEDGE, the students get:
- Understanding of specific features and challenges of the knowledge-based entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial process, the role of knowledge in the entrepreneurial process.
- Overview of the knowledge-based entrepreneurship in Estonia and worldwide, trends on market. Business opportunities in Estonia and globally.
- Understanding of processes of launching knowledge.based startup, specific aspects of management and support processes, strategic options and growth paths.
- B. SPECIAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCES, the student:
- Understands basic concepts and terminology of the knowledg-based business sector.
- C. KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCES, the student:
- Can analyze and shape knowledge-based entrepreneurial process, and strategy and business models for knowledge-based companies.
