"Kosmosesüsteemid" on jätkukursus ainele LOTI.05.071 "Kosmosetehnoloogia alused", ning pakub tehniliselt veidi sügavamat ülevaadet satelliidi alamsüsteemidest ning nende tööpõhimõtetest.

Kursus on jagatud loenguteks ning seminarideks. Loengud annavad ülevaate satelliidi süsteemide arendamisest, kosmosekeskkonnast, orbiitidest, struktuuri arendamisest, soojusregulatsioonist, elektrilistest toitesüsteemidest, sidesüsteemidest, satelliidi asendi määramisest ja juhtimisest ning pardaarvutitest.

Seminarides lahendame satelliitide alamsüsteemide arendamisega seotud ülesandeid:
1. nõuete tuletamine satelliidi alamsüsteemidele, disainikriteeriumite leidmine ning disainiparameetrite varu arvestamine,
2. lihtsa pardaarvuti arhitektuuri arendamine ja selle plokk-diagrammil kujutamine,
3. lihtsa Kalman filtri ning PID kontrolleri implementeerimine,
4. soojusregulatsiooni planeerimine satelliidi alamsüsteemile,
kirjeldus_en:
This course is continuation of the LOTI.05.071 "Introduction to Space Technology", providing a technically more thorough overview of spacecraft subsystems and their working principles.

The course consists of lectures and seminars. The lectures will provide an overview of spacecraft systems engineering, space environment, orbits, structure design, thermal control, electrical power systems, communication systems, attitude determination, attitude control and on-board computer systems.

In seminars we will tackle the following problems related to spacecraft subsystem development:
1. deriving requirements, margins for an example mission,
2. designing the architecture of a spacecraft on-board computer and drawing its block diagram,
3. implementing a simple Kalman filter and PID controller,
4. planning the thermal control of a spacecraft system,
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of this course the participants will:
- 1. have an overview of the mission phases and subsystems of a typical spacecraft,
- 2. have an overview of spacecraft system design,
- 3. have an overview of various effects of the space environment on spacecraft systems,
- 4. know the basic effects of radiation on electronics and software,
- 5. have an overview of various orbits and orbital parameters,
- 6. have an overview of the principles of spacecraft structure design, implementation and limitations,
- 7. have an overview of how vibration and shock affect spacecraft systems, as well as testing procedures,
- 8. have an overview of the thermal properties of materials most commonly used in spacecraft,
- 9. have an overview of thermal control methods applicable to spacecraft and the limitations of these methods,
- 10. have an overview of spacecraft electrical power systems and power distribution,
- 11. have an overview of spacecraft communication systems,
- 12. know the terms: SNR, CW, FSK, PSK, thermal noise,
- 13. know what is spacecraft attitude and how to calculate it,
- 14. have an overview of spacecraft sensors for attitude determination sensors and actuators for attitude control,
- 15. be able to enumerate and describe the basic functionality of a spacecraft on-board computer,
- 16. have an overview of basic redundancy schemes (hot, cold, TMR) and why they are used.

kirjeldus_et:
Loomuuringute eetika on loodus- ja meditsiiniteaduste üheks nurgakiviks ja ilma sellealaste teadmisteta jääb ülikoolist saadav haridus selgelt poolikuks. Loomuuringute eetika on üks neist kriitilistest teemadest, mis on muutumas järjest aktuaalsemaks ja millega pea iga loodus- või meditsiiniuuringutega tegelev inimene oma erialases töös varem või hiljem kokku puutub. Loomade uurimise meetodite suhtes on erinevaid eetilisi seisukohti, kuid üldjuhul neist ei räägita. Seetõttu puudub üliõpilasel võimalus kaalutletud otsuseks, kas kasutada loomuuringutel meetodeid, mis eeldavad loomade tapmist (paraku üsna levinud praktika) või valida hoopis sellised meetodid, mis loomade tapmist ei nõua. Tegemist väga põhimõttelise otsusega, mis nõuab vastava temaatika head tundmist. Kuna üliõpilasel tuleb juba stuudiumi varases staadiumis teha oma valik, millise töörühmaga liituda ja milline uurimisteema valida, siis oleks hea, kui iga loodus- ja meditsiiniteaduste üliõpilane  omandaks võimalikult varakult vajalikud teadmised loomuuringute eetikast. Kursuse käigus tutvustatakse loomuuringute eetika sõlmprobleeme ja erinevaid meetodeid, mis võimaldavad loomuuringuid läbi viia ilma loomi tapmata - selliste meetodite hulk on viimastel aastatel oluliselt kasvanud ja nendega on võimalik asendada paljusid vanu meetodeid, mis on oma nii teaduslikust kui eetilisest seisukohast ära elanud. Kursusel omandatud teadmiste põhjal saab iga üliõpilane kujundada oma seisukoha ning vastavalt sellele teha oma valikud, milline uurimisteema ja meetodid valida. 
Loomuuringute eetika kursus annab vajalikud baasteadmised, mille põhjal üliõpilane saab teha kaalutletud otsuse, mis pikas perspektiivis on igaühe jaoks äärmiselt oluline. 
Kursuse temaatika on põnev, praktiline ja arendav. Ja seda mitte ainult erialast haridust silmas pidades, vaid ka igaühe üldist vaimset arenguteed.
kirjeldus_en: The ethics of animal research is one of the cornerstones of natural and medical sciences, and without this knowledge, the education received in the university remains incomplete. This statement is not an exaggeration and animal research ethics is one of those critical topics that almost every person involved in natural or medical sciences comes into contact in his later professional work. There exist a number of different ethical positions about the methods used in animal research and a student should know these in order to make a well-considered decision whether to use methods for animal studies that require slaughter of animals (still a rather common practice) or to choose methods that do not require such cruelty. This is crucial. During the course, the core issues in animal research ethics and various methods that allow animal studies to be carried out without killing animals are introduced. The number of such methods has grown considerably in recent years and can replace many cruel methods. Based on the knowledge gained from the course, each student can formulate his or her own position and make a choice, which methods to use. Thus, the course on animal research provides the necessary background knowledge on which the student can make a well-considered decision.
opitulemused_en: - A student who has completed the course: 1) has acquired basic knowledge of animal research ethics; 2) knows a variety of methods that allow for animal studies to be carried out without the killing of animals, i.e. using alternative approaches; 3) can formulate an opinion on the methods used in animal research, can critically evaluate different methods and is open to novel approaches

kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of the principles of defining culture (culture and environment, culture and another culture, culture and society, culture and thinking, culture and communication). The students are given an overview of disciplines that analyze culture (cultural anthropology, cultural studies, cultural semiotics, cultural psychology, cultural sociology, cultural philosophy). Students are thought to distinguish between disciplinary, inter- and transdisciplinary notions. Key concepts of cultural research (language, communication, memory, identity, dynamics, text etc.) are thought via rich variety of examples.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus tugineb Myersi ja Twenge õpikule Social Psychology pakkudes põhjalikku ülevaadet sotsiaalpsühholoogia olulisematest teemadest ja rakendustest. Kursuse eesmärk on uurida, kuidas sotsiaalne mõjutamine kujundab inimeste mõtteid, tundeid ja käitumist, aidates mõista ühiskondlikke ja isiklikke protsesse mitmel tasandil. Õppetöö keskendub sellele, kuidas inimesed tajuvad ja tõlgendavad sotsiaalset reaalsust ning millist rolli mängivad sotsiaalsed normid ja grupid meie igapäevaelus.

Kursuse teemade hulka kuulub sotsiaalne tunnetus, mis käsitleb viise, kuidas inimesed töötlevad ja salvestavad sotsiaalset teavet, sealhulgas stereotüüpe ja heuristikaid. Samuti uuritakse sotsiaalset mõjutamist, keskendudes võimu ja konformismi mõjudele ning grupimõtlemise rollile otsuste tegemisel. Suurt rõhku pannakse suhtumiste ja nende muutumise teooriatele, sealhulgas veenmise mehhanismidele ja kognitiivsele dissonantsile.

Lisaks käsitletakse eelarvamuste ja diskrimineerimise allikaid, uurides, kuidas sotsiaalsed normid ja stereotüübid kujundavad inimeste vaateid ja kuidas nende mõju vähendada. Kursus hõlmab ka inimestevaheliste suhete psühholoogiat, pöörates tähelepanu armastusele, altruismile ja agressioonile, ning uurib grupiprotsesse, sealhulgas koostööd ja konflikte.

Õppetöö keskendub sotsiaalpsühholoogia praktilistele rakendustele, rõhutades selle olulisust erinevates valdkondades, nagu tervis, haridus ja õigussüsteem. Läbi teaduspõhise lähenemise saavad üliõpilased väärtuslikud teadmised ja oskused, mis aitavad mõista ja lahendada kaasaegseid ühiskondlikke väljakutseid.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is based on Social Psychology by Myers and Twenge, providing an in-depth overview of key topics and applications in social psychology. It explores how social influence shapes people's thoughts, feelings, and behaviors, offering insights into societal and personal processes at multiple levels. The course emphasizes understanding how individuals perceive and interpret social reality, as well as the role of social norms and group dynamics in daily life.

Topics include social cognition, which examines how people process and store social information, including stereotypes and heuristics. Social influence is another major focus, highlighting the effects of power, conformity, and groupthink on decision-making. Attitudes and their change are studied through theories of persuasion and cognitive dissonance.

The course also delves into the origins of prejudice and discrimination, exploring how social norms and stereotypes shape perspectives and how their impact can be mitigated. It covers interpersonal relationship dynamics, including love, altruism, and aggression, and examines group processes such as collaboration and conflict.

The practical applications of social psychology are emphasized throughout the course, with attention to its relevance in fields such as health, education, and the legal system. By adopting an evidence-based approach, students gain valuable knowledge and skills to understand and address modern societal challenges.
opitulemused_en:
- We are inherently social human beings. This course provides a scientific approach to studying how we affect people, and how we are affected by people around us. Key objectives are:
- 1) Identify and understand the major theories, principles, and research findings in the field of social psychology.
- 2) Define basic scientific methods used in social psychological research.
- 3) Apply social psychological theories and principles to real life experiences, both in one's own life and in a broader social context.
- 4) Critically evaluate social psychological theories and research.
- 5) Write clearly and logically, being able to explain one's position on a variety of social psychology issues.

kirjeldus_et:
Aine annab ülevaate näo-lõualuude piirkonna kirurgilistest haigustest lastel. Üliõpilane omandab teadmised laste puhul läbiviidavast lokaal- ja üldanesteesiast, põletikulistest haigustest näo-lõualuude piirkonnas, hammaste eemaldamise näidustustest ja vastunäidustustest, lümfadeniidi kliinilistest sümptoomidest, ravist ja differentsiaaldiagnostikast. Laste trauma osas käsitletakse hammaste ja lõualuude murde, diagnoosimist ja ravimeetodeid. Kaasasündinud näo-lõualuude anomaaliate korral käsitletakse huule-suulaelõhede etioloogiat, patogeneesi, sümptomatoloogiat, kompleksraviplaani tegemist ning kirurgilise ravi erinevaid meetodeid. Käsitletakse kaasasündinud branhiogeense-, türeoglossaalse tsüsti ja fistli, dermoidtsüsti, lümf- ja hemangioomi etiopatogeneesi, diagnostika ja ravimeetodeid.
Praktikumid viiakse läbi Stomatoloogia kliiniku näo-lõualuudekirurgia osakonnas ja Stomatoloogia kliiniku suukirurgia osakonnas, kus üliõpilased õpivad diagnoosima, raviplaani koostama ja läbi viima lihtsamaid protseduure polikliiniku tingimustes. Üliõpilane koostab ja esitab akadeemilise haigusloo. Üliõpilane teeb iseseisvalt kliinilist tööd, analüüsib igat oma tööd praktikat juhendava õppejõuga, tagasisidestatud protseduurid kannab oma e-portfooliosse.
kirjeldus_en:
Obligatory course deals with the surgical diseases in the oral- and maxillofacial region of children.The student leans local and general anaesthesia in children, odontogenic inflammations in the region of jaws, indications and contraindications of tooth extraction in children, the clinical symptoms of lymphadenitis of lymphnodes in maxillofacial region in children, treatment and differenttial diagnosis.The part of children traumatology consists of injuries of teeth and of the jaws (contusion, luxation, fracture etc.), diagnostic methods and treatment. The part of congenital anomalies in maxillofacial region of children consists of aetiology and patogenesis of cleft lip and palate, symptomatology, planning of complex treatment and different  methods of  surgical treatment. The student learns etiopathogenesis, diagnostics and methods of treatment the congenital branchial and thyreoglossal cysts and fistulas, dermoidcysts, lymph- and haemangiomas. 
Practical works are carried out on the above mentioned topics and they take place in the department of maxillofacial surgery in the hospital and in the department of oral surgery in outpatient clinic of Stomatology. Practical work consists of writing case histories of surgical patients and carring out clinical observation of patients, participation in operations, consultations and practical work with surgical patients in the hospital and outpatient clinic. The clinical work performed by the student has been analyzed with the tutor, the student has received feedback and the work has been included in the student's e-portfolio.
opitulemused_en: - * The students are expected to have a theoretical knowledges of the maxillo-facial region diseases and practical experiences to perform some procedures.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab baasteadmised biofüüsikas ja käsitleb mitmeid eksperimentaalseid meetodeid, mida kasutatakse valitud bioloogiliste protsesside uurimisel. Valgud on bioloogilise evolutsiooni käigus optimeeritud "nanomasinad". Nad on heaks looduslikuks mudeliks kaasaja tehnoloogilistele väljakutsetele reageerimiseks, nagu efektiivne päikeseenergia kogumine ja teiste keskkonnasõbralike energiaallikate kasutamine. Valgu struktuur ja dünaamika on seotud tema bioloogilise funktsiooniga. Kursuses käsitletakse valkude sisestruktuuri ja ülesehitust lähtudes molekulidevahelistest vastastikmõjudest; antakse ülevaade olulisematest biomolekulidega seotud funktsionaalsetest protessidest, sh prootonite pumpamisest bakteriorodopsiinis, elektronergastuste energia ja elektroni siiretest fotosünteetilistes pigment-valgu kompleksides jne; käsitletakse erinevate katseliste uurimismeetodite tööpõhimõtteid ja nende võimalusi biomolekulide struktuuri, dünaamika ja vastastikuste interaktsioonide uurimiseks. Peatähelepanu on pööratud nendele meetoditele, mida Tartu Ülikoolis kas juba rakendatakse või mis on rahvusvahelise koostöö korras meie õpetlastele kättesaadavad, sh: a) neutronite hajumismeetodid (difraktsioon, väikese nurga all hajumine, mitteelastse hajumise spektroskoopia) ja b) laserspektroskoopilised meetodid (kiire ajalise lahutusega neeldumis- ja kiirgusspektroskoopia, kõrge spektraalse lahutusega selektiivspektroskoopia, võnkespektroskoopia, ainumolekuli spektroskoopia). Õpe toimub inglise keeles.
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides a basic knowledge of biophysics and about several experimental techniques used to study selected biological processes. Proteins function as "biological nano-machines", which have been highly optimized during evolution and can thus serve as role models for current technical challenges like efficient harvesting of solar energy or hydrogen production as environmentally friendly fuel. Structures and dynamics of proteins are well-adapted to their biological functions. 
Protein and membrane structure, its building blocks and underlying molecular interactions will be discussed. An overview about important functional processes in biomolecules includes proton pumping in bacteriorhodopsin, excitation energy and electron transfer in photosynthetic pigment-protein complexes. The principles of several experimental techniques applicable to study structure, dynamics as well as electronic interactions in biomolecules will be presented. The main focus is on approaches available at UT and includes: a) neutron scattering methods like diffraction, small angle scattering and inelastic spectroscopy and b) laser spectroscopy like time-resolved absorption and fluorescence, vibrational, site-selective and single molecule spectroscopy. 
The lectures will be held in English.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of this course, the student should be able to:
- 1. Have a basic understanding of biological macromolecules, its building blocks and underlying molecular interactions.
- 2. Know about important functional processes in biomolecules like light-harvesting, excitation energy transfer, electron transfer and proton transfer
- 3. Understand and apply basic models for scattering techniques investigating structure and dynamics of biomolecules.
- 4. Understand principles and applications of spectroscopic methods to study excitation energy transfer and electron transfer

Metroloogia keemias on õppeaine, mis asub analüütilise keemia (keemiliste analüüside) - st ainete koostise (või ühtedes ainetes teiste ainete sisalduse) ja struktuuri määramise teadus - ning metroloogia (mõõtmiste teadus) piiri peal ja mõnevõrra lihtsustatult võib selle aine eesmärgi sõnastada nii: millised meetodid/lähenemisviisid on olemas selleks, et keemiliste analüüside tulemused oleksid "õiged" ja kuidas neid meetodeid kasutada. Aine on väga praktiline ja üritab anda teadmised ja oskused, mis on vahetult laboris kasutatavad. Õppetöö toimub loengute, praktikumide (arvutipraktikumid) ja seminaridena ja päris sageli ka niiöelda "loengpraktikumseminaridena", st sama õppetunni raames esitatakse tudengitele mingi meetod/lähenemisviis, siis võtavad tudengid oma arvutid ja lahendavad (õppejõu juhendamisel) vastava näiteülesande ning seejärel arutatakse ühiselt, mida saadud tulemustest võib järeldada.

Kursus annab teadmised kahes põhilises valdkonnas: 
1. Mõõtmine, mõõtetulemus, mõõtemääramatus keemias (mõõtmiste ja mõõtemääramatuse põhiprintsiibid, ISO GUM ja Nordtest meetodid määramatuse hindamiseks) 
2. Jälgitavus, valideerimine, referentsmaterjalid, laboritevahelised võrdlusmõõtmised
kirjeldus_en:
Metrology in chemistry is a course on the borderline between analytical chemistry (chemical analysis) - ie the determination of the composition (or content of some substances in a given object) and structure - and metrology (measurement science), and in a somewhat simplified way, the purpose of this subject is: which methods/approaches exist to ensure that the results of chemical analyses are "correct" and how to use these methods. The course is very practical and tries to provide knowledge and skills that can be used directly in the laboratory. Teaching takes the form of lectures, practicums (computer practicums) and seminars, and quite often so-called "lecturepracticumseminars", ie in the same session, students are presented a method/approach, then they take their computers and solve (under the guidance of a teacher) a practical example/problem and thereafter follows a discussion on what information can be deduced from the results.

The course gives knowledge and skills (both in theory and in practice) in the following main subject areas: 
1. Measurement, measurement result, measurement uncertainty in chemistry (Basics of measurement, measurement uncertainty, The ISO GUM method of uncertainty estimation, The Nordtest method for uncertainty estimation) 
2. Traceability, validation, reference materials, interlaboratory comparisons (Traceability of measurement results, Traceability in Chemistry, Interlaboratory comparisons, Reference Materials, Validation of analysis procedures)
opitulemused_en:
- The student is fluent - both by theoretical knowledge and practical skills with the main concepts of the following subject areas:
- 1. Measurement, measurement result, measurement uncertainty in chemistry (Basics of measurement, measurement uncertainty, The ISO GUM method of uncertainty estimation, The Nordtest method for uncertainty estimation)
- 2. Traceability, validation, reference materials, interlaboratory comparisons (Traceability of measurement results, Traceability in Chemistry, Interlaboratory comparisons, Reference Materials, Validation of analysis procedures)
- In addition, student:
- -- is able to process the acquired information and present it clearly;
- -- is able to analyse a document or other material and evaluate its accuracy, suitability and relevancy for the intended purpose.
- -- is able to present experimental results in different ways - graphs, diagrams, schemes, etc.
- -- Is able to work according to deadlines and plan his/her work accordingly.
- -- Is able to apply the obtained knowledge in practice.

Tegemist on sissejuhatava kursusega infoturbesse, mis on peamiselt suunatud mitteinformaatikutele. Kursuse eesmärgiks on anda kuulajale ülevaade praktilistest infoturbega seotud probleemidest ja õpetada kuulajat infoturbest lähtuvaid probleeme tuvastama. 

Loengud on jaotatud kolmeks teemaplokiks. Esimene teemaplokk käsitleb enda andmete ja privaatsuse kaitsmist. Teine teemaplokk keskendub avaliku võtme krüptograafiale ning selle rakendustele (TLS, ID-kaart, mobiil-ID, e-hääletamine, blockchain). Kolmas teemaplokk annab ülevaate autentimismeetoditest, erinevat tüüpi rünnetest (kahjurvara klassifikatsioon, küberründed, õngitsusründed, erinevad veebiründed, wifi ründed, mobiilsidevõrkude vastased ründed) ning mõningatest kaitsemeetmetest.
kirjeldus_en:
This is an introductory course that is created for non-IT students. The aim of the course is to give the students an overview of practical information security problems and to teach the students to recognise the problems / threats related with information security. 

The topics are categorized into three groups. First group of lectures gives an overview of ways on how to protect your data and privacy. The second group of lectures gives an overview of public key cryptography and its applications. The third group of lectures starts with authentication and then focuses on different kinds of attacks (social engineering, web attacks, other technical attacks, wireless security and attacks against mobile networks).
opitulemused_en:
- After this course the student:
- * can assess password complexity and knows how to manage passwords
- * has an overview of authentication methods and usages of cryptography
- * knows where and how data encryption is used
- * knows why privacy matters and what is needed to maintain anonymity
- * has an overview of ways to back up data and how to securely erase data
- * recognizes simple social engineering attempts
- * has a technical overview of the Estonian ID-card and e-voting
- * understands security risks involved in using smart devices
- * has an overview of technical, web-based and wireless (WiFi) attacks
- * knows how to send encrypted messages
- * has basic knowledge about the security of mobile networks

Käsitletakse selliseid autoreid nagu  Gryphius, Lessing, Lenz, Goethe, Schiller, Kleist, Hölderlin, Mörike, Tieck, Büchner, Heine, Fontane ja Hauptmann. Põhirõhk on lugemistehnikatel ja hermeneutikal ning valitud kirjandusteoste analüüsil ja arutelul, kuid puudutatakse ka erinevaid kirjandusteooriaid ja metodoloogikat.
kirjeldus_en: The seminar deals with German language literary texts from the beginning to the end of the 19th century, introducing to some of the key authors such as Gryphius, Lessing, Lenz, Goethe, Schiller, Kleist, Hölderlin, Mörike, Tieck, Büchner, Heine, Fontane and Hauptmann. The course will concentrate on close reading techniques and hermeneutics and focus on the discussion and analysis of selected literary works, but touching on various issues of literary methodology and theory. Even though it cannot provide a comprehensive history of literature, it will proceed chronologically to enable the students to better understand the historical basis and development of literary forms and topics.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, the students will be familiar with a good number of the most important authors and developments in German literary history form the beginning until the end of the 19th century. They will have become accustomed to literary concepts and have acquired skills how to discuss and critically analyse literature of different periods and genres, orally and in writing.
They will have developed digital skills such as using search engines and data banks while being aware of their structure and operation modes so that they can critically evaluate the sources and their reliability. Furthermore, they have practised using various word processing functions and creating content in different formats.

kirjeldus_en: The course provides basic knowledge of complaints, patogenesis, algorithms of diagnostics and treatment as well as prevention of diseases of ear-nose-throat, head and neck. The course consists of academic lectures and practical training.

- -has an overview of the rehabilitation of the patients with ear, nose and throat disorders, particularly with hearing loss

Loengukursuses ja seminarides käsitletakse:
· orgaanilise keemia meetoditega seotud üldküsimusi ja mõisteid,
· süvendatult levinumate orgaaniliste reaktsioonide mehhanisme,
· tähtsaimate aineklasside saamise meetodeid,
· aineklasside üleminekute põhilisi reaktsioone,
· kaitsvate rühmade keemiat.
kirjeldus_en:
The course will cover the following chapters:
· the basic concepts of organic chemistry methods,
· advanced approach of most common organic reaction mechanisms,
· preparation of basic organic compounds,
· common transformations between organic compound classes,
· the chemistry of protecting groups.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course:
· understands the basic concepts of organic chemistry methods,
· should be able to evaluate possible reactions proceeding from structure of an organic compound and describe the mechanism of most common organic reactions,
· is able to comprehend the preparation and transformation of different classes of organic compounds,
· can describe several functional group protecting methods and their applications,
· knows how to search and analyze information from chemical databases to solve practice problems and is also able
to share this information in writing as well as orally using digital tools if applicable,
· can use chemical drawing programs to present practice problem solutions to other students.

kirjeldus_et: Aine läbinud tudeng omandab teadmised peamistest praktilistest meetoditest, mida kasutatakse tänapäeva internetiturunduses. Läbitavate teemade hulka kuuluvad veebilehe disain, otsingumootori turundus, sotsiaalmeedia turundus, e-kirja turundus ja veebikeskne sisuloome. Aine rõhuasetus on rohkem sotsiaalmeedia turunduse kasutamisel, pidades silmas asjaolu, et just see on kriitilise tähtsusega tänases internetiturunduse strateegias.
kirjeldus_en: By the end of the course, the student will gain knowledge of the main practical methods used in Internet marketing. Among the topics covered in the course will be website design, search engine marketing, social media marketing, e-mail marketing, and Internet-based content creation. Social media marketing and search engine marketing will be the cornerstones of the course, as they are most important in nowadays marketing.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has passed this course will:
- - be able to bring out the most important components of internet marketing strategy,
- - know how to create high-quality web pages and how to assess other webpages,
- - know how to implement funnel theory in context of internet marketing,
- - be skilled in using search engine marketing,

kirjeldus_en: Proof trees. Main equivalences of predicate logic. Sequent calculus. Peano axioms. Graphs. Walks, cycles, connected graphs. Trees. Spanning trees. Minimum weight spanning trees.   Directed graphs. The shortest path problem.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. Has acquired a systematic and coherent overview of main discrete structures used in mathematics and computer science and of corresponding concepts, results and methods.
- 2. Constructs mathematical arguments in areas covered by the course and expresses them clearly using the standard terminology and notations.
- 3. Expresses (inc. orally and to peers) statements using propositional and predicate formulas, establishes properties (e.g. satisfiability, validity) of and relations (e.g. equivalence, consequence) between these formulas, converts formulas into equivalent formulas in a suitable form, and relates results to the original statements.
- 4. Applies mathematical induction to prove statements.
- 5. Explains (inc. orally and to peers), illustrates with examples, and associates with each other the basic notions of graph theory, can use graphs and trees to model situations, and draws conclusions about the situation using basic properties of graphs and trees.

kirjeldus_en: Students gain the basic knowledge for using qualitative research method. The knowledge and skills acquired from theoretical lectures and reading tasks are practically applied for conducting qualitative research: students plan the research (formulate the aim of the research and research questions), conduct data collection, use thematic and content analysis methods and write a short report.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has completed the course
- - Knows the main characteristics of a qualitative research method and can make an argumentative choice for it based on the research problem and the theoretical paradigm
- - Follows the ethical principles of qualitative research in research planning, data collecting and data analysis and is aware of the researcher's responsibility
- - Knows different qualitative data collection methods and uses them
- - Can use the basic methods of qualitative data analysis and write the analysis
- - Knows how to evaluate results of qualitative analysis

nimi_en: Principles of Communication and Health Behaviour in Medicine
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: Anneli Rätsep, Ave Kovaljov, Laura Kaljurand, Marje Oona, Marta Velgan
kirjeldus_et: Suhtlemise ja tervisekäitumise aluste aine keskmes on suhtlemise baasoskused ja nende rakendamise võimalused patsiendiga konsultatsiooni läbiviimisel ja tervisekäitumise edendamisel. Käsitletav kontekst lähtub Calgary-Cambridge konsultatsioonimudelist, mida sisustavad motiveerivast intervjueerimisest lähtuvad suhtlemisvõtted. Mõlemad lähenemised on tõenduspõhised ning leidnud meditsiinivaldkonnas laialdast rakendamist. Aines omandatakse teadmised ja oskused õppematerjalidega tutvumise, praktiseerimise, analüüsimise ja arutelude kaudu.  Keskse meetodina on aines rakendatud tiimipõhist õpet (Team Based Learning - TBL). Aine jaguneb iseseisvaks õppeks ja kontaktõppeks ning sellel on Moodle tugi. Moodle kursus sisaldab õppematerjale, individuaalselt ja grupiviisiliselt tehtavaid töid ja nende juhiseid ning hindamist ja tagasisidestamist. Moodles toimub jooksev ja kujundav hindamine,  osaliselt iseseisvatele töödele tagasiside andmine. Tagasiside andmise põhirõhk on seminarides. Õppematerjalideks on interaktiivsed õpiobjektid, mis sisaldavad videoloengud, teemakohast teaduskirjandust ning kinnistavaid ülesandeid ja enesekontrolli teste. Kontaktõppes rakendavad õppijad eelnevalt läbi töötatud teoreetilisi teadmisi situatsioonülesannete lahendamisel. Praktikumides harjutatakse konsultatsiooni alustamise, info kogumise ja jagamise põhimõtteid, kuidas hoida struktuuri ja koostöölisi suhteid patsiendiga, jagatud raviotsuste/plaanide tegemiseni välja. Aines käsitletakse muid patsiendiga suhtlemise kulguja ravisoostumist mõjutada võivad teemasid: hoiakud ja väärtused, suhtlemistõkked, otsustusprotsessi mõjutavad tegurid ning nende seosed konfliktide tekkimise ja ravivigadega.  Lisaks käsitletakse aines laiemalt tervisekäitumist mõjutavaid tegureid ning kitsamalt erinevate haavatavate gruppidega (nt lapsed, noorukid).
kirjeldus_en:
The core of the subject of communication and health behaviour is learning the basic skills of communication and the their implementation in patient consultation treating and promoting health behaviour of the person. The context is based on the Calgary-Cambridge consultation model, which is furnished by communication techniques based of motivational interviewing. Both approaches are evidence-based and have widely implemented in the field of medicine. 
Knowledge and skills are acquired through reading, observing, practicing, analyzing, and discussing the study materials. The subject is divided into independent learning and contact training and has the support of Moodle. In addition to study materials, the Moodle course includes instructed individual and group work, as well as evaluation and feedback. Formative and Interim assessment is used in Moodle. Feedback is provided mainly in seminars but also for some individual tasks. 
The learning materials are interactive study objects that include recorded video lectures, thematic scientific literature reading, such as articles and textbook chapters. Specific tasks and self-control tests are used for embedding the topic. In contact training in form of seminars and precticums learners apply their theoretical knowledge in solving specific tasks. All parts of Consultation Course as starting the consultation, collecting and sharing information, providing the structure and building the relationships up to making shared treatment decisions/plans will be practiced in seminars. 
The role of attitudes and stereotypes, barriers to communication, factors affecting decision-making and their associations to conflict and treatment errors will also be addressed.

hindamise_meetod:
Korralisel hindamisel (automaatne arvestus) kujuneb lõpphinne kõikide moodulipõhiste arvestuslike tööde (testid ja iseseisvad tööd) kogumina: kui arvestuslikud tööd on tähtaegselt esitatud ja saanud positiivse hinde ning pole puudumisi, siis Moodle hindamistabel loeb automaatselt aine arvestatuks. 

Esimesel kordushindamisel kujuneb lõpphinne samuti kõikide arvestuslike tööde kogumina, kus nädala jooksul automaatsest arvestusest, hindab rühma juhendaja kuni kolme töö puhul korralisele hindamisele tähtaegselt esitamata jäänud või nõuetele mitte vastanud tööd ja kuni kahe puudumise korral tasandustööd ning nõuetele vastavate tööde puhul kannab sisse arvestused.

Teine kordushindamine toimub semestri lõpus ja on mõeldud neile, kellel aine jooksul esines võlgnevusi rohkem kui kolme iseseiva töö puhul või on puudutud rohkem kui kahest praktikumist. Kompleksjärelarvestus on aineülene kombineeritud hindamine, mis koosneb kirjalikust ja suulisest osast.

oppejoud: Elo-Hanna Seljamaa, Lona Päll, Tenno Teidearu
kirjeldus_et: Lähtudes mõistepaarist analüütiline ja rahvapärane, vaatleb kursus ametliku kultuuri ja rahvakultuuri vastasmõjusid ning suhteid kogukondade ja teiste rühmade argipraktikate tasandil, mille tundmine on vajalik vaimse kultuuripärandi valdkonna protsesside mõistmiseks ja vastutustundlikuks suunamiseks. Kursusel käsitletakse süvendatult folkloori ajaloolist kujunemist analüütilise kategooriana erinevas geograafilises ja ühiskondlik-kultuurilises kontekstis, autentsuse mõistega seonduvat ning kaasaegseid folkloristlikke teooriaid, mis mõtestavad pärimust traditsioonisidusa kommunikatiivse praktika ja identiteediloome ressursina. Erilist tähelepanu pööratakse neile folkloorižanritele, mis leiavad aktiivset kasutust meelelahutustööstuses, turisminduses ja teistes majandusharudes nii kohalikul kui ka rahvuslikul ja rahvusvahelisel tasandil, või mida rühmad kasutavad sümboolseks kommunikatsiooniks ametliku kultuuri esindajatega.
kirjeldus_en: Taking as its starting point the conceptual distinction between the analytic and vernacular, the course looks at interactions between official and folk culture and relationships between communities and other groups on the level of daily practices. The course explores the emergence of folklore as an analytic category in diverse geographic and socio-cultural contexts, issues pertaining to the concept of authenticity, and contemporary folkloristic theories that conceive of folklore as a tradition-based communicative practice and resource for the (re-)creation of identity. Special emphasis is laid on folklore genres that are used by the entertainment industry, tourism and other branches of the economy, or by groups for symbolic communication with representatives of official culture.

Final assignment can be an oral presentation or a short essay about a vernacular expression. Details in Moodle.

It explores the rights and obligations of the parties to the employment contract, the legal regulation of working hours, rest periods, holidays, wages, the responsibilities of the parties, and the resolution of disputes arising from employment relationships.

1) Tervislik eluviis
2) Tervisekool
3) Kardioloogi juures
4) Terapeudi juures

The course introduces medical vocabulary related to the following topics:
1) Healthy lifestyle
2) Health school
3) Consultation with a cardiologist
4) At a family doctor (GP)
5) Medications - our friends or enemies?
All the texts are adapted.
Basic grammar is also revised during the course.
opitulemused_en:
- On completion of the course the students will be able to:
- - make professional presentations
- - understand and create oral and written texts in medicine
- - read longer medical texts independently and bring out essential information
- - give clear and detailed answers to speciality-related questions
- - use the acquired vocabulary in situations related to their future profession

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Maailm on üleilmastumas juba üle tuhande aasta.  Aga keskendudes kaasaegse üleilmastumisele ja unustades maailma juhtivaid poliitilisi vorme, meie pilt üleilmastumisest on puudulik.  See ainekursus defineerib rahvad ja impeeriumid idealtüüpidena (Max Weber), uurib nende seletatavat võimu ajaloos ja ajalookirjutamises, tõlgendab 20. sajandit dekoloniseerimise protsessina (impeeriumid saavad ümberkujundatud rahvus-vabariikideks), aj juhib tähelepanu imperialistliku ja rahvusliku printsiipide lepitamises kolmes 20. sajandi kõige ideoloogilisemas impeeriumis:  Natsi Saksamaa, Nõukogude Venemaa ja Ameerika Ühendriigid
kirjeldus_en: The world has been globalizing for at least a millenium.  However, its internal boundary haven't always received the attention they deserve in narratives and interpretations of globalization.  This course defines nations and empires as contrasting political ideal types (Max Weber), investigates their respective explanatory historical and historiographical roles in world history, tells the story of the 20th century as one of decolonization of empires into nation-states, and explores the uneasy balance of national and imperial dimension in the three most ideologically ambitious imperial nations of the 20th century:  Nazi Germany, Soviet Russia, and the USA
opitulemused_en:
- Upon finishing the course the student
- * identifies both the theoretical differences between nations and empires as forms of political organization;
- * speak intelligently about the place of nations and empires over the sweep of globalization as the big story of world history
- * write and think critically about the national and imperial dynamics of world history and contemporary geopolitics

a) Aine on esitatud lähtudes tänapäevasest uurimisseisust.  
b) Aine esitamisel on aluseks ajalisuse printsiip, mis loob abistava koordinaadistiku nagunii abstraktses konstrueerimis-ja fikseerimisprotsessis.
c) Ajalise telje sees on aine  struktueeritud nende probleemide ümber,  mis on hilisemale kujunemisele kõige olulisemat mõju avaldanud. 
d) Aine on jagatud 32 tunnile ehk 16 loengule, mis omakorda moodustavad 4 etappi. Esimene etapp esitab sissejuhatuse ainesse ning tutvustab viimastel aastatel esitatud uusi analüüse ja interpretatsioone ainest,  käsitleb  sotsialistliku realismi toomist Eesti kunsti ning lõpeb esteetilise positsiooni taaskehtestamisega eesti kunstis (loengud 1-6). Teine etapp käsitleb paradigma muutusi eesti kunstis, eesti vangardkunsti  ja selle lõpetamist 1980.aastate stagnatsiooniperioodil (loengud 7-10). Kolmas etapp käsitleb postmodernistliku ideoloogia jõudmist eesti kunsti, uut rahvusromantismi lainet  (loengud 11-14).  Neljas etapp käsitleb muutusi, mis algasid 1990.aastate kunstis ja kunstielus, institutsionaalseid muutusi ning uue tehnoloogia ja uue meedia mõju ja tähendust eesti kunstis (loengud 15-16).
kirjeldus_en:
Estonian art in the post-war period  introduce the period since 1945 up today. Presenting the material  I have starting points as follows: 
a) As Estonian post-war history of arts is standing in front of crucial "re-writing" process of it's topic, all the  new interpretations have been introduced and used.
b) Although the overview is not a "story of art" (linear history which devides an art according to chronology), the chronological principles have been used to afford  a more structural lectures in a very abstract systems of visual arts.   
c) The main attention is driven to more significant moments and problems  in the post-war period, the critical analyzes  and  the  changing contexts are given. The subject is  divided into 16 lectures, which are concentrated into four parts. 
The first part introduces the key debates on the post-war period, the period of socialist realism till the mid 1950, and the re-establishing the aesthetic values as  fundamental evaluating system  (lectures 1-6). 
The second part is concentrating  into changes of paradigms in the art of the end of sixties and to the question of avant-garde in Estonian art. The more radical  view  was stopped by so-called stagnation period in politics and art.  (lectures 7-10)
The third part  considers the problem of post-modern in Estonian art, and a neo-national romantism movement (lectures 11-14).
The fourth part starts from the crucial political changes in 1990s, the changes in art and in local  art world, the institutional changes. Introduction to the problem of new technology and new media in Estonian art (lectures 15-16).
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The students have a comprehensive introduction  to the  post-war period in Estonian art.

nimi_en: Swedish Political, Economic and Cultural Relations with Russia in the 16th-18th Centuries
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus antakse süvendatud ülevaade Rootsi-Vene poliitilistest, majanduslikest ja kultuurilistest suhetest 16. sajandi keskpaigast 18. sajandi esimese veerandi lõpuni. Kahe riigi poliitilisi suhteid mõjutasid eelkõige permanentsed sõjad (1555-1557, 1570-1595, 1609-1617, 1656-1661, 1700-1721) ja rahuaegadele jäänud diplomaatilised missioonid ning sõlmitud lepingud. Oluline on esile tuua Stockholmi võimukandjate nägemus Venemaast ning Moskva riigi suhtumine Rootsisse ja viimase koosseisu kuulunud provintsidesse. Majanduslikus mõttes vajasid naaberriigid teineteise ressursse: Rootsi hindas Vene toorkaupu lina, kanepit ja metsa; Venemaa vajas Rootsi vaske, rauda jt metalle. Kultuurisidemed rajanesid Venemaa vajadusele saada Rootsi kaudu oskustööjõudu ja teadmisi; Rootsis huvi Vene keele, tunti kommete jms vastu. Kahe maa vahel oli kokkupuutepunkte ka kirikuelu alal.
kirjeldus_en: The political relationships between the two countries were influenced by frequent wars (1555-1557, 1570-1595, 1609-1617, 1656-1661, 1700-1721) and diplomatic missions and treaties in the meantime. We will consider the Swedish rulers' politics towards Russia and Russia's political ambitions in regard to Swedish Empire and its provinces. In economic terms both countries were in need of each other's resources and products: Sweden imported flax, hemp, timber, etc. from Russia; Russia, in its turn, was most interested in Swedish production of various metals. Cultural relations were dominated by economic concerns on Russian side: Russia looked for skilled workers and know-how from Sweden and via Sweden from Europe. Sweden took interest in the culture and habits of its powerful eastern neighbour. The countries had contacts also in church matters.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The course provides the student with systematic and comprehensive knowledge of Swedish political, economic and cultural relations with Russia from the time of the Russo-Swedish War of 1555-1557 to the Treaty of Nystad in 1721. It contributes to better understanding of the history of the Baltic Sea region as a whole and of Estonian history in particular.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus ehitub üles loengutest ja praktikumidest.
Kursuse saab jagada tinglikult alateemadeks: (1) meditsiinigeneetika alused, s.h. monogeenste ja komplekshaiguste geneetika; (2) hambahaigustega seotud geneetika; (3) geneetika teadmiste ja analüüside rakendused meditsiinis; (4) DNA analüüsi meetodid - baasarusaam; (5) meditsiinigeneetika andmebaaside kasutamine, s.h. kliinilises töös.
kirjeldus_en:
The curriculum consist of lectures and practical course.
The course comprises of subtopics: (1) basic principles in medical genetics, monogenetic and
complex genetic diseases; (2) genetics of dental disorders; (3) applications of genetics in medicine; (4) the basics of genetic analysis methodology; (5) utilization of medical genetics databases in clinical work.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Obtained:
- - the basic terminology and concepts in medical genetics
- - basic genetics of dental disorders
- - an up-to-date integrated understanding about the role of genetics in medicine, as well as the respective applications in different medical fields
- - basic understanding of laboratory methods for DNA analysis
- - ability to utilize contemporary online medical  genetics databases
- 2. Prepared and presented a seminar to the fellow-students on a top paper (major development or breakthrough, selected by the course lecturer) in genetic studies related to stomatology and dentistry
- 3. Improved translational skills in:
- (i) utilization of the obtained knowledge from the lectures in preparing the seminar presentation and critically interpreting the presented research article and its scientific quality;
- (ii) balance between independent study process and team work with other students in the practical course, group discussions and in preparing the seminar presentation;
- (iii) synthesizing obtained knowledge and positioning in a wider context in the field, critical thinking;
- (iv) motivation to follow the developments and implications in genetics in the field

Antakse alusteadmisi erinevatest lähenemistest kultuuri mõistele ja kultuuride võrdlemise võimalustest. Tutvustatakse kaasaegseid kriitilisi kultuuri vaatlemise võimalusi, sh globaliseerumise kontekstis. Teoreetilisi käsitlusi täiendavad arvukad juhtumiuuringud ja näited, mille abil üliõpilased omandavad oskuse kultuuridevahelisi erinevusi ja sarnasusi kontekstiteadlikult analüüsida ning praktikas kultuuridevahelises suhtluses tekkida võivaid probleeme vältida.
kirjeldus_en: The course aims to introduce intercultural communication proceeding from theories of culture, language and translation. The course facilitates the development of communicative competence and especially intercultural communication competence and leads students towards a broader, context-aware understanding of texts in Estonian and foreign languages. The course introduces different approaches to the interpretation of cultures and the possibilities for comparing cultures, we well as contemporary critical approaches to culture in the context of globalization. Theoretical treatments will be complemented by numerous case studies and examples through which students acquire the skill of analyzing intercultural differences and similarities in a context-aware manner and to avoid problems of intercultural communication in practice.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students will gain an understanding of the main principles of culture and communication and are able to analyze case studies of intercultural communication. Students develop communicative and intercultural communication competence, broad and context-sensitive analysis of texts in Estonian and in foreign languages, cultural sensitivity, group work and self-expression skills.

Sageli on joogid jäänud ilma vajaliku tähelepanuta meie igapäevases söömises, kuigi nad varustavad meid toitainete, toiduenergia ja mitmete eriliste bioaktiivsete ühenditega. Kursuse jooksul analüüsitakse piima ja fermenteeritud piimaproduktide, mineraalvee, karastusjookide, mahlade, kohvi, kakao ja tee, puljongi, õlle, siidri, veini ja alkoholi nii häid kui ka võimalikke probleemseid toimeid tervisele. Antud kursus on inimorganismi biokeemia- ja meditsiinipõhine ning kuulub arstiteaduse üliõpilastel meditsiinilise biokeemia aine juurde. Seetõttu on see valikkursus 2. kursuse kevadsemestri õppekavas.
kirjeldus_en: Drinks and health is a subject which systematically introduces the students with knowledge of the biochemical composition of drinks and their impacts to the consumer`s health. The drinks are often without necessary attention in our everyday nutrition, although they furnish us with nutrients, food energy and bioactive compounds. The advantages and disadvantages of milk and fermented milk beverages, mineral waters, soft drinks, juices, coffee, cacao and tea, bouillon, beer, cider, wine and alcohol are analysed. This course is biochemistry and medicine-based subject. To get closer to this goals the training programme involves: a) interpreting everyday objects/ situations (drinks commertially or otherwise available) from the point of view of biochemical information (e.g. to list the ingredients from a drink´s lable or producers sources and to analyze them biochemically – as a team work); b) reading sample materials about selected drinks; c)performing an individual referative work on a drink; d) commenting/ analyzing fellow-students referative works; e) performing a test. The course corresponds to 40 hours work so it is not a big course and adding the tasks would only lead to stress about shortage of time – so we concentrate mainly on the health issues of phenolic compounds of drinks, artefitial sweeteners in drinks, additives and preservatives in drinks, possible sources of allergy and intolerance in drinks together with the benefitial effects.

kirjeldus_et: Psühhofarmakoloogia kursuses käsitletakse psühhoosivastaste ravimite, rahustite ja uinutite, antidepressantide, tümostabilisaatorite, nootroopikumide ja muude kognitiivseid võimeid suurendavate ravimite ning sedatiivsete, stimuleerivate ja psühhedeeliliste uimastite avastamist-leiutamist, tarvitamist läbi ajaloo, toimeid ja kõrvaltoimeid, toimemehhanisme. Uimastite farmakoloogiaga koos käsitletakse ravimsõltuvuse neurobioloogilisi aluseid. Tutvutakse psühhofarmakoloogilise uurimistöö peamiste meetoditega. Kursuse algul tutvutakse ravimiteaduse üldiste seaduspärasustega. Iseseisev töö kaasaegsete teadusartiklitega, milles on objekti või meetodina kasutatud psühhoaktiivseid ained, aitab neid teadmisi kinnistada ja tutvustab erialast laiema levikuga slängi.
kirjeldus_en: The course "Psychopharmacology" covers the discovery, use, effects and adverse effects of antipsychotics, anxiolytics and hypnotics, antidepressants, mood stabilizers, nootropics and other cognitive enhancers, and sedative, stimulant and psychedelic intoxicants. Along with the pharmacology of addictive drugs the neurobiology of drug dependence will be covered. Basic methodology of psychopharmacology will be introduced. The course begins with an introduction of the principles of general pharmacology. Independent work of students on scientific papers which have either studied psychoactive drugs or made use of such compunds to gain insights into brain function will reinforce the understanding of the concepts and terminology of psychopharmacology.

kirjeldus_et: Aine tutvustab lineaarsete alalis- ja vahelduvvooluahelate kirjeldamise meetodeid. Käsitletakse elektri- ja magnetahelate teooria üldpõhimõtteid, hargneva elektriahela kirjeldamise meetodeid (Kirchhoffi seadused, voolude superpositsioon, Nortoni ja Thevenini ekvivalentskeemid), vahelduvvoolu jada- ning rööpahelate parameetrite arvutamist, RLC-ahela sageduskoste ja hüveteguri leidmist ning ahelate omavahelist sidestamist.
kirjeldus_en: The course introduces the methods of describing of the linear DC and AC circuits. The following topics are covered: a) basic concepts of the theory of electric and magnetic circuits; b) design methods of the series-parallel electric circuits (Kirchhoff laws, superposition theorem, Norton and Thevenin equivalent circuits); c) methods for calculation of the parameters of series-parallel AC circuits; d) the frequency responses and quality factors of RLC-circuits; circuit coupling methods.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of this course, the student should be able to:
- 1. Calculate the voltage, current, resistance and dissipated power on the series-parallel connected resistors in the DC networks using the voltage and current divider principles, equivalent circuit method and the concepts of electromotive force, internal resistance, load line and operating conditions.
- 2. Calculate the functional parameters in the series-parallel DC circuits which possess independent sources in several branches using various formalisms (Kirchhoff laws, superposition theorem, Norton and Thevenin equivalent sources); choose the most effective way of problem solving according to the geometry of the given circuit (number of nodes and branches) and the required goal of calculations (analysis of either the circuit in detail, or the dependence of the functioning of DC circuit on the load conditions).
- 3.  Calculate the values of current in the different parts of the series-parallel AC circuits consisting of up to 4 components (R, L or C), calculate the voltage values on the certain components of these circuits and the power values dissipated in those components; draw the phasors of the AC circuits for which the complex impedance is given.
- 4. Calculate the frequency responses and quality factors of series-parallel AC circuits; design the passive frequency filters (low-pass, high-pass and band-pass filters).
- 5. Optimize the AC circuit to reach the maximum power transfer (compensation of the reactance, use of the matching transformers etc)

nimi_en: Tradition and Identity in Multicultural Society
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursuse keskmes on identiteedi loomine multikultuurses ühiskonnas. Kursuse raames vaadeldakse, milliseid vorme võtavad identiteedi-teemalised arutlused erinevates ühiskondlikes ning kultuurikontekstides, ning pööratakse tähelepanu ka multikultuursusele Eestis. Tähelepanu all on esiteks koha ning traditsioonide tähendus tänapäeva ühiskonnas, teisalt käsitletakse mingil määral ka "vana" multikultuursust, sest tegemist pole ainult kaasaegses ühiskonnas esineva nähtusega. Üheks teemaks on välitööde eripära multikultuursust või multilokaalseid nähtusi uurides, ning võõra kultuuri uurimisega seotud eetilised küsimused. Märksõnadeks on identiteet, multikultuursus, lokaalsus/globaalsus, koht/paikkond, "teised", transnatsionaalsed kogukonnad, võim.
kirjeldus_en: This course concentrates on identity formation in a multicultural society. During the course identity negotiations in different cultural and societal contexts will be discussed, paying attention also to multiculturalism in Estonia. The meaning of place and traditions in present-day society will be considered, but on the other hand also so called "old" multiculturalism is touched, since the phenomenon is not restricted to contemporary societies. In addition, the nature of fieldwork while doing research on multiculturalism or on multilocal phenomenon is discussed, as well as ethical issues related to investigating foreign cultures. Keywords: Identity, multiculturalism, local/global, place, "others", transnational communities, power.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After successfully finishing the course, a student should be able to analyse the meaning of place, tradition, transnational communities and other factors affecting the construction of identity in multicultural societies. S/he is familiar with the central theoretical standpoints of the field, is able to critically analyse literature on topic and to use acquired skills while completing the course assignments.

Introducing person
Colours
Countries, nationalities and languages
Family and relatives
Occupations
Numerals, phone numbers, address
Studies
My day. My week. 
My favourites
My country and hometown
Leisure time and hobbies.
The basic grammar:
	The gender of nouns

Personal and possessive pronouns
Declension of nouns and adjectives (singular only)
Verb forms: present, past and future (imperfect only)

Teemad: meetrilised ruumid (koonduvus, näited (ka normeeritud ruum), struktuur), täielikud meetrilised ruumid (näited (ka Banachi ruum), põhiteoreemid), pidevad operaatorid (põhimõisted, Banachi püsipunkti printsiip), kompaktsus (klassikaliste matemaatilise analüüsi teoreemide üldistused, kompaktsuse kriteeriumid), sissejuhatus topoloogilistesse ruumidesse, read normeeritud ruumides, pidevate lineaarsete operaatorite ruum, lõplikumõõtmelised normeeritud ruumid.
kirjeldus_en: This is a first course in functional analysis. Topics: metric spaces (convergence, examples (including normed linear spaces), balls, open sets, closed sets, closure, interior), complete metric spaces (examples (including Banach spaces), main theorems), continuous operators (continuity criteria, Banach fixed point theorem), compactness (extensions of Weierstrass theorems, compactness criteria), introduction to topological spaces,  series in normed spaces, the space of continuous linear operators, finite-dimensional normed spaces.

opitulemused_en: - After passing the course students have acquired basic knowledge and skills of functional analysis. In particular, they know the following basic notions and main results concerning them: metric spaces (convergence, examples (including normed linear spaces), balls, open sets, closed sets, closure, interior), complete metric spaces (examples (including Banach spaces)), continuous operators, compactness, series in normed spaces, the space of continuous linear operators, finite-dimensional normed spaces. kirjeldus_en: Familirizing with modern electronics laboratory environment. After finishing the course students would be able to work independently in lab environment without harming themselves, coworkers and lab equipment. Practical work takes place in a University of Tartu electronics lab "Ideelabor" (Nooruse 1, rooms 110 and 113)
opitulemused_en:
- 1.	After finishing the course students will be able to work independently with common electronics laboratory equipment like: precision multimeter, oscilloscope, LCR-meter, digital microscope, SMD soldering station, power supply, signal generator and ohter tools.
- 2.	In addition students will be able to operate specific devices available at lab like: PCB plotter, SMD Reflow Oven, X-Ray inspection, thermal Imaging camera, laser cutter and 3d printer.
- 3.	In addition students will be able to present their results and work with laboratory equipment in appropriate manner.

kirjeldus_en: This course examines the history of Finland from the archaeological  perspective from  Stone Age to Middle Ages.
opitulemused_en: - The student who has passed the course knows the sources of Finnish archaeology as well as the main academical opinions on the settlement and development of the material and mental culture on the territory of Finland from the Stone Age to the historical times. The student knows the periodization of the Finnish Stone Age.

kirjeldus_en: The course is based on the analysis of works of both Russian and European writers who tried to elaborate the image of the neighbor, to find common and different features in Russia and Europe and to find the ways of cooperation in the changing world. The influence of the war against Ukraine on the image of Russia and Russians in the modern world
hindamise_eeltingimused:
.Final exam will be held at the end of May or in June, during the examination session, the exact date will be discussed with the students (one of the possibilities to pass the exam is 28 May 2026 after the class or the next day). The next possibility in June will be discussed during the first class. The retake of the exam is scheduled for June 25, 2026.
To pass the exam a student must write an essay (without using AI!), which should encompass:
1) analysis of the movie or literary text or travelogue chosen by the student from the given list or independently (except the films or texts which were discussed in detail during classes). The aim is to reflect on the topic of national stereotypes or on the other issue within the present course; 
or
2) reasoning on the case, independently chosen by the student, from the point of view of the issues within the present course.

The topic must be confirmed by the teacher. The purpose of the essay is to demonstrate that the student has mastered the basic concepts of the course and the topics that were developed. Lecture notes can be used when writing an essay, but in this case, it must be referred to. It is also necessary to become familiar with the research literature, which is indicated in the list below or found independently by the student.

The volume of essay should be about 3000 words plus a list of references (sources used). References are required. 
 
The essay must be submitted before May 14, 2026.

The exam will be held in the form of discussion between the student and the teacher on the issues of student’s essay. During the exam, feedback will be given to each student individually. The student will be asked to defend his or her ideas and statements. Additional questions will be asked if there is any necessity to clarify the issue (they echo the issues discussed during the classes).
hindamise_meetod:
The course is graded using the scale from A to F, where F indicates that the course is failed. 
The following scheme will be used while calculating the course grade:
Final exam: essay and discussion on its topic and additional questions on the issues from the course (if needed)  70% of course grade
Participation and verbal activity 30% of course grade

kirjeldus_et: Eetika olemus ja ajalugu. Moraal. Ärieetika olemus. Teleoloogia ja deontoloogia. Eetilise otsustamise mudelid. Eetika ja töö. Eetika ja ettevõte. Eetika ja tarbijad.
kirjeldus_en: Ethics and morality. Essence of business ethics. Ethical theories. Models of ethical decision making. Ethics at workplace. Ethics and organization. Ethics and consumers.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course student:
- - Knows to essence of main ethical theories applied in the field of business ethics
- - Is able to analyze the core differences of the theories
- - Knows how to specify ethical dilemma and is able to analyze the reasons behind ethical dilemmas that occur in business situations
- - Is able to identify (and prevent if possible) ethical issues in organizational performance
- - Is qualified to analyze ethical issues in the framework of ethical theories
- - Is able to explain why the particular decision is ethical or unethical.

Lõpphinde kujunemisel läheb arvesse: 
(1) Grupitöö. 
 - Kui kodutöö on õigeaegselt esitamata, siis hinnatakse töö 0 punktiga, mis tähendab automaatselt, et kursuse lõpphinne on "mittearvestatud".  
(2) Seminarides osalemise eest saadud punktid. 
- Soovituslik on osaleda kõikides seminarides. Seminari rühma on võimalik muuta kooskõlastades see eelnevalt õppejõuga.  
- Puudumise korral pole seminare võimalik järele teha. 
 - Puudumist on võimalik vabandada arstitõendiga (esitada enne seminari) - sel juhul annab õppejõud asendusülesande. 
- Muudel põhjustel puudumine (reisimine, sh töölähetus) - asendusülesandeid ei anta. 
- Seminaride hindamisel võetakse arvesse ettevalmistust, kohapeal osalemist ja/või järelülesande sooritust. 
(3) Positiivne hinne kontrolltöö eest. Kontrolltöö: max 60 punkti, positiivse hinde lävend 30 punkti. Juhul, kui kontrolltöö hinne jääb alla lävendi, siis on võimalik kontrolltööd ühel korral järele teha.

nimi_en: Assessment Strategies and Methods in Clinical Psychology
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Kätlin Anni, Liina Haring, Margus Ennok, Teele Möldre
kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate individuaalse uurimise ja hindamise meetoditest kliinilises psühholoogias. Antakse teadmised peamistest kliinilise psühholoogia meetoditest ja nende kasutusvõimalustest psüühiliste protsesside ja psüühikahäirete hindamisel. Tutvutakse selliste meetoditega nagu diagnostiline intervjuu, enesekohased küsimustikud, kognitiivsete funktsioonide ja vaimsete võimete hindamise meetodid, isiksuse uurimise meetodid ning võimalused skisofreeniaspektri häirete ja prodromaalperioodi hindamiseks. Üliõpilased saavad võimaluse ise läbi proovida mõningaid hindamismeetodeid ja nende tõlgendamist. Kursuse käigus tuleb läbi viia üks psühholoogiline hindamine ja esitada uuringu kokkuvõte, milles demonstreeritakse oma teadmisi ja oskusi tõenduspõhisest hindamisest.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of individual assessment methods in clinical psychology. More specifically the assessment strategies and methods of psychological processes and psychiatric disorders in the clinical context will be discussed. The diagnostic interviews, self-report questionnaires, methods to assess cognitive functioning, intellectual abilities as well as methods assessing personality functioning and schizophrenia spectrum disorders will be introduced. Students will have the possibility to practice some of the methods and interpret the results. During the course the student is expected to carry out the psychological assessment and present the report, demonstrating the knowledge in evidence-based assessment.

Knows the assessment methods of schizophrenia spectrum disorders and prodromal period.

nimi_en: Estonian History in the Middle Ages
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Õppeaines käsitletakse peamiseid sündmusi ja suhteid keskaegsel Liivimaal (sh tänapäeva Eesti alal) ristisõdade ajajärgust (12.-13. sajand) kuni ca 1520. aastani. Üliõpilaselt eeldatakse lisaks loengutes osalemisele ka täiendava relevantse teadus- ja õppekirjanduse iseseisvat lugemist, aktiivset osalemist aineseminarides ning arvustuse koostamist ühe kohase monograafia kohta.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of the main events and relations in medieval Livonia (including the territory of present-day Estonia) since the Christianization of the region (12th-13th AD) until ca 1520. The participants of the course are required to independently read additional scientific literature, actively participate in practical seminars, and hand in a written review of a relevant scientific monograph.

2. Nõuetekohase kirjaliku koduse töö tähtaegne esitamine. Tähtaeg: 23. aprill 2026. 

Haridusliku erivajadusega üliõpilasel on õigus taotleda üldistest tingimustest ja tähtaegadest erandeid (kohandusi). Vastavas küsimuses tuleb üliõpilasel iseseisevalt pöörduda õppeosakonna nõustaja poole, kes koostab soovitatud kohanduste loetelu ja edastab selle vastutavale õppejõule. Õppejõud saab kohandussoovitusi arvestada vaid siis, kui info jõuab temani õigeaegselt, s.o semestri alguses. Vastavalt ülikooli õppekorraldusele on kohandused ennetav meede ega rakendu tagasiulatuvalt. Pöördudes nõustaja poole alles semestri lõpus, mil õppeaine kontakttunnid on juba toimunud ning iseseisvate tööde esitamise tähtajad möödas, ei ole kohanduste tegemine enam võimalik. Kui iseseisva töö tähtaeg on juba möödunud ning õppejõudu ei ole eelnevalt teavitatud hariduslikust erivajadusest tingitud raskusest töö õigeks ajaks esitada, ei ole võimalik soovitatud kohandusi tagantjärele arvesse võtta. 

Tõendatud haigestumise või muu õppetöös ajutiselt osalemist takistanud põhjuse korral on vastutaval õppejõul õigus teha üliõpilasele erand üldisest võlgnevuste heastamise tähtajast. Üliõpilaste võrdse kohtlemise tagamiseks peab erisuse põhjendus olema tõendatud (nt: arstitõendiga). Erandi lubamisel või sellest keeldumisel on õppejõul õigus võtta arvesse üliõpilase varasemat osalemist kontakttundides ja hinnata varasemate osalemiste/puudumiste pinnalt erisuse võimaldamise otstarbekust. Juhul, kui üliõpilane on kontakttundidest puudunud sedavõrd palju, et vastavate teemade rahuldaval tasemel iseseisvalt ära õppimine ja aine õpiväljundite saavutamine ei ole võimalik, on õppejõul õigus keelduda täiendava tähtaja võimaldamisest.
hindamise_meetod: Üliõpilasel, kes on täitnud kõik lõpphindamisele pääsemise tingimused, kujuneb hinne suulise eksami sooritamise tulemusel.

- - to understand the basis of the application of the norms and principles of the company law to apply them
- - to recognize the legal problems solved by the norms and principles of the company law
- - to have a knowledge in the important company law court cases
- - to solve independently company law cases according to the applicable methodology

kirjeldus_et:
Üliõpilased kavandavad juhendaja juhendamisel väikestes rühmades / meeskondades erinevaid tegevusi, milleks võivad olla näiteks teemaõhtute või muude oma eriala propageerivate ürituste läbiviimine ülikoolivälises asutuses, kus õppijal on tavapärasest õppetöös osalemisest erinev roll. Praktika lõpus koostab üliõpilane praktikaaruande, mille üks olulisemaid osasid on üliõpilase eneseanalüüs. 
Erandina on käsitletav ülikoolis tehtav õppeassistentide töö ja projektipõhine praktika, millel on valdavalt ülikooliväline tellija.
Praktika läbiviimiseks on vaja ülikoolipoolse ja praktikabaasipoolse juhendaja (ülikooli välise asutuse töötaja) olemasolu. Praktikabaasipoolne juhendaja annab praktika lõpus eelnevalt kokkulepitud vormis tagasisidet ülikoolipoolsele juhendajale selle kohta, kuidas praktikant oma ülesannetega toime tuli, milline oli tema areng, ettevalmistus jne.
kirjeldus_en:
After having formed small groups/teams, students will plan and organise different activities and events (supervised by the supervisor), e.g specialty-related theme nights, exhibitions, fairs etc at non-university institutions where the students have different role from their everyday student role. After participating in practical training students compile a report in which one of the most important components is self analysis.
The work of study assistants carried out in the university and project-based practice that mainly has non-university base is treated as an exception. Supervisors are needed on the behalf of the university and the trainee base for conducting practical training. After the end of the training the trainee base's supervisor gives feedback to the supervisor of university's side, how the trainee managed with his/her tasks, developed during the training, what kind of preparations were made by the student for the training, etc.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students are able to reflect their experience gained in teamwork at a non-university institution; can evaluate their input and accomplishments during their work; they are able to distinguish between different roles in a team and are aware of ways of communication and shared responsibilty within a team.

Analüüsimaterjaliks on autentsed norra-/rootsi-/taanikeelsed tekstid aimekirjanduse, ilukirjanduse, teabekirjanduse ja tarbekirjanduse vallast, sh kultuurispetsiifilise sisuga tekstid. Kursuse sisu varieerub aastast-aastasse vastavalt sihtgrupile: rootsi filoloogid teevad tööd rootsikeelsete, taani filoloogid taanikeelsete ja norra filoloogid norrakeelsete tekstidega.
kirjeldus_en: During this course, students will analyse and compose various types of texts. Students will learn about the most important models and techniques of practical text analysis and will further develop their written and oral communication skills. Authentic Norwegian / Swedish / Danish fiction, popular science, nonfiction and consumer-oriented texts, including culture-specific content, will be analysed. Course content varies from year to year according to the target audience: Swedish philologists work with Swedish, Danish philologists with Danish texts and Norwegian philologists with Norwegian texts.

Evidence-based physiotherapy methods in the pre- and post-operative stages of illnesses as well as in acute and chronic stages are being addressed. There is a clinical practice that experiences and analyzes what is happening in the world of work. The student performs self-reflection on the basis of experience in the world of work.

nimi_en: Basic Knowledge for the Research in Medical Biochemistry (I)
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: Ceslava Kairane, Kalle Kilk, Rando Porosk, Siiri Altraja, Tiiu Kullisaar
kirjeldus_et: Õpetatakse meditsiinilise biokeemia kasutuses olevaid meetodeid. Eeldab suures osas ka iseseisvat tööd teaduskirjandusega.
kirjeldus_en: This course gives knowledge about the general principles and ethics of scientific investigations, about safety regulations related to the work in laboratory, about scientific methodology and statistics. Students are obliged: a) to analyze an structure and an essence of  excellent scientific articles; b)  and to write an essay about a good scientific article in the field of medical biochemistry (concerning medicine, dentistry or pharmacy problems) and to present this vision on Chair's seminars.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who graduated the course:
- - has overview of different scientific publication types in biomedical science
- - knows structure of scientific article and can easily find answer of the biomedical problem from article
- - orientates in medical biochemical terminology, can bring medical examples and use this knowledge for writing a conclusive overview of articles in Estonian or in English.
- - can theoretically explain basic principles and demand for different laboratory methods used in medical biochemistry
- - can analyze scientific information; allocate it into the biomedical context.

kirjeldus_et: Õpetatakse kompleksselt peamisi kopsude ja hingamiselundite haigusi, samuti keskseinandi, söögitoru ja rindkereseina kirurgilisi haigusi (käsitletakse epidemioloogiat ja patogeneesi, haigustunnuseid ja sümptomeid, haiguse kliinilist kulgu, diagnoosimist (sealhulgas invasiivse diagnostika meetodeid), ravi (sealhulgas kirurgilist ravi) rehabilitatsiooni, haiguste preventsiooni, üldisemat hingamiselundite haiguste ravikorraldust ning rindkeremeditsiinis esinevate ägedate haigusseisundite diagnostikat ja ravi). Käsitlemist leiavad pulmonoloogias ja torakaalkirurgias kasutatavad uurimismeetodid, kopsuhaiguste paomorfoloogia, patofüsioloogia, immunoloogia ja hingamiselundite kaitsemehhanismid. Erinevate hingamiselundite haiguste õpetamise maht on mõnevõrra erinev - suhteliselt detailsemalt on käsitletud sagedamini esinevaid haigusi (bronhiaalastma, krooniline obstruktiivne kopsuhaigus, alumiste hingamisteede infektsioonid ja viimaste tüsistused, rindkerepiirkonna kasvajad, kopsukelme haigused), kuid tundma õpetatakse ka suhteliselt harvem esinevaid haigusi, kus oluline koht on sageli invasiivsel diagnostikal. Pulmonoloogia ja torakaalkirurgia kursus moodustab käesoleval hetkel osa Tartu Ülikoolis õpetatavast sisehaiguste ainest.
kirjeldus_en: The major respiratory disorders and diseases of the chest, including diseases of the mediastinum, esophagus, and chest wall are discussed in details (epidemiology, etiology and pathogenesis, signs and symptoms, clinical course, diagnosis (including invasive diagnostics), differential diagnosis, treatment (including surgery), rehabilitation, prevention, common respiratory health care, and management of respiratory emergencies) along with methods of investigation, in respiratory medicine, pulmonary pathology, pathophysiology, immunology, and defense mechanisms of the lung. The attention paid on different pulmonary disorders vary - diseases of higher prevalence are discussed in more details (i.e. bronchial asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, lower respiratory tract infections and their complications, thoracic neoplasms, and diseases of the pleura), but relatively less prevalent respiratory diseases, where invasive diagnostic methods are often used, are also taught. The Course on Pulmonary Medicine and Thoracic Surgery accounts for a part of the Course on Internal Medicine taught in the University of Tartu.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course, the students should be able to:
- 1) understand the principles of the nature and diagnosis of the diseases of the chest and respiratory system, as well as the basic methods of investigation used in chest medicine with an ability to interpret the results,
- 2) understand the essentials of pulmonary epidemiology, pathology, pathophysiology, immunology, and defense mechanisms of the chest and respiratory system,
- 3) autonomously investigate the pulmonary patient and suggest the preliminary diagnosis of major respiratory diseases including restrictive, obstructive, neoplasmatic, and infectious pulmonary diseases, as well as chest injury and diseases of the mediastinum, esophagus, and chest wall,
- 4) suggest further methods of investigations necessary to confirm the diagnosis in certain situations and interpret the respective results,
- 5) suggest and substantiate complex treatment options, including surgical treatment, in various respiratory diseases,
- 6) understand the principles of continuity of the respiratory care, pulmonary rehabilitation, and disease prevention,
- 7) know the principles of assessment of the patient and provide appropriate care in cases of respiratory emergencies and exacerbations of chronic respiratory disorders.
