Kultuurikorralduse praktika toimub professionaalses kultuuriorganisatsioonis. Vähemalt 8 (kaheksa) nädala jooksul peab üliõpilane töötama organisatsioonis, vaatlema ja osalema, analüüsima kogetut ning võtma osa organisatsiooni igapäevatööst.
Praktika üldiseks eesmärgiks on rakendada praktikasse üliõpilase poolt omandatud teoreetilisi teadmisi, sh seoses kultuuriorganisatsiooni tegevuse analüüsi ja korraldustööga.
Praktika sooritamine toimub vastavalt praktika juhendile, mis on leitav õppeaine Moodle keskkonnas. Praktika lõpeb kaitsmisega. Erandkorras võib kaitsmine toimuda ka veebi teel (selle eelduseks on mõjuv põhjus ja kokkulepe õppejõuga). Veebi teel kaitsmise jooksul peab tudeng tagama ühenduse, kus ta osaleb kõnes nii heli kui ka pildiga.
kirjeldus_en:
The 15 EAP practice takes place in a cultural organization. Within at least 4 weeks the students should work in the organization, observe, analyse and take part in organization's everyday work.
The general goal is to put into practice the theoretical knowledge student has gained from curricula so far and use those skills to analyse a cultural organization and its obligations and use the knowledge in real life practice. 
Activities must be planned according to the guidelines (located in Moodle). The course ends with a defence. In exceptional cases the defence can also take place as a video call (if there is a relevant cause and it is permitted by the responsible teacher). In case of a video call, it is obligatory to participate actively, using the audio and video connection.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Passing the course involves implementing theoretical and practical knowledge and skills that are relevant in terms of every-day work of a cultural organisation, including preparing and executing events and activities.
- 2. Student can analyse the role and current situation of the organisation, including business model and other relevant factors.
- 3. As a team member, student has been an active contributor in the process of organising a cultural event, including its main stages: ideation, planning, executing and follow-up activities.

Koos tõestustega antakse tulemused (hinnangud, nende dispersioonid ja dispersioonihinnagud) üldkogumi ja osakogumi kogusumma ning keskmise ja osakaalu hindamiseks. kirjeldus_en: This course introduces the basic probability sampling methods.  Estimation of population and domain totals, means and proportions in general and for the special sampling designs are considered. Also, estimation of a ratio and the problem of nonresponse are introduced. Computer exercises are meant for application of theoretical material, a survey in hypothetical StatVillage is carried through.

kirjeldus_en: The course covers the following topics: the birth of philosophy in Ancient Greece, the Eleatic School, Ancient Atomists, philosophical problems discussed by Ancient Sophists, the significance of Socrates for the history of Ancient Greek philosophy, Plato's doctrine of being, Plato's doctrine of knowledge and thinking, Plato's doctrine of the soul and virtues, Plato's political teachings, Hellenistic philosophy: the Stoics, Epicureans, Skeptics, the change of the position of philosophy in the intellectual world of the Christian Late Antiquity, R. Descartes and the foundations of modern philosophy, D. Hume's empiricist scepticism, I. Kant's theoretical and practical philosophy, G. W. F. Hegel's system of speculative philosophy, F. Nietzsche's concept of European nihilism, K. R. Popper's critical rationalism. (For more details, see semester programs.)
opitulemused_en: - On successful completion of the course, the student is familiar with the problems and solutions, main concepts and arguments relevant to the philosophical doctrines considered, and is able to link these subjects to their historical-cultural contexts.

kirjeldus_et:
Norra keel algtaseme läbinuile (süvaõpe) on jätkukursus HVLC.06.022 Norra keel algtaseme läbinuile (süvaõpe), tase 0>A2'le Skandinaavia keelte ja kultuuride valdkonnas norra keele ja kirjanduse harus õppivatele üliõpilastele. Kursusel osalemise eeltingimusteks on norra keele teadmised Euroopa Nõukogu keeleoskustasemel A2.

Tunnid eeldavad aktiivset osavõttu, teeme palju rühma- ja paaristööd. Samuti on suur rõhk iseseisval tööl, muu hulgas tuleb peale iga läbitud peatükki sooritada peatükki kokkuvõttev kontrolltöö. Semestri jooksul loeme lisaks õpikumaterjalile ka ilukirjandust, et tutvuda norra kirjandusega ja laiendada oma sõnavara. Samuti esitab iga üliõpilane semestri jooksul ühe individuaalettekande. Selle käigus harjutame oma seisukohtade väljendamise ja põhjendamise oskust, kaasüliõpilaste ettekannete mõistmist, vestluse arendamist ja küsimuste esitamist.

Kursusel on ka veebimoodul Moodle keskkonnas, mis sisaldab tunniks vajalikku materjali, kommentaare grammatika kohta, interaktiivseid harjutusi, vajalikke linke jpm. Õpime eesmärgipäraselt kasutama netipõhiseid keeleõpperessursse, sh sõnaraamatuid. 
Kursus on ehitatud üles temaatilistele kommunikatsioonieesmärkidele, mille käigus omandatakse ja harjutatakse vastavat sõnavara ja vajalikke grammatikareegleid. 

Käsitletavad teemad:
Kogemused ja tulevikuplaanid
Kooselu ja abielu
Eluase ja keskkond
Toit ja tervis
Sisse- ja väljaränne
Kultuur ja traditsioonid
Kool ja haridus
Töö
Meedia
Norra vanal ajal
Norra naftaajastul
Heaoluühiskond
Norra ajalugu
Inimõigused
kirjeldus_en:
Norwegian for Beginners II (Intensive Course) is a continuation of the course HVLC.06.022 Norwegian for Beginners I (Intensive Course), meant for for students of Scandinavian languages and cultures majoring in Norwegian language and literature. A knowledge of Norwegian at level  A2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference is a prerequisite to taking the course.

The classes require active participation, we do a lot of group- and pairwork. There is also a great focus on independent work; among other tasks, a test has to be taken after each completed unit. In addition to reading textbook materials, we will read fiction texts in order to get to know the Norwegian literature, as well as expand our vocabulary. Every student holds an individual presentation during the semester. This allows us to practice expressing and explaining our views, understanding fellow students' presentations, holding a conversation and asking questions.

The course has its own web module on Moodle, containing lesson materials, comments on grammar, interactive exercises, links to useful resources etc. We will also learn to use different online language learning resources, including dictionaries.

The course is constructed on thematic communicative tasks. While working on the communicative goals, relevant vocabulary and necessary grammar are acquired and trained. 

The topics of dicussion are:
Experiences and plans 
Marriage and living together
Housing and environment
Food and health 
Immigration and emigration 
Culture and traditions 
School and education 
Work 
Media 
Norway in the old times
Norway in the Age of Oil
Welfare society 
History of Norway 
Human rights

Ainekursusel tutvustatakse üldiselt ka lastehaiguste, sisehaiguste ja neuroloogiliste haiguste valdkonnas rakendatavaid füsioterapeutilise hindamise põhimõtteid ja teste. Ainekursus sisaldab arvukaid praktikume ning iseseisvat, ühe patsiendi funktsionaalsete häirete hindamise praktikat. Õpioskuste arendamist toetab patsiendi hindamisprotsessi planeerimine, hindamismeetodite vaheliste seoste loomine, hindamistulemuste analüüs ja oma tegevuse dokumenteerimine.
kirjeldus_en: The course acquires the techniques of physiotherapeutic assessment, which are mainly used to identify functional problems in patients with orthopedic problems. The course also introduces the principles and tests of physiotherapeutic assessment in the field of pediatric, internal and neurological diseases. The course includes practical teaching and independent practice of assessing the functional disorders of one patient. The development of learning skills is supported by planning the patient assessment process, creating links between assessment methods, analyzing assessment results and documenting their activities.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- student:
* knows the principles of physiotherapeutic assessment and the principles of  patient`s physiotherapy report compilation 
* understands the importance of physiotherapeutic assessment in identifying patient functional problems
* perform independenty various physiotherapeutic measurements and tests
* applies practical skills acquired during the course to the patient's systematic physiotherapeutic assessment
* structure the results of the physiotherapeutic assessment into the relevant sub-phases of the physiotherapy report
* plans high-quality physiotherapeutic assessments for all patients in the future

kirjeldus_en: Diagnostic methods in cardiology. Diagnosis and management of heart diseases. This course is a part of "Internal diseases":
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the programme, the students should know:
1) The epidemiology, ethiology and pathogenesis of heart diseases
2) The clinical presentation and complications of heart diseases

2. is able to diagnose different diseases in oral-maxillo-facial region.
3. is able to interpret  the results of common diagnostic methods.
4. knows principles and practical skills about acute and complicated dental diseases (pericoronaritis,periostitis, alveolitis, dental luxation...)
5. knows technique of extraction of lower and upper jaw teeth.
6. knows treatment and after-treatment of abscesses in oral cavity 
7. knows different antibiotics and principles of treatment

10. at the end of the practice a student compose an account and the certificate of character signed by a lecture.

kirjeldus_et: Euroopa pronksi- ja rauaaja loengukursuses keskendutakse eelkõige Euroopa (Lääne-, Kesk- ja Lõuna-Euroopa) pronksi- ja rauaajale. Kursust alustatakse metalliaja algusega seotud probleemide - esimeste metallide kasutuselevõtt, vaseaja ja varase pronksiaja kultuurid - lahkamisest. Seejärel keskendutakse peamistele metalliaja kultuuridele ja tähtsamatele leiupiirkondadele, samuti majanduse, kaubanduse ja ühiskonna arenguga seotud küsimustele. Ühtlasi seostatakse pronksi- ja rauaaja arheoloogiline materjal antiikmaailma ajaloolistest allikatest teadaoleva andmestikuga nn barbaarsete rahvaste kohta (keldid, germaanlased jt). Kursus lõpeb ülevaatega Euroopa rahvasterännuajast.
kirjeldus_en: The course of lectures will mostly concentrate on the European (i.e. West-, Central- and South-European) Bronze and Iron Ages. In the introductory part the problems concerning the start of the Metal Ages - such as the distribution of first artefacts made of metal, the cultures of the Cupper and the Earliest Bronze Age - are discussed. In the following, the main cultures and regions of the Metal Ages as well as the aspects of the development of economy, trade and society will be analysed. Archaeological evidence of the Bronze and Iron Ages will be compared with data about the so-called barbarian peoples (e.g. the Celts, Germanic tribes) achieved from written sources of the classical Ancient World. In the final lectures, the European Migration Perion will be treated.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course:
- *knows the main developmental trends of the Bronze and Iron Ages in Europe
- *has knowledge about the main archaeological cultures of the Bronze and Iron Ages in Europe
- *is capable to use this knowledge in the study of particular research tasks
- *can find additional information in this field
- *evaluates European archaeological heritage

kirjeldus_et:
Aine sisuks on kirjaliku uurimuse koostamine. Uurimistöö peab vastama õigusteaduskonna nõukogu poolt kinnitatud kirjalikele töödele esitatavatele nõuetele. 
1. Üliõpilase uurimustöö on üliõpilase poolt valitud teemal ja õppejõu juhendamisel koostatud kirjalik uurimus.
Uurimistöö teema valib üliõpilane kooskõlastatult juhendajaga kaitsmisele eelneval sügissemestril 15. oktoobriks.
2. Kirjalik uurimustöö peab vastama oma sisult ja mahult juhendava õppejõu poolt määratud nõuetele, sisaldama 6 EAP ulatuses iseseisvat tööd ning olema kirjutatud arvutitrükis 1,5-intervallise reavahega, 12-punktilise tähesuurusega, ca 2000 tähemärki leheküljel, Times New Roman'i kirjas (ligikaudne maht ca 20-25 lk). Kirjalike tööde esitamisel tuleb kinni pidada kehtestatud lõpptähtaegadest (vt akadeemiline kalender).
Juhendajaks võivad olla õigusteaduskonna õppejõud või isikud, kes on oma ala tunnustatud spetsialistid, ning kellel on vähemalt magistrikraad või sellele vastav haridustase.
Juhendaja võib väljastpoolt õigusteaduskonda olla ainult juhul, kui selleks on mõjuv põhjus. Välisjuhendaja kooskõlastab üliõpilase avalduse ja välisjuhendaja kirjaliku nõusoleku alusel osakonna juhataja.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: Beatrice Veidenberg, Ivo Volt, Janika Päll, Kadri Novikov
kirjeldus_et:
Kursus hõlmab tutvumist antiikmaailma materiaalsete säilinud objektidega de visu kas antiikses Vahemereruumis või Euroopa kesksetes antiigipärandit säilitavates muuseumides. Sissejuhatavale seminarile järgneb tutvumine erialakirjandusega valitud objekti kohta, õppereis ning lõpuks teadmiste süstematiseerimine, mis päädib rühmatöö või õpimapiga.
  Kursust on võimalik läbida ka iseseisvat projekti läbi viies - see lepitakse kokku aine õppejõu(dude)ga.
kirjeldus_en:
The course make the students acquainted with some places in the ancient world in the Mediterranean region or in some central museums in Europe which hold the remains of ancient material culture. After the introductive seminar the students have to collect information from the relevant secondary literature and then to observe their situation in loco during the study trip. Finally the compilation of the questionnaire or portfolio for recording the collected data is planned.
  It is possible to pass the course by conducting an independent reasearch or project - this will be coordinated and supervised by the lecturer(s) of this course.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After the educational visit students: 1) can connect their theoretical knowledge about ancient world with the practical experience from the Mediterranean region,
2) know the main institutions and regions which are responsible for the preservation and storing of the remains from the ancient world.
3) is able to plan the visits to museums and cultural heritage objects, to do the research necessary for an educational visit. 
4) collaborates with fellow-students in planning and conducting the visits and in creating the end-project of the course.

The student, who chooses an independent project:
1) with the guidance of the lecturer plans and conducts a research project or
2) plans and helps to conduct and participates in an event, exhibition etc.
3) manages his/hers activities, reflects on the work process.

kirjeldus_et: Aines käsitletakse statistilist hindamisteooriat sügavuti. Koos tõestustega esitatakse klassikalised tulemused efektiivsest (parimast nihketa) hinnangust, piisavast statistikust, Cramer-Rao võrratusest, Rao-Blackwelli teoreemist. Tutvutakse statistikas tähtsa eksponentsiaalse jaotuste perega. Tuletatakse suurima tõepära hinnangu omadusi nagu invariantsus, mõjusus, asümptootiline normaalsus. Õpitakse suurima tõepära hinnangut leidma ka numbriliste meetoditega. Süvendatakse teadmisi hüpoteeside testimisest, vaadeldakse tõepärasuhte testi ja ühtlaselt võimsaimaid teste. Vaadeldakse usaldusintervallide ja usalduspiirkondade leidmist. Lõpuks käsitletakse statistilise sõltuvuse olemust ja selle liike, sõltuvuse mõõtmiseks defineeritud kordajaid ja nende valimihinnanguid. Praktikumide eesmärk on teoreetiliste tulemuste rakendamine praktiliste ülesannete lahendamiseks.
kirjeldus_en: Statistical estimation theory is considered in depth. The classical results about the best unbiased estimator, sufficient statistic, Cramer-Rao inequality and Rao-Blackwell theorem are presented with proofs. The exponential family of distributions is introduced, which is an important class of distributions in statistics. The main properties of the maximum likelihood estimator, such as invariance, consistency and asymptotic normality, are derived. Numerical methods for finding maximum likelihood estimators are also introduced. The theory of testing hypotheses is studied deeper, the likelihood ratio test and uniformly most powerful tests are considered. Interval estimation and finding confidence regions is studied. Finally, the notion of statistical dependence is treated, various dependence measures are defined and their estimation is studied. The aim of the tutorials is to apply theoretical results in concrete tasks.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab põhjaliku ülevaate kaasaegsest veebiarendusest, keskendudes Reacti ja Vue.js raamistikele. Õppijad omandavad praktilisi oskusi dünaamiliste üheleheliste veebirakenduste (SPA) loomiseks, kasutades komponentidel põhinevat arhitektuuri, olekuhaldust, kliendipoolset suunamist ja API-de integreerimist. Kursus on jagatud kaheks võrdseks osaks: esimene pool keskendub React-ile, teine Vue.js-ile. Kursuse läbimisel suudab õppija iseseisvalt arendada ja juurutada kaasaegseid veebirakendusi mõlemas raamistikus.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides a comprehensive introduction to modern front-end web development with React and Vue.js. Students will acquire practical skills in building interactive and modular single-page applications (SPAs) using component-based design, state management, client-side routing, and API integration. The course is divided into two equal parts: the first half focuses on React, the second on Vue.js. By the end of the course, students will be able to develop, structure, and deploy modern web applications independently using both frameworks.
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of this course, students should be able to:
- •	Can set up and configure front-end projects using both React and Vue.js.
- •	Can create reusable and modular components using JSX (React) and template syntax (Vue).
- •	Understands and applies state management, routing, and lifecycle methods in both frameworks.
- •	Is able to build forms with validation and connect applications to external APIs.
- •	Can manage global state using Context API or Redux in React and Pinia in Vue.
- •	Can deploy modern web applications using tools such as Firebase or Vercel.
- •	Is able to evaluate and compare different front-end frameworks for project-specific needs.

kirjeldus_et: Ainekursus keskendub küsimustele, mis seonduvad globaliseerumisest tulenevate religioossete ja teoloogiliste väljakutsetega. Olukorras, kus Euroopa linnades elavad koos kristlased, moslemid, budistid ja teised, on vältimatu mitmesuguste pingete teke. Sellest tõdemusest on saanud alguse akadeemiline valdkond, mis küsib erinevate religioonide teoloogiliste kontseptsioonide "tõlgitavuse" järele ning püüab adekvaatselt vastata globaliseerumise väljakutsele. Kursuse läbinu orienteerub kõige üldisemates dilemmades, mis teoloogide ees selles valdkonnas seisavad.
kirjeldus_en: The lecture course concentrates on the questions that arise from the religious and theological challenges related to globalization. In today's Europe, large populations of Christians, Muslims, Buddhists and others live closely side-by-side. This unavoidably leads to various tensions and misunderstandings. The field of interreligious theology emerged to address these tensions openly, with one of the central points of interest being the "translatability" of central theological concepts of various religions. The attendant is to have an overview of the most general dilemmas that theologians face in this respect.

Inimühiskonna varast arengut ja tsivilisatsioonide teket puudutavate seisukohtade evolutsioon antiigist tänapäevani, rõhuasetusega 20. sajandi ja eriti viimaste aastakümnete vaatekohtadele.

kirjeldus_en: Main theories of the development of state and civilisations. Principal case studies and their influence on the formation and development of the theories. Anthropological, archaeological and historical sources on the early development of human societies and the emergence and development of early civilisations.

- The ability to see the reasoning and evidence behind the theories, to connect the theories with the empirical evidence from history, cultural anthropology, and archaeology.
- The ability of critical estimation of different theories, and for forming and defending his/her own points of view about the formation of civilisations.

During the course, learners complete individual tasks as well as do pair and group work to develop language skills and their usage of legal vocabulary (incl. comparing terms in Estonian and English). 
Legal terminology topics: international law, private international law, commercial law, intellectual property. 
Learners will read a legal article of their choice and individually discuss it. As part of the task, they will also compile a short glossary of the terms in the article. 
Learners will make a team presentation on one of the ECHR decisions.

kirjeldus_et: Esitatakse termodünaamika põhialused (I ja II seadus, soojusmahtuvus, termodünaamiliste potentsiaalide meetod). Termodünaamiliste süsteemide tasakaalu ja stabiilsuse tingimused. Faasiruumi mõiste. Boltzmann-Maxwelli, Fermi-Dirac'i, Bose-Einsteini jaotusseadused.
kirjeldus_en: This course begins with the foundations of thermodynamics (I and II law, specific heats, heat capacity, entropy). Then we review conditions of stability and equilibrium of thermodynamic systems, foundations of statistical physics, develop the concept of the phase space. Finally we describe Boltzmann-Maxwell, Fermi-Dirac, Bose-Einstein distribution laws.

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus antakse ülevaade keskaja kunsti periodiseerimisest ning visuaalses keskkonnas toimunud olulistest protsessidest. Õpitakse tundma erinevat tüüpi ehitisi ja kunstiteoseid, käsitletakse kunsti tellimise, valmistamise ja annetamisega seonduvaid küsimusi. Analüüsitakse kunsti seoseid võimu, religiooni ja sotsiaalsete hierarhiatega. Käsitletakse sakraalhooneid ja -kunsti, liturgiat ja ruumiliigendust ning memoriaalkunsti, samuti keskaegsete teadmiste kajastumist kunstis, huumorit ja groteski. Arendatakse visuaalsete allikate kriitilise tõlgendamise oskust.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the periodization of medieval art and significant processes in the visual environment. Students will learn about different types of buildings and artworks, and will address issues related to art commissioning, production, and donation. The course will analyze the connections between art, power, religion, and social hierarchies. It will cover sacred buildings and sacred art, liturgy and spatial organization, as well as memorial art, the representation of medieval knowledge, humour and the grotesque. The course aims to develop skills in critically interpreting visual sources.

Üldistatud lineaarne mudel on klassikalise lineaarse regressiooni paindlik üldistus, kus uuritav tunnus ei pea tingimata olema normaaljaotusega. Jaotuste eksponentsiaalse pere defineerimisega koondatakse ühe nimetuse alla lai klass mudeleid, mille jaoks on välja töötatud  ühtlustatud lähenemine suurima tõepära meetodi hinnangute leidmiseks.

Üldistatud lineaarseid mudeleid võib nimetada "kõige arenenumaks lihtsate mudelite klassiks": nad on palju keerukamad tavalisest lineaarse regressiooni mudelist, aga säilitavad siiski tõlgendatavuse. Tõlgendatavus on üldistatud lineaarsete mudelite põhieelis veel keerukamate mudelite klasside ees ja seetõttu on nad heaks võrdlusaluseks paljudele masinõppe mudelitele, mille prognoosivõime võib olla parem, aga mille tõlgendamine ei ole enam ei lihtne ega selge.
kirjeldus_en:
Generalized linear model (GLM) is a flexible generalization of classical linear regression, where the distribution of response variable is not restricted to normal distribution. By introducing the exponential family of distributions, GLMs gather a wide range of models under one maximum likelihood estimation framework. 

GLMs can be considered as the class of "most advanced simple models": they go beyond the complexity of ordinary linear models, but retain the interpretability property. Thus, they serve as a benchmark for most machine learning problems, where non-linear relations are modeled and the interpretability is no longer clear nor simple.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course, a student
- - knows exponential family of distributions and is able to use these distributions in modelling
- - is able to select models with appropriate link functions and response functions
- - is able to fit  models with overdispersion
- - is able to find a suitable class of models to solve a given problem, estimate the parameters of the models, critically assess and interpret the results and analyze the practical implications

hindamise_meetod:
Praktikandil on kaks juhendajat, praktikabaasi poolne ja ülikoolipoolne. 
Ülikoolipoolne juhendaja hindab koostöö laabumist ning annab tagasisidet töökohapoolsele juhendajale ja praktikandile. Samuti annab ülikoolipoolne juhendaja lõpliku hinnangu praktika edukusele, kõrvutades töökohapoolse juhendaja hinnangut, praktikandi eneseanalüüsi ning isiklikke tähelepanekuid. praktikabaasi poolne juhendaja tutvustab praktikandile töökorraldust, annab talle konkreetseid tööülesandeid, annab praktika jooksul tagasisidet praktikandi tegevusele ning täidab hinnangulehe, mis koos praktikandi koostatud aruandega on aluseks ülikoolipoolse juhendaja lõplikule hinnangule.

kirjeldus_et:
Käesoleva 3- punktilise kursuse raames toimub 10 kahetunnilist loengut, harjutusülesanded, arutelud ning iseseisva töö ettekanded.
Teemad on järgmised:
1.Sissejuhatus geneetikasse. Ajalooline perspektiiv. Geneetika põhimõisted
2. Geenid ja kromosoomid. Autosoomid ja sugukromosoomid. Pärandumise põhialused
3. Geenide avaldumine. Epigeneetika
4. Muudatused pärilikus materjalis ja nende avaldumine ning mõju fenotüübile
5. Monogeensed ja komplekstunnused. Keskkonna mõju tunnuste avaldumisele
6. Käitumisgeneetika kujunemine. Käitumisgeneetika uurimismeetodid ning teemakohased harjutused
7. Intellektipuue ja selle monogeensed põhjused
8. Mitmete geenide poolt mõjutatud kognitiivsed probleemid
9. Psüühika- ja käitumishäired ja nende geneetilsised põhjused
10. Neuropsühhiaatrilise geneetika arengusuunad Eestis ja maailmas
Õppeainel ei ole eeldusaineid, mistõttu antakse kursuse raames ülevaade geneetika põhitõdedest piisavalt üldisel tasemel ning mahus, mis on vajalik käitumisgeneetika temaatika mõistmiseks.
kirjeldus_en:
The current course (3 EAP) includes 10 2-hour lectures, practical exercises and discussion seminar.
The topics to be covered, are:
1. Introduction to genetics. Historical perspective. The basic concepts of genetics
2. Genes and chromosomes. Autosomes and sex chromosomes. The main principles of inheritance
3. Expression of genes. Epigenetics
4. Changes in genetic material, their phenotypic effects
5. Monogenic and complex traits. The influence of the environment on complex traits
6. The development of behavioural genetics. Study methods used in behavioural genetics. Practical exercises
7. Cognitive disabilities and the underlying monogenetic causes
8. Cognitive abilities and underlying polygenic causes
9. Mental- and behavioural disorders and their genetic causes
10. The current state of neuropsychiatric genetics in Estonia and globally
There are no prerequisite subjects for this course and thus, half of the course will concentrate on basics of genetics which will be taught at general level but sufficient to understand the principles of behavioural genetics.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the subject:
- 1. has acquired the basic principles of genetics, to understand the main laws of genetics
- 2. is able to place the contemporary knowledge of genetics into the context of human behavior and psychology
- 3. understands and explains the research results in the field of behavioural genetics

In grammar and syntax the rules of succession of the words in a sentence and the dependence of the meaning of a sentence on it, expression of tenses, persons and other grammatical functions in Chinese as well as special functional words and affixes and measure words will be learned. Mastering the writing of characters and calligraphy as well as knowing their etymology will be accented.

nimi_en: Military Conflicts in the Middle East (20th - 21st Centuries)
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Ainekursuse alguses tutvustatakse Lähis-Ida ja muude lähipiirkonna riikide paiknemist (sh Araabiamaad, Iisrael, Iraan, Afganistan, Pakistan jne) hetke maailma poliitilisel kaardil. Ühtlasi antakse ülevaade tähtsamatest eristustest rahvusliku päritolu ja usulistesse gruppidesse jaotumise alusel. Kursuse eesmärkide omandamise ja mõistmise eelduseks on kogu regiooni ajaloolis-poliitiliste jõujoonte kujunemise lühiülevaade: islami päritolu ja levik, teiste usuliste gruppide mõjud, Iisraeli riigi teke, NSVL (Venemaa), USA (NATO) ning Hiina mõjud Külma sõja ajal ning ka kaasajas. Samuti on oluline mõista sõjaliste konfliktide religioossete põhjuste mehhanisme nii islami kui judaismi seisukohalt, kuid samuti eri lääne ideoloogiate perspektiivis. 

Pikemalt peatutakse I maailmasõja aegsel ja järgsel Lähis-Ida poliitilisel kujunemisel, sealjuures araablaste vabanemine Türgi impeeriumi kolonialismist; Iraagi, Süüria, Liibanoni, Jordaania riigi teke, poliitilised arengud Pühal Maal; II maailmasõja lõppemisele järgnenud Iisraeli riigi sünd ning hilisemad sõjad; Iraani, Iraagi, Egiptuse, Liibüa, Tuneesia, Saudi Araabia, jne riikide pingekolded ja konfliktid. Loomulikult kõige tähtsamate seast käsitletakse eraldi just ka Suessi kriisi, Seitsmepäevast sõda 1967. a ja selle tulemeid, 1973. a Yom Kippuri sõda, Iraani islamirevolutsiooni, Iraagi-Iraani sõda, Esimest ja Teist Lahesõda, Araabia kevadet, ISISe sõda ja mitmeid teisi. Samuti käsitletakse olulisemaid rahulepinguid nagu näiteks Camp Davidi lepped, Oslo lepped ja Abraham Accordsi lepped. 
Ühe kõige olulisema püsiteemana ka kogu viimase ligi sajandi maailmapoliitikas võetakse vaatluse alla Iisraeli-Palestiina konflikti ajalugu ja hetkeseis (sh Hamasi ja Hezbollah sõjad, Venemaa mõju Süürias, Iraani mõjutegevus, jne), arenevad konfliktid ja ka rahuprotsessid teistes araabia- ja islamimaades eesmärgiga mõista või arvesse võtta tulevasi potentsiaalseid arenguid.
kirjeldus_en:
The initial part of the course gives an overview of the geography of the Middle-Eastern political and geopolitical map (Arab countries, Israel, Iran, Afghanistan, Pakistan, etc). The most important national and religious groups of the region are introduced. To understand the pluralistic nature of the area, the short introduction to the evolution of historical, religious and political developments of the region is given, including the origins and spread of Islam, influences of other religious groups, birth of the state of Israel, Soviet (Russian), USA (NATO) and China during the Cold War and after. 
 
Among several points of interest, the developments during and after the World War I are explained, including the liberation of Arabs from the Ottoman colonialism; founding of the States of Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan; political developments in the Holy Land, the creation of the State of Israel after World War II and later wars; different tensions and wars involving Iran, Iraq, Egypt, Saudi-Arabia, Libya, etc. are introduced. Of course, among the most important ones, the Sues Crisis, Six Day War in 1967 and its consequences, 1973 Yom Kippur War, Islamic Revolution in Iran and Iraq-Iran War, First and Second, Gulf Wars, Arab Spring, ISIS wars and many others are analysed including the consequent different peace deals such as Camp David Accords, Oslo Accords, Abraham Accords, etc. 
As one of the most important and also constant topics in the world politics and geopolitical problems during almost more than a century, the history and present situation  Israeli-Palestinian conflict (including Hamas and Hezbollah Wars, Russian influence in Syria, Irani influence, etc.) is introduced and anlysed during the whole course combined with  the overview of developing conflicts and/or peace processes in other Arabic or majority Islamic countries for being able to evaluate the possible future developments in the region.
opitulemused_en: - A student who has passed the course has an overview of contemporary political situation of the Middle Eastern region which is a prerequisite for being involved with this region either through culture, business, politics or diplomacy. The course also explains the general history of the area, the mechanisms of religious and political situation of the Middle-East, all of which is needed for indepth research on any further specific issue.

Aine kood: FLKU.10.014 | Nimi (ET): Lähis-Ida sõjalised konfliktid (20.-21. sajandil) | Nimi (EN): Military Conflicts in the Middle East (20th - 21st Centuries) | EAP: 3.0 | Semester: kevad | Õppeastmed: bakalaureuseõpe, doktoriõpe, magistriõpe | Õppetöö vorm: päevaõpe | Keel: inglise keel | Hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi) | Linn: Tartu linn | Teaduskond: humanitaarteaduste ja kunstide valdkond | Õppejõud: Art Johanson, Peeter Espak | Toimumisajad: Teisipäev | Kirjeldus: Ainekursuse alguses tutvustatakse Lähis-Ida ja muude lähipiirkonna riikide paiknemist (sh Araabiamaad, Iisrael, Iraan, Afganistan, Pakistan jne) hetke maailma poliitilisel kaardil. Ühtlasi antakse ülevaade tähtsamatest eristustest rahvusliku päritolu ja usulistesse gruppidesse jaotumise alusel. Kursuse eesmärkide omandamise ja mõistmise eelduseks on kogu regiooni ajaloolis-poliitiliste jõujoonte kujunemise lühiülevaade: islami päritolu ja levik, teiste usuliste gruppide mõjud, Iisraeli riigi teke, NSVL (Venemaa), USA (NATO) ning Hiina mõjud Külma sõja ajal ning ka kaasajas. Samuti on oluline mõista sõjaliste konfliktide religioossete põhjuste mehhanisme nii islami kui judaismi seisukohalt, kuid samuti eri lääne ideoloogiate perspektiivis. 

Pikemalt peatutakse I maailmasõja aegsel ja järgsel Lähis-Ida poliitilisel kujunemisel, sealjuures araablaste vabanemine Türgi impeeriumi kolonialismist; Iraagi, Süüria, Liibanoni, Jordaania riigi teke, poliitilised arengud Pühal Maal; II maailmasõja lõppemisele järgnenud Iisraeli riigi sünd ning hilisemad sõjad; Iraani, Iraagi, Egiptuse, Liibüa, Tuneesia, Saudi Araabia, jne riikide pingekolded ja konfliktid. Loomulikult kõige tähtsamate seast käsitletakse eraldi just ka Suessi kriisi, Seitsmepäevast sõda 1967. a ja selle tulemeid, 1973. a Yom Kippuri sõda, Iraani islamirevolutsiooni, Iraagi-Iraani sõda, Esimest ja Teist Lahesõda, Araabia kevadet, ISISe sõda ja mitmeid teisi. Samuti käsitletakse olulisemaid rahulepinguid nagu näiteks Camp Davidi lepped, Oslo lepped ja Abraham Accordsi lepped. 
Ühe kõige olulisema püsiteemana ka kogu viimase ligi sajandi maailmapoliitikas võetakse vaatluse alla Iisraeli-Palestiina konflikti ajalugu ja hetkeseis (sh Hamasi ja Hezbollah sõjad, Venemaa mõju Süürias, Iraani mõjutegevus, jne), arenevad konfliktid ja ka rahuprotsessid teistes araabia- ja islamimaades eesmärgiga mõista või arvesse võtta tulevasi potentsiaalseid arenguid. | Hindamise eeltingimused: Essee koostamine | Hindamise meetod: Ettekanne - uurimustöö (sh probleemi või teema selge esitamine ja mõistmine). kirjeldus_et: Kursuse eesmärk on tutvustada Korea kirjandust, keskendudes eelkõige 20.-21. sajandi teostele. Läbi kirjandusteoste katkendite, lühijuttude lugemise ning muude meediumite ja arutelude kaudu  käsitletakse peamisi teemasid korea kaasaegses kirjanduses ning seostatakse neid ka muude protsessidega korea ajaloos ning ühiskonnas. Tekstidena kasutatakse korea kirjanduse erinevate žanrite ja autorite ingliskeelseid tõlkeid.
kirjeldus_en: The aim of the coure is to give students an overview of Korean literature, mainly focusing on literary trends of the 20th-21st centuries. Through lectures, in-depth reading and discussion of selected short stories, and other mediums, we will examine the major themes that appear in modern Korean literature. The reading list consists of English translations of Korean fiction. Students are encouraged to look into Korean literary texts in transnational and trans-disciplinary contexts and to explore innovative ways to read them. In particular, we will follow the literary developments side by side with the evolution of historical events, and see how the two paths are inevitably interwoven.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of the course, the student
- 1. has an overview of the main trends and genres in Korean literature and has developed their literary analysis skills.
- 2. is able to connect the trends in Korean literature with historical events and the developments in Korean society.
- 3. has developed and practised their academic writing skills through written assignment(s).
- 4. has been able to develop their group work and discussion skills during seminars.

Every participant's practical task consists of conserving an item in lab conditions.

kirjeldus_et: Käsitletakse reumatoloogiliste autoimmuunsete haiguste etiopatogeneesi, diagnoosimist  ja ravi sidudes teoreetilise ettevalmistuse bed side õppimisega. Põletikulistest autoimmuunsetest  haigustest keskendutakse reumatoidartriidile, spondüloartriitidele ja difuussetele sidekoehaigustele (süsteemne erütematoosluupus, süsteemne skleroos, dermato- ja polümüosiit, vaskuliidid). Metaboolsetest ja degeneratiivsetest  haigustest on rõhk osteoporoosil, osteoartroosil ja  ainevahetushaigustel (podagra, pseudopodagra,jt) . Käsitletakse ägedate reumaatiliste situatsioonide lahendamist. Õpitakse diferentsiaal-diagnostikat ja erinevate (infektsioossed , geneetilised jmt) faktorite osalust haiguste vallandumisel ja kulus.
kirjeldus_en: The general approach is „from bench to bedside“ . The theoretical knowledge obtained will be fortified by real life patients at the rheumatology ward. Rheumatoid arthritis, spondyloarthropathies, diffuse connective tissue diaseases (systemic lupus, systemic sclerosis, vasculitides, dermato- and polymyositis), metabolic and degenerative musculoskeletal conditions (osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, gout) will be focused on. Also genetic and infectious factors for rheumatic diseases will be analyzed. The main rheumatologic emergencies will be discussed with appropriate management algorithms.

kirjeldus_en: This course gives an overview different partial differential equations arising in mathematical finance, their derivation procedures and numerical solution methods. In the computer labs students acquire practical skills for computing the prices of various financial options.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course the student
- 1. understands the procedure of derivation of partial differential equations for option prices;
- 2. Is able to derive various finite difference methods for solving the partial differential equations of mathematical finance
- 3. Is able to implement the numerical methods as computer codes in a high level language
- 4. Knows how to estimate the actual error of the result of a numerical method and is able to use the skills for computing the prices of concrete options with a prescribed accuracy.

kirjeldus_et: Õppeaine annab tervikliku ülevaate inimkäitumisest organisatsioonis. Käsitletavad teemad: juhtimine ja eestvedamine; organisatsioonide arendamine, muudatuste juhtimine, organisatsioonikultuur, ja selle seos töötajate vaimse tervisega; töörahulolu ja motivatsiooni toetamine; individuaalsed erinevused ja rühmad organisatsioonis. Pöörame tähelepanu teooria ja juhtimispraktika seostele.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives a comprehensive overview of human behaviour in the organisational context. Attention will be paid to the connections between management theory and practice. Topics covered: Management theories and their evolution, leadership, developing organisations, overseeing changes, organisational culture, motivation, individual differences and groups in organisations.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Following a successful completion of this course, students should:
Knowledge
have a systematic knowledge of the connections between human behaviour and organisation;
be familiar to the basic concepts and key areas of organisational psychology;
have the knowledge of the main principles and opportunities in applying organisational psychology.
Critical thinking
understand the impact of the organisation's internal and external environment upon the human behaviour in the organisation and have the ability to critically analyse this impact;
be able to critically analyse the principal texts and research results in organisational psychology;
be able to critically analyse problems and cases to do with human behaviour in the organisation, and provide solutions to these by drawing upon theoretical knowledge.
Presentation
be able to present comprehensive knowledge of human behaviour in the organisational setting and prove its validity in both written and oral form.
Collecting information
be able to find and make use of both written and digital information on issues relating to human behaviour in the organisation.
Approaches and attitudes
know and follow the ethical principles of operating in the context of an organization whilst performing roles in management and management consultancy;
show a desire to critically analyse organisational goals and use the knowledge in psychology to achieve these.

kirjeldus_et: Avaliku sektori ökonoomika analüüsib riigi (valitsuse) rolli majanduses. Kursuse läbimisel omandatakse avaliku sektori ökonoomika teoreetilised alused. Analüüsitakse, missugustel juhtudel turg toimib ja missugustel juhtudel tuleb valitsusel sekkuda. Sekkumise peamiseks ajendiks võib olla näiteks ebapiisav konkurents, välismõjud, avalikud hüvised. Valitsuse sekkumise vajadust ei analüüsita üksnes efektiivsuse seisukohast lähtudes, sageli on olulised ka jaotuse (nt vaesuse) küsimused. Käsitletakse riigipoolse majandusse sekkumise vorme (maksud, regulatsioonid, dotatsioonid jne) ning sekkumisega kaasnevaid probleeme (riigitõrked).
kirjeldus_en: During the course of public sector economics the role of government in economy is analysed. Students who pass the course aquire the theoretical basic principles of public sector economics and finances. The efficiency of markets is analysed and the reasons behind the government intervention are discussed. The justifications for interventions may be for instance monopoly power, extrenalities, provision of public goods. Situations that require government intervention are not always associated with non-efficiency of markets, the distribution (inequality) issues are also important. Different forms of government intervention (taxes, regulations, subsidies etc) and the problems accompanying interventions (i.e. government failures) are analysed.

Erinevate ülesannete kaudu laiendatakse üliõpilaste sõnavara.
kirjeldus_en: The course deals with the English lexicon and the issues of vocabulary acquisition. It has both a theoretical and practical component. Students learn about various aspects of the English lexicon (its size, composition - general and specialist vocabularies -, aspects of knowing a word, word formation) and how vocabulary is acquired (the organization of the mental lexicon, storing and retrieving words). They do activities to expand their own vocabularies.
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of the course, the student will be able to discuss
- - the structures and functions of words in English,
- - the structure of the English lexicon,
- - meaning with respect to individual words and meaning relations in the lexicon,
- - techniques and activities for understanding, remembering and using newly acquired lexis.

Esimeses osas käsitletakse järgnevaid teemasid: nimisõnad, artiklid, asesõnad, omadussõnad, määrsõnad, eessõnad, fraasiverbid.
kirjeldus_en: The course takes the form of seminars (28 hours) and independent work in Moodle (50 hours). The course covers the practical aspects of English syntax and morphology. The course lasts for two semesters. During the first semester, the following topics are covered: nouns, articles, pronouns, quantifiers, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions, phrasal verbs.
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of the course, the student:
- - is able to recall and paraphrase the essential concepts of the grammar topics covered during the course (nouns, determiners, pronouns, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions and phrasal verbs)
- - memorizes the English terminology necessary for analysing linguistic structures
- - analyses and explains the use of linguistic structures by referring to the appropriate grammar rules and using the appropriate terminology (including the analysis and evaluation of linguistic structures produced by the other students)
- - reads critically linguistic texts in English and synthesises new information by creating connections between texts and with previous knowledge
- - forms grammatically correct language structures in English
- - is aware of their strengths and weaknesses in English grammar and is able to find additional sources for developing their grammar skills

"Vene keel algtasemele II" on "Vene keel algtasemele I" kursuse jätkuks ja on mõeldud üliõpilastele, kes on õppinud vene keelt ühe semestri vältel või kelle teadmised vene keeles vastavad A1 tasemele.

opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- A student who has completed the course has acquired the necessary vocabulary and grammar, enabling them to use all language skills in the everyday-life topics covered during the semester: to understand and produce texts of various types, to converse, and to comprehend spoken language. The student is able to talk about their studies, future work, and hobbies, express opinions, and participate in discussions within the covered topics according to language level.

kirjeldus_et: Tänapäeva hiina keele hääldamise ja kirjutamise põhialuste õppimine. Pinyin'i baasil hääldamisharjutused. Hiina kirjamärkide algjoonte ja elementide loogika ning etümoloogia seletamine ja õppimine. Elementaarse suhtluskeele sõnavara ja kõnemustrite õppimine (tervitamine, enda tutvustamine, kontakti loomine, arvsõnad, õppetöö ja huvid, ostmine, jne). Elementaarse süntaksi ja grammatika reeglid.
kirjeldus_en: Teaching the basic rules of pronunciation and writing of Contemporary Standard Chinese. Phonetic exercises on the basis of pinyin. Teaching and explaining the logic of the stroke order and radicals as well as etymology of Chinese characters. Mastering the vocabulary and speech patterns of elementary conversation (such topics as greetings, self-introduction, making contact, using numerals, study and hobbies, buying, etc). Elementary rules of syntax and grammar.
opitulemused_en: - After passing the course, students (1) know and are able to practice the principles of the Chinese pronunciation on the basis of pinyin phonetic alphabet; (2) know the rules of writing of Chinese characters and are able to write them in the correct way; (3) are able to communicate in Chinese to establish contact and exchange polite expressions in different situations.

nimi_et: Visioonid impeeriumist: Briti impeerium ja kaunid kunstid
nimi_en: Visions of Empire: The British Empire and the Arts
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb Briti Impeerium kajastamist kunstis, maade avastamiste aegadest impeeriumi lagunemiseni. Erilise tähelepanu all on India kui impeeriumi kroonijuveel, kus väljamõeldu ja teostatu jõudis hiljem kõigisse dominioonidesse ja kolooniatesse. Kursus on illustreeritud rikkaliku pildimaterjaliga, aga eeldatakse ka 6 EAP ulatuses iseseisvat tööd tekstidega, mida on samuti küllalt palju.
kirjeldus_en: The course will explore how the British Empire was depicted in the arts, from the age of exploration to the disintegration of empire. India as the jewel in the imperial crown will be central to the discussion, as things devised and employed there were sooner or later implemented in other parts of the empire. The course is richly illustrated with pictorial material. However, the reading material is also quite copious, as befits a 6 ECTS course. The course ends with a non-graded exam. Revision questions will be available from the beginning of the course and you can use your materials freely at the exam. This use, however, has to be creative, not just copying answers from books, so that I can see that your grasp of material is adequate. In order to qualify for the exam you have to participate in at least 8 sessions from the overall 10, the introductory lecture not being among those ten.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- will be able to navigate in the cultural spaces explored during the course, being aware of the political agenda behind stylistic developments, their native antecedents and cultural implications. And on the very basic level the student would just be aware of the vast and now rapidly disappearing cultural heritage.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Eksamile kvalifitseerumiseks tuleb osaleda minimaalselt 8 sessioonil 10st, kusjuures sissejuhatav loeng ei kuulu nende sessioonide hulka.
hindamise_meetod: Kursus lõpeb mittehindelise eksamiga, kusjuures kordamisküsimused on kursuse algusest peale teada. Eksam toimub lahtiste materjalidega, kuid eeldatakse mitte raamatust konkreetse materjali ümberkirjutamist, vaid arutlevaid vastuseid, mis näitavad võimekust töötada materjalidega loovalt.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb  Skandinaavia kirjanduse peamiseid suundi, epohhe, autoreid ja teoseid perioodil 16. sajandist kuni tänapäevani. Kursuse keskmes on tekstide lugemine ja analüüs; väljavalitud tekstid illustreerivad Norra, Rootsi ja Taani kirjandusajaloo tähtsamaid autoreid ja teoseid. Norra filoloogide puhul on rõhuasetus tehtud rootsi ja taani kirjandusele; rootsi filoloogide puhul norra ja taani kirjandusele ning taani filoloogide puhul norra ja rootsi kirjandusele. Samas tuuakse esile Skandinaavia kirjanduse üldiseid suundumusi ning selgitatakse paralleele ja erinevusi erinevate maade vahel.
kirjeldus_en: The course offers an overview of the central trends, epochs, authors and works in Scandinavian literature from the 16th century to present day. The main emphasis is on reading and analysing various texts; the texts chosen illustrate the most significant authors and works in Norwegian, Swedish and Danish literary history. For students of Norwegian philology, emphasis is on Swedish and Danish literature; for Swedish philologists, on Norwegian and Danish literature; and for Danish philologists, on Norwegian and Swedish literature. Besides that, overall trends in Scandinavian literature are introduced, and parallels and differences between the countries are explained.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Eksamile pääsemise eelduseks on aktiivne osavõtt auditoorsest õppetööst, suuliste ettekannete pidamine õppejõududega kokkulepitud teemadel.

nimi_en: Czech for Beginners II, Level A1.2 > A2.1
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)

kirjeldus_en: Continuation of a complex course on studying the Czech language. The basic accent is concentrated on morphology and development of oral and written skills. Conducting conversations, writing of brief essays, reading and translation of educational texts and fiction.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student, who passed the second part of the course on studying the czech language acquires knowledge of the language at level A2.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
1) Kohustuslik osavõtt õppetööst (75%)
2) 3 kontrolltööd semestri jooksul

kirjeldus_en: This course provides an introduction to digital product management. We begin with the business model of a digital product, discuss how to come up with ideas and innovate digital products, learn about customers' needs via user research, manage requirements and work with the concept of MVP, how to do user testing, manage the product roadmap, manage risks, and discuss product metrics.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completing this course, students will be able to:
- * Describe, analyze, and develop a business model for a digital product
- * Apply different ideation techniques for product innovation, and conduct user research to understand user needs
- * Elicit and formulate requirements for digital products, and understand what constitutes a good user experience
- * Define and determine the minimum viable product of a digital product
- * Conduct user testing, manage risks associated with digital products, and work with a roadmap of the digital product
- * Use quantifiable data to monitor, analyze, and assess the performance of a digital product

kirjeldus_et: Loengukursuses ehitatakse mõju printsiibist lähtudes üles laetud osakese ja elektromagnetvälja teooria 4-mõõtmelises formalismis. Tuletatekse osakeste ja elektromagnetvälja ja energia-impulsi ja impulsimomendi tensorid ning nende jäävus. Kirjeldatakse elektromagnetlaineid laenguvabas ruumis, suvaliselt liikuva laengu välja (elektromagnetlainete kiirgamist) ning laengute süsteemi välja suurtel kaugustel süsteemist (multipoolreaksarendust).
kirjeldus_en: This lecture course, guided by the action principle, builds up the theory of charged particles and electromagnetic field in 4-dimensional formalism. The energy-momentum and angular momentum tensors for the particles and the field are derived, as well as the conservation laws. Finally electromagnetic waves in a charge-free space, the field of an arbitrary moving charge (radiation), and the field of the system of charges in large distances from the system are described (multipole moments).

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus on ülesehitatud poola keele vormiõpetuse ja lauseõpetuse praktilistel aspektidel. Tähelepanuallikateks on nimisõnad, omadussõnad, määrsõnad, eessõnad, tegusõnad jne. Põhiliselt õpitakse kursusel suulise ja kirjaliku kõne oskusi: lugemist, tõlkimist ja erinevate raskusastmetega tekstide analüüsimist.

Arutluste põhiteemad:
1. isiksused, huvialad
2. töö, hõivatus
3. tulevikuplaanid
4. linn, turism
5. inimestevahelised suhted
6. eetika
7. olmetarbed
8. televisioon, kino, raamatud
9. tehnoloogia ja leiutised.

Grammatika põhiküsimused:
1. tegusõna mineviku, oleviku ja tuleviku vormid
2. artiklite kasutamine
3. modaaltegusõnad
4. tingimust väljendavad laused
5. gerundiiv ja infinitiiv
6. passivi kasutamine.
kirjeldus_en:
The course deals with the practical aspects of Polish syntax and morphology. The major topics discussed are nouns, articles, pronouns, quantifiers, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions, verbs and tenses; the phrase and the sentence. Continuation of a complex course on studying the practical studying of language is connected with development of oral and written skills, and also with reading, translation and the analysis of texts of various complexity.

Main discussion topics:
1. personality, hobbies
2. job, employment
3. plans for future
4. city, tourism
5. interpersonal relations
6. ethics
7. household items
8. tv, cinema, books
9. technology and inventions

Main grammar issues:
1. present, past and future tense forms
2. the use of articles
3. modal verbs
4. conditional sentences
5. gerund vs infinitive
6. the use of passive voice
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- By the end of the course the students are able to use Polish grammar at level B1 and is capable to connect and compare knowledge from adjacent scientific areas. They are able to form grammatically correct language structures and explain their choices referring to the corresponding rules and using appropriate terminology.

kirjeldus_en:
The course gives an overview of the main periods of Spanish literature and the principal authors. Main authors of Spanish literature are introduced, above all departing from translations of Spanish literature in Estonian.
Reception of Spanish literature in Estonia; Medieval literature, the Renaissance and the "Golden Age", 18th- and 19th-century literature; 20th-century literature (1898 generation, 1927 generation, etc.).
opitulemused_en:
- 1)	Students taking the course will have knowledge about all major phenomena of Spanish literary history, its authors and works and their aesthetic-philosophic and ideological context from the Middle Ages till the end of the 20th century.
- 2)	A student has read at least 5 important literary Works (in Estonian translation) and is able to associate them with literary, historic and cultural context.
- 3)	A student presents a review-essay (10 pages) about the the obligatory reading material of older Spanish literature and makes a presentation about a work of modern Spanish literature.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate ja praktilise kogemuse hajussüsteemide realiseerimise erinevatest viisidest. Vaatluse alla tulevavad hajussüsteemide terminoloogia ja omadused, kaugprotseduuride süsteemid, hajusobjektisüsteemid, nimeteenus, hajusfailisüsteemid, sünkroniseerimine hajussüsteemides, transaktsioonid, ajateenus ja programmeerimine lõimedega.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview and practical experience in different ways of implementing distributed systems. The subjects include distributed systems terminology and properties, remote procedure systems, distributed object-oriented systems, distributed file systems, synchronisation in distributed systems, transactions, time service and programming with threads.
opitulemused_en: - After taking the course student must be able to describe and give practical examples about the basic properties of distributed systems: resource sharing, openness, parallel processing, scalability, fault tolerance and transparency. Student must be able to design a simple distributed system and explain the fulfillment of the following goals during design: naming, communication, software structure, load sharing and coherency management. Student must also be able to explain the security risks of the created system and be able to alleviate the risks. Student must be able to describe the programming models of threads and understand naming services, distributed file systems and Web Services. During the course students must participate in a group-project to create one distributed application using the knowledge obtained at the course.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus keskendub kultuuripärandi mõtestamisele ja rakendamisele erinevas geograafilises, ühiskondlik-kultuurilises ja majanduslikus kontekstis, pöörates ainelise kõrval süvendatumat tähelepanu vaimse kultuuripärandi sfäärile. Analüüsitakse kultuuripärandi rolli kohalikus, riiklikus ja rahvusvahelises kultuuripoliitikas ning majanduses, lähtudes erinevatest vajadustest ja võimalustest maailma eri piirkondades. Vaadeldakse minevikupraktikate, artefaktide, väljenduste ja suhtlusvormide kasutust tänases kontekstis, kus kaasaegse turisminduse, brändingu ja migratsiooni tingimustes toimib kultuuripärand ühiskondlik-kultuurilise ning majandusliku ressursina.
kirjeldus_en: The course explores conceptualisations and applications of cultural heritage in diverse geographical, social, political, economic, and cultural contexts, with particular focus on intangible cultural heritage. The role and place of cultural heritage are scrutinised in international, national, and local cultural policies, as well as in broader policy frameworks beyond the culture domain. To analyse the implementation of heritage-related policies at different heritage governance levels, the course relies on the experiences of various stakeholders (e.g., policymakers, public servants, heritage professionals and practitioners, scholars, etc.), studying good practices and challenges in work with cultural heritage. The processes of heritagisation are further discussed in relation to issues, including but not limited to ownership and rights, commodification, tourism, nationalism, globalisation, cultural diplomacy, sustainable development, etc.

Practical exercises include the analysis of real world economic situations according to the theory.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- At the end of the course students know the economic functions of financial institutions and markets having obtained specific terminology, and knowledge about development and structure of financial markets, regulation of markets, financial assets.
Learning outcomes.
At the end of this course, students will:
Have a knowledge of the functions and functioning of the various financial markets.
Have a knowledge of different financial instruments.
Be able to make investment decisions according to portfolio theory.
Be able to choose between different financial assets according to their risk respect to financial market participants.
Be able to analyse, and compare the financial assets according to users' needs and specific features.

Moodustab ühe osa ainest "Kirurgia" 12 AP
Praktikumide käigus läbitakse erinevate keha piirkondade luumurdude konservatiivse ja operatiivse ravi küsimused, aga ka artroosi ja artriidi operatiivse ravi võimalused. Luumurdude ja haiguste klassifikatsioonid. Selgitatakse, missugused on artroskoopia, osteosünteesi, artroplastika, lülisamba operatiivse ravi näidustused, meetodid ja tulemused. Vähemalt ühel korral osalemine polikliinikus ja traumapunki esmaste kabinetis. Visiidid traumatoloogia osakonnas, patsientide uurimine ja ettekandmine. Iga tudeng valmistab ette haigusjuhu analüüsi koos ravi teoreetilise põhjendusega, haigusjuht kantakse ette ja analüüsitakse ühel viimastest praktikumidest.
kirjeldus_en: Students passed the course should know classification of fractures and methods of conservative and operative treatment, diagnostics and treatment of orthopaedic diseases and polytrauma patients. Explanations are given about indications and treatment results in different surgical treatment options like: arthroscopy, osteosynthesis, arthroplasty, spinal fusions. At least one practical study will be held in policlinic with consultant and one in trauma emergency. Walk arounds in trauma department, investigation of patients and presentation. Every student should prepare patient case with theoretic analysis and present it one of last seminars.
opitulemused_en:
- Student, passed course:
- -	knows investigation of skeletal system
- -	understands principles of treatment of different orthopaedic conditions
- -	understands principles of treatment of injuries of skeletal system
- -	knows principles of physiotherapy in case of orthopaedic conditions and traumas
- -	understands critical situations and subsequently urgency in treatment connected to traumas and orthopaedic diseases

kirjeldus_et:
Räägime reisimisest ja minevikusündmustest, möödunud aegadest ja praegustest oludest, tulevikuplaanidest, peresuhetest, stereotüüpidest, moest ja kehast, meeleoludest, elumuutustest ja igapäevaelust, toidust ja tervisest.  Arutleme töö ja karjääri, pragmaatika ja viisakusreeglite üle. Käsitleme ka digikultuuri ja sotsiaalmeediat. Tutvume veidi hispaaniakeelse maailma pühade ja kommetega. 
Igapäevased kodutööd on kursuse edukaks läbimiseks hädavajalikud, nende ja tunnitöö sooritamiseks kasutatakse ka digitaalseid vahendeid. 
Grammatika:
- lihtminevik (pretérito indefinido), kestev minevik (pretérito imperfecto) ja täisminevik (pretérito perfecto)
- ajaväljendid 
- ser vs estar
- umbisikuline tegumood 
- imperatiiv jaatavas ja eitavas vormis 
- kaudsihitist kasutavad verbid (meeldima-tüüpi)
- pronoomenite kombinatsioon (CI + CD) 
- perifrastiline tulevik: ir a + infinitiiv
kirjeldus_en:
We will discuss travelling and past events, times gone by and present times, future plans, family relationships, stereotypes, fashion and the body, moods, life changes and everyday life, food and health. We will cover topics related to work and career, pragmatics and rules of politeness, as well as digital culture and social media. In addition, we will get to know some holidays and traditions in the Spanish-speaking world.
Daily home tasks are an essential part of a successful completion of this course. To complete these and class tasks, digital tools will also be used. 
Grammar:
- Past simple (pretérito indefinido), past imperfect (pretérito imperfecto), and present perfect (pretérito perfecto)
- time expressions
- ser vs estar
- impersonal constructions
- imperative in affirmative and negative forms
- verbs that take an indirect object (like "gustar", "encantar")
- combination of pronouns (CI + CD)
- periphrastic future: ir a + infinitive
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course students will
- use the Spanish language at A2 level, in oral and written form and within the acquired topics, according to the rules of orthography and pronounciation.
- They will apply conversation formulas, grammar at lower intermediate level, and basic vocabulary in dialogues, role plays, written texts and other communicative situations covered.
- They will express their opinions on general everyday topics, and gather and present information about the Spanish-speaking world.
- They will read and retell different types of texts, and complete written tasks required for academic communication and university studies.
- They will plan their time in ways that result in the completion of the requirements and use appropriate sources and digital tools to fulfil tasks.

Antakse ülevaade  vastutusõpetuse olulisematest õigusteoreetilistest koolkondadest. The issues concerned with tort law are also adressed. Particular attention is paid to negligence liability, vicarious, producyt liability and damages. In addition to the theoretical basis, the relevant court practice is examined in connection with discussed topics.

kirjeldus_et: Käsitletakse kaasaegse elektrokeemia aktuaalseid probleeme. Vaadeldakse metalli pindkihis aset leidva potentsiaalilanguse (nn. metallifaasi karakteristikute, nagu elektronide efektiivse massi, Fermi ekraneerimispikkuse ja laengukandjate tiheduse) mõju adsorptsiooniprotsessi ja elektrokeemilise kineetika seaduspärasustele. Antakse ülevaade voltamperomeetrilistest analüüsimeetoditest, korrosioonist ja galvaanilistest protsessidest. Samuti analüüsitakse elektrilise kaksikkihi, orgaaniliste ühendite ja ioonide adsorptsiooni ja elektrokeemilise kineetika kvantkeemilisi mudeleid. Käsitletakse elektrilise kaksikkihi ehituse ning reagentide ja produktide loomuse mõju laenguülekande-kineetikale. Analüüsitakse erinevate kütuseelementide (polümeerelektrolüüdil, fosforhappel, sulatatud karbonaadil, tahketel oksiididel põhinevad kütuseelemendid) tööprintsiipe.
kirjeldus_en: Some more hot topics of modern electrochemistry will be discussed. Influence of the potential drop in the thin surface layer (i.e influence of the metal phase characteristics: effective mass of electrons, Fermi screening length, density of charge carriers etc.) on the electrochemical kinetics of various processes (adsorption, electro-reduction of various ions) will be given. Also the corrosion processes and theory of voltametric studies will be discussed. Also the quantum chemical models for the electrical double layer structure, adsorption of organic molecules and ions as well as for electrochemical kinetics will be analyzed. Influence of the electrical double layer structure as well as of the nature of reagents and products on the charge transfer kinetics will be demonstrated. The basic principles of various fuel cells (polymer electrolyte, phosphoric acid, molten carbonate and solid oxide fuel cells) will be given.
opitulemused_en:
- Graduates have acquired adequate knowledge of planning and organization of  conceptions of the electrical double layer and corrosion processes, engineer's profession and career prospects in the labour market.
- Graduates are able to analyze, assess and offer innovative solutions to technical and technological problems in their speciality. Graduates are able to collect scientific and technological information, interpret and use the data in problem-solving and further training. Graduates are able to understand connections between different processes and to apply theoretical knowledge in authentic process planning and use as well as form proper attitudes to encourage creative activities in their speciality, sense of responsibility and life-long learning. Graduates have been prepared to work in the field of the electrical double layer and corrosion processes or in other specialized areas, demonstrating initiative and sense of responsibility. Graduates have acquired and are able to assess problems and role of the electrical double layer, corrosion processes and theory of voltametric studies in the development of society.

Eksam koosneb kahest alaeksamist: kirjalik test ja praktiliste oskuste eksam. Lõpueksami läbimiseks on vajalik sooritada mõlemad eksamiosad positiivsele tulemusele. Kirjalikku eksamiosa hinnatakse eristaval skaalal ja praktilist eksamiosa mitteeristaval skaalal. Lõpueksami lõpphinne on eristav.

Õppeaine maht ei määra selle aine küsimuste arvu eksamil. Iga õppeaine küsimuste arvu eksamil määrab lõpueksami komisjon. Eksamiküsimused on juhuslikus järjekorras, ühekaupa lehtedel ja küsimuste vahel saab esimesest kuni viimaseni vabalt edasi-tagasi liikuda seni, kuni eksamitöö on esitatud.

Ülesandeid jaamadesse võib tulla järgmistelt erialadelt: anestesioloogia ja intensiivravi, kliiniline farmakoloogia, onkoloogia, silmahaigused, üldkirurgia, veresoontekirurgia, traumatoloogia ja ortopeedia, lastekirurgia, pulmonoloogia ja torakaalkirurgia, uroloogia, kardioloogia, sisehaigused, gastroenteroloogia, endokrinoloogia, reumatoloogia, nefroloogia, hematoloogia, infektsioonhaigused, kriitilised seisundid erakorralises meditsiinis, kõrva-nina-kurguhaigused, lastehaigused, naha- ja suguhaigused, naistehaigused ja sünnitusabi, neuroloogia ja neurokirurgia, perearstiteadus, psühhiaatria, taastusravi.
kirjeldus_en:
The exam consists of two sub-exams: a written test and a practical skills exam. To pass the final exam, it is necessary to pass both parts of the exam with a positive result. The written part of the exam is graded on a differentiating scale and the practical part of the exam on a non-differentiating scale. The final grade of the final exam is differentiating.

The exam consists of questions that check knowledge on the clinical subjects of the medical curriculum (internal medicine with infectious diseases, thoracic and cardiac surgery, specialties of surgery (incl. general surgery, vascular surgery, urology, and pediatric surgery), traumatology and orthopedics, oncology, anesthesiology, intensive care and emergency medicine, gynecology and obstetrics, pediatrics, neurology with neurosurgery, psychiatry, skin and venereal diseases, ear, nose and throat diseases, eye diseases, and family medicine). The volume of the course does not determine the number of questions in the exam in that subject. The number of questions for each subject in the exam is determined by the examination committee. The exam questions are in random order, one by one on the pages, and one can freely move back and forth between the first to the last question until the exam work is submitted.

The practical exam is conducted in the format of an objective structured clinical exam (OSCE). The tasks of the practical exam are divided into exam stations.
opitulemused_en:
- In the final exam:
- 1.	The student proves the achievement of the objectives of the curriculum.
- 2.	Shows that he has acquired professional knowledge and skills.
- 3.	Demonstrates the ability to apply the knowledge and skills acquired in the curriculum in a simulated environment.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Completing the curriculum of Medicine in full.
hindamise_meetod:
The exam consists of 10-15 stations. At each station, one task must be completed within 8 minutes, preceded by a 2-minute period for task review (including transition time from the previous station). The tasks are based on realistic clinical scenarios.
Skills are assessed across five categories:
1. Taking patient history
2. Describing objective findings
3. Planning investigations and interpreting results
4. Prescribing treatment, performing procedures, and evaluating treatment outcomes
5. Communicating with and counselling the patient

kirjeldus_et:
Kursusel osalemise eelduseks on Euroopa keeleõppe raamdokumendi keeleoskustase A2.
Auditoorsed kohtumised toimuvad prantsuse keeles, äärmisel vajadusel võetakse selgituste andmisel appi inglise keel. Tudeng võiks tunnis kasutada võimalikult palju prantsuse keelt, kuid inglise keel ei ole hädaolukorras keelatud.
Palju pööratakse tähelepanu suulisele väljendusoskusele ja suulise teksti mõistmisele. Samuti korratakse ja õpitakse mitmeid grammatikastruktuure (nt enneminevik, oleviku partitsiip, gerundium, tingiv kõneviis, subjunktiivi olevik, mineviku infinitiiv jne).
Puudutatakse ka prantsuse kultuuriteemasid. Võimalusel kasutatakse lisaks ehtsaid keelelisi allikaid, et tudengid harjuksid autentse keelega.
kirjeldus_en:
The course presupposes the Council of Europe Level A2.
The course will be given in French but English might be used for specific and technical explanations in case of misunderstanding. Students are expected to speak French during the course but might use English if necessary. 
A particular focus will be given to the oral comprehension and expression. Some grammar structures will be studied as well such as the past perfect, present participle, gerund, past infinitive, conditional, present subjunctive etc.
Various topics related to french culture will be studied during the semester. Authentic documents will be given as much as possible, in order to familiarize students to an authentic language.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student:
- At the end of the level, students will be able to express their opinion on simple topics and to deal with everyday life situations in french. They will be able to understand conversations about familiar topics and to identify the main points. They will also be able to have a conversation on a familiar topic with a french speaker.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus on mõeldud neile, kelle igapäevane töö või teadussuund pole seotud arvutusliku bioloogiaga. Kursuse raames õpivad tudengid tundma mõningaid levinud veebipõhiseid ja Linux käsurea tööriistu ja nende tööpõhimõtet.

Teemad, mida kursuse raames uurime:
- bioinformaatilised andmebaasid
- genoomse DNA sekveneerimine, annoteerimine, võrdlemine ja evolutsioon
- järjestuste homoloogia võrdlemine
- PCR praimerite disain
- Linux käsurea programmid
- Perli skriptide kirjutamine
- järjestuste analüüs: genoomi kokkupanek, RNA-Seq, metagenoomika
kirjeldus_en:
This course is meant to those whose everyday work is not related to computational biology. During this course students will learn to use several web based and Linux command-line tools and algorithms behind these tools.

The following topics are covered:
- bioinformatics databases
- sequencing, annotation, comparison, and evolution of genomes
- sequence alignment
- PCR primer design
- Linux command-line tools
- Perl scripting
- sequence analysis: genome assembly, RNA-Seq, Metagenomics
opitulemused_en:
- After taking a given course, students:
- - can do simple nucleic acid and protein sequence analysis using sequence databases and perform keyword searches
- - can perform PCR primer design
- - use Linux command-line and write simple Perl scripts
- - can execute pipelines for genome assembly, RNA-Seq and Metagenomics
- In addition, students:
- - obtain an understanding what scientific questions can be solved by studying full genome sequences

kirjeldus_en: The course is sequel to Basic Latin 1, but now more attention will paid to questions of syntax. Constructions of sentence are analysed and easier passages of original texts are read.
opitulemused_en: - By the end of the course, students will be able to analyze and translate more complicated Latin texts, find the stems of nouns, verbs and adjectives, determine declensions of nouns and conjugations on verbs and form correct morphological forms. They are able to translate different participle forms, identify the most common pronouns and be familiar with constructions "accusativus cum infinitivo" , "nominativus cum infinitivo" and "ablativus absolutus". They are able to analyse complex Latin sentences and determine the functions of subjunctive sentences. Students are able to create simple sentences in Latin by themselves.

Samuti analüüsitakse erinevaid kirjalikke tekste ja pööratakse tähelepanu inglise keele sõnavara iseärasustele (kollokatsioonid, sünonüümide konnotatiivsed erinevused, register, sõnatuletus, idioomid ja väljendid). Grammatika seminarides käsitletakse süsteemselt inglise keele grammatikat (nimisõna, asesõna, artiklikasutus, demonstratiivid, adjektiivid, adverbid, lause, relatiivsõnad ja -laused, sõnajärg) harjutuste ja tekstide kaudu.
kirjeldus_en: The course is divided into two parts: Text Analysis and Practical English Grammar. The main focus of Text Analysis will be on enhancing vocabulary (collocations, connotations, register, word derivation, idioms and expressions) to help students to exchange ideas and express thoughts. In the grammar class the major grammar areas (noun, pronouns, use of articles, demonstratives and quantifiers, adjectives, adverbs, sentence construction, linking, relative pronouns and relative clauses, word order) will be revised through language awareness exercises.
opitulemused_en: - The aim of the course is to improve students' competence in written and oral communication in English as well as to enhance their vocabulary. The students will be able to analyse and explain grammatical constructions and their meaning using grammatical terminology.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse eesmärgiks on arendada kliendiga töötamise  kognitiivseid oskusi.
Kursuse teoreetilises pooles antakse ülevaade klienditöö strateegilisest planeerimisest kognitiiv-käitumuslikus raamistikus, kursuse praktilises osas luuakse klienditöö mudel ning läbitakse praktiliste harjutuste kaudu kõik selle mudeli osad. inglise keel 
The course is aimed at development of cognitive skills in working with a client. 
The theoretical part of the course gives an overview of the strategic planning of the work with a client in a cognitive-behavioral framework. In the practical part, a model for working with a client will be created and all the parts of this model will be worked through via practical tasks. The video session will offer an example how the acquired instrument of working with a client could be applied in solution focused perspective.
kirjeldus_en: The theoretical part of the course gives an overview of the strategic planning of the work with a client in a cognitive-behavioral framework. In the practical part, a model for working with a client will be created and all the parts of this model will be worked through via practical tasks.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student who has passed the course 
- has comprehensive overview  of the lifeskills theoretical framework and understands the lifeworld perspective of the client
- owns cognitive skills for strategic planning of work with a client and the instrument for their realisation
- knows cognitive-behavioural approach to client's problem; is familiar with main principles of the solution-focused short therapy.
