kirjeldus_et: Perearstiteadus on aine, milles käsitletakse perearstiteaduse arengut ja mõistet, perearsti töövaldkondi, -meetodeid ja -vahendeid; käsitletakse sagedasemaid terviseprobleeme ning sekkumise võimalusi esmatasandil, muuhulgas haiguste ennetamist ning tööd riskirühmadega. Põhitähelepanu osutatakse probleemikesksele lähenemisele indiviidile ja perekonnale ning treenitakse esmatasandi arstiabile iseloomulikku arstikku mõtlemist. Käsitletakse perearstiabi sisu erinevates vanuserühmades, erinevate vastuvõtu võimaluste metoodikat (kontakt-, kaug-, koduvisiit) ning ambulatoorse arstiabi iseärasusi võrreldes haiglameditsiiniga.
kirjeldus_en: Family medicine is a subject that covers the development and definition of family medicine, the scope, methods and tools of the family doctor's work, the most common health problems and the possibilities for intervention at primary health care level, including disease prevention and working with risk groups. Emphasis will be placed on a problem-oriented approach to the individual and his family, and on training in the medical thinking that characterizes primary care. The content of family medicine for different age groups, the methodology of the different types of consultations (contact, remote, home visits) and the specificities of outpatient care in comparison with hospital medicine will be addressed.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- is able to name the core values and characteristics of family medicine; knows the basic tasks of a family doctor; is able to name the main health problems that are referred to the primary health care center; have practiced the most common methods of examining patients in the primary health care center.

kirjeldus_et: Õppeaine põhitähelepanu on pööratud kriitilises seisundis olevale erakorralisele haigele. Osalemise eelduseks on arstiõppe nelja esimese kursuse läbimine. Üliõpilased õpivad antud aines  tundma erakorralise meditsiini organisatsiooni ja patsientide tiraaži põhimõtteid, omandavad eluohtlike sündroomide diagnostika ja ravi alused ning treenitakse taaselustamisvõtteid. Üliõpilane omandab raske trauma ja erakorralise kirurgilise haiglakäsitluse põhimõtted. Iseseisva tööna osalevad üliõpilased intensiivravi osakonna ravitöös ning esitavad arvestusel haigusloo. Omandatud oskuste ja teadmistega on üliõpilane valmis siirduma 6. kursuse praktikale erakorralise meditsiini osakonnas, kus omandatakse edasised oskused ja teadmised antud erialal.
kirjeldus_en: The course is primarily focused on critically ill patient. Students will learn about the organization of emergency medicine, the management of life-threatening conditions, principles of emergency surgery and management of severe trauma. Skills for adult cardio-pulmonary resuscitation will be obtained. Students will be involved in everyday work of department of intensive care and they will present summary of case report at examination. Knowledge and skills acquired during the course will prepare the student for the practice in emergency department, which is in the programme of 6th study year.

hindamise_meetod: Suuline arvestus. Üliõpilane esitab suuliselt lühikokkuvõtte haigusloost ning vastab ühele teoreetilisele küsimusele (vt. kordamisküsimused). Õppeaine arvestatud saamiseks peab üliõpilane olema saavutanud vähemalt 75 % õpiväljunditest.

Pööratakse üliõpilaste tähelepanu vigastuste kirjeldamisele ja selgitatakse selle tähtsust vigastuste tekkemehhanismi ja tekitamise aja määramisel. kirjeldus_en: During the course students get an overview of the nature and causes of death, injuries and their causing mechanisms, nature and causes of health damage, possibilities of laboratory investigations in solving juridical problems. Attention is paid to the importance of describing injuries and its role in determing mechanism and time of injuries and  to the juridical aspects of filling in medical documentation.
opitulemused_en: - Students can examine and describe injuries, know mechanisms of their origin, know legislation of medico-legal investigation of deaths and living persons. Sudents know doctor's obligations for examining patients with health damages and dead bodies in cases of external causes of death and know expert's rights and obligations performing expertise. Students understand how significant it is to fill medical documentation correctly.

hindamise_meetod:
The course consists of two parts: E-Commerce and IT Contracts.

Students must work through the prescribed literature and tasks in order to prepare for lectures and seminars. Knowledge of the materials and the solutions of the tasks will be verified during the discussions held in the courses and seminars.
Individual work must be performed for both parts of the course in addition to attending lectures and seminars and working through the prescribed literature.
The objective of the individual work is to provide an assessment concerning the student's progress in the course.

Differentiated assessment will apply to individual work. The grade for the course will be formed of two components:
1. the two pieces of individual work to be performed within the framework of part E-Commerce of the course - 50% and
2. the two pieces of individual work to be performed within the framework of part IT-Contracts of the course - 50%.

Students must achieve at least 51% of the maximum grade in both parts of the course in order to pass. The individual work can get up to a total of 100 points.
A negative result in one part of the course will result in a negative total grade. A negative grade in one part of the course will not prevent passing the second part of the course.

kirjeldus_en:
The course covers:

1. Copyright law vis-a-vis ICT
1.1. Basic principles of copyright in information society (incl. legal protection of software and databases)
1.2. Use of rights (e.g. free use, Digital Rights Management)
1.3. Use of copyrighted works (e.g. pursuant to law, contract, Creative Commons); non-free and free software licenses (BSD, GPL, MIT);

2. Industrial Property
2.1. Basic principles of the legal regimes of trademarks and domain names in relation to information society
2.2. Basic principles of patent law, design law etc regarding information society.

3. Enforcement of Intellectual Property Rights in the Information Age
3.1. Practical insight to litigation in IP-IT law;
3.2. Case law of national, as well as International courts or other bodies (e.g. ECJ)

4. Future of IP and IT law 
4.1. Stability of multistakeholder model of internet governance, possible successes and failures of rights management and enforcement etc.

kirjeldus_et:
Praktika eesmärgiks  on  aga  täiendada  õppuri  üldarstlikke  teadmisi,  tagamaks  tugevad  ning  laiad baasteadmised mis võimaldavad edasi õppida mistahes valitud erialal. Kliiniline praktika on eelnevalt täies mahus omandatud teoreetilisi teadmisi nõudev ja rakendav õppeaine. Kliinilise praktika raames on võimalus osaleda vastuvõtul ja lahendada sagedasemaid probleeme, millega patsiendid pöörduvad perearstikeskusesse, osaleda profülaktilise töö planeerimisel ja läbiviimisel ja teostada koduvisiite.
Perearstipraksises tuleb läbida 8 nädala pikkune peremeditsiini tsükkel. Peremeditsiinipraktikaks tuleb üliõpilasel endal sobiv praksis leida. Selleks sobib iga Eestis registreeritud  perearst  või  perearstikeskus  ning  välismaal  asuv  sarnase  profiiliga erialaesindaja või asutus. Peremeditsiini võib veel lisaks teha ka valiktsüklina ja   sooritamise  eelduseks  on  praktikabaasi nõusolek üliõpilane vastu võtta. 
Peremeditsiini  tsüklile  vastavad  seminarid  viiakse  läbi  elektroonselt Moodle õpikeskkonnas, kus tuleb valida ja analüüsida iseseisvalt 1 haigusjuht ja esitada kirjalikult aruteluks määratud töögrupis. Lisaülesanded on  täpsustatud päeviku vastava peatüki all.
kirjeldus_en:
The purpose of the practice is to complement the student's knowledge of general medicine, to assure strong and extensive basic knowledge that will allow the student to study any specialty of their choice. Clinical practice is a subject which needs and applies the previously acquired theoretical knowledge. During clinical practice, you can participate in appointments and solve most common problems the patients come to the family physician with, participate in planning and conducting prophylactic work and do home visits.
You need to finish 8 weeks of family medicine cycle in a family medicine practice. For the family medicine practice, the student needs to find a suitable practice place on their own. Every family physician or family medicine practice in Estonia or an abroad representor of the specialty or facility with a similar profile is suitable. Family medicine can additionally be taken as an extracurricular cycle and the prerequisite is the practice base's agreement to take the student.
Seminaries of family medicine cycle will be carried out electronically in the study environment of Moodle, where you need to choose and analyse 1 cases and present them for discussion in a set work group. Additional assignments are specified under the relevant chapter of the diary.
Everything that the student has learned during the five years can be used in practical work in family medicine. During the family medicine practice the student can do family doctor`s everyday work: resolve different problems in different age and gender groups, make home visits and do preventive work and give advice towards changing patient lifestyle.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. knows andis able to use patient-centred consultation methods in different age and gender groups of the patients and knows the core principles of the management of the chronically ill patients.
2. knows and is able to solve most common health problems in family practice (in different age and gender groups of the patients).
3. knows and is able to use most important prevention methods in family practice.
4. is able to give advice in changing patient lifesyle.
5 .knows the most important differential diagnosis principles in family medicine.
6. is able to choose and interpret the results of the most important laboratory analysis and other investigations used in family medicine.
7. knows the core principles of the management of the chronically ill patient.
8. knows how to use literature and to use evidence-based approach in family medicine.
9. fill the practice logbook  with purpose to help to achieve these goals. 
We have tried to include as few as possible fields that are used to check the sole performance of practice. You should fill out the practice logbook so that it would be a job for you and for no-one else!
In addition to everyday clinical work the student must practice the practical skills , make homevisits and take part in seminars.

kirjeldus_et:
Õpetatakse kompleksselt peamisi nahahaigusi ja seksuaalsel teel levivaid haigusi (käsitletakse epidemioloogiat ja patogeneesi, haigustunnuseid ja sümptomeid, haiguse kliinilist kulgu, diagnoosimist, ravi, rehabilitatsiooni ja haiguste preventsiooni. 

Käsitlemist leiavad dermatoloogias ja veneroloogias kasutatavad uurimismeetodid, naha- ja suguhaiguste patomorfoloogia, patofüsioloogia ja immunoloogia. 

Erinevate naha ja suguhaiguste õpetamise maht on mõnevõrra erinev - suhteliselt detailsemalt on käsitletud sagedamini esinevaid haigusi (nakkuslikud nahahaigused, allergodermatoosid, papuloskvamoossed nahahaigused, reaktiivsed erüteemid, autoimmuunsed villilised nahahaigused, rasunäärmete haigused, juuste haigused, kroonilised sidekoehaigused, vaskuliidid, nahakasvajad, seksuaalsel teel levivad infektsioonid), kuid tundma õpetatakse ka suhteliselt harvem esinevaid haigusi (pärilikud nahahaigused, troopilised nahahaigused).
kirjeldus_en:
The major skin diseases and sexually transmitted diseases are discussed in details (epidemiology, etiology and pathogenesis, clinical features and clinical course, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and prevention). 

The attention paid on different skin diseases and sexually transmitted diseases vary - diseases of higher prevalence are discussed in more details (i.e. infectious skin diseases, allergodermatoses, papulosquamous disorders, reactive erythemas, autoimmune bullous diseases, sebaceous gland disorders, hair disorders, connective tissue diseases, vasculitis, skin tumours and sexually transmitted infections), but relatively less prevalent diseases (genetic skin disorders, tropical skin disorders) are also taught.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course, the students should be able to:
- 1) understand the principles of the nature and diagnosis of the skin diseases and sexually trasmitted diseases, as well as the basic methods of investigation used in dermatology and venereology with an ability to interpret the results,
- 2) understand the essentials of epidemiology, pathology, pathophysiology and immunology of the skin diseases and sexually transmitted diseases,
- 3) autonomously investigate the patient with skin and sexually transmitted diseases and suggest the preliminary diagnosis of major diseases including infectious skin diseases, allergodermatoses, papulosquamous disorders, reactive erythemas, autoimmune bullous diseases, sebaceous gland disorders, hair disorders, connective tissue diseases, genetic skin disorders, vasculitis, skin tumours, tropical skin disorders and sexually transmitted infections.
- 4) suggest further methods of investigations necessary to confirm the diagnosis in certain situations and interpret the respective results,
- 5) suggest and substantiate complex treatment options, including systemic and topical treatments, dermatosurgery, cryotherapy, lasertherapy and phototherapy in various skin diseases and sexually transmitted diseases.
- 6) understand the principles of continuity of the care of patients with skin diseases and sexually transmitted diseases, rehabilitation and prevention of above mentioned diseases.

Käsitletakse antiikaja elamut, sööke ja nõusid, perekonnaelu, haridust, muusikat, seltskondlikke ja perekondlikke tavasid, linnade infrastruktuuri ja ühisteenuseid.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of the Greek and Roman antiquities, traditions, social relations, and the settings connected with everyday life, education and upbringing. During the course, the following topics will be treated: buildings of ancient times, food, family life, education, music, social and family traditions and public services.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After participating in this course students can relate the aspects of the realia in everyday life to the development of the motives in literature. They will be able to describe the conditions connected to the house, family life, music, leasure time, and various forms of the public services, which formed the basis for the cultural atmosphere in Ancient Greece and Rome. The students are able to compare the aspects of everyday life in Greek and Roman culture and associate the ancient and modern cultures. Student compiles a short research paper on one of the themes given at the beginning of the course, where he/she applies the aquired knowledge in the written form. Student analyzes one of his/her fellow student's paper and gives a ratiocinated feedback to it. Studens have had a practical experience in making ancient food or in some other aspect of everyday life.

kirjeldus_en: The subject gives overview of the health care institution functioning and the nature of the basic nursing care, concepts and nursing process. To monitor patients' condition and carry out basic caring procedures and easier nursing procedures is taught. Overview of the nature of the hospital infection is given and principles of a- and antiseptics are taught.
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course the student:
- - knows how a health care institution is functioning and how to behave in this environment;
- - can follow the principles aseptic and antiseptic, knows how to avoid the spread of hospital infection,
- - knows the basic nursing concepts and the nature of nursing process,
- - can assess patients' vital signs,
- - describe and carry out basic nursing procedures, care for the patient following living procedures,
- - knows the basics of pharmaceutical conduct.

Kursuse põhirõhk on suunatud maakoore ehituse, tema erinevate struktuuride, nende tekke ning arengu ja maakoort
moodustavate kivimite deformatsioonide tundmaõppimisele. Õpitakse tundma. Omandatakse struktuurse analüüsi
meetodeid, selgitatakse maakoore struktuuride kuju geoloogilistel kaartidel ja geoloogilistel läbilõigetel. Kursus annab
algteadmisi geoloogiliseks välikaardistamiseks jt. uuringuteks.
kirjeldus_en: This course is concerned primarily with the structure of the earth crust - offering description and interpretation, as well as formation, of geological structures and deformations of the sedimentary, igneous and metamorphic rocks in the Earth?s crust. The course is offering basic knowledge of geological maps and mapping - how the earth crust structures and deformations are mapped and designed on the geological maps.
opitulemused_en:
- 1.Struktuurigeoloogia olemus; maakoore kivimilise ehituse ja nende struktuuride (arhitektuuri) kirjeldamine selle kujunemisloo ajalis ruumilstest protsessidest ja suhetest lähtuvalt.
- 2.Selle väljund praktikasse; geoloogilised kaarid kui piirkonna maakoore ehituse (struktuuri) ja selle formeerumise ajalis-ruumiliste protsesside, tingimuste, keskkondade jmt. peegeldajad.
- 3.Struktuurse analüüsi ja selle erinevate komponentide sisu ja otstarve struktuurigeoloogiliste eesmärkide lahendamisel.

- 9.Settekivimite lasumusvormid ja nende esinemine geoloogilistel kaartidel.
- 10.Tektooniliste struktuuride väljendumine geoloogilistel kaartidel; reeglid nende struktuuride morfoloogia hindamiseks.
- 11.Magmakivimid geoloogilistel kaartidel.

Kursuse raames käsitletakse orgaaniliste ainete struktuuri määramise meetodeid, keemilisi ja aparatuurseid. Põhiliselt on vaatluse all IR, Raman, TMR-spektroskoopia ja massispektromeetria. Käsitletakse spektrite arvutamist, simuleerimist ja kompleksset interpreteerimist. Tutvustatakse TMR-spektroskoopia erinevaid meetodeid, k. a. dünaamiline ja korrelatsioon-spektroskoopia. kirjeldus_en: The aim of the course is to give thorough knowledge and skills about the structure analysis of organic compounds. The instrumental and chemical methods for determination of structure of the organic compounds will be presented.The main attention will be devoted to the IR, Raman, NMR and MS spectrometry. Calculations, simulations and complex interpretation of spectra will be also discussed. Different methods of NMR spectroscopy (DNMR, correlation NMR) will be introduced. Practical exercises and structure analysis complex tasks will be carried out. English speaking students can take a course, but earlier notice by e-mail is required.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students should know:
-the basic theory of magnetic behavior of the nuclei of atoms and how this is used in NMR spectroscopy.
-the phenomena of relaxation of the nuclei of atoms, the structure relationship and influence on the NMR spectra.
-the rules of splitting of the NMR signals according to spin-spin coupling of nuclei. They should be able to estimate the equivalency of different spin- systems and know the effects derived from topicity.
-the NOE effect, one- and multidimentional techniques of NMR, dynamic NMR and solvent effects in NMR spectroscopy.
-the fields of application of NMR technique, interpret the spectral information and requirements of publications of the NMR information.

kirjeldus_en: In quantum cryptography we use quantum mechanical effects to construct secure protocols. The paradoxical nature of quantum mechanics allows for constructions that solve problems known to be impossible without quantum mechanics. This lecture gives an introduction into this fascinating area. Possible topics include:basics of quantum computation, breaking crypto with quantum computers, quantum key distribution, quantum commitments (possibility/impossibility), quantum zero-knowledge.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course the student
- * knows quantum mechanics, quantum computing, and quantum cryptography
- * understands how quantum mechanics allows us to create protocols that achieve tasks hitherto impossible
- * understands the mathematical formalisms required to prove the security of quantum cryptographic protocols

kirjeldus_et: Arstiteaduskonna biokeemia on õppeaine, mille vältel tutvutakse metaboliitide ja teiste inimorganismi biomolekulide klassifikatsiooni ja nomenklatuuriga, omandatakse antud ühendite konfiguratsiooni, konformatsiooni ning stereokeemia põhialused. Kursuse põhitähelepanu on pööratud inimese metabolismis toimuvatele põhireaktsioonidele ning nendes osalevatele heterofunktsionaalsetele ja heterotsüklilistele metaboliitidele. Samuti käsitletakse biomakromolekulide, nagu peptiidide, valkude, süsivesikute, lipiidide ja nukleiinhapete ülesehitust ning biokeemilis-meditsiinilisi omadusi. Antud õppeaine viimane osa käsitleb segamakromolekule ning raku välismembraani ehitust. Kursus on üles ehitatud meditsiinikeskselt, st. reaktsioonide ja metaboloomi moodustavate biomolekulide näited on valitud inimorganismist lähtuvalt, kusjuures põhitähelepanu on pööratud nende reaktsioonide mehhanismidele, millel baseerub tänapäevase meditsiini diagnostika ja ravi.
kirjeldus_en: Biochemistry in Faculty of Medicine is a subject, which introduces medical students to the classification and nomenclature of human body biomolecules, explains configuration, conformation and stereochemistry of metabolites and other biomolecules. General types of metabolic reactions of human body and their biomedical background are important parts of subject. Furthermore, structure and biomedical characteristics of structural and functional biomacromolecules as peptides, proteins, carbohydrates, lipids and nucleic acids are introduced. Last part of Biochemistry deals with mixed macromolecules and structure of cellular membrane. This Biochemistry is medicine-based subject, therefore all examples of human body biomolecules and reactions are chosen on the basis of human metabolism and today´s medical diagnostics.

kirjeldus_et:
Valikkursus on mõeldud V kursuse üliõpilastele, kus käsitletakse nii seedetrakti üla- kui alaosa verejooksude põhjusi, epidemioloogiat, diagnostikat, raviprintsiipe (konservatiivne ja operatiivne), prognoosi ja profülaktikat. Käsitletakse nii kinniste kui lahtiste kõhutraumade epidemioloogiat, diagnostikat, raviprintsiipe, sealhulgas eraldi maksa, sapiteede, põrna, pankrease ja sooletrakti vigastusi.
Kursus annab ülevaate maksa- ja neerusiirdamise käsitlusest ja päraku piirkonna healoomuliste haiguste kaasaegsest käsitlusest.
kirjeldus_en:
The elective course is intended for 5th year medical students. The course deals with hemorrhages of the upper and lower digestive tract: their causes, epidemiology, diagnosis, treatment principles (conservative, operative), prognosis, porphylaxis; closed and open abdominal traumas, injuries of the liver, biliary ducts, spleen, pancreas and intestinal tract.
The course provides a survey of  the contemporary management of liver and kidney transplantation as well as of benign rectal diseases.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student knows
- 1)  the epidemiology, diagnostics, general treatment principles and possibilities of endoscopic treatment for haemorrhages of the upper gastrointestinal tract.
- 2) the epidemiology and diagnostic options of haemorrhages of the lower gastrointestinal tract.
- 3) development trends of laparoscopic surgery, specific complications and mechanisms of their origin.
- 4) indications for bariatric surgery and main principles of surgical treatment;
- 5) the algorithm of treating abdominal trauma (diagnosing + treatment).
- 6) the causes, diagnosing and treatment principles of constant pressure syndrome.
- 7) indications for liver transplantation, principles of pre- and postoperative treatment.
- 8) indications for kidney transplantation, principles of pre- and postoperative treatment.
- 9) diagnostics and main treatment principles of more common rectal diseases.

- enese ja teiste esitlemine (nimi, rahvus, elukutse);
- inimeste ja asjade tuvastamine või tutvustamine (Kes see on? Mis see on?)

- kodulinn ja elukoht

- sissejuhatus grammatika terminoloogiasse 
- häälduse alused
- numbrid

- määrav, umbmäärane ja liitunud artikkel
- nimisõna grammatiline sugu, omadussõna mees- ja naissoo vormid, mitmuse moodustamine
- eessõna "de" kasutamine nimisõna ees (nimisõnalise täiendi sidumiseks või kuuluvuse väljendamiseks)
- eessõna kasutamine maa- ja kohanimede ees
- eituslause
- küsilause, küsisõnad 
- possessiivid ehk omastavad omadussõnad
- isikulised asesõnad (lause alus, rõhuline asesõna)
- lähitulevik
- „Si" kasutamine("jah"- vastus eitavas vormis esitatud küsimusele)
kirjeldus_en:
The course presupposes no preliminary knowledge of French.
The contents of  the course as communication situations and vocabulary related:
- presenting oneself and others (name, nationality, profession)
- identifying or introducing persons and objects (Who is this) What is this?)
- expressions of courtesy (greetings, apologies, etc.)
- introducing oneself,  personal data (name, age, address, profession, marital status, etc.)
- work and studies
- leisure activities, sports, preferences
- hometown, living quarters
- dates, time, schedule
- making, accepting or refusing a proposition 
Grammar topics:
- introduction to the grammar terminology
- pronunciation rules
- numbers
- verb conjugation (present tense, indicative mood)
- article (definite, indefinite, contracted)
- nouns and adjectives (gender and plural)
- prepositions "de" and "à"
- prepositions before countries' names and other place names
- negative sentence
- interrogative sentence, interrogative words
- possessive adjectives ( adjectifs possessifs)
- personal pronouns (pronom sujet, pronom tonique)
- immediate future (Futur proche)
- using "Si" for "Yes"
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student will have acquired the necessary vocabulary and grammar in a way that it covers all four language skills in what comes to coping within everyday life matters treated during the language course: he is able to communicate in a simple manner; can write a short message or a postcard, fill in a form with personal data; is able to describe himself, his living quarters, family and acquaintances;  understands written and oral texts on familiar subjects.

oppejoud: Katre Luhamaa, Mary-Liis Mustonen, Silvia Kaugia, Sirje Kaljumäe
kirjeldus_et:
Õiguse entsüklopeedias käsitletakse riigi ja õiguse tekkimist ja mõistet, õigusnormide ja õiguskorra struktuuri, õiguse süsteemi, õiguse realiseerimist ja õiguse tõlgendamist ning õiguse efektiivsusega seonduvaid küsimusi.
Riigiõiguses tegeletakse põhiseadusest tuleneva riigi süsteemiga, sh võimude lahususega, põhiõiguste tähenduse ja rakendamisega, samuti sellega, kuidas saab algatada põhiseaduslikkuse järelevalve kohtumenetluse ja kuidas see toimub.
Haldusõiguse osas leiavad käsitlemist haldusõiguse põhialused. Samuti tutvustatakse haldusmenetluse ja halduskohtumenetluse põhimõtteid ja kohtupraktikat.
Rahvusvahelise õiguse osas leivad käsitlemist rahvusvahelise õiguse allikad ja põhiprintsiibid, rahvusvahelise õiguse subjektid, peamised teoreetilised koolkonnad, rahvusvahelise vastutuse põhimõtted ja ÜRO toimimine. Lühidalt peatutakse rahvusvahelistel inimõigustel.
kirjeldus_en:
The course comprises the fileds of encyclopaedia of law, constitutional law, administrative law and international law. The encyclopaedia of law is offering an overview of the origin and nature of state and law, the structure of legal norms and legal order, system of law, realization, interpretation and efficiency of law.
In the part of constitutional law treats of the questions of the state system based on the Constitution, among that the separation of powers, meaning and applying of fundamental rights, also the initiation of constitutional review procedure is dealt with. 
The principles of administrative law will be looked over in the part of the administrative law. This course also introduces the principles of administrative procedure and administrative court procedure. In addition to the theoretical basis, the participants will be acquainted with the acts of parliament and the jurisprudence in question.
Part dedicated to international law will look at the sources and main principles of international law, the subjects and main theoretical schools of international law. It also explores international responsibility of states as well as the functioning of the UN. International human rights law will be analysed as a material area of international law.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus katab järgnevad teemad:

* Digitaalsed tõendid ja nende erinevused klassikalistest tõenditest.

* Digitaalsete tõendite kasutamine ja säilitamine.

* Digitaalsete tõendite kogumine ja kasutamine kohtus.

* Küberkriminalistika.

* Küberkuritegevus.
kirjeldus_en:
The course covers:

* Digital evidence and its differences from traditional types of evidence.

* Use and preservation of digital evidence.

* Admissibility of digital evidence and tactical considerations.

* Computer forensics.

* True cybercrime - criminal activity inherently involving ICT (viruses, unauthorized access and data alteration).

* Cyberbullying and -stalking.

* Credit card fraud, identity theft and money laundering.

* Child pornography.

* Criminal procedure involving cybercrime and collection of evidence.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students:

* are familiar with general principles of digital evidence and can differentiate them from other types of evidence.

* understand how digital evidence is collected, analysed and used in court.

* know the process of handling digital evidence and are familiar with the tools and methods used by experts.

* can solve cases and analyse judicial decisions dealing with digital evidence.

* are familiar with general principles of computer forensics.

* understand the basic technical concepts of main types of cybercrime and main issues in cybercriminal law enforcement.

* can apply the rules of criminal procedure to a digital environment. 

* can identify and discuss problems arising of the intersection of IT, criminal activity and court procedure

Kursus toimub kombineeritult loengu vormis osade, vestluste, arutelude ja praktiliste töödega. kirjeldus_en: Translation: history, theory, practice gives an insight into translation studies covering topics from St. Jerome to Martin Luther and Anton Thor Helle and addresses exeptional translation practices from Johannes Aavik to Tõnu Õnnepalu. We will look at translation theory and translational practices through the important texts in translation history. We will analyze, compare and contrast and translate as well. The course combines lectures, discussions and practical sessions. The course concentrates on the texts from different genres with the focus on religious and literary texts. Unless instructed otherwise, the students have to prepare one commented translation (depending on the number of participants exchangeable with an essay or presentation). Other practical tasks will take place during the sessions.

- After passing the course student has an overview of the important events, texts and practices in European translation history;  is able to find relevant material for research, match it with methodology and analyze the findings with the help of a suitable
- The course aims to provide different angles to the meaning of the term 'translation' by means of historical contextualization and practice. The course will give the students a foothold in translation studies as well as cultural studies that is important both for future translators and aspiring (translation) scholars.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb sissejuhatavaid teemasid programmeerimiskeelte transleerimisel: regulaaravaldised, kontekstivabad grammatikad, süntakspuud ja koodi genereerimine. Keskseks teemaks on arvutiteaduse üks kõige olulisemaid mõisteid: induktiivsed definitsioonid. Kontekstivaba grammatika on mugav vahend induktiivselt defineeritud hulkade kirja panemiseks. Programmide ülesehitusest arusaamine on esimene samm selgema ja usaldusväärsema tarkvara arendamiseks. Enamus selle kursuse harjutused on loodud selleks, et just sellist arusaamist arendada.
kirjeldus_en: The course covers introductory topics in compiler construction, focusing on regular expressions, context-free grammars, syntax trees and code generation. Central to this course is one of the most important concepts in computer science: inductive definitions. Context-free grammars is a convenient notation for this. As structural induction is a fundamental proof method in formal verification, understanding the inductively defined structure of computer programs is the first step towards trustworthy program design. Most exercises in this course are designed to develop such an understanding.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion, the student will demonstrate a deep understanding of the structure and interpretation of computer programs by being able to:
- - Design a grammar to formalize the syntax of a simple toy language based on its informal description with examples.
- - Apply a parser generator and standard tree walking methods to parse programs of that language and obtain their abstract syntax tree.
- - Implement both an interpreter and a compiler generating (simplified) machine instructions.
- - Understand underlying concepts sufficiently to recognize true/false statements, classify and analyze grammars, determine words of a formally defined language, etc.
- The most crucial outcome of this course, however, is in the affective domain of learning. The student will come to
- - Acknowledge that bad programming inflicts real pain upon other people.
- - Appreciate the moral significance of code correctness in light of the ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct.

kirjeldus_et: Aine sisaldab loenguid ja praktikume. Üliõpilaste praktilise töö käigus toimub suu- ja hambahaiguste kompleksne ravi kogu semestri jooksul, töötades paaris kaasüliõpilasega. Üliõpilane arendab edasi oma diagnostika, ravi planeerimise ja teostamise oskusi osutades patsiendile hambaravi, suukirurgia ja hammaste proteesimise raviteenuseid. Üliõpilane teeb iseseisvalt kliinilist tööd, analüüsib igat oma raviplaani ja raviprotseduuri praktikat juhendava õppejõuga, tagasisidestatud protseduurid kannab oma e-portfoliosse.
kirjeldus_en: This subject contains lectures and practicals. In clinics students work in pairs. Practical clinical work consists of comprehensive treatment of patients with multiple oral- and dental diseases. Students develope further their treatment planning, diagnostic and treatment skills in oral pathology, cariology, endodontics, periodontology, oral surgery and prosthodontics. Practical training contains comprehensive treatment of patients. The treatment plan and clinical work performed by the student has been analyzed with the tutor, the student has received feedback and the work has been included in the student's e-portfolio.

opitulemused_en:
- Students
- can diagnose and treat patients using different diagnostic and treatment methods in complicated patients according to patients needs and possibilities.
- know dental ethics and develope excellent communication skills with patients and medical personnelle
- obtain systemic approach to oral rehabilitation for complicated patients, practicing comprehensive treatment similar to general practitioners in the dental clinics.
- can diagnose, plan and perform treatment of dental caries, endodontic and periodontal pathologies
- can diagnose, plan and perform treatment of oral mucosal diseases
- can perform oral surgery procedures 
- know modern diagnostic tools, materials, constructions and biomechanic issues of dental prosthesis
- know the effect of various pathologies on stomatognathic system to better design complex treatment plan for patients with partial or full edentulism, 
- are able to use modern diagnostic tools, materials, constructions in prosthetic dentistry
- know the biomechanic nature of dental prosthesis.
- know the possibilities and risks of treatment with implants in dentistry 
- follow minimum requirements for treatment procedures

kirjeldus_et: EM praktika põhitähelepanu on pööratud erakorraliste seisundite esmasele diagnostikale ja ravile erakorralise meditsiini osakonnas. Osalemise eelduseks on arstiõppe viie esimese kursuse läbimine. Üliõpilased õpivad tundma erakorralise meditsiini organisatsiooni ja patsientide tiraaži põhimõtteid, omandavad kliinilise kogemuse ja praktilised oskused erakorraliste haigete esmasel haiglakäsitlusel.
kirjeldus_en: The emergency medicine practice cycle is focused on primary assessment and treatment of acutely ill or injured patients in emergency department. Students will learn about the organisation of emergency medicine, triage and obtain practical skills for initial management of emergency patient.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the emergency medicine cycle the Student:
- - knows the organisation of emergency medicine and is able to perform triage in emergency department
- - is able to contact with the patient and to collect disease history, is able to perform objective examination of the patient and to assess the results of investigation or analysis
- - is able to perform basic medical manipulations and investigations according to recommendation of clinical practice logbook
- - knows the primary management of a patient in critical condition (cardiac arrest, major trauma, life-threatening arrhythmias, acute coronary syndrome, acute respiratory failure, acute renal failure, coma and shock)
- - knows how to complete medial documentation in emergency department

kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb kaasaegse loomuliku keele töötluse (NLP) põhikontseptsioone ja -meetodeid, keskendudes eeltreenitud transformeripõhiste mudelite kasutamisele praktilistes rakendustes. Käsitletakse andmete ettevalmistamist, mudelite kohandamist ja hindamist ning kontrollitud eksperimentide kavandamist ja veaanalüüsi. Lisaks analüüsitakse NLP-süsteemide piiranguid ja ühiskondlikku mõju ning tutvutakse valdkonna teaduskirjandusega, arendades oskust esitada tulemusi selgelt ja põhjendatult.
kirjeldus_en: The course covers the core concepts and methods of contemporary natural language processing (NLP), with a focus on the practical use of pretrained Transformer-based models. Topics include data preparation, model adaptation and evaluation, as well as the design of controlled experiments and systematic error analysis. In addition, the course examines the limitations and societal impact of NLP systems and engages with domain-specific research literature, developing the ability to present results clearly and with well-founded justification.
opitulemused_en:
- By completing this course, students will be able to:
- 1) Apply and adapt pretrained Transformer-based language models to practical NLP tasks, including data preparation, finetuning, evaluation, and deployment.
- 2) Design and carry out controlled experiments to analyze model behaviour, including the use of appropriate baselines, evaluation metrics, and systematic error analysis.
- 3) Critically assess the capabilities, limitations and broader societal implications of contemporary NLP systems, including issues related to bias, safety and reliability.
- 4) Interpret and analyze domain-specific research articles and present their own results clearly in both written and oral form.

kirjeldus_et: Ideoloogiad on vahendid, milleta ei saa läbi ei üksikisikud, mitteformaalsed võrgustikud, sotsiaalsed liikumised, huvigrupid, erakonnad, riigid ega ka rahvus-vahelised ja -ülesed organisatsioonid. Ideoloogiad liidavad inimesi poliitikaga, aitavad inimestel poliitikat mõista, korrastavad riikide- ja parteidevahelist konkurentsi ja koostööd, organiseerivad poliitikat kohalikul, riiklikul ja riigiülesel tasandil ning annavad sihid ja eesmärgid, mida järgides erinevad poliitilised toimijad (liikumised, huvigrupid, erakonnad, riigid) üritavad tõusta võimule ja-või muuta riiki ja ühiskonda. Et ideoloogiad (liberalism, sotsialism, konservatism, fašism, natsionaalsotsialism, anarhism, feminism, ökologism, mitmekultuurilisus, usuline fundamentalism, vabastusideoloogiad) pakuvad igaüks välja erinevaid ja tihti vastandlikke arusaamu olemasolevast (mis on hästi või halvasti) ja tulevast (kuidas peaks olema), on kursuse eesmärgiks mõtestada ja mõista poliitikas toimuvat lähtuvalt erinevate ideoloogiate vaadetest ja käsitlustest, kõigepealt mõista konstruktiivselt iga ideoloogilist vaadet ning anda seejärel võimalus igale osalejale kujundada välja oma argumenteeritud seisukoht vastava ideoloogia suhtes. Kursuse jooksul koostavad tudengid uurimuse sellest, kuidas ideoloogia (ideologiad) toimib (toimivad) valitud toimija(te) näitel, uurimises kasutatakse võrdlevat meetodit.
kirjeldus_en: Ideologies are means used by individuals, informal networks, social movements, interest groups, political parties, states, International and supranational organizations. Ideologies connect individuals to politics, help them to understand politics, organize competition and collaboration between states and political parties, organize politics at local, state and global levels, and provide goals whereby various political actors (movements, groups, parties, states) attempt to gain power or to change the state and society. As ideologies (such as Liberalism, Socialism, Conservatism, Fascism, Nazism, Anarchism, Feminism, Ecologism, Multiculturalism, Religious Fundamentalism, and Liberation Ideologies) follow different understandings about the present (what is good and what is wrong) and the future (how ought to be), the aim of the course is: to understand political phenomena from the perspective of various ideological views and approaches; to start with a constructive knowledge of each ideological approach and thereafter to present an opportunity for each participant to construct his or her argumented position regarding the ideology under discussion. Students are expected to develop their own research project that focuses on selected political actors and ideologies, where they use comparative method.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student who successfully passes the course:
- knows the key attitudes and conceptions that unite or divide ideologies and their sub-divisions
- knows the key authors of the ideological approaches and their main messages
- is familiar with the messages and the style of argumentation in selected writings of the main authors of the ideological schools
- is able to relate ideological worldviews to the political actors and phenomena
- is able to analyze the workings of political ideology 
- is able to present pro et contra arguments related to an ideological position.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate ingliskeelsete kultuuride ühisjoontest ning käsitleb seejärel nelja kultuuri - Suurbritanniat, Iirimaad, Kanadat ja Ameerika Ühendiike - põhjalikumalt. Keskendutakse riikide ühiskonnakorraldusele ja väärtushinnangutele, nii ajaloolises dimensioonis kui päevakajaliste küsimuste valguses. Üliõpilased õpivad analüüsima erinevaid ühiskondlikke ja kultuurilisi fenomene riikides eraldi ning riikide võrdluses, samuti võrdluses nende endi kultuuriga.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the present situation of different English-speaking cultures on the example of the UK, Ireland, Canada and the USA. Their commonalities and differences will both be studied. The focus will be on the political and social organisation of the countries as well as on their dominant cultural values. Students will learn to analyse different societal and cultural phenomena in the four countries separately and in comparison to each other and their own culture.

The course introduces the vocabulary related to the following topics: on vacation; past events; food and drink, in food store; everyday activities; clothes, colours; family.
Grammar: past tense: passato prossimo; superlativo assoluto; pronouns (i partitivi (singolare), i pronomi diretti lo, la, li, le, ne); use of si impersonale; use of questo/quello; possessive pronouns; past tense: imperfetto.
opitulemused_en:
- On completion of the course the students will be able to:
- - understand simple texts (both oral and written) in Italian
- - use the vocabulary and grammar covered during the course in simple everyday situations.

nimi_et: Prantsuse keel algtaseme läbinuile (süvaõpe), tase A1 > A2
nimi_en: French for Beginners II (Intensive Course), Level A1 > A2
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus on ehitatud üles temaatilistele kommunikatsioonieesmärkidele (kaaskondsete ja perekonna tutvustamine, peresündmustest teavitamine, lühieluloo koostamine; esemete kirjeldamine, kingituse valik, ostude sooritamine, kultuuritavade-traditsioonide võrdlus, söögikombed, roogade kirjeldamine, söögikoha külastamine etc), mille käigus omandatakse ja harjutatakse vastavat sõnavara ja vajalikke grammatikareegleid.
kirjeldus_en: The course is constructed on thematic communicative tasks (presenting one's family, talking about family life, announcing family events, composing a brief biography; describing various objects, shopping, choosing gifts, comparing cultural habits/patterns and traditions; talking about food, cookery and eating habits, etc). Related to these topics a consequent vocabulary, syntax constructions and grammar rules are reviewed and trained.
opitulemused_en:
- The student attended the course
- - knows the communication elements and grammar by lower intermediate level
- - has a knowledge of the vocabulary needed in common and more official contexts and knows how to use it
- - has a knowledge of French sentence structure and of composing short texts on various topics
- - is capable of reading texts of lower intermediate difficulty level
hindamise_eeltingimused:
1) Aktiivne osalemine tundides vähemalt 90% ulatuses.
2) Kirjalike kodutööde esitamine nõuetekohasel tasemel ja õigeaegselt.
3) Positiivne tulemus kontrolltööde eest (65% õigeid vastuseid).Ühte kontrolltööd on võimalus teha kaks korda, kontrolltöö järelevastamine toimub kahe nädala jooksul pärast kontrolltöö toimumist õppejõuga kokkulepitud ajal, hiljem järele vastata pole võimalik; kontrolltööst kaks korda läbi kukkumine tähendab eksamile mittelubamist.
 
- Iseseisvalt loetud lektüüri vastamine (kontrollivormid: kirjalik/suuline tõlge emakeelde ja vestlus loetu üle prantsuse keeles)
- Suuline vastamine kolmes osas: 
1) Aine jooksul läbivõetud teemasid haarav vestlus (kordamisküsimused Moodle-is).
2) Loo jutustamine minevikus (kogetud minevikusündmuse edasiandmine kasutades kaht minevikuaega passé composé/imparfait) + looga seotud vestlus.
3) Loo jutustamine minevikus kasutades erinevaid aegu (passé composé/imparfait/plus-que-parfait) ja kõneviise (Indicatif/Conditionnel/Subjonctif) + looga seotud vestlus.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate bakterite talitluse üldistest seaduspärasustest ja põhimõistetest. Käsitletakse bakterite ainevahetust, kasvu- ja arengufüsioloogiat, keskkonna muutuste toimet organismi kui terviku funktsioonile, stressifüsioloogiat. kirjeldatakse protsesse, mis toimuvad rakkude jagunemisel. Rõhku on pandud geenide ekspressioonile ning ekspressiooni regulatsioonile lähtuvalt bakteri füsioloogiast. Andakse ülevaade raku membraanide ehitusest ja funktsioonidest. Käsitletakse ainete transporti ja kirjeldatakse erinevaid sekretsioonisüsteeme. Käsitletakse kvoorumi tunnetamisega seotud füsioloogilisi muutusi bakterirakus. Selgitatkse, millised muutused toimuvad stressi tingimustes kasvavates bakterites. Iseloomutatakse füsioloogiliste protsesside geneetilistregulatsiooni erinevates kasvutingimustes.
kirjeldus_en: The course will provide an understanding of the fundamentals and basic principles of the structure function, energy metabolism, growth, and regulatory mechanisms of bacteria. It will provide an insight on the basic mechanisms involved in: determining microbial cell shape, cell division, regulation of the synthesis of gene products, sensing and responding to environmental signals. Different secretion mechanisms found in bacteria are also described. The lecture series also contain a module outlining the strategies for survival in extreme and stressful environments, quorum sensing, microbial cell growth and cellular responses to environmental changes and expression of specific gene systems in a population dependent manner. The regulation of physiological processes through control of gene expression and enzyme activity is also covered, as well as the survival mechanisms used under different growth (incl. stravation) conditions.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student acquires an understanding of the physiological processes in bacteria and the mechanisms of regulation that control these processes in different growth environments and conditions.
- Understand in-depth the processes in the bacteria during the different growth phases, the production of energy and its consumption. In addition, the function of bacteria in the population and the collective behaviour of planktonic and sessile cells are understood.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab inimese ja meditsiinigeneetika alusteadmised ning ülevaate kliinilise geneetiku tööst.
Käsitletakse monogeensete ja kromosoomhaiguste geneetikat; arengugeneetikat; multifaktoriaalsete haiguste ja kasvajate geneetikat; geneetika laiemat rolli meditsiinis ja selle eripärasid; molekulaardiagnostika, pärilike haiguste sõeluuringute ja geeniteraapia aluseid; kaasaegseid kliinilise geneetika tööpõhimõtteid ning koostööd teiste meditsiinierialadega.
kirjeldus_en:
The course provides basic knowledge in human and medical genetics and an overview of the clinical genetics field.
The course covers genetics of monogenic and chromosomal diseases; developmental genetics; genetics of multifactorial diseases and cancer; broader role and special features of genetics in medicine; molecular diagnostics and screening programmes of genetic diseases, basis of gene therapy; state-of-the art overview of the clinical genetics applications and interactions with other medical disciplines.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Obtained :
- - basic terminology in human and medical genetics
- - state-of-the art basic knowledge in medical genetics
- - knowledge in using online databases in human and medical genetics
- - current understanding of medical genetics applications, challenges and ethical aspects
- - an overview of the clinical genetics field, and its role in medicine
- 2. Improved translational skills
- - in putting the obtained knowledge in genetics in a broader context in medicine
- - in teaming up with fellow students in preparing course homework and during the practical course
- - oral and written presentation skills
- 3. Basic knowledge to follow in future the developments and applications of genetic tools in the chosen medical field
hindamise_eeltingimused:
1. Mandatory attendance to the practical course.
2. Independent homework and set tasks (e.g. in Moodle or to be presented at the course) positively conducted and presented on-time to the course lecturer.
hindamise_meetod:
Final assessment of the course materials takes place in two separate tests:
1. Basic human and medical genetics
2. Clinical genetics.

The students have to pass the set threshold in both tests. The final mark reflects the knowledge in both parts of the course with the weight 2/3 for part 1 and 1/3 for part 2.

Scientific research can be accepted as elective placement with agreement of the supervisors of clinical practice.

Kirurgia praktika kestab 8 nädalat (4+4), mida võib sooritada abdominaalkirurgia, lastekirurgia, onkokirurgia, traumatoloogia,  uroloogia, veresoontekirurgia, torakaalkirurgia ning üldkirurgia osakondades. 
Lisaks kliinilisele igapäevatööle tuleb üliõpilasel praktika raames tegeleda arstile vajalike praktiliste oskuste harjutamisega ning võimalusel võtta osa seminaridest. 
Käsitletakse kirurgilise haige uurimist, raviplaani koostamist, ravikäigu ja tulemuste hindamist, andmete dokumenteerimist ning ettekandmist.
Praktika käigus tuleb täita praktikapäevikut.
kirjeldus_en:
The practical course in surgery lasts 8 weeks (4+4) and can be passed at the departments of general surgery, abdominal surgery, paediatric surgery surgical oncology, traumatology, urology, thorasic and vascular surgery. In addition to daily clinical work, the students have to train practical skills necessary for physician and, when possible, ta take part in seminars.
The subject deals with the investigation of the surgical patient, designing of the treatment plan, assessment of the treatment course and results, documentation of the data and their presentation.
Within the course, the students have to fill in the diary of medical training (surgery).

kirjeldus_en: The course provides a survey of evidence-based assessment and treatment techniques used in handling different motor dysfunction in children.
opitulemused_en:
- The student:
- 1. describes potential functional limitations based on the child's diagnosis, phrases problems and aims of physiotherapy, analyses the finds and plan the therapy;
- 2. fills out a systematic report of the therapy process and results.
- 3. finds and analyses specialized scientific literature, distinguishes relevant information from irrelevant.
- 4. knows and describes the main evidence-based physiotherapeutic treatment and evaluation methods in paediatrics;
- 5. analyses the need for devices and knows the main principles of adjustment according to the patient's age and diagnosis.
- 6. has good team work skills

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Aleksei Kelli, Maris Vutt, Marta Cantero Gamito
kirjeldus_et:
Tegemist on erinevaid õigusvaldkondi hõlmava koondainega, mis käsitleb järgmiseid teemasid:
1. IO-l baseeruvate ettevõtete elutsüklite ülevaade, innovatsioon ning erinevad ärimudelid
2. IO-l baseeriva ettevõtte asutamine ning struktureerimine
3. Peamised lepingulised suhted ettevõttes, kui eesmärgiks IO adekvaatne kaitse (asutajad, töötajad, alltöövõtjad)
4. Risikikapitali kaasamine erinevates faasides, läbirääkimised
5.	IT ettevõte ja nn targad töösuhted: välistööjõu kaasamine, tööjõu motiveerimine, migratsiooniküsimused, optsioonid
6.	Ettevõtte IO strateegia kujundamine
kirjeldus_en:
Covers various aspects of IPR Intensive Enterprise Lifecycle, including:
1. IPR intensive enterprise life cycle stages, innovation and such companies business models
2. IPR intensive business formation and structuring (including internationally)
3. Key contractual matters in the company (relationships between founders, employees, sub-contractors) (keeping the IP in the company)
4. Engaging in venture capital during these different stages of a company, negotiations
5. IT company and smart employees: hiring foreign employees, motivation packages, migration issues, share-option plans.
6. Development of IP Strategy (patents, but even more importantly IP protection without the use of patents)

- After completing this course students:

- - Are skillful in evaluating different projects.

- - Are able to reason the importance of a project to funders and other interested parties.

kirjeldus_et:
Le prérequis pour le cours est le niveau B1 du CECR. 
Le cours sera donné uniquement en français. Les étudiants devront parler uniquement en français pendant le cours. 
Une attention particulière sera portée sur la compréhension et l'expression orale. Quelques structures grammaticales seront aussi étudiées. Par exemple le conditionnel, les pronoms y/en, la double pronominalisation etc.
Divers sujets concernant la culture francophone et l'actualité seront étudiés. Les documents authentiques seront utilisés aussi souvent que possible, pour habituer les étudiants à un français authentique.
kirjeldus_en:
The course presupposes the Council of Europe Level B1.
The course will be given mostly in French but English might be used for specific explanations and information. Students are expected to speak mostly in French, especially when their level allows them to do so. 
A particular focus will be given to the oral comprehension and expression. Some grammar structures will be studied as well.
Various topics related to French culture and actuality will be studied during the semester. Authentic documents will be given as much as possible, in order to familiarize students to an authentic language.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- By the end of the level, students will be able to have a conversation in french, to give their opinion on a subject and to present their arguments. They will be able to communicate on various subjects in a spontaneous manner and without major interruptions. They will be able to discuss complex subjects in a clear and structured way.

kirjeldus_et: Rahvusvahelise õigusmõistmise süsteemi tähtsus on oluliselt tõusnud viimastel aastakümnetel. Riigid pöörduvad üha tihedamini omavaheliste vaidluste lahendamiseks rahvusvaheliste kohtute poole ja aktsepteerivad üha rohkem etteulatuvalt nende jurisdiktsiooni. Samas on juurde tulnud ka kohtuid ja tribunale, kus menetluse osapoolteks saavad olla ka füüsilised ja juriidilised isikud, kas hageja, kostja või süüdistatuna. Õppeaine uurib rahvusvahelisi kohtuid ja tribunale ajaloolisest, poliitilisest ja õiguslikust vaatenurgast. Fookus on ennekõike riikidevaheliste vaidluste lahendamisel, kuid õppeaine käsitleb ka investeerimisvaidlusi ja kriminaalmenetlust. Alustuseks selgitatakse vaidluste rahumeelse lahendamise õiguslikku raamistikku. Seejärel võetakse vaatluse alla valitud rahvusvahelised kohtud ja tribunalid, et selgitada nende olemasolu põhjuseid ning uurida loomise ja toimimise detaile. Käsitlemist leiavad sellised teemad nagu jurisdiktsioon, vastuvõetavas, ajutised meetmed, kohalduv õigus, menetlus, otsuse vastuvõtmise protsess, lahendite täideviimine jms.
kirjeldus_en: International judicial system has significantly gained momentum in recent decades. States are more frequently settling their disputes before international courts and have increasingly accepted their jurisdiction in advance. At the same time, there are new courts and tribunals where natural or legal persons can appear either as plaintiffs or defendants. The course examines international courts and tribunals from historical, political and legal perspectives. The focus is foremost on inter-State dispute settlement, but the course looks also at investment disputes and criminal prosecution. The course explains first the general legal framework for peaceful settlement of disputes and then turns to selected international courts and tribunals to examine the reasons for having such institutions and the specifics of their creation and functioning. Discussion cover such issues as jurisdiction, admissibility, provisional measures, applicable law, procedure, decision-making process, enforcement of decisions etc.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course is able to:
- -- explain and compare different methods of peaceful settlement of disputes
- -- comprehen the role of international courts and tribunals in the international legal order
- -- understand the procedure before international courts and tribunals
- -- know the content and impact of selected influential cases
- -- identify the contemporary developments and challenges in international judicial system

Kursuse raames õpitakse kasutama erinevaid andemete kogumise ja analüüsi võtteid, sealhulgas läbi viima intervjuusid, fookusgruppe, vaatlust, sisu- ja diskursuseanalüüsi. kirjeldus_en: In the course of lectures, seminars, and practical assignments students will learn about the strengths and weaknesses of qualitative methods compared to the quantitative research techniques. The participants of the course are introduced to the main types of qualitative research design, and to planning a qualitative research project. The course will provide an overview of a number of techniques for data collection and analysis including interviews, focus groups, observation, content and discourse analysis. The participants will also have an opportunity to reflect on the issues of trustworthiness of qualitative research, and on ethics in research with human subjects.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of the course the participants will:
- - understand the epistemological foundations of qualitative research
- - know the strengths and weaknesses of qualitative and quantitative research methods
- - know the main approaches to qualitative research and are able to apply these for designing a qualitative research project
- - have obtained the necessary knowledge and skills for qualitative data collection and are able to apply these for a research project
- - have obtained the necessary knowledge and skills for qualitative data analysis and are able to apply these for a research project
- - understand the concepts of validity, reliability, and generalizability in qualitative inquiry, and are able to assess the trustworthiness of qualitative research

kirjeldus_et: Loengud annavad üldise ja mitmetahulise ülevaate EL-i poliitilis-institutsionaalsetest arengutest ja ajaloost. Iseäranis keskendutakse järgmistele küsimustele: lõimumisprotsessi dünaamika, kõige tähtsamad hiljutised institutsionaalsed arengud, EL-i teoreetiline alus ja sellega seotud mõisted, Liidu institutsionaalne, poliitiline ja majanduslik olemus ning pinged "laienemise" ja "süvenemise" vahel. Auditoorses tegevuses kasutatakse arutelusid rühmades.
kirjeldus_en: The lectures will provide a general and multifaceted overview on the political-institutional developments of the EU and its history. In particular the following aspects will be discussed: the integration process over time, the most recent institutional developments, the EU's theoretical foundation and the main related concepts, the Union's institutional, political, and economic nature, and the tension between "widening" and "deepening".  Group discussion is favoured.
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, student will have a solid understanding of the nature, foundation, history, and overtime institutional and political developments of the EU.
- By the end of the course students are expected to:
- - Be familiar with the EU development and structure
- - Critically read the institutional and political developments EU and discuss the future trajectories
- - Contextualize the EU within the debate on federalism, inter-governamentalism, functionalism, etc.
- - Be able to discuss the most recent and most relevant pan-European issues
- - Understand (and problematize) the democratic and political process in the EU
- - Be familiar with the EU policy-making

Kursus keskendub järgmistele teemadele:
- Väärtusteooria: raha ajaväärtus, väärtpaberite väärtuse hindamine. 
- Finantseerimisotsused: finantsstruktuur, kapitali hind, finantsvõimendus, kapitalistruktuuri teooriad (nt M&M I ja II teoreem), optimaalse kapitalistruktuuri kujundamine, võimendusanalüüs.

kirjeldus_en:
The course is focused on following topics:
- Valuation theory: the time value of money, valuing of financial instruments. 
- Financing decisions: financial structure, cost of capital, financial leverage, capital structure theories (i.e. M&M propositions I and II), optimal capital structure theory, operating and financial leverage.
- Investment decision: asset structure formation, capital budgeting, project valuation. 
- Dividend decisions: dividend policy, dividend policy theories. 
- Working capital management: management of net working capital, inventory management, credit and receivables management, cash management. 
- Financial statement analysis: financial ratio analysis, financial planning.
- International aspects of financial management.

- After passing the course student

Käsitletakse kõiki põhilisi Rooma eraõiguse valdkondi: isikuõigust, perekonna- ja protsessiõigust, asja-, võla - ja pärimisõigust võrdlevalt tänapäeva Eesti ja muude Rooma õigusel põhinevate õigussüsteemidega. Selgitatakse erinevate eraõiguse süsteemide põhimõtteid ja käsitletakse mõistete kujunemislugu ning tähendusmuutusi erinevates õigussüsteemides.
kirjeldus_en:
The course provides an overview of the Roman Private Law (8th century BC-6th century AD), which provided the basis for the further development of the civil law tradition.
The course tackles all the important areas of the Roman Private Law of persons, family law, procedual law, property law, law of obligations and the heritage law in connection with the contemporary private law.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- To finish the course successfully the student should be able to explain the content of the basic concepts of the Roman private law (and Estonian valid private law), the principles and functioning of these concepts. He should be able to orientate int the system of private law on the basis of the Institutes of Gaius. The student should be able to understand norm, to which area of private law this norm belongs to and to put the norm into the context of relevant private law institute. He should be able to compare generally the Roman norms with those of valid today (using the laws of the Estonia) and to discuss about the origin, formation and needs of the institutes of private law. The student should have acquired the basic rules of writing a scientific paper and should be able to put them into practice.

kirjeldus_en: Design of quantitative research, selecting a sample. Collecting data in quantitative research, structure of the data, educational databases. Getting overview of the data, grouping the data, analysis of the quality of the data. Comparing and relating data samples. The analysis of latent variables (factor analysis, structural equation models). Hierarchical data and multilevel analysis in education. Application of Item Response Theory (IRT). Presentation and interpretation of the results in the scientific papers and presentations.
opitulemused_en:
- The doctoral student who has completed the curriculum
- - is able to design quantitative research in education, to gather data and/or find data in databases, to analyse the quality of the data and to choose appropriate methods for data analysis,
- - is able to analyse quantitative data and interpret the results considering the educational aims of the research,
- - is able to analyse and write educational quantitative research papers based on contemporary data analysis,
- - is able to present the results of quantitative data analysis on scientific conferences and to practitioners.

kirjeldus_en: This course aims to provide an overview of a number of protracted regional conflicts in Eurasia. We will examine closely conflicts ranging from North and South Caucasus to Transnistria, and from Ukraine/Crimea to Central Asia, from the collapse of the Soviet Union until today. More specifically, we will apply conflict assessment toolbox, and analyse dividers and connectors, principal players and secondary actors, drivers of conflict and peace, and finally, windows of vulnerability and opportunity in these regional conflicts.

During the course the student has to collect training/workout related data and to record  them into the web-diary of your own choice. The data can be entered manually or using different smart devices (preferred). Additionally, the summaries about the workouts must be compiled. In Moodle the learning materials must be analysed and a written test must be done related to the impact of physical load and physical activity to human body.

Geneetika praktikumi seitse teemat hõlmavad olulisemaid molekulaargeneetika meetodeid ja protsesse nagu näiteks geenide kloonimist, uute bakteritüvede konstrueerimist ning samuti geeniekspressiooni ja mutatsioonisagedust mõjutavate tegurite uurimist. kirjeldus_en: The aim of the practical course is to give an overview of experimental methods used in modern genetics and an experience in laboratory work. The practical course in genetics consists of seven topics that cover most important aspects in molecular genetics e.g. cloning of genes, construction of different bacterial strains, analysis of gene expression and studies of mechanisms underlying mutational processes. Additionally, a practical work with a  fruit fly is conducted.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course students :
- - have an experimental experience of methods routinely used in modern genetics
- - are able to use the acquired skills and knowledge in everyday laboratory work

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse teemaks on loomade märgiline kommunikatsioon. Tähelepanu pööratakse biokommunikatsiooni eeldustele, elementidele ja erinevatele tüüpidele ning selle omadustele erinevates keskkondades. Analüüsides näiteid mitmetest loomarühmadest (selgrootud, kalad, roomajad ja kahepaiksed, linnud, imetajad), käsitletakse kommunikatsiooni ja semiootiliste protsesside rolli loomade sotsiaalses, territoriaalses ja sugulises käitumises. Lähemalt vaadeldakse kommunikatsiooni inimese ja loomade vahel ning zoosemiootilisi aluseid loomade
kirjeldus_en: The topic of the course is sign communication among animals. Attention will be paid to the prerequisites, elements and types of biocommunication as well as its properties in different environments. By analysing examples from many animal groups (invertebrates, fishes, reptiles and amphibians, birds, and mammals), the role of communication and semiotic processes in the social, territorial, and sexual behaviour of animals will be discussed. Closer attention will be paid to communication between human beings and animals, as well as to the zoosemiotic features that form the basis for depicting animals in mythology, folklore, and literature.

kirjeldus_en: The course will cover the SEM methods both theoretically and in practice. Different possibilities of using these methods in behavioral science are studied in the course of practical exercises. Half of the course consists of computer-based practical sessions. The software used is R.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course, a student will:
- 1. know the concept, mathematical ideas and different methods of SEM.
- 2. be able to apply different SEM methods on empirical research data (by using the relevant software) and to interpret the developed models within the context of a particular research problem.
- 3. be able to critically analyse the application of methods (a skill of analysing scientific articles by studying how the authors have applied the studied methodology).

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Anu Tammeleht, Halliki Harro-Loit, Kadri Simm, Kadri Tamme, Kertu Rajando, Margit Sutrop, Mari-Liisa Parder, Marju Lauristin, Marten Juurik, Tiiu Tarkpea, Urmas Sutrop
kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse eesmärk on anda osavõtjatele ülevaade hea teaduse võtmeküsimustest: teaduspublikatsiooni autorsuse kokkuleppimine mitme autoriga publikatsiooni korral, teavitatud nõusoleku küsimine, andmete töötlemine, uuringusse kaasatud inimeste privaatsuse ja isikuandmete kaitse tagamine, teadustööks vajalike lubade, nõusolekute ja eetikakomitee kooskõlastuste sisu ja taotlemine.
Kogu kursust toetab eesti- ja ingliskeelne e-keskkond, mis koondab erinevate teadusvaldkondade jaoks olulist materjali, mille hulgast doktorant valib enda jaoks õppeülesanded 6 EAP mahus.
Kursus on ehitatud üles nii, et vastavalt eriala ja uurimistöö spetsiifikale saavad doktorandid valida enda jaoks sobivad teemad ja ülesanded. Kursusel on seminarid, kus erinevate erialade doktorandid saavad kogeda hea teadustava tõlgendamisel distsiplinaarseid erinevusi.
kirjeldus_en: The aim of the course is to provide participants with an overview of the key issues of research integrity: making decisions about the authorship of a scientific publication in multi-author publications, obtaining informed consent, processing data, ensuring the protection of privacy and personal data of the subjects involved in the study, obtaining necessary permissions, consents and ethics committee approvals for research and understanding their meaning. The entire course is supported by an e-learning environment that brings together materials that are relevant to different fields of science. From them, the doctoral student chooses 6 EAP worth of assignments. The course is structured in such a way that doctoral students can choose topics and tasks appropriate for their specialty and specifics of research there. oppeaste: bakalaureuseõpe, integreeritud bakalaureuse- ja magistriõpe, magistriõpe
kirjeldus_et:
Läänemere regioon elik Põhja-Euroopa ei ole väga tihedalt asustatud piirkond, kuid siia kuulub üheksa erinevat riiki, millel on oma unikaalne poliitiline süsteem. Nendes süsteemides on küll palju sarnaseid elemente, kuid ka mitmed olulised erinevused. Poola, Eesti, Läti ja Leedu on teinud läbi keeruka siirdeprotsessi viimase 35 aasta jooksul ning nende poliitilised süsteemid kuuluvad samasse gruppi pikaajaliste demokraatiatega Põhjamaades ning ka Saksamaal. Kuigi Poolas on olnud jälgitav demokraatliku protsessi õõnestamine, on ta siiski jäänud demokraatlikuks režiimiks. Enamus Läänemere maid on unitaarsed riigid, aga Saksamaa eripäraks on selle föderatiivne süsteem. See kursus keskendubki nendele sarnasustele ja erinevustele Läänemeremaades, mõistmaks kuidas poliitilised süsteemid nendes riikides toimivad. 

Kursuse käigus analüüsitakse järgmiseid teemasid ja küsimusi: Läänemere riikide poliitilised süsteemid: poliitilise süsteemi definitsioonid, poliitilised institutsioonid ja nende suhted, konstitutsioonid, seadusandja ja selle roll, seadusandva ja täidesaatva võimu suhted, peamised poliitilised tegijad nagu parteid ja huvigrupid, nende mõju poliitilisele süsteemile, kodanikuõigused ja -vabadused, sotsiaalne usaldus ja tolerants vähemuste suhtes, sooline võrdõiguslikkus, sotsiaalne lõimumine.
kirjeldus_en:
The Baltic Sea region, or Northern Europe, is not a densely populated area, yet it comprises nine different countries, each with its own unique political system. While these systems share many similar elements, they also display several important differences. Poland, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania have undergone a complex transition process over the past 35 years, and their political systems now belong to the same group as the long-standing democracies in the Nordic countries and Germany. Although Poland has recently experienced democratic backsliding, it has nonetheless remained a democratic regime. Most Baltic Sea countries are unitary states, whereas Germany stands out due to its federal system. This course focuses precisely on such similarities and differences among the Baltic Sea countries in order to understand how their political systems function.

During the course, the following themes and questions will be analysed: the political systems of the Baltic Sea states; definitions of political systems; political institutions and their relationships; constitutions; the legislature and its role; relations between the legislative and executive branches of power; key political actors such as parties and interest groups and their influence on the political system; civil rights and liberties; social trust and tolerance towards minorities; gender equality; and social integration.

kirjeldus_en: Taxonomy, morphology, physiology, resistance to antibiotics of microorganisms. Microflora of environment and human organism. Microbial pathogenicity and virulence. Resistance of organism.Immunological reactions. Microbiological diagnostics of infectious diseases - coccal and aiborne infections, intestinal and urinary tract infections, anaerobic infections, spirochaetoses, mycoses, infections caused by protozoa, viral infections
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, the students should be able to:
- 1. State the normal flora and infective microorganisms of the human body and describe the host‐ parasite relationship
- 2. List the pathogenic microorganisms, their general characteristics, classifications, nomenclature and methods of identification of bacteria
- 3. State the sources, modes of transmission and describe the pathogenesis of the diseases produced by the microorganisms.
- 4. Describe the mechanisms of immunity of infection
- 5. Apply the methods of sterilization and disinfection to prevent and control infections
- 6. State the suitable antimicrobial agents for treatment and vaccines available for prevention of communicable diseases
- 7. Recommend the laboratory investigations for making a microbiological diagnosis.
- 8. Use the correct method of collection, storage and transport of clinical specimens for microbiological investigations
- 9. Plan and interpret laboratory investigations for the diagnosis of infectious diseases and to correlate the clinical manifestations with the etiologic agents.
- 10. Identify the common infectious agents with the use of basic laboratory procedures and the use of sensitivity tests to select suitable antimicrobial agents.

kirjeldus_en: The course of pathophysiology for pharmacy students consists of etiology and pathogenesis of main syndromes and diseases in the hierarchic subsystems (organ systems, organs, tissues, cells, subcellular elements). Alteration in the function of any subsystem affects other subsystems as well as the system as whole. In cases in which the mechanism of disease and the mechanism of clinical intervention are well understood, the treatment is said to be rational, or clearly based on scientific knowledge.

opitulemused_en:
- Learning outcomes

Students who have completed  the  course:
- is able to explain the changes in the functions of human organ systems in pathological processes and the  most common diseases at both cell and organism level.
- knows and is able to associate the development mechanisms of disorders caused by harmful factors and also treatment principles.
- know and analyze the  basic regulatory mechanisms  that ensure the stability of  the internal environment.

kirjeldus_et: Õppeaines käsitletakse levinumaid rahvusvahelisi harjutuskohtu võistlusi (Willem C.
