nimi_en: Semantics and Pragmatics of the Russian Language
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus tutvustab semantika (tähendusõpetuse) üldiseid suundi ja terminoloogiat ning vene keele semantika tunnusjooni. Kursus katab järgmisi teemasid: sõna funktsioonid, sõnatähenduse struktuur (signification, denotation, referent), vene polüsemantilise sõna tähenduste hierarhia ning arenemise üldjooned, sõna semantilised ning süstemaatilised seosed keeles, sõnatähenduse komponentide analüüs. Kursus on pühendatud  vene keele pragmaatiliste vahendite kirjeldusele lauses ja tekstis. Käsitletakse vene keele pragmaatika iseärasusi: temporaalsuse ja lokaalsuse pragmaatilist aspekti, hinnangu erinevaid tüüpe, kõneakti tüüpe, evidentsionaalsust, dialoogi tüüpe ja struktuuri.
kirjeldus_en: The word's functions, structure of its meaning (signification, denotation, referent), hierarchy and development of meanings of the Russian polysemantic word, semantic and systematic connections of a word in a language, componential analysis of a lexical meaning. The pragmatic aspect of temporality and localization, the different types of evaluation and speech acts, evidentiality, a dialogue's types and structure are considered in this course.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The students learn to systematize their knowledge's about structure of the lexical meaning, syntagmatic and paradigmatic connections of the Russian word; they are able to use the methods of the componential analysis, to find a reason of the wrong use of a Russian word and describe the conditions of the correct use. The students learn to orient in the theoretical background of pragmatics, know the peculiarities of the Rissian's pragmatics, are able to analyse the different  types of texts and to use  the acquired knowledges in the independent scientific investigations.

kirjeldus_et:
Eesti keele kursus on esimeseks etapiks riigikeele eksami ettevalmistusele C1 tasemel. Kursusel arendatakse vestlus-ja argumenteerimisoskust, rikastatakse sõnavara, harjutatakse sobivat kõneregistrit; tutvutakse kirjutamistesti struktuuriga ning harjutakse kirjutusülesandeid, arendatakse õigekirja; kuulatakse erineva sisu ja funktsiooniga tekste, täidetakse valikvastustega kuulamisülesandeid; arendatakse üldist lugemisoskust ja eesmärgipärast lugemist. 
Õpik:
M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed" õpik ja töövihik
Teemad: 
1) Võõrkeelte õppimine. Grammatika: rõhuliited -ki, -gi, kord-liitsõnad 
2) Saatused, elulood ja kannapöörded. Grammatika: liht- ja täisminevik, tingiv kõneviis.
3) Kehakeel ja välimus. Grammatika: mitmuse käänded, tud-kesksõna.
4) Ametid ja töökohad. Grammatika: umbisikuline tegumood, ühendtegusõnad abisõnaga ära.
kirjeldus_en:
The course in Estonian is the first stage in the preparation for taking the National Advanced Estonian Language Test (C1). During the course the students will develop their conversation and reasoning skills, extend their  vocabulary, practice choosing a proper register of speech, study the structure of the written test and practice writing tasks (paying attention to the spelling), listen to different text types and do multiple choice listening tasks, develop general reading skills and reading for a purpose.
Study book:   
M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed" study book and workbook
Topics: 
1. Studying foreign languages. Grammar: suffixes of stress -ki, -gi, kord-compound words 
2. Destinies, biographies and about-turns. Grammar: past simple, present perfect, subjunctive mood.
3. Body language and appearance. Grammar: plural cases, past participle.
4. Jobs and professions. Grammar: Passive Voice, linking verbs with the particle ära.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who has passed the course will have been prepared for taking the National Advanced Estonian Language Test (C1) by practicing all four language skills.
- Speaking: He/she can communicate spontaneously by using grammatically correct language and proper register (might still use the avoidance strategy); understand oral speech in detail; express emotions and point out most important aspects; clearly express his/her ideas and opinions and present complicated arguments for and against a given statement.
- Writing: He/she can express his/her ideas and viewpoints in writing; write long personal letters and relate them to received information, write formal letters (CV, application, summary etc.), is good at grammar and is able to write correctly and understandably.
- Listening: He/she undestands oral texts on topics that are related to social life, academic world or work; understands the content of linguistically complicated lectures, presentations ets and professional discussions; is able to follow the conversation of native speakers; understands recordings and media files about professional work or studies.
- Reading: He/she can independently find specific information in the text by using ancillary materials, understand the content of news, articles and reports; understand text that are not related to his/her profession by using special dictionaries; can get primary as well as secondary information out of the texts read.

kirjeldus_et:
Käsitleme kaasaegseid suurandmete halduse ja töötlemise arhitektuure: batch, microbatch, streaming; data lakehouse.

Praktilised töövahendid: Spark/Flink, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Airflow andmete salvestamiseks ja töötlemiseks.

CDC, andmevood ja töövoogude orkestraatsioon: andmete liikumine toorandmetest analüütika- ja masinõppevalmiduseni.

Poolstruktureeritud ja struktureerimata andmete haldus (nt MongoDB, Neo4j) ning lihtsad AI-andmetorud.

Andmekvaliteedi, töökindluse, ning kulu-/jõudlusoptimeerimise põhimõtted suurandmete platvormidel.

Kursus kasutab pööratud klassiruumi (reverse classroom) põhimõtet: teooria omandatakse eelsalvestatud videoloengute ja iseseisva lugemise kaudu, kohapealsed sessioonid (8 × 4 tundi) on kohustuslikud ning keskenduvad lühitestidele, praktilistele harjutustele ja aruteludele.

Õpe on nii individuaalne kui ka rühmapõhine; kontakttunnid toimuvad kohapeal.
kirjeldus_en:
Modern large-scale data management and processing architectures: batch, micro-batch and streaming, the lakehouse concept.

Practical tools: Spark/Flink, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Airflow for storing and processing data.

Change-data-capture, data streams and workflow orchestration: moving data from raw sources to analytics- and ML-ready datasets.

Management of semi-structured and unstructured data (e.g. MongoDB, Neo4j) and simple AI-oriented data pipelines.

Principles of data quality, reliability, and cost/performance optimisation in big data platforms.

The course follows a flipped (reverse) classroom approach: theoretical material is provided via pre-recorded video lectures and readings, while on-site classroom sessions (8 × 4 hours) are mandatory and focus on short tests/exams, hands-on exercises and discussion.

Learning is both individual and group-based. The course follows blended learning (recorded theory + in-person labs) principals.

kirjeldus_et:
Aines käsitletakse vaakum- ja krüotehnikat lähtudes füüsikaüliõpilaste, eelkõige bakalaureuseõppe rakendusliku suuna üliõpilaste prognoositavast vajadusest vastavate teadmiste järele.
Käsitletakse gaaside omadusi normaal- ja hõrendatud tingimustes. Tutvustatakse vaakumi kasutamist teaduses ja tehnikas. Õpitakse tundma vaakumpumpade, vaakummeetrite ja vaakumsüsteemide ehitust ja nende tööpõhimõtteid.
Tutvutakse temperatuuri mõõtmise ja gaaside veeldamise meetoditega. Õpitakse tundma erinevat tüüpi krüostaatide ehitust ja vedela heeliumi kasutamise võimalusi ning ülimadalate temperatuuride saavutamise meetodeid. Tutvutakse ainete omadustega ülimadalatel temperatuuridel, ülijuhtivuse ja ülivoolavusega.
kirjeldus_en: The course deals with vacuum techniques and cryogenics necessary for the students who will choose the direction of applied science to proceed. Firstly, properties of gases will be explored and the examples of the use of vacuum in science and technology will be given. The working principles of vacuum pumps, manometers and different kind of vacuum systems will be explained. Next, the methods of liquifying the gases and measuring the temperature will be described. The overview will be given of the use of liquid helium nowadays. Also the principles ways to achive ultra low temperatures will be explained and the construction of different cryostats described. The properties of matter at ultra low temperatures will be described as well including the superconductivity and superfluidity.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course a student
- * Knows what is vacuum, low vacuum, high vacuum and ultra-high vacuum and also knows the absolute temperature scale
- * Knows where and why vacuum and low temperature are used in research and technology
- * Knows Maxwell's thermodynamic equations and is able to apply them in transformations
- * Is able (basing on kinetic theory) to calculate the average mean free path and velocity of molecules in rarefied gases
- * Is able to calculate thermal conductivity in rarefied gases
- * Is able to calculate the resistance and conductance of holes and vacuum tubes
- * Is able to carry out calculations on the gas flow and pumping speeds
- * Knows the structure and working principle of different types of vacuum pumps and vacuum meters; can also list different type of cryostats and explain their working principles
- * Knows how to connect different pumps into a pumping system
- * Has the knowledge of leak detection
- * Is able to use the vacuum system and evaporate films.

The course gives comprehensive overview about the legal framework, international environmental oblications and technological aspects of drinking water and wastewater management. Production of potable water from ground water as well as from surface water will be introduced. Special focus is also given to the modern technologies of municipal and industrial wastewater treatment.

- 2) knows requirements for basic types of consumable waters
- 3) is acquainted with legislation in the field of drinking water, wastewater and other types of consumable waters. Knows main principles of international cooperation in the field of water resources and management
- 4) knows main technologies in drinking water technology

- 6) is able to perform simple calculations which are in use in water and wastewater technologies
- 7) knows how is working an water enterprise, can analyse the technology used in the enterprise and is able to give reasons for applying technological solutions in the water enterprise

1. Äriprotsesside juhtimise põhimõtted: Mis on äriprotsesside juhtimine? Millal ja miks hakatakse tegelema äriprotsesside juhtimisega? Äriprotsesside juhtimise elutsükkel; tüüpilised äriprotsessid (maksmise protseduur, arve esitamine).

kirjeldus_en:
1. Principles of business process management: What is business process manegement? Why and when should BPM be undertaken? BPM lifecycle; typical business processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash).
2. Business Process Modeling: Purpose and principles of business process modeling, business process modeling notations and tools; business process standards and reference process models (SCOR, ITIL, SAP reference models).
3. Business Process Analysis: Activity-based costing; scenario-based analysis; techniques for business process re-design; business process simulation.
4. Process Performance Measurement: Defining measures for business processes; aggregating and processing data for business process performance measurement; discovering typical business processes from event logs.
5. IT Solutions: Techniques for designing IT Solutions for process automation; relations between business process management and software architectures; workflow management systems and business process management suites.
6. Case studies and projects in business process management
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of this course, students should be able to:
- 1. Demonstrate knowledge of the organizational and technical challenges of business process management.
- 2. Document complex business processes at different levels of detail using contemporary business process modeling techniques.
- 3. Identify and analyse business improvement options on the basis of business process models.
- 4. Apply qualitative and quantitative techniques to analyse the performance of business processes and to assess the impact of business process changes.
- 5. Understand how business process management can be used as an overarching method to design and deploy IT solutions and to achieve business-IT alignment.

kirjeldus_et: Õppeaine pakub võimalust mõista ja analüüsida inimõigusi erinevates jurisdiktsioonides võrdlevalt. Õppeaine raames keskendutakse peamiselt Euroopa ja rahvusvahelise õiguse inimõigusalasele praktikale ning siseriiklikule kohtupraktikale Euroopas ja Põhja-Ameerikas. Teemakäsitlus algab teoreetiliste lähtekohtade analüüsiga ning võrdleva meetodi tutvustamisega ning jätkub üksikute inimõiguste (nt vähemuste õigused, sõnavabadus, eraelu kaitse ning soolise ja usulise diskrimineerimise keeld) põhjalikuma käsitlusega, et mõista teooria, õiguslike mõistete ja praktika omavahelisi seoseid ning hinnata inimõiguste kaitse vahendite effektiivsust ning võrdleva meetodi kasulikkust ja piiratust õigusmõistmisel. Konreetsed teemad võivad olenevalt aktuaalsusest aastate lõikes varieeruda.
kirjeldus_en:
The course involves a study of human rights issues drawing mainly on material from European and international human rights law and domestic legal systems of Europe and North-America. It highlights the key controversies in modern human rights law, and the possible range of responses in different jurisdictions. 

The course begins with an introduction to comparative human rights. We will then consider the similarities and differences between the basic human rights texts of the jurisdictions and the basic theoretical and legal approaches to protection of human rights. 

We will then proceed with considering the meaning of particular human rights and their significance in theory and in practice, and the efficacy of the legal institutions designed to protect them. Several specific substantive issues (minority rights, freedom of speech, privacy and equality) will be studied in depth to illustrate the complex interplay between theory, legal concepts and procedure, and between legal and non-legal sources of protection. The course as a whole will aim to provide the opportunity for in-depth comparative study, during which the appropriateness, utility and limits of the comparative legal techniques will be considered.The focus is on comparing reasoning in actual court cases and analyzing them in the larger human rights framework.The topics of the course may change every year.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who has passed the course:
- - has the ability to identify and analyse key issues in the theory and practice of human rights.
- - has the ability to analyse why there are different approaches and outcomes in different jurisdictions to selected rights.
- - has a good knowledge of how selected human rights are implemented and applied in practice.
- - understands the potential and the limitations of law as a tool to address human rights concerns.
- - understands the potential and limitations of the comparative method in the practice of human rights.
- - has practiced being a presenter, moderator, discussant and a panel member at the conference-style seminars dedicated to research paper presentations and discussion
- - has improved their analytical and writing skills on contemporary human rights issues

kirjeldus_en: This course provides students the basic knowledge and basic skills to help and assist in case of a major accident, disaster and military conflict. Also, the structure of the medical services of defence forces in peace and war time is the topic of subject as well as  the amount  of medical assistance  in different phases of accidents.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who graduated the course:
- 1. Knows the structure of the medical services of defence forces in peace and war time and undrestands the volume of providing medical assistance  in different phases of assistance.
- 2. Knows disaster organization and understands the principles of medical care as part of it.
- 3. Is able to enumerate a variety of human and natural types of disasters and types of major accidents.
- 4. Understands the injuries that occur with different mechanisms of traumatic event.
- 5. Is able to implement the initial triage and knows the principles of conducting a secondary triage.
- 6. Is able to give life-saving first aid and knows the principles of approaching the trauma patient.
- 7.  Knows the basic threat groups of TBK and basic first aid principles in case of damage caused by TBK.
- 8. Understands the necessity of the implementation of personal protective equipment in case of TBK and knows the protection levels of various protection gear.

Various learning methods (i.e. set of lectures, seminars, written assignments, and teamwork) are used in order to get many-side understanding of strategic management.

- Knows how to relate strategic management to the other economic affairs. 
- Gains experiences for assessment and strategic analysis in the decision making.
- Gains experiences and attitudes how to apply modern approaches of strategic management in organizations.
- Learns experiences how to organize teamwork for analyzing strategic problems.

kirjeldus_et:
Tutvustatakse taimeökoloogias kasutatavaid peamisi meetodeid: koosluste struktuuri ja liigilise koosseisu kirjeldamine, keskkonnatingimuste kirjeldamine, eksperimentaalne ökoloogia välitingimustes, populatsioonide interaktsioonide uurimine, geobotaaniline kaardistamine. Pärast peamiste meetodite omandamist praktiseerib iga osavõtja oma oskusi konkreetses uurimisprojektis. Tudengid esitavad praktikaprojekti tulemused ja eneseanalüüsi, järgneb juhendajate tagasisidestamine. 
Praktikum on vaba kõigile soovijatele, kuid eriti soovitav nendele, kes tulevikus tahavad spetsialiseeruda ökoloogia erialale.
kirjeldus_en:
Main methods used in plant ecology will be introduced and practiced: describing the structure and species composition of associations, describing environmental conditions, experimental ecology in the open air, studying the interactions of populations, geobotanic charting. After the acquisition of main methods, every student will participate in a specific research project. The students will present the results of their project and self-analysis, supervisors will give feedback on practical work.  
Field course is open to everyone, but it is highly recommended to those wishing to specialise in ecology in the future.

kirjeldus_et:
Sisu lühikirjeldus 
Kursus koosneb kolmest moodulist:
I - Sissejuhatus bioinformaatikasse.
*	Geenide ja valkude in silico analüüs - peamised otsingualgoritmid (blast), järjestuste andmebaasid, DNA järjestuste failitüübid, alignment analüüs, fülogeneetiliste puude koostamine etc. 
*	PCR-i praimerite disain
*	Genoomi erinevate regioonide analüüs - enhanserid, promootorid, kodeerivad ja mittekodeerivad järjestused, geenide intron-ekson struktuur, (alternative) splicing, kattuvad geenijärjestused (kaasaarvatud miRNA geenid) 
*	Geeniekspressiooni anmete analüüs (RNA seq, microarray, protein arrays, chip data) 
*	Interaktoomi ja GO andmeanalüüs
*	Valk-valk interaktsioonide võrgustike analüüs.

II - Genoomi konstrueerimise moodul
*	The Synthetic Biology Open Language (SBOL):  a community standard for communicating designs in synthetic biology 
*	DNA järjstusega manipuleerimine, genoomi editing, koodonite optimeerimine
*	In silico sünteetiliste geneetiliste võrkude ja funktsionaalsete moodulite disain ja konstrueerimine lähtudes erinevatest genoomidest pärit algmaterjalidest
*	Sünteetiliste valk-valk interaktsioonide võrgustike disain kasutades Short Linear Motif (SLiMs) andmebaase
*	Loogikaelementide disain - sarnasus arvutitehnoloogiaga
*	In silico valkude disain  
*	Heteroloogiliste biosünteesi radade disain ja sisestamine tootjarakkude genoomi: Design-Build-Test-Cycle
*	Biosünteesi radade bioinformaatika. 
*	Disainerrakuvabrikute metabolismi analüüsi meetodid. 

III - Build-a-Genome-Course ettevalmistav moodul
*	SCRAMBLe meetod genoomi muutmiseks ja suunatud evolutsiooniks
*	Sissejuhatus Phosphoprocessor'ite tehnoloogiasse
*	Kromosoomi struktuuri ja konstrueerimisstrateegia disain
*	Kromosoomi sünteesi praktiline ajakava ja kuluanalüüs.
kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of three modules: 
I - Introductory bioinformatics module
*	In silico analysis of single genes and proteins - basic search algorithms (blast), retrieval options, file types, alignment options, phylogenetic tree building etc. 
*	Design of primers for single genes - PCR primers, cDNA cloning primers 
*	Analysis of genomic regions - enhancers, promoters, coding regions, intron-exon. structure, (alternative) splicing, overlapping genes (including miRNA genes) 
*	Analysis of gene expression data (RNA seq, microarray, protein arrays, chip data). 
*	Analysis of interactome and GO data.
*	Analysis of protein interaction networks.


II - Genome engineering module
*	The Synthetic Biology Open Language (SBOL):  a community standard for communicating designs in synthetic biology. 
*	Sequence manipulations, genome editing, codon optimization 
*	In silico implementation of synthetic gene networks and functional modules based on genetic information from various species
*	Design of synthetic protein interaction networks using the Short Linear Motif (SLiMs) databases
*	Design of logic gates - outreach to computer engineering
*	In silico protein engineering 
*	Assembly of heterologous biosynthetic pathways in cell factory producer strains and cell lines; integrating across the Design-Build-Test-Cycle.
*	Bioinformatics for the synthetic biology of natural products. 
*	Metabolic modeling of engineered microbial cell factory strains. 

III - Build-a-genome-course pre-planning module:
*	The genome SCRAMBLe method
*	Introduction to the Phosphoprocessors toolbox
*	Design of a chromosome structure and the minichunk recombination strategy
*	Setting up a practical timeline and performing a cost analysis of the chromosome synthesis.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of the course participants will know relevant databases for biological data (incl. genomic regions, protein domains, protein-protein interactions, gene expression data, Gene Ontology). The course will give an overview of the main bioinformatics methods that the attendee can later use in his/her research projects that involve the analysis of genetic information and/or design of novel genetic circuits. The course offers an alternative to the classical form of bioinformatics courses in terms of additional modules focused on genome engineering and rational design of chromosomes. It also introduces an innovative Synthetic Biology Open Language (SBOL):  a community standard for communicating designs in synthetic biology.
- Participants of the course will receive the following set of skills:
- 1)	In silico analysis of cellular processes: genetic information and its manifestations.
- 2)	Ability to apply bioinformatics methods for analysing gene regulation (incl. sequence alignment and analysis, primer design, gene expression analysis, CRISPR).
- 3)	Will know relevant databases for biological data (incl. genomic regions, protein domains, protein-protein interactions, gene expression data, Gene Ontology).
- 4)	Basic skills in in silico assembly of synthetic organisms in the Synthetic Biology Open Language (SBOL)- from hereditary material to metabolic pathways.

kirjeldus_en: The lecture course presents an overview of the properties of inorganic substances.  Much attention is paid to the relationships between the properties of substances and their structure and character of chemical bonding.  The topics covered by the lecture are examined and explained by solving exercises and problems in seminars.
opitulemused_en:
- Student having passed the course,
1.knows the main classes of inorganic substances,
2.is able to apply the principles of the structure of substances for the characterising of the properties of substances,
3.knows the equilibria of acid-base and redox processes and has the skills in problem solving,
4.knows the typical reactions of inorganic substances and is able to characterise them,
5.knows the main applications of inorganic substances in practice and is able to connect them with the properties of substances.

kirjeldus_et:
Aine annab ülevaate pilditöötluse alusteadmistest toetudes varasematele teadmistele programmeerimises. Sisu on suunatud magistritudengitele ning põhineb programmeerimiskeelel Python.
Seminarid sisaldavad teadusartiklite esitamist ja arutelu esitatud materjali üle. Praktikumid koosnevad pilditöötluse põhiprintsiipide mõistmisest ning nende implementeerimisest.
Materjal sisaldab, aga ei ole piiratud, järgnevat: pildi esitust, värviruume, mustrite tuvastamist, segmenteerimist, osalist masinõpet ja ruumilisi fotosi.
kirjeldus_en:
The course will help to build a foundation of image processing knowledge on top of preexisting skill of programming, some of which is preferably in Python. The content will be mainly targeted at Master's level students.
Seminars consist of presenting research results or chapters from the textbook, and discussion. Lab sessions comprise (of) understanding how the core principles of image processing work and how to implement them.
The content includes, but is not limited to the following: image formation, compression and representation, colour spaces, pattern recognition, depth and stereo imaging, segmentation, some ML.

kirjeldus_et: Selle kursuse eesmärk on anda tudengitele tugev alus küberjulgeoleku põhimõtetes, krüptograafilistes tehnikates ja andmepõhistes ründetuvastuse meetodites. Kursus tutvustab kaasaegseid küberohte, kaitsemeetmeid ning andmeteaduse ja masinõppe rakendamist ohtude tuvastamisel ja ennetamisel.
kirjeldus_en: This course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in cybersecurity principles, cryptographic techniques, and data-driven methods for detecting attacks. It introduces modern cybersecurity threats, defensive strategies, and the application of data science and machine learning for threat detection and prevention.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- demonstrate knowledge of key concepts in cybersecurity, cryptography, and data science.
- analyze and classify various cyber attack types and their detection mechanisms.
- implement encryption and key exchange algorithms to secure data and communications.
- detect and mitigate network and host-based attacks using appropriate tools and techniques.
- use IDS/IPS and machine learning models for real-time intrusion detection.
- apply data-driven security approaches using real-world cybersecurity datasets.
- utilize SIEM, EDR, and SOAR technologies for effective threat monitoring and incident response.
- monitor, analyze, and respond to cyber threats.

kirjeldus_et:

Seejärel valmivad praktilised grupitööd lõimitud õppest, mille kavasid ühiselt analüüsitakse ning mis ka praktikas osaliselt läbi mängitakse.

Õppijad kavandavad oma minitunnid kas kontaktõppe või e-õppena.
Iga paar-kolmik otsustab  ise, kas tund toimub live-s (tunniplaanijärgsetel seminariaegadel) või individuaalse e-õppena, viimasel juhul saab iga õppija valitud minitunnid läbi teha endale soovitud ajavahemikul. Tunni loojad saavad ise valida keskkonna ja tagasisidestamise keskkonna.
kirjeldus_en:
Introduction of the integrated learning including Integrated Language and Subject learning, the learning concept of current Estonian National Curriculum, general competencies and cross-curricular themes. There is a study visit to experience integrated learning in the library environment.

Learners plan integrated mini-lessons in groups of 2 to 3 (4). These can be live lessons (take place during the seminars) or e-lessons. For e-lessons the student choose the e-learning environment, and also the environment of assessment-feedback. All e-lessons are open to other students to visit in suitable time.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Is able to describe and practically implement:
the learning concept of current Estonian National Curriculum, including general competencies and cross-curricular themes. Is familiar with the principles of Integrated Language and Subject learning.

Plans learning experiences in an integrated way (practical lesson planning & teaching) including the general competencies and cross-curricular themes into the objectives and considering them in choosing teaching and learning and assessment methods.

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus antakse ülevaade Eesti hariduskorralduslikust süsteemist ning selle toimimise põhialustest. Tuuakse paralleele Euroopa Liidu arengutega ning seostatakse arengud mitmesuguste katusorganisatsioonide tegevusega. Alustatakse diskussiooni hariduse eesmärgi teemal ning selle saavutamise erinevate teede osas.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of Estonian educational system and main principles in it. European dimension is introduced as engine of several changes and also connections to some roof organizations having influence to the system. Discussions about the goals in education and different ways how to achieve it are started.
opitulemused_en:
- Knows main principles of Estonian educational system.
- Knows main educational trends in EU and reasons for those.
- Identifies different managerial ways to achieve educational goals.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
Osalemine ettevalmistunult (üliõpilane on tutvunud ette antud lugemismaterjalidega seminarideks 2-5) vähemalt 80% seminaridest.

Üliõpilane on esitanud tähtaegselt (vähemalt 2 nädalate enne esitluse toimumist) nõuetele vastava kursuse lõputöö "Hariduselus lahendamist vajava probleemi lahendusprotsess" esiltuse ja esitlenud seda (rühmatööna) seminaris. 

Arvestuse saamiseks on vajalik, et esitlus sisaldaks järgmist:
* Ülevaade probleemist (millist probleemi lahendatakse; probleemi kontekst; probleemiga seotud osapooled; probleemiga seotud arvandmestik.)
* Probleemi seotus kehtivate arengukavadega.
* Probleemi asetumine rahvusvahelisse konteksti.
* Probleemi puudutav peamine õiguslik regulatsioon.
* Millised hariduse katusorganisatsioonid tuleb kaasata probleemi lahendamisse? Millised on nende katusorganisatsioonide võimalikud seisukohad selles teemas avalike infokandjate põhjal?
* Milline on rühma ettepanek probleemi lahendamiseks? Kas ja milliseid õigusakte ning kuidas tuleks muuta? Kes on olulised osapooled, et soovitud lahendus rakenduks?
* Milline on soovitud tulemus, kui probleem on lahendatud? Kuidas hindate mõju?

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Kursus on mõeldud keskkonnatehnoloogia, geoloogia ja ökoloogia 1. aasta üliõpilastele ning kõigile neile, kes soovivad mõista nii looduses kui ka tehiskeskkonnas toimuvaid protsesse keemilisest aspektist. Keskkonnakeemia kursuses käsitletakse neid keemia põhialuseid, mis võimaldavad aru saada keskkonnas kulgevate protsessidest, samuti keskkonna saastamise ning selle mõjude uurimise keemilistest alustest. Kursusel õpitakse arvutama ainete ja ioonide sisaldusi ning arutatakse saadud tulemuse üle, et motiveerida üliõpilasi kaasamõtlema ja -rääkima keskkonnasaastumise teemadel. Teemade läbirääkimisel ja ülesannete lahendamisel oodatakse üliõpilaste osalemist individuaalsetes ja rühmaaruteludes, et valmistuda erinevates kategooriates esitatud eksamiküsimuste vastamiseks (vt. all). Kursuse auditoorsed kohtumised toimuvad kaks korda nädalas. Lisaks tuleb ajakava jälgides lahendada ja esitada tähtajaliselt kuus kohustuslikku kodutööd, millele lisaks võib esitada veel 2 kodutöö, mis ei ole kohustuslikud.  
Eksamiküsimuste kategooriad: mõisted (4 küsimust), valikvastusega küsimus, lühike selgitus (4 küsimust), pikem analüüs (2 küsimust), keskkonnakeemiline maailmapilt, arvutusülesanded.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is intended for 1st year students of environmental technology, geology and ecology and for all those who want to understand the processes taking place in both natural and man-made environments from a chemical point of view. The course of environmental chemistry covers the basics of chemistry, which allow to understand the processes taking place in the environment, as well as the chemical bases of environmental pollution and the study of its impact. The course teaches how to calculate the contents of substances and ions and discusses the results in order to motivate students to think and talk about environmental problems. Students are expected to participate in individual and group discussions to discuss topics and solve tasks in order to prepare for answering exam questions in different categories (see below). The course meetings take place twice a week. In addition, following the schedule, six compulsory homework assignments must be resolved and submitted within the deadline, in addition to which 2 more non-compulsory homework assignments may be submitted.
Categories of examination questions: concepts (4 questions), multiple choice question, short explanation (4 questions), longer analysis (2 questions), environmental chemical worldview, calculation tasks.

nimi_et: Prantsuse keel kõrgtasemele I, B2.1 > B2.2
nimi_en: French for the Advanced Level I, B2.1 > B2.2
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Kursusel osalemise eelduseks on prantsuse keele teadmised Euroopa Nõukogu keeleoskustasemel B 2.1/B 2.2 või Erasmus programmi raames vahetusüliõpilasena saadud kogemused prantsuskeelses ülikoolis.
Semestris käsitletav teemade valik on aktuaalne. See lähtub Prantsuse ajakirjandusest, nii jooksvatest ajakajalistest kui ka temaatilistest ajakirjanumbritest. Kursuse arutelude aluseks on ka ühiselt vaadatavad filmid, millega kaasneb filmianalüüs.
Teemad:
- Ülevaade prantsuse meediast: televisioon, tähtsamad päeva- ja nädalalehed
- Kultuur ja ühiskond: aktuaalsed tendentsid 
- Prantsuse kino: täispikkade ja lühifilmide vaatamine ja analüüsimine nende filmide jaoks koostatud pedagoogiliste materjalide põhjal; sünopsise ja stsenaariumi mõistmine ja koostamine, kriitiliste hinnangute andmine 
- Prantsuse keele arengutendentsid
- Argumenteerimisoskuse arendamine: teksti ülesehitus ja loogilised seosed
kirjeldus_en:
The course presupposes the Council of Europe Level A 2.1/A 2.2, or a language experience acquired during a (students' exchange) stay in a French-speaking university
The subjects treated during  the course will be chosen according to the current events in France. The movies included into the course as an audio-visual aid for further discussions, will also be used to practice film analysis.
Contents by general topics:
- General survey of French media: television, main daily and weekly newspapers
- Culture and society: current tendencies
- French cinema: movies and short films' analysis will be based on didactical materials (a set of different questions and tasks related to the film) available on the net.
- French language in evolution
- Means for developing argumentation skills:  how to construct a coherent text.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- By the end of the course the student will have improved his oral expression skills towards more clarity and fluency, has enriched his vocabulary. The student has also developed his comprehension of written and spoken texts, their use of language has improved in terms of rhythm and phonetics.

Kursus koosneb interaktiivsetest loengutest. Loengu esimeses osas sõnastatakse esmalt probleem ja tuuakse tegelik näide mõjuhinnangu läbiviimisest. Loengu teises osas võetakse käsile praktiline ülesanne, mida lahendatakse loengu näites analoogselt tudengite poolse diskussiooni läbi. kirjeldus_en:
The class in divide conceptually into two parts:
1) the theory, logic and methods behind impact assessment; and 
2) application of the methods on actual use cases and the interpretation of the results

The course will consist primarily of interactive lectures. The first part of the lecture gives an example of the problem and an actual impact assessment. This is followed by a practical task where students have to use the same analytical approach to go through the steps needed to conduct an impact assessment for a defined problem. For selected examples an actual data driven impact assessment will be conducted in class and the results interpreted.

kirjeldus_en: The subject focuses on various religious branches within Islam, or which have grown out of or been influenced by Islam (Salafism, Wahhabism, Ahmadia, Alevis, Alavids, Zaids, Ismailites, Druze, Jezids, Baha'i religion, etc.), presents the history of these movements, ritual perceptions and the connection with the mainstream of Islam. - 1) has an overview of the different branches of Islam and their peculiarities
- 2) is able to compare different  branches of Islam with each other and with the main direction of Islam
- 3) is able to work with source materials;
- 4) is able to analyze the pluralistic religious landscape of Islam.

kirjeldus_et:
Ainekursusel on kolm moodulit: 1) erialase teadusartikli kirjutamine, 2) teadustöö tulemuste suuline esitamine kitsale erialaesindajate ringile (näiteks teaduskonverentsidel) ja laiemale üldsusele (näiteks TED-talks, teaduse populariseerimine kooliõpilaste seas jms) ja 3) populaarteaduslike tekstide kirjutamine (Novaatori või Vikipeedia artiklid, teadusblogid, doktoritöö populaarteaduslik kokkuvõte jms). 

Kursuse peamine eesmärk on kogemusõppe teel arendada loomulikus ja turvalises keskkonnas doktorantide eneseväljendusoskust. Kursus võimaldab paindlikku õpet, sealhulgas õppijate individuaalsetele vajadustele vastavat e-õpet ja praktikume.

1. Teadusartikli kirjutamine

Kursus arendab teadusartiklite ja muude teadustöö keskkonda sobivate tekstide kirjutamise oskust. Selles moodulis arendatakse kirjalikku väljendusoskust teadusartikli kirjutamisega ning kaasõppijatelt ja õppejõult saadava põhjaliku tagasisidega. Kursuse lõpuks valmib üliõpilasel esitamisvalmis teadusartikli käsikiri.

2. Teadustöö tulemuste suuline esitamine

Kursus arendab teadustöö tulemuste suulise esitamise oskust. Selles moodulis arendatakse suulist väljendusoskust teadusliku ettekande koostamise ning kaasõppijatelt ja õppejõult saadava põhjaliku tagasisidega. Kursuse lõpuks valmib üliõpilasel esitamisvalmis (konverentsi)ettekanne.

3. Teaduskommunikatsioon 

Kursusel arendatakse populaarteaduslike ettekannete koostamise ja avaliku esinemise osksusi. Selles moodulis arendatakse kirjalikku ja suulist väljendusoskust populaarteaduslike tekstide koostamise ja kaasõppijatelt ja õppejõult saadava põhjaliku tagasisidega.
kirjeldus_en:
Communication science is threefold: (1) writing a research article in English for publication in your discipline; (2) communicating your research orally to a scientific audience at, for example, science conferences, and/or communicating your research orally to non-science audiences (think about formats such as TED speeches or presentations to high school students); (3) writing non-scientific texts about your research, i.e. texts that popularises your science or discipline (think about formats such as Novaator articles or Wikipedia articles or blog posts or newspaper articles or the popular science chapter of your thesis).

1.	Scientific writing: 

The course increases your writing skills of scientific and professional genres. This section of the course provides you with opportunities to apply these skills in the process of writing a full academic paper and to receive ample feedback from your peers and the instructor. By the end of the course you should have a complete draft (more or less) ready for submission. 

2.	Presenting science: 

The course increases your presentation skills of scientific and professional genres. This section of the course provides you with opportunities to apply these skills in the process of presenting a full academic presentation and to receive ample feedback from your peers and the instructor. By the end of the course you should have a presentation (more or less) ready for a conference. 

3.	Popular science: 

The course increases your presentation skills of scientific and professional genres. This section of the course provides you with opportunities to apply these skills in the process of writing a popular science article and present a popular science presentation and to receive ample feedback from your peers and the instructor. By the end of the course you should have an article and a presentation (more or less) ready.

kirjeldus_et:
Õppeaine konkreetne sisu aastati erinev. Teemade valikut muudetakse ja täiendatakse vastavalt vajadusele. 
1. Valentsiteooria: Ülevaade erinevatest süntaksiteooriatest (dependentsgrammatika, valentsi- ja käändeteooria(d)), nendes kasutatavatest põhimõistetest ja rakendusvõimalustest lingvistikas. Lausemudelid ja nende seos moodustajate tähendusega. Verbi valentsi kajastamisvõimalusi sõnaraamatutes. Rektsiooni ja valentsi probleemid võõrkeele õpetamisel.
2. Fraseoloogia: Ülevaade fraseoloogia kui teaduse kujunemisest ning fraseologismide erinevatest käsitlustest. Fraseologismide tekkimise keelelised, pragmaatilised ja ajaloolis-kultuurilised tingimused. Fraseologismide klassifikatsioonid. Fraseologismide kasutamine tekstis (eri funktsionaalstiilides). 
3. Saksa keele ajavormid: Ajavormide absoluutne ja relatiivne funktsioon; leksikaalsed vahendid aegade ja ajaliste seoste väljendamiseks; konteksti osa temporaalsete funktsioonide määratlemisel. Kesksel kohal on kahe minevikuvormi, preteeritumi ja perfekti ühiste ja erinevate joonte analüüs.
kirjeldus_en:
The concrete content of the course differs annually. The choice of themes is changed and replenished according to necessity.
1.	Theory of valency. Overview of different theories of syntax (dependence grammar, valency and case theories, their main concepts and ways of application in linguistics. Sentence models and their relation with the meaning of constituents. Possibilities of expressing verb valency in dictionaries. Problems of government and valency in foreign language teaching.
2.	Phraseology. Overview of formation of phraseology as a research area and different treatments of phraseological expressions. Linguistic, pragmatic, historical and cultural conditions for the genesis of phraseological expressions. Classifications of phraseological expressions. Use of phraseological expressions in texts (in different functional styles).
3.	German tenses. Absolute and relative function of tenses; lexical means for expressing time and temporal relations; the role of context in determining temporal functions. The central role belongs to the analysis of similarities and differences of two past forms - the preterite and the perfect.
opitulemused_en: - The student who has successfully completed the course is familiar with theoretical foundations and development of methodology in the areas discussed in the seminar and is able to apply this knowledge.

M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed" õpik ja töövihik
Teemad: 

1) Kaubandus ja tarbijakaitse. Grammatika: ainsuse ja mitmuse osastav, umbisikulise tegumoe minevik.	
2) Kodukeemia ja prügi. Grammatika: põhiarvsõnade käänamine, v-, tav- ja nud- kesksõna.
3) Kool ja haridus. Grammatika: liitlause, sõnajärg lauses.
4) Tervis ja eluiga.Grammatika: verbirektsioon (saav kääne), sihitud ja sihilised tegusõnad.
kirjeldus_en:
Textbook:
M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed";  the student book and the work book
Topics:

1) Commerce and consumer protection. Grammar: partitive (singular and plural), impersonal voice (past tense).
2) Household chemistry and garbage. Grammar: declination of cardinal numerals, participle.
3) School and education. Grammar: compound and complec sentences, word order in a sentence.
4) Health and lifespan. Grammar: verb government, transitive and intransitive verbs.
opitulemused_en:
- After completion of the course, students have mastered the skills required to take the Advanced Estonian Language Test (C1).
- Speaking C1: students can give clear and detailed descriptions on a wide range of topics related to personal experiences, they can develop a clear argument, expanding and supporting their points of view and comparing different viewpoints.
- Writing C1: students can write clear, detailed texts on a variety of topics, write a report or an essay using a variety of sentence types.
- Listening C1: students can understand the main ideas of long and complex speech in standard language, listen critically, draw conclusions and recognize indirect sociocultural implications.
- Reading C1: students can read long and complex texts for different purposes (newspapers, overviews, instructions), using appropriate reference sources and reading strategies.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus sisaldab loenguid ja praktikume. Aine käigus käsitletakse hammaste, parodondi ja suulimaskesta haiguste etioloogilisi tegureid, patogeneesi, diferentsiaal diagnostikat ja ravi iseärasusi lastel. Käsitletakse arengu käigus tekkivaid hambakudede muutusi. Õpitakse hambakaariese kulgu, seda mõjutavaid tegureid, kaariese erinevaid staadiume ja nende ravi piimahammaskonnas. Käsitletakse kaariese põhilisi komplikatsioone:pulpiit ja periodontiit, nende diagnostika ja diferentsiaaldiagnostika meetodeid ja ravi erinevaid võimalusi piima-ja vahelduvas hammaskonnas, ning juurte formeerumise perioodi jäävhammaskonnas. Õpitakse hindama parodondi seisundit laste hammaskonnas, käsitletakse lapseea sh. juveniilse parodontiidi diagnostikat ja ravi meetodeid. Õpitakse erinevaid haigusi, mille kliinilised nähud avalduvad limaskestal. Põhjalikumalt käsitletakse lastel enamesinevaid stomatiite ja nakkushaigustega seotud muutusi suuõõne limaskestal.
kirjeldus_en: The course includes lectures and practical trainings. Etiological factors, pathogenesis and characteristic features of treatment of dental-,pulpal-,periodontal-and oral mucosal diseases in children will be covered during the course. Changes of dental tissues which occur during development will be covered. The course of caries, its affecting factors, different stages of caries and their treatment in decidous-, changing-and permanent teeth and in the period of root formation. The diagnostics and treatment methods of childhood periodontitis including agressive periodontitis will be covered. Various diseases will be learned which have mucosal clinical signs. More frequent changes of oral mucosa associated with infectious diseases will be covered in detail. Traumatic injuries of the teeth will be covered.
opitulemused_en: - The aim of the subject is to give basic knowledge of oral and dental diseases in children. Students who have passed the course must know how to diagnose and treat diseses of dental hard tissues, pulpitis and periodontal abscess in decidous-, changing and permanenet teeth. Students.have to diagnose the changes in periodontium and oral mucosa and know how to treat these changes.

kirjeldus_en: The course starts with an aim to define international relations as a discipline driven by specific practical and theoretical concerns, followed by a short introduction into the evolution of the discipline. The second, and main, part of the course includes a series of lectures and seminars which focus on the key formative concepts, such as sovereignty, anarchy and governance, agency, structure and the state, international system and international society, power, security, war and peace, conflict and cooperation, norms and identity, the role of the individual. The concepts are introduced through some of the classical texts that have shaped the discipline over the recent years; as a rule, each concept is introduced both from the rationalist and the constructivist perspective.  The concluding part of the course sums it up by linking the problematic of international relations with the notion of modernity and asking whether today's practice of world politics is evolving beyond modernity or back to pre-modern times.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course is able to:
-- Understand the disciplinary logic of international relations and its evolution since the beginning of the 19th century.
-- Identify the agents, variables and main principles in the field of international relations.
-- Understand the key dividing lines between the rationalist and constructivist approaches in contemporary international relations.
-- Enhance their ability to use scholarly concepts of international relations in speech and in writing for academic debate and practice based analysis 
-- Improve their skills of critical selection of sources, analytical reading and synthesis of sources. 
-- To find and formulate practical problems and needs in field of international relations and law, demanding complex inter-disciplinary research and solutions.

- knows, what a category and a functor is,
- knows different types of morphisms, objects and functors,
- knows what natural transformations are and is able to compose them in two ways,
- can prove and make use of the Yoneda Lemma,

kirjeldus_et:
See kursus on loodud andmaks üliõpilastele ülevaate nakkushaiguste epidemioloogia põhimõtetest ja praktikast, keskendudes sellele, kuidas nakkushaiguste esinemine ja kontroll rahvatervislikele aspektidele.

Selle kursuse õpieesmärgid hõlmavad sügavamat arusaama järgmisest:

1.	Nakkushaiguste epidemioloogia üldpõhimõtted, 
nakkushaiguste peamised levikuviisid, nakkusahel, epideemiatekke tingimused ja kulg.

2.	 Puhangute uurimine, seire, nakkushaiguste andmete analüüs ja laboratoorne diagnostika.

3.	 Erinevad nakkushaiguste kontrolli strateegiad.

4. Epidemioloogiliste meetodite rakendamine nakkushaiguste mõistmisel ja kontrollimisel.

Üliõpilased on võimelised pakkuma välja uuringukavandeid erinevate nakkushaigustega seotud puhangute jaoks ja põhjendama nende valikut; kriitiliselt hindama nakkushaiguste epidemioloogiaalast kirjandust; ning tugevdama oma oskust koguda ja esitada tõendust ennetus- ja kontrolliprogrammide väljatöötamiseks. Käsitletakse nakkushaiguste epidemioloogias kasutatavaid mõisteid (inkubatsiooniperiood, latentperiood, levikuvisiid, allikad ja reservuaar).
kirjeldus_en:
This course is designed to provide students with an overview of the principles and practices of infectious diseases epidemiology with focus on how the presence and control of communicable diseases affects public health locally, nationally and internationally.

Learning objectives for this course include a greater understanding of: 

1) general principles of infectious diseases epidemiology, including outbreak investigation, surveillance, analysis of infectious diseases data, and laboratory analyses;

2) major modes of transmission of infectious diseases;

3) different control strategies for infectious diseases; and

4) the practical application of epidemiologic tools for the understanding and control of infectious diseases.

Students will be able to propose study designs for different infectious disease-related questions and be able to justify the choice of these designs; critically evaluate the infectious disease epidemiology literature; and reinforce their ability to present and write scientifically to develop prevention and control programs. Epidemiological characteristics such as incubation period, infectious period, means of transmission and reservoir of these infectious diseases will be evaluated.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Upon successful completion of the module, a student will be able to:

Explain key concepts, terms and quantities used to describe the frequency, distribution and transmissibility of infectious diseases.
Explain the principles underlying simple transmission dynamic models of infectious diseases.
Design, conduct, analyse, interpret and report an outbreak investigation.
Interpret and evaluate surveillance data on infectious diseases.
Explain main infection control methods.

kirjeldus_en: The course is divided roughly into two blocks: the first focuses on electoral behavior while the second examines electoral systems. The first half of the course presents the main theoretical approaches to voting behavior, as well as the most important empirical results. It also offers an overview of the major cross-national survey studies in the field. The second half of the course examines the characteristics of electoral systems, their prevalence in the world, ways to measure them, and their effects on party systems.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successfully passing the course, students will be able to:
- 1) understand the role of elections in representative democracy,
- 2) distinguish the impact of different electoral systems on voting and party behavior,
- 3) describe, compare, contrast, and critically evaluate the main theories of voting,
- 4) be familiar with the major cross-national databases for survey and electoral data in order to find data for independent research projects
- 5) design an empirical research project that uses survey and/or electoral data to test theories of political behavior.

nimi_en: Human Resource Management and Organization Behaviour
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Aine läbinud üliõpilane tunneb personali juhtimise ja organisatsioonikäitumise sisu ja mõistab kohta organisatsiooni (ettevõtte) tegevuse suunamisel,  nii töötaja kui juhi töö spetsiifikast lähtuvalt. Teab personali juhtimise eripärasid, sh personali planeerimise, kujundamise (värbamine, valik), rakendamise (hindamine, tasustamine) ning koolitamise ja arendamise valdkondades. Mõistab organisatsioonikäitumise põhiküsimusi, sh. indiviidi hoiakud, väärtused, motivatsioon, grupi/meeskonna toimimine, organisatsiooni sidustamine. On omandanud teadmised ning praktilised oskused inimressursi juhtimise ja organisatsioonikäitumise olulisemates küsimustes. On omandanud praktilised kogemused personali kujundamise ja rakendamise ning suunamise ja meeskonnatöö valdkondades. Oskab analüüsida personali juhtimise ja organisatsioonikäitumise probleeme ning prognoosida inimressursi juhtimise positiivseid ja negatiivseid tagajärgi.
Oskab hinnata inimkäitumise rolli ja arendamise võimalusi organisatsioonis.
kirjeldus_en: The subject involves personnel management and organizational behaviour. Its aim is to analyse the link between the functioning of an organization and the human behaviour. The problems connected with the study of bearing are handled from the point of view of the person filling the role of an executive. Under the observation are the questions about formulating and harnessing the staff and also the theoretical and practical problems of the employees behaviour.
opitulemused_en:
- Understands the role of human resource management and organisational behaviour in the development of organisation (enterprise) from both the manager's and the employee's perspective.
- Knows the specifics of personnel management: personnel planning, recruitment and selection, appraisal and compensation and development.
- Understands the key issues of organisational behaviour: beliefs, values, motivation, group/teamwork principles, and connectedness in organisation.
- Can relate human resource management and organisational behaviour with management as a whole from both perspectives: theoretical and practical.
- Is able to design and develop of personnel (recruitment and selection) and manage it effectively (appraisal and compensation).
- Is able to assess the human behaviour and its development possibilities in an organisation.
- Has acquired practical experience how to design and develop of personnel.

kirjeldus_et:
Loengukursuse esimene osa sisaldab arutlusi kvantmehaanika põhiprintsiipide ja -postulaatide sisu ja tähenduse üle, ülevaadet kvantteooria teket enim mõjutanud eksperimentidest (Plancki kvanthüpotees, fotoefekt, Millikani katsed, Comptoni hajumine), näiteid kvantmehaanika deduktiivse ülesehituse erinevatest ekvivalentsetest variantidest (Schrödingeri, Heisenbergi ja Diraci esituste põhivõrrandite tuletamine; koordinaadi-, impulsi- ja energiaesituste eripära).
Teises osas omandatakse teadmisi hajumise kvantteooriast. Detailsemalt käsitletakse osalainete meetodit ja häiritusest põhjustatud kvantsiirete teooriat (Dysoni rida, Diraci-Schiffi-Fermi kuldreegel, Borni rea summeerimine ja visualiseerimine), samuti mitmesuguseid tunnel- ning resonantsnähtusi. Põgusalt tutvutakse ka pöördhajumisteooria alustega ning selgitatakse mittepeegeldavate potentsiaalide vahetut seost mittelineaarsete evolutsioonivõrrandite kuju säilitavate püsilahendite ehk solitonidega.
Kolmandas osas võetakse vaatluse alla üldine momendi operaatori omaväärtusprobleem (mis lahendati enne kvantmehaanika teket!). Uuritakse spinn-momendi ja spinn-magnetmomendi mõistete füüsikalist sisu ning osakeste spinniga seotud eksperimente ja rakendusi (Stern-Gerlachi katsetulemuste tõlgendamine, Larmori pretsessioon ja tuumamagnetresonants, ülipeen-vastasmõju ja vesiniku 21-cm joon). Analüüsitakse osakeste eristamatuse printsiibist tulenevaid järeldusi (Pauli keeluprintsiip), spinni otsest mõju kvantansamblite omadustele (Maxwell-Bolzmanni, Fermi-Diraci ja Bose-Einsteini jaotusseadused), selgitatakse elektronide tsooniteooria üldprintsiipe, Brillouini tsooni mõistet, tahkiste klassifikatsiooni elektrijuhtivuse alusel (metallid, pooljuhid, dielektrikud), Bose-Einsteini kondensatsiooni olemust jne.
Lisainfo: vt Õppematerjale.
kirjeldus_en:
Part One: main principles and postulates of quantum mechanics; Planck hypothesis; photoelectronic effect; Millikan experiments; Compton scattering; Schrödinger, Heisenberg and Dirac pictures; coordinate, momentum and energy representations.
Part Two: quantum theory of scattering (Dyson series, Dirac-Schiff-Fermi golden rule, summation and visualization of Born series); tunnelling and resonance effects; basics of inverse scattering; relationship between reflectionless potentials and solitons.
Part Three: general eigenvalue problem of angular momentum (solved by Elie Cartan in 1913); spinn momentum and magnetic moment; Stern-Gerlach experiments; Larmor precession; nuclear magnetic resonance; hyper-fine spin-spin interaction and 21 cm line of hydrogen; identical particles and Pauli principle; basics of quantum statistics: fermion and boson systems at low temperatures; Bose-Einstein condensation; general principles of zone theory: Brillouin zone, metals, semiconductors and dielectrics.

Kursusel on neli põhisuunda: 
Esmalt saab ülevaate mittereligioossete mõttevoolude  ajaloolisest arengust ja kujunemisest, et tekiks arusaam, miks mõistetakse ja mõtestatakse mittereligioossust täna just nii nagu seda tehakse. Kursuse teine tahk seevastu tegelebki tänase mittereligioossuse väljendumisvormidega sotsiaalteaduslikust aspektist. Kolmandaks pöörame erilist tähelepanu mittereligioossusele Eesti ajaloos ja tänases ühiskonnas ning viimaks, neljandana, käsitleme ka neid aspekte, mis on seotud mittereligioossuse ja teaduse, riigi ning avaliku ruumi ja organisatsioonidega.
kirjeldus_en:
The course has four main strands: 
First, an overview of the historical development and emergence of non-religious currents of thought is give, in order to gain an understanding of why non-religion is understood and conceptualised today in the way it is. The second part of the course will deal with contemporary expressions of non-religiousness from a social scientific perspective. Thirdly, we will pay particular attention to non-religion in Estonian history and in contemporary society, and, finally, we will address aspects of non-religion in relation to science, the state and public space and organisations.
opitulemused_en:
- * From the perspective of intellectual history: the student is aware of the origins, development and impact of non-religious currents of thought
- * Philosophically: the student is familiar with the main positions of non-religious schools of thought
- * Socio-scientifically: the student is aware of the different expressions of non-religion in contemporary culture and human life

kirjeldus_et: Disain saab alguse probleemist, läbides kõiki eluvaldkondi. Käsitletakse disaini kui loomeprotsessi. Teemad: stiilid ja stilistika, graafiline disain, toote disain, disain keskkonnas ja  keskkonna disain.  Disainiprotsess: ajurünnak idee leidmiseks, probleemi sõnastamine, ideekavandi visandamine ja arutelu seminaris. Kursuse võtab kokku probleemi analüüsi põhjal valitud/ täiustatud eseme disainlahendus (rühmatööna). Rühmatöö esitlus kaaslastele ja arutelu töö käigus selgunud seostest õpetajatööga, näited ülesandeideedest õpilastele ning tööprotsessi reflekteerimine leidmaks praktilisi meetodeid õpetajatöö jaoks.
kirjeldus_en: Design begins with a problem, going through all areas of life. Design is treated as a creative process. Topics: styles and stylistics, graphic design, product design, design in the environment, and environmental design. Design process: brainstorming to find an idea, formulating the problem, sketching a concept design, and discussing in a seminar. The course concludes with a design solution for an object selected/improved based on the analysis of the problem (as group work). Presentation of the group work to peers and discussion of the connections that emerged during the work with teaching work, examples of assignment ideas for students, and reflection on the work process to find practical methods for teaching work.

nimi_en: Special Seminar on German Literary Studies
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_en: The seminar will raise awareness about the relation among key agents of society. It will first discuss different positions with regard to the concept of biopolitics, with a focus on Michel Foucault and Giorgio Agamben. Based on this theoretical foundation, it will look at the current Covid-19-situation in Germany and analyse three recent German novels which describe health biopolitics scenarios in fictional dystopias. These analyses will allow to get familiar with some representatives of contemporary German literature, reflect on the role of literature in society and on the functioning of societies.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, the students will be thoroughly familiar with several key texts and authors of the topical cultural theory concept of biopolitics and can explain their specificity.
They will have thoroughly read three contemporary German novels.
They will be able to understand, describe and apply this concept to an important current debate and understand better how societies function generally.
They will have better understood and practiced how to approach and discuss literary texts.
They will have developed their own ideas about the relationship of politics and literature as well as on the role of the arts in society.
They will have trained their reading and analytical skills of highly complex primary and secondary literature, and practiced their presentational skills.
They will have developed their own methodological and theoretical skills and applied them to a text in academic oral and written exercises, producing a cogent, clearly structured evaluation.
They will also have developed and practised transferable skills such as problem solving, data analysis, communication skills, time management, work ethics, listening and providing feedback.
They will have developed digital skills such as using search engines and data banks while being aware of their structure and operation modes so that they can critically evaluate the sources and their reliability. Furthermore, they have practised using various word processing functions and creating content in different formats.

kirjeldus_en: During this course, the overview of common study types in epidemiology is given, together with a range of statistical models developed to analyse the data from such studies. - After passing this course, the student knows how to:
- - Read in, manipulate and visualize data with R
- - Is familiar with different types of epidemiological study plans and knows how to correctly analyze accordingly collected data
- - Conduct advance level analysis with survival data, such as time-splitting etc

kirjeldus_et:
Practice Report
After completing his/her practice, the student prepares a practice report explaining where the practice was done, what legal tasks performed during the practice, what where the benefits the practice, etc. The report should include a more detailed coverage of one specific case or issue on which the student worked. The practice report must be signed by the immediate supervisor. The immediate supervisor provides a separate assessment of the student, e.g. did the student have necessary theoretical background, was the student able to apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations, how the student was able to integrate into the team and work with others. The assessment must not be shown to the student, but given in a sealed envelope which the student attaches to his/her practice report. The student submits his/her practice report to the contact person (currently Lehte Leesik) at the School at the earliest convenience. There is no specific form for a practice report or an assessment. 
Assessment of the Practice Report
School's practice supervisors review the practice report, and decide whether the practice was related more to international law or human rights and whether the student receives the credits in the form of P2OG.02.215 International Law Practice (6 ECTS) or P2OG.02.216 Human Rights Law Practice (6 ECTS). If necessary, they will meet with the student to discuss the practice and its results. The final result of the practice is either passed or not passed.

kirjeldus_et: See kursus katab martingaaliteooria põhimõisteid mahus, mis on vajalik finantsmatemaatika alase kirjanduse mõistmiseks. Alustades diskreetse aja martingaalidest, tuuakse sisse põhimõisted ja tulemused ning jõutakse pideva aja martingaalide, Ito stohhastilise diferentsiaalarvutuse ja stohhastiliste diferentsiaalvõrrandite rakendusteni finantsmatemaatikas.
kirjeldus_en: The course covers the fundamentals of martingales. Starting with discrete time martingales, it also covers some basics of continuous time martingales. Ito calculus as well as applications to option pricing thery are discussed..
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course the students
- - Know the definition and basic properties of conditional expectation and is able to use them in solving problems related to stochastic processes
- - Knows the meaning of the basic terms of martingale theory (martingale, sub- and supermartingale, square and cross variation, uniformly integrable martingale, stopping time etc)
- - Understands the implications of the martingale convergence theorem
- - Understands the construction of the stochastic integral and knows it's basic properties
- - Knows and is able to use the Ito's formula
- - Understands the concept of the risk neutral measure in option pricing, knows and is able to use the Girsanov's theorem.

nimi_en: British Children's Literature in Language Learning
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Aine keskendub I ja II kooliastme õpilastele mõeldud inglise lasteraamatutele ja nende autoritele, tuntud tegelaskujudele ja raamatukangelastele, teoste positiivsele ja kasvatuslikule sõnumile. Analüüsitakse nii klassikalisse kui ka kaasaegsesse inglise lastekirjandusse kuuluvaid teoseid. Pööratakse tähelepanu lasteluulele, muinasjuttudele ja tänapäeva populaarsetele lasteraamatutele. Kirjanduse sidumisel keeleõppega õpitakse kasutama I ja II kooliastme õpilastele kohaseid õpitegevusi. Tutvutakse erinevate didaktiliste võtetega, mis muudavad lastekirjanduse arendavaks ja motiveerivaks võõrkeeleõpetuse vahendiks alghariduses. Aine õpetamisel kasutatakse interaktiivseid meetodeid, draamaülesandeid, analüüsitakse filmikatkendeid ja tehakse läbi erinevaid õpetamisvõtteid, mis sobivad lastekirjanduse õpetamiseks I ja II kooliastmes.
kirjeldus_en: The subject concentrates on recognized children's books, well-known characters and heroes, positive and educative message of the British Children's Literature treated in the 1st and 2nd school stage.  Different authors, both children's classic and contemporary tendencies are analyzed. Children's poetry (nursery rhymes), fairy tales and contemporary BCL are focused on. While integrating literature and language learning appropriate activities which motivate foreign language learning in the 1st and 2nd school stages are introduced. Thus interactive methods, drama activities, as well as analyses of film clips are used.

kirjeldus_en: The web-based course revises and expands the knowledge of grammar on prepositions, the rection of the verb and pronouns. Every grammar topic will be introduced by a theoretical part that gives the rules and examples and which is followed by self-test exercises, graded tests and finally, the final test.
opitulemused_en: - By the end of the course, the students will have improved their knowledge of the covered grammar topics and they are able to apply the knowledge both in oral and written speech.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
The number of times you can take the self-test exercises is unlimited. The teacher cannot see these results. 

The graded tests of all chapters consist of interim tests and the final test. In order to get a "Pass", it is necessary to get a positive result (at least 51% of the points) in all interim and final tests. It is possible to take the graded tests for the second time if the first attempt was less than 51%.

The tests come with a time limit. It is different in the case of each test. When you are in the middle of the test, it is visible how much time is given and how much time is still left.

NB! If the self-test exercise or the graded test require using the letter ß, you can use the following keyboard combinations: the keys Alt 0223 / Alt Gr 0223 or letters "ss".

The period of three weeks has been given to learn each topic. At the beginning of the course, the graded tests of all three topics are available, but after the three weeks for each topic is over, the respective test will close. At the end of the course, there is one additional week given to eliminate any shortcomings. In the case of graded tests, you will find out your results right away (except for the picture assignment: relative pronoun C). Before taking the relative pronoun C test, it is highly recommended to take the preliminary test, which is also available on the page of graded tests. It is possible to see the scores of the graded tests on the menu on the left from "My grades". 

On the main page in Moodle, there are three forums available:
1. News and information - this is the place where the teachers can post additional information about the course.
2. Issues - the students can turn to the teachers or fellow students if they should have any questions or issues regarding the exercises and test.
3. Freies Gespräch - the students can talk to each other in German, preferably, regarding matters of this course and other topics.

The following topics will be addressed:


1.	General introduction. Definition of the subject.
2.	The evolution of the evolutionary thought.
3.	Evidence for evolution
4.	Variability and struggle for existence
5.	The theory of natural selection
6.	Random events population genetics
7.	The Neutral Theory of Molecular Evolution
8.	Two and multilocus population genetics: LD- linkage disequilibrium
9.	Genome evolution
10.	The origin and history of life, (incl. mass extinctions). 
11.	Evolution of man
12.	Evolution of the immune system
13.	Evolvability
14.	Why sex?
15.	Sexual selection
16.	Reconstruction of phylogeny
17.	The units of selection
18.	Adaptive explanation

20.	Evolution and classification

Eksamil on kokku 8-10 küsimust ja ülesannet. Enamik küsimusi nõuavad mõõduka pikkusega kirjalikku selgitust. Abimaterjalide kasutamine ei ole lubatud. Aega on ühe loengu jagu.

Eksamiessee (B) kirjutamine on iseseisev ning esitamine toimub Moodleis. Loengutsükli lõpus tekib Moodlisse esseeteemade nimekiri. Iga loengu/teema kohta saab olema 2-3 essee teemat. Eksami tegemiseks antakse ajaaken (~kaks nädalat) mille sees saab tudeng eksami teha endale sobival ajal. Peale põhieksami aega ja tulemuste teatamist tekib järeleksami ajaaken samal põhimõttel. Eksamil saab iga tudeng loosiga ühe teema ja kirjutab 4h jooksul Moodleis 2-3 lk pikkuse essee.

Aine eest kokku saab saada maksimaalselt 10 punkti.

kirjeldus_et: See kursus arendab üliõpilaste oskust kasutada akadeemilist sõnavara tõhusaks inglise keeles lugemiseks ja kirjutamiseks. Üliõpilased uurivad kollokatsioone, sõnaperekondi, liiteid ja tüvesid ning harjutavad akadeemilistele tekstidele omaste grammatiliste ja leksikaalsete mustrite tuvastamist ja rakendamist. Õppimine toimub praktiliste ülesannete kaudu interaktiivsetes veebiharjutustes. Hindamine põhineb interaktiivsetel sõnavaraülesannetel (70%) ja viiest ülesandest koosneval portfooliol (30%), mis soodustavad oskuste ülekannet autentsetesse akadeemilistesse kontekstidesse.
kirjeldus_en: This course develops students’ knowledge and use of academic vocabulary for effective reading and writing in English. Students will explore collocations, word families, affixes, and roots to expand their lexical range, and practise identifying and applying grammatical and lexical patterns common in academic texts. Learning takes place through hands-on practice with interactive online exercises. Assessment is based on interactive vocabulary exercises (70%) and a portfolio of five tasks (30%) that encourage transfer of skills to authentic academic contexts.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of the course, students will be able to:
- ◦ Apply knowledge of academic vocabulary, collocations, and word formation strategies to expand their lexical repertoire for academic reading and writing.
- ◦ Recognise and use common grammatical and lexical patterns to produce contextually appropriate academic texts.
- ◦ Employ a range of cohesive, comparative, and cause-effect expressions to structure arguments.
- ◦ Integrate vocabulary for reporting, referencing and hedging in order to engage appropriately with sources in academic writing.
- ◦ Reflect on and adapt their use of academic vocabulary and expressions to improve disciplinary appropriateness in their own field of study.

Üliõpilane tegutseb kahe nädala vältel praktikakoolis,  täidab klassiõpetaja tööga seotud ülesandeid, vaatleb ja analüüsib õppetööd, viib läbi II kooliastmes vähemalt 12 proovitundi põhiainetes (eesti keel, matemaatika, loodusõpetus + lisaeriala aine)
Aine õpiväljundite täitmiseks on vaja sooritada põhipraktika koolis, osaleda ava- ja lõpuseminaril ja sooritada Moodle keskkonnas ettenähtud kodutööd.
kirjeldus_en:
Brief description of the content of the classroom teacher's basic practice II:
The student works in a practice school for two weeks, performs tasks related to the work of a class teacher, observes and analyzes teaching work, conducts at least 12 trial lessons in all basic subjects (Estonian language, mathematics, natural sciences + additional subject) in the second grade.
In order to fulfill the learning outcomes of the subject, it is necessary to complete the basic internship at school, participate in the opening and closing seminars and complete the homework prescribed in the Moodle environment.

kirjeldus_en:
The following topics will be discussed:
sociocultural system and subcultures; possibilities and principles of evolvement of subcultures; identification mechanisms of subcultures; the spatial dimensions of subculture; individual identity and agency in subcultures; relationships of race/class/gender/sexuality in subcultures; representation of subcultural sensibilities and activities in arts and media; commodification of subcultures; glocalization of subcultures; (re)writing subcultural history, etc.
opitulemused_en:
- The student will:
- 1)	be familiar with various conceptualizations of subcultures and able to combine them in a consistent semiotic analysis
- 2)	distinguish and identify the complex relations between subcultures and their creative and conflicted interactions with what is considered "dominant culture"
- 3)	be able to predict, demonstrate and evaluate the developments in a certain sociocultural system and its subsystems

nimi_en: Russian Approaches to International Law and Human Rights
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Rahvusvaheline õigus on "eri kohtades erinev", nagu David Kennedy ütles. Vastav kursus keskendub rahvusvahelise õiguse ja inimõiguste eripäradele Venemaal, võttes arvesse nii ajaloolisi, teoreetilisi kui ka praktilisi aspekte. Tähelepanu pööratakse Venemaa rahvusvahelise õiguse teoreetikutele, eelkõige Martensile, kuid ka rahvusvahelise õiguse nõukogude traditsioonile. Lisaks ÜRO ja jus ad bellumiga seotud praktikale analüüsitakse Euroopa inimõiguste õiguse, investori ja riigi vahekohtu ning Venemaa praktika WTOs olulisemaid juhtumeid. Vaadeldakse Venemaa suhtumist rahvusvaheliste vaidluste rahumeelsesse lahendamisse. Lõpus toimub mõne temaatilise filmi vaatamine, et paremini tutvustada Venemaa rahvusvahelise õiguse ja inimõiguste alaste lähenemisviiside filosoofilisi ja isegi teoloogilisi aluseid.
kirjeldus_en: International law is "different in different places", as David Kennedy ones put it. This course focuses on specific features of international law and human rights in Russia, considering both the historical, theoretical and practical aspects of the subject matter. Attention will be paid to Russian theorists of international law, especially Martens but also the Soviet tradition of international law. Leading cases of European human rights law, investor-state arbitration and Russian practice in the WTO will be analysed, besides the obvious practice related to the UN and the jus ad bellum. Russia's attitudes to the peaceful settlement of international disputes will be considered. Finally, by watching together some thematic movies the philosophical and even theological foundations of Russian approaches to international law and human rights will be examined.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course is able to:
- - Explain the specific features of the theory and practice of international law and human rights in Russia
- - Employ the method of comparative international law in the Russian context
- - Find and analyse the legal cases and sources of international law specific to the Russian context
- - Understand the main Russian-related cases in the European Court of Human Rights and other bodies of international adjudication

E	the analysis of legal problems is shallow with significant deficiencies is most aspects; only some rudimentary norms and principles have been used; overall, the coverage of the subject suffers of superficial treatment, poor knowledge of law and unsound presentation [51-60 points]
