kirjeldus_en: The first part of the course is on the univariate GARCH models and their estimation. The second part of the course is on multivariate GARCH models and their estimation. The third part of the course is on univariate and multivariate Stochastic Volatility models and estimation. The fourth part is on Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall. The last part of the course is on how different volatility models can be compared in terms of performance after estimation.

- After passing the course student
- After taking the course students will know about the univariate and multivariate models of volatility; estimation and forecasting of volatilities, covolatilities and correlations between series; how to write a program in Matlab on estimation and forecasting volatility models.

nimi_en: Privacy and Data Protection - Ethics, Law, and Information Technology
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Õppeaine keskendub andmete elutsükliga kaasnevatele õiguslikele, eetilistele ja poliitilistele küsimustele, alustades andmete kogumisest kuni nende säilitamise, töötlemise, analüüsi ja kasutamiseni. Need küsimused haakuvad aruteludega privaatsuse, andmekaitse, jälitustegevuse, turvalisuse, julgeoleku, klassifitseerimise, diskrimineerimise ja otsustamise autonoomia üle. Läbi juhtumianalüüside tutvustatakse erinevaid tehnilisi, õiguslikke ja turupõhiseid lahendusi riskide maandamiseks ning kooskõla saavutamiseks andmete osas kehtivate regulatsioonide ja eetikanormidega.
kirjeldus_en: The course examines legal, ethical and policy issues that characterise the lifecycle of data from collection, to storage, processing, analysis and use. Among else, this includes the discussion of issues related to privacy, data protection, surveillance, security, classification, discrimination, and decision autonomy. Focusing on case studies related to exploring these matters across various disciplines, the course will introduce the technical, legal, and market approaches for managing risks and facilitating compliance with data-related ethical and legal requirements.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Praktikum aitab süvendada optika loengukursuse kuulamisel saadud teadmisi ning võimaldab saada praktilisi kogemusi töös optiliste seadmetega. Praktikum eeldab tulemuste arvutil töötlemise oskust.
Optika kursuse olulisi temaatikaid käsitlev laboratoorsete tööde praktikum, mis on oluliseks täienduseks optika loengukursusele. Praktikumis tutvutakse optiliste mõõteseadmete ja mõõtmiste põhialustega ja saadakse esialgsed optiliste mõõtmiste kogemused. Praktikumis on üles seatud 21 praktikumitööd, mis jagunevad 8 optika eri teemat/ainevaldkonna vahel. Praktikumi sooritamiseks tuleb semestri juures sooritada edukalt 10 laboratoorset tööd.
kirjeldus_en:
The aim of the course is to give students the practical experience in the field of optical measurements. The course includes exercises in geometrical optics, interference, diffraction, dispersion, polarization, reflection and absorption.
The laboratory course is an essential complementary part to the lecture course of Optics and helps reinforce knowledge obtained at lectures. The laboratory course makes acquaintance with the equipment and basic principles of optical measurements, gives some skills in optical experiments. There are assembled 21 different laboratory works divided between 8 sub-subjects of optics in optics laboratory. For fulfilling the academic requirements of this course, 10 laboratory works required to perform successfully during the term.

opitulemused_en:
- Outcomes:
By the end of this course by combination with lectures and seminars students have acquired knowledge and understanding of the most fundamental laws and principles of optics and research techniques; essentials of optical phenomena and their applications. Student will gain the experimental and analytical skills required for optical experiments, basic knowledge on technical design of optical equipment, beam alignment and data acquisition. They understand safe and proper handling of common optical equipment. Students are able to apply the optical principles discussed in optic courses to experimental situations and solve practical problems, compare the experimental results and theory, report the results of an experiment and demonstrate the knowledge and understanding of error analysis.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus toimub neljas osas, aga kahes jaotuses (praktiline ajakirjandus I ja II): 
esimene osa keskendub uudisele kirjutavas meediumis, teine osa uudisele audiomeediumis, kolmas uudisele audiovisuaalses meediumis ja neljas digimeedias. Mõtteliselt on iga osa 6 EAP vääriline.
1) uudis kirjutavas meediumis: tudengid töötavad nädalas ühe täispäeva kui reaalne toimetus, otsides kajastamisväärseid sündmusi, tehes reporteritööd ning kirjutades sama päeva õhtuks valmis uudise.
2) uudis audiomeediumis: tutvustatakse audiouudise tegemise põhimõisteid ja aluseid. Praktiliste tööde abil omandatakse ja kinnistatakse oskusi tekstuudise ja salvestatud uudismaterjali tegemiseks, samuti toimetamisoskusi.
3) uudis audiovisuaalses meediumis: igal nädalal kahel õppepäeval toimuv kursus keskendub uudisväärtusliku sündmuse leidmisele ja selle vormistamisele audiovisuaalseks uudiseks. 
4) uudis digimeedias: kaasaegne ajakirjandus ja digimeedia. Digimeedia arengud ja üleminekud trükimeedialt digile. Trendid digimeedias. Kommunikatsiooniprotsessid ja -ahelad meediaorganisatsioonis. 5) tehniliste vahendite kasutamine; toimub lõimituna terve kursuse jooksul. Produktsiooni ja postproduktsiooni võtete ja kasutatavate seadmete tundma- ja kasutamaõppimine konkreetsete õppeülesannete täitmiseks ning edaspidiseks rakkepädevuseks. 
Erinevate osade täpsem kirjeldus on esitatud vastava osa aineprogrammis.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is divided into four parts across two sections (Practical Journalism I and II):  
The first part focuses on news in written media, the second on news in audio media, the third on news in audiovisual media, and the fourth on digital media. Conceptually, each part corresponds to 6 ECTS credits.

1. News in written media:  
   Students work one full day per week as a real newsroom, identifying newsworthy events, performing reporting tasks, and writing a completed news story by the evening of the same day.

2. News in audio media:  
   Introduces the key concepts and principles of creating audio news. Through practical exercises, students acquire and reinforce skills in producing text-based news, recorded news material, and editing.

3. News in audiovisual media:  
   A twice-weekly course focusing on identifying newsworthy events and transforming them into audiovisual news pieces.

4. News in digital media:  
   Modern journalism and digital media. Developments and transitions from print to digital media. Trends in digital media. Communication processes and chains in media organizations. Target audiences, trends, use of diverse sources, and coverage of different media types and events. Lessons from reporting on exceptional events and crises, and their application in everyday work.

5. Use of technical tools:  
   This aspect is integrated throughout the course. It involves learning and applying production and post-production techniques and equipment to complete specific course assignments and build future professional competency.

Detailed descriptions of each part are provided in the respective course syllabi.

Alguse saavad terve rida teoloogia paradigmasid, mille tundmine kergendab oluliselt kaasaegses teoloogilises diskursuses orienteerumist (seejuures sugugi mitte üksnes evangeelse teoloogia omas!), kuivõrd viimane on suurel määral mõistetav vaikimisi või avalikult toimuva kriitilise toetumisena või konstruktiivse vastandumisena 19. sajandil väljatöötatud põhjapanevatele programmidele. Epohhaalne tähendus kogu järgnevale teoloogiale on Friedrich Daniel Ernst Schleiermacheril (1768-1834), kelle subjektiivsusteoreetilisel teoloogiapõhjendusel asub seetõttu ka üks raskuspunkt.	Samuti käsitleb kursus teoloogilise mõtte arengut 20. sajandil, võttes arvesse selle sotsiaal-poliitilist konteksti.
kirjeldus_en: In the history of protestant theology, the 19th century is an epoch, during which theology so to say reaches the Modern Era in the real sense of the word. In its strivings to think and articulate the truth and relevance of the Christian faith against the background of the era's consciousness of problem and truth, protestant theology becomes unprecedentedly diverse and pluralistic. A wohle range of theological paradigms emerge. Being acquainted with them is essential for finding one's way in the contemporary theological discourse (this does not apply only to protestant theology!), because to a high degree it can be understood as either implicit or explicit critical leaning on or constructive confrontation with the fundamental programs worked out in the 19th century. As all the theology to follow has most deeply been influenced by Friedrich Daniel Ernst Schleiermacher (1768-1834), the course will lay special emphasis on his grounding of theology by means of a theory of subjectivity. The course handles also theological thought in the twentieth century by taking into consideration its social and political context.

kirjeldus_et: Vanavene kirjanduse tekkelugu, eripära, žanrid; uued suunad XVIII saj. vene kirjanduses. Loengukursus annab ülevaate vanavene kirjanduse tekkimisest ja eripärast XI-XVIII s. ning kultuuri arengust.
kirjeldus_en: The origins of ancient Russian literature, its features and the genre system. The transfer of the European trends into the Russian literature in the 18th century. The course provides an overview of the evolution of Russian literature and culture from the Middle Age to the end of the 18th century.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course the student
- 1) has an idea about the origin, characteristics and stages of development of Russian literacy and culture from the Middle Ages to the XVIII century,
- 2)  knows about a cultural and historical context of the evolution of medieval Russian literature,
- 3) knows the basic works of the principal writers of the period studied,
- 4) analyzes literary texts of the period,
- 5) combines the knowledge and skills acquired in the course of the history of Russian culture in the framework of the new literary material.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus uurib erinevate konfliktide olemust. See käsitleb eri tüüpi konfliktide ennetamist, ohjamist ja võimalikku lahendamist, mis tulenevad rahvusvahelisest või siseriiklikust rivaalsusest. Kursus laiendab konfliktijuhtimise ja -lahendamise olemasolevat teoreetilist raamistikku, vaadeldes identiteedi-, võimu- ja struktuuridimensioonidel põhinevaid uusi lähenemisi vaenulikele suhetele. Kursusel arutletakse sõja legaalsuse ja sõdiva riigi legitiimsusega seotud küsimuste üle; rahvusvahelise rahuvalve, rahuehituse ja jõustamisoperatsioonide üle; konfliktide vahendamise, läbirääkimiste, dialoogipraktikate ning oodatavate tulemuste üle, võimu jagamisest tuleneva leppimise/leppimatuse üle.
kirjeldus_en: The course explores the nature of different kinds of conflicts. It examines the prevention, management and the eventual resolution of various types of conflict that originate from inter-state and inter-group competition, and expands the existing scope of conflict management and resolution theories through the examination of emerging theories on the identity, power and structural dimensions of adversarial relationships. It discusses issues related to legality of war and legitimacy of the warring state; international peace-keeping, peace-building and peace enforcement; conflict mediation, negotiations, dialogical practices and expected outcomes in the form of reconciliation and power-sharing models.

kirjeldus_en: This is an advanced course in human rights providing an in-depth knowledge of selected issues. As it is an advanced course, it requires some pre-knowledge of human rights and their protection internationally and domestically.  The course involves case study of controversial human rights issues drawing mainly on material from regional and international human rights law and domestic legal systems of Europe and North America (US, Canada). It highlights some of the key controversies in modern human rights law, and the possible range of responses in different jurisdictions to controversial topics. The focus is on comparing reasoning in actual court cases and analyzing them in the larger human rights framework. The course as a whole will aim to provide the opportunity for in-depth comparative study, during which the appropriateness, utility and limits of the comparative legal techniques will be considered. The topics of the course may change every year.
opitulemused_en:
- Learning outcomes
A student who has passed the course:
- has the ability to identify and analyse key issues in the theory and practice of human rights.
- has the ability to analyse why there are different approaches and outcomes in different jurisdictions to selected rights.
- has a good knowledge of how selected human rights are implemented and applied in practice.
- understands the potential and the limitations of law as a tool to address human rights concerns.
- understands the potential and limitations of the comparative method in the practice of human rights.
- has practiced being a presenter, moderator, discussant and a panel member at the conference-style seminars dedicated to essay presentations and discussion
- has improved their analytical and writing skills on contemporary human rights issues

- * develop an improved capacity to identify the structure of an argument in a text and assess it.

kirjeldus_et: Kursusel ei eeldata tudengi varasemat kokkupuudet kvantfüüsikaga, seetõttu alustatakse sissejuhatusega kvantmehaanika algusaegadesse ning kirjeldatakse väga põgusalt kvantmehaanikas kasutatavat matemaatilist aparatuuri. Seejärel hakatakse kirjeldama kvantfüüsika kõige olulisemaid efekte ja aspekte rakenduslikust seisukohast, nt tunnelefekt, dualismiprintsiip, energianivood aatomis, elektroni spinn, ja tuuakse välja ka levinumad rakendused.
kirjeldus_en: No previous contact with quantum physics is presumed from the student, therefore the course starts with an introduction to the early days of quantum physics and the reasons for it's development, also a brief description of the mathematics of quantum physics is given. Most of the course will, however, revolve around describing the most important effects and aspects of quantum physics from their practical standpoint. For example, the tunnel effect, wave-particle duality, energy levels in an atom, electron spin, and some practical applications of all these phenomena will be discussed.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course, student will be able to
- 1) explain, why the phenomena described in the course cannot be adequately explained using classical physics.
- 2) give the modern description of the atom and explain, using energy levels, how a photon is emitted or absorbed and associate it's energy to atom's energy levels.
- 3) describe the tunnel effect and explain the role of this effect in the electronic devices studied in the course.
- 4) explain the role of quantum numbers in describing the atom and how spin is related to magnetism.

kirjeldus_en: This course provides an overview of the main approaches to qualitative inquiry and introduces students to the core data collection and analysis methods relevant for political studies broadly conceived. The course offers hands-on skills development in qualitative data collection methods (such as in-depth interviewing, focus group research, ethnographic techniques) and in qualitative data analysis (e.g. content and narrative analysis). In addition to applied research skills, the students are invited to reflect on the issues of ethics and quality/credibility in conducting qualitative research in political studies.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Tutvustatakse klassikalise regressioon- ja dispersioonanalüüsi (ANOVA) ning logistilise regressioonanalüüsi meetodeid. Õpitakse erinevate mudelite hindamist ja tõlgendamist. Vajadus regressioonimudelite järele tekib olukorras, kus uuritakse tunnustevahelisi seoseid, täpsemalt ühe tunnuse sõltuvust  ühest või mitmest ülejäänud tunnusest. Arvutipraktikumides õpitakse kasutama vaba statistikatarkvara R ning tutvutakse lähemalt regressionimudelite hindamisega selle tarkvara abil.
kirjeldus_en:
Classical regression analysis, Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and logistic regression analysis methodologies will be introduced. Interpretation and estimation ideas of different models will be considered. The need for regression methods arises when one is interested in the dependence of one specific variable on one or several other variables. In computer practicals freeware package R will be used. 

This course is taught in Estonian. International students can substitute it with Statistical Data Science (LTMS.00.025) that consists of 3 modules:  the first part (2 ECTS) is covering the same topics as Biostatistics I (ARTH.03.021) and the second part (2 ECTS) the same topics as Biostatistics II (ARTH.03.022).
opitulemused_en:
- Student has knowledge and abilities to choose, use and interpret statistical models:
linear regression, logistic regression, Poisson regression and survival models.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus süüvib aastate lõikes vahelduvate 20. sajandi ameerika autorite või kirjandusrühmituste loomingule. Autorite loomingut vaadeldakse ajastu kultuuriliste pingeväljade kontekstis  (modernsus, I maailmasõda, muutuvad väärtushinnangud, rahvusvaheline ideede ringlus jne, sõltuvalt konkreetsel semestril käsitletevate autorite ringist) ja seoses rahvusvahelise kirjanduskontekstiga. Kursuse käigus loetakse originaaltekste ning kirjandusteoreetilisi tekste ning harjutatakse teoreetiliste mõistete rakendamist kirjanduse analüüsis. Arendatakse erinevaid kriitilise lugemisega seotud oskusi, suulise väitluse ning ingliskeelse akadeemilise kirjutamise oskust.
kirjeldus_en: The course focuses on 20th century American authors or literary groups. The choice of authors varies over years. The work of the authors is viewed in the context of the tensions of the period (modernity, WWI, changing values, global travel of ideas, etc., depending on the choice of authors in the given semester) and connections to world literature. Students read original texts and literary theory and practice using theoretical concepts in their work. Students develop the skill of applying different types of critical reading and their skills of academic discussion and academic writing in English.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Students who have completed the course know the work of 20th c. American authors covered in the course and the tensions echoed in their work (e.g. modernity, WWI, Great Depression, post-WWII conformism, globalization, etc., depending on the choice of authors in the particular semester). Students are able to apply different methods of literary analysis (e.g. close reading and to apply different literary critical concepts. They develop their skills of spoken and written English, critical reading, discussion and academic writing skills.

kirjeldus_en: This course will provide an introduction to the fundamentals of the science of annual rings of tree growth, plant anatomical and climatological conditions, principles, methods and application fields of dendroclimatology and dendrochronology.
opitulemused_en: - Students 1) are able to define annual rings of conifers and deciduous tree species, know the growth patterns of them and the main environmental factors, 2) can explain the main principles of dendrochronology, 3) know the application fields of dendrochronology in the history, ecology and forestry, with the state of the art of these fields in Estonia and in the world.

kirjeldus_en:
3-D structure of proteins; X-ray; Neutron diffraction. Structure of proteins in solution from NMR methods. The structural building blocks. Motifs or supersecondary structures. Assembly of proteins from the building blocks.
Protein diversity. Introns, exons, and inteins and exteins. Divergent evolution of families of proteins. Convergent evolution. Evolution of proteins by fusion of gene fragments. Homology, sequence identity, and structural similarity.
Principles of chemical catalysis. Transition state theory. The Hammond postulate. Chemical basis of the Hammond postulate. Intramolecular catalysis: The "effective concentration" of a group on an enzyme. General acid-base catalysis. Entropy: The theoretical basis of intramolecular catalysis and effective concentration. Electrostatic catalysis. Metal ion catalysis. Covalent catalysis. Electrophilic catalysis by Schiff base formation. Pyridoxal phosphate-Electrophilic catalysis. Thiamine pyrophosphate-Electrophilic catalysis. Nucleophilic catalysis. Structure-activity relationships. Nucleophilic attack at the carbonyl group. The principle of microscopic reversibility or detailed balance. The principle of kinetic equivalence.
opitulemused_en:
- Module 1: Cell Signaling, provides an overview of main principles and mechanisms signal transduction.  Concepts like information flow, cellular computation, and decision making will be introduced. A systematic overview of main eukaryotic and prokaryotic signaling pathways will be presented.
- Module 2: Biomolecular Catalysis, will provide a sufficiently detailed overview of the basic enzyme mechanisms and kinetic approaches to study enzymes.
- Module 3: Structural Biology, will give a basic overview of protein (and DNA) structure. Special lectures are dedicated to contemporary methods for structural analysis of proteins and other biological macromolecule.  Structural modeling methods and software will be introduced and tested in a seminar.
- Module 4: provides and overview of bacterial signaling, protein synthesis and antibiotic mechanisms.

kirjeldus_en:
Different ways of music critics throughout the history. Different forms and styles of reviews will be handled; the role of reviewer, responsibility that comes with giving a review, options and the issue of objectivity will be discussed.
Through practical writing students will experience how the text is created, what could be the background of a writer, inspiration and motivation and the role of editing and preparing for publishing. We take examples on experienced reviewers past and today. Talk about communication between music manager, musician and journalist, options and problems.

Practical work: to visit different music events with a goal to review them.
opitulemused_en:
- I students are familiar with primary field of music critics: introduction on different fields of publishing in (music)critics through an overview of different texts (secondary and scientific literature)
II Writing an essay on chosen music specific subject
III Students are capable of analyzing different types of critic texts

kirjeldus_et: Arengubioloogia kursusel käsitletakse loomade embrüonaalse ja postembrüonaalse arengu käigus toimuvaid protsesse. Loengud ja praktikumid on ülesehitatud arengu loomulikku kulgu järgides. Esmalt keskendutakse isas- ja emassugurakkude arengule (spermatogenees ja oogenees) ja seejärel vastavalt viljastumise, lõigustumise ja gastrulatsiooni protsessidele (varane areng). Kursuse teises osas vaadeldakse gastrulatsiooni käigus tekkinud lootelehtede (ektoderm, mesoderm, endoderm) kujunemist vastavateks organiteks (organogeneesid). Lisaks käsitletakse eraldi ka soo determinatsiooni ja postembrüonaalse arengu põhiprotsesse.
kirjeldus_en: The course of developmental biology deals with processes occurring during the embryonic and post-embryonic development of animals. First part of the lectures and practical works focus at first on the development of male and female germ cells (gametogenesis) and then on the processes of fertilization, cleavage and gastrulation stage (early development). Second part of the course concentrates to the development of germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, endoderm) and their derivatives and organogenesis (organ`s formation). In addition, sex determination and main processes of post-embryonic development are also considered/discussed separately.

opitulemused_en:
- The student who passed the course:
- 1) Orientates in terminology of developmental biology, understands the principle processes of development, and is able to integrate these processes in different animals.
- 2) Is competent in describing the early developmental stages, such as fertilization, cleavage, gastrulation, and understands the processes occurring/taking place during these stages.
- 3) Understands the formation process of germ layers and how they give a particular shape to different tissues, organs, organ systems.
- 4) Has knowledge about post-embryonic stages of development (growing, aging, metamorphosis, regeneration)
- 5) Can describe the formation of sperm as well as egg cells and understands the process of how the sex is determined
- 6) Is capable of working with microscope and can analyse the samples seen in microscope

hindamise_meetod:
Kursuse jooksul teeme:
1) 4 vaheeksamit
2) Semestri lõpus on vestlus peatükkide 1-5 teemadel, kus peab saama vähemalt 51% so vastama hindele "E":

A: Kasutab õpitud grammatilisi konstruktsioone osavalt ja hõlpsasti, vigu on vähe ning need ei sega suhtlemist (vead artiklite, eessõnade kasutuses, ühildumises, ebaregulaarsete vormidega). Sõnavara on lai ja asjakohane, väljendab end sujuvalt, ilma pikemate pauside ja kõrvalise abi vajaduseta.

B: Kasutab õpitud grammatilisi konstruktsioone enamasti õigesti, väiksemate vigadega (artiklite ja eessõnade kasutuses, ühildumises, ebareeglipärastes vormides jne). Tudeng tõestab, et valdab läbitud materjali nii sõnavara kui grammatika osas. Mõned sõnavalikud ei ole kõige adekvaatsemad, aga on siiski arusaadavad. Mõnel puhul vajab abi öeldu selgitamisel või parandamisel, aga mitte olulises mahus.

C: Kõige rohkem õpitud konstruktsioonid on selged, teistega tekib kõhklusi. Artiklite, eessõnade, ebareeglipärasuse kasutamisel on teatavaid probleeme. Kasutatud sõnavara on valdavalt asjakohane ja üsna lai. Kohati vajab enese parandamisel või sõnade otsimisel kõrvalist abi, alati ei leia sobivat lahendust.

D: Valdab põhigrammatikat, ent keerulisemate struktuuridega (ebaregulaarsus, kaudsihitis) on probleeme. Sõnavara on suuremas osas adekvaatne, ent osa õpitud sõnadest ei tule meelde, vajab enese väljendamiseks ning parandamiseks palju aega ja kõrvalist abi. Osa küsimustest, probleemidest ei leia lahendust.

E: Sõnavara ja grammatika osas on olulisi puudujääke. Eksib regulaarsete verbide pööramisel, ei valda verbide ser/estar/hay õpitud kasutusi, ei kasuta üldse artikleid. Eessõnu üldiselt kasutab, aga süsteemitult ja ebakorrektselt. Vajab palju kõrvalist abi ja tuge, ent näitab siiski, et on semestri jooksul omandanud elementaarse suhtlusoskuse.

F: Ei ole suuteline verbe olevikus pöörama, puudub elementaarne sõnavara. Ei ole täitnud eksamile pääsemise tingimusi.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse käigus tutvustatakse Põhjamaade kirjanduse valitud epohhe, žanre ja autoreid. Peatähelepanu all 19.-21. sajand ning eeskätt keskendutakse taani, norra ja rootsi kirjandusele, ent  paralleele tuuakse ka islandi, fääri ja soomerootsi kirjandusega. 

Kursus koosneb ülevaateloengutest ja temaatilistest blokkidest, mis seostuvad konkreetse epohhi, žanri, kirjandusliku motiivi või autoriga. Teemad võivad aastate lõikes varieeruda, vastavalt õppejõudude ning üliõpilaste huvidele. Seminarides analüüsitakse vastava temaatikaga seonduvaid tekste.
kirjeldus_en:
This course introduces the students to a select number of authors, genres, and topics in the literature of the Nordic region. The focus will be on the literature of the 19th- 21st centuries (primarily Denmark, Sweden, and Norway, but also a few Faeroese and Greenlandic works). 

The course consists of overview lectures and thematic blocks related to a specific era, genre, literary motif or author. Topics may vary from year to year, according to the interests of the lecturers and students. The seminars analyze texts related to the respective topic.

opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. After passing the course, student is familiar to the relations between linguistics and semiotics. 2. He/she knows the basic concepts and approaches of linguistics 3. He/she knows the content of linguistics as an academic discipline. 4. He/she can orientate in the major directions and periods of the semiotics of language. 5. He/she can define the basic concepts and terms of linguistics and language semiotics. 6. He/she has acquired principles for independent thinking in linguistics and semiotics. 7. He/she knows the basic linguistical-semiotical ideas. 8. He/she can critically evaluate the achievements of contemporary paradigms and schools in linguistics and language semiotics.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus algab elu- ja ühiskondliku ruumi ja selle muutumise süsteemse käsitlusega. Selgitatakse ruumi muutumise ja regionaalsete erisuste tekke põhjusi, tutvustatakse valdkonna olulisemaid mõisteid, tuntumaid teooriaid ning vastavate probleemide tasandamiseks kasutatud poliitikaid. Edasi tutvustatakse avaliku sektori planeerimisprotsessi: selle ajaloolist arengut, olulisemaid paradigmasid ning kaasaegset arusaama strateegiate ja arengukavade koostamist, avalikustamist ja rakendamist. Antakse ülevaade Eesti planeeringu- ja arendussüsteemist ja vastavate poliitikate rakendamise võimalustest kohtadel. Osalejad saavad rühmatööna teha praktilise ülesande, et vahetult tutvuda Eesti reaalse kohaliku ja omavalitsuste (arendus)tööga.sotsioloogias ja avalikus halduses. Kursuse raames toimub tutvumisekskursioon riigi arendusasutustesse.
kirjeldus_en: The course concentrates on compilation of development plans and strategies of preparing and implementing the planning process of the public sector as well as on their publication and application on the basis of new methods. An exhaustive overview of Estonian planning and development system, including working policies and the possibilities of their application is given. The course provides necessary preparation for work in public authorities and local government authorities; it is recommended to students of fields related to public administration and economy. Some basic knowledge in economics, sociology and public administration is expected.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After passing the course, students (1) better understand spatial processes, (2) know most common regional problems and policies, (3) understand  specifics of public planning, (4) knows EU and Estonian planning and development system, (5) are able to take adequately part in planning procedures.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursusel valitakse välja moodsa elustiiliga kaasnev keemiline aine või ainete rühm, mis põhjustab keskkonnaprobleeme. Ühenditele tehakse juhendatud artikliotsing, mille analüüsi tulemusena tuuakse välja keemilised ja füüsikalised omadused, analüüsimise või töötlemisega (keskkonnast eraldamisega) seotud probleemid, allikad, levik, mõju jmt. Kursus koosneb kodusest ettevalmistusest ja aktiivsest osalemisest diskussioonides.
Kursuse jooksul tuleb koostada vähemalt kaks ettekannet ning vähemalt üks pikem kirjalik töö, mõelda loovalt ning avaldada oma arvamust. Kõigepealt on etteantud artikli ja selle andmete analüüs ja seejärel otsib igaüks oma artikli, mille töö täpne pikk kirjeldus on Moodle kursusel.  Õpime otsima teadusartiklit, keerulist teaduslikku sisu lugema, läbi töötama ja analüüsima, järeldusi tegema suuliselt ja kirjalikult, argumenteerima ja oma väiteid kaitsma. Töötame individuaalselt ja rühmas, samuti saavad üliõpilased tagasisidet nii individuaalselt kui grupina.
Kursusel hinnatakse 1-5 punkti skaalas artiklivalikut, ettekandeid, argumenteerimise oskuseid, osalemist diskussioonides ja kirjalikku eneseväljendusoskust.
kirjeldus_en:
The course selects a chemical substance or group of substances that is associated with a modern lifestyle and causes environmental problems. The students are subjected to a guided article search, the analysis of which reveals chemical and physical properties of the substances, as well problems related to the chemical analysis or processing methods (separation from the environment). The course consists of individual home preparation and active participation in group discussions. During the course, at least two presentations and at least one longer written work must be prepared, as well creative thinking and expressing one's opinion is expected from each participant.
The course assesses the choice of articles, presentations, argumentation skills, participation in discussions and written self-expression skills on a scale of 1-5 points.

kirjeldus_et:
Praktilised tööd analüütilisest keemiast: kaalumine, lahuste valmistamine, levinumate analüüsil kasutatavate laborivahendite käsitsemine, proovi eeltöötlus, tiitrimeetria (ka mittevesilahustes), potentsiomeetria, kromatograafia, kromato-massispektromeetria, aatom- ja molekulspektroskoopia.
Andmetöötlus (k.a. mõõtemääramatuse hindamine reaalselt kogutud andmetega) analüütilises keemias.
Iga töö sisaldab erinevaid etappe: etteantud andmete kohta arvutusfaili koostamine; suuline arutelu töö teooria ja rakenduste kohta; praktiline töö; arvutused reaalselt saadud andmetega tabelarvutusprogrammis ning andmete ja saadud tulemuste kriitiline hindamine.
kirjeldus_en: The basics of practical work in analytical chemistry are introduced: weighing, handling of pipettes, burettes, volumetric flasks, working with concentrated acids and bases, etc. The methods involved are: sample preparation, titrimetry (acid-base, complex-formation, redox), potentiometry, gas chromatography, Flame photometry, UV-Vis photometry, data treatment in analytical chemistry.

nimi_et: Julgeoleku väljakutsed Aasia Vaikse ookeani regioonis
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Ainekursus koosneb kahest osast. Esimene osa annab ülevaate piirkondliku julgeoleku põhilistest mõistetest ning seejärel uurib suundumusi, mis kujundavad julgeolekuolukorra Ida-Aasias. Antakse ülevaate Hiina geopoliitikast ja hiinlaste arusaamast maailmakorrast; Jaapani julgeolekupoliitika arengutest Külma Sõja ajal ja pärast seda; pingetest Taiwani väinas ja julgeolekuolukorrast Korea poolsaarel. Teine osa uurib julgeolekustamise probleeme Kagu-Aasias. Keskpunktiks on ASEAN-i turbluentne integratsioonipoliitika. Uuritakse julgeoleku väljakutseid teatud Kagu-Aasia riikide nõrkuste tulenevalt, nt terrorism, kodusõda ja sõjaline osalus; pinged pakutud ASEAN demokratiseerimise ümber; ASEANi integratsiooniprotsessi võrdlus teiste piirkondlike organisatsioonidega ja ASEANi koht laiemas Aasia-Vaikse ookeani julgeolekukorras.
kirjeldus_en: This course will be delivered in two parts. Part one will give an overview of the core concepts in regional security before proceeding to examine the particular trends that shape security in East Asia. This will include an overview of China's geopolitics and perceptions of world order; the evolution of Japan's security policy during and after the Cold War; tension in the Taiwan Straits; and the security situation along the Korean Peninsula. Part two will examine the security challenges in South-East Asia. This will centre around the sometimes turbluent politics of integration within the Association of South-East Asian Nations (ASEAN). Specific issues to be examined will include the security challenges arising from state weakness within certain South-East Asian states such as terrorism, civil war, and military involvement in politics; tensions surrounding proposed ASEAN democratization; ASEAN's integration process compared to other regional organizations; and ASEAN's place within the wider Asia-Pacific security order.

kirjeldus_en: The Seminar of Entrepreneurship consists of three parts. At the end of the second part every student has joined a laboratory and in cooperation with this laboratory fabrication of a product has started. The student has established a small business which' aim is to develop a science-intensive product. During the third part of the course, the small business continues and developes manufacturing the product. The student manages advertisement, marketing and accounting. In seminars the problems relative to the activities are discussed and analyzed.
opitulemused_en: - A student who has completed the Seminar of Entrepreneurship, has established a small business which fabricates a science-intensive product elaborated in cooperation with a scientific laboratory. The student understands the relations between materials science and technology business, and has knowledge and skills to associate research and development in the area of materials science and technology with product development and merchandising. He/she can recognize and word the business problems connected with materials, and can solve these problems proceeding from given information during given time-frames using suitable methods. The student can work in team, including as the team leader. He/she can manage a small business.

Kursuse esimeses pooles uuritakse peamisi tegureid, mis mõjutavad välispoliitika otsustusprotsesse. Erilist tähelepanu pööratakse  välistele, kohalikele, ametlikele ja kontseptuaalsetele faktoritele, mis kujundavad välispoliitikat. Kursuse teises pooles  uuritakse välispoliitika dünaamikat mõjutavate mudelite, tugevaid ja nõrku külgi.
kirjeldus_en: This course will combine factor-based and model-based approaches to examine the contemporary literature that comprises Foreign Policy Analysis (FPA) as a seminal sub-field in International Relations. Foreign policy is ubiquitous with international politics as it is the most commonly recognized mode of state agency. Foreign policy is driven and constrained by a wide variety of "international", "transnational" and "domestic" variables. To provide structured examination of the influence that the most pertinent variables in these categories have on the foreign policy decision-making process, this course is divided into two different sections. Section I will examine the principal factors that regularly affect the foreign policy decision-making process. This includes assessment of the external, domestic, formal institutional, transnational and ideational factors that shape foreign policy. Part II will examine the strengths and weaknesses of the main models proposed to explain the main decision-dynamics involved in the foreign policy formation process, this will include assessment of the rational-actor model; the governmental politics model; the leadership trait approach; the operational code approach; prospect theory; poliheuristic theory; analogical reasoning; and groupthink.

kirjeldus_et:
Tööde nimekiri:
1. Newtoni rõngad (Hödemann) Ülesanded teemal: interferents.
2.Interferents tasaparalleelselt plaadilt (Hödemann) Ülesanded teemal: interferents.
3.Michelsoni interferomeeter  (Hödemann) Ülesanded teemal: interferents.
4. Islandi paost prisma: kaksikmurdumine (polariseeritud valguse interferents) (Hödemann) Ülesanded teemal: polarisatsioon
5.Polariseeritud valguse uurimine (Hödemann) Ülesanded teemal: polarisatsioon.
6.Spektroskoobi gradueerimine (Tõldsepp) Ülesanded teemal: peegeldumine, murdumine ja absorbtsioon. 
7. Fotoelemendi kasutamine luksmeetrina (Tõldsepp) Ülesanded teemal: fotomeetria.
8.Tutvumine mikroskoobiga (Tõldsepp) Ülesanded teemal: läätsed ja nende süsteemid.
9. Optilise süsteemi prilliklaas uurimine (Tõldsepp) Ülesanded teemal: läätsed ja nende süsteemid.




Töökorraldus praktikumis: Üliõpilast ei lubata praktilist tööd tegema, kui
  -   tema teoreetiline ettevalmistus on ebarahuldav;
  -   tal on kaitsmata või esitamata kaks sooritatud tööd.

Üliõpilane arvatakse praktikumi rühmast välja, kui tal on jäänud tegemata kaks praktilist tööd.
kirjeldus_en: The target group is the students of material science. The course contains 8 laboratory works in the field of optics.
opitulemused_en:
- Course consists of 8 experiments, that will teach following skills and theoretical knowledge:

1) Theoretical understanding of light interference on the basis of following experiments: Newton rings, interference form glass plate with flat parallel surfaces, Michelson interferometer. Ability to analyze and interpret fringe patterns using image analysis software ImpactGo! and MathCad. Ability to solve physics tasks based on mentioned experiments.

2) Theoretical understanding of light polarization. Ability to experimentally to create and  analyze polarized light (linearly polarized, circularly and elliptically polarized light). Working principle of half and quarter wave plate. Ability to solve physics tasks based on light polarization.

3)Theoretical understanding of polarized light interference. Ability to solve physics task on polarized light interference.

5)Knows and understands basic characteristics of a spectroscopic instrument (optical radiation, dispersion, spectrum, resolution, etc.,), meaning and their importance in practical spectroscopy. Knows the construction and working principle of a simple prism monochromator. 

4)Understands and knows the basic concepts of following photometric sizes and units (eg. luminous and radiant flux, lumen and candela). Knows how to use a photocell, understands its structure and working principles. 

6)Knows and understands how the image will be created by the optical system inside the microscope. Knows the meaning of the following basic concepts (resolution, numerical aperture, magnification, etc). Will be able to solve assignments and problems related to the lenses and to the systems constructed of them.

7)Knows a different type lenses and understands how the rays behave after passing the lens.
Understands and knows how to explain the basic concepts (eye an optical system, focus, cardinal point optical power).
hindamise_eeltingimused: Juhendav õppejõud annab üliõpilasele loa praktilise töö tegemiseks, kui vestlusest selgub, et üliõpilase teoreetilise ettevalmistuse tase on töö tegemiseks piisav.   Valmis tööd tuleb kaitsta, s.t. võimalike vigade korral need vead parandada ning vastata juhendaja täiendavatele küsimustele.
hindamise_meetod:
Kui on toimunud 4 tööd, siis on ajakavas nädalane paus (üks nädal praktikumi ei toimu).  Järgmist 4 tööd pääsevad tegema ainult need, kelle eelmised 4 on arvestatud.
Üliõpilane saab arvestuse, kui ta on edukalt sooritanud ja kaitsnud 6 praktilist tööd ning saanud teooriat kontrollivast testist vähemalt 70%.

kirjeldus_et: Kemodünaamika kursuses tutvustatakse erinevates keskkondades toimuvad dünaamilisi protsesse ja erinevate ainete jääkide metabolismi ja kemodünaamikat erinevates tingimustes. Kursus on jagatud neljaks suuremaks plokiks, mille teemad on tinglikult õhk, vesi, pinnas ja elusorganismid. Suurt tähelepanu pööratakse konkreetsete praktiliste probleemide analüüsile ning jääkainete kontsentratsioonide muutumise arvutamisele erinevates keskkondades, mis võimaldab hinnata saasteahelaid, aga ka erinevate ainete bioakumulatsiooni.
kirjeldus_en: Dynamic processes and metabolic changes of chemical compounds going on in different environments are introduced and analyzed from the standpoint of chemistry. The course of Chemodynamics consists of four blocks, entitled as Atmosphere, Hydrosphere, Geosphere and Biosphere. Special attention is paid to case studies concerning the calculation of residual concentrations and accumulation of potentially harmful compounds and their metabolites in different environments, enabling to assess pollution chains and (bio)accumulation.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
Students can analyze and associate processes going on with chemical compounds in different environments; calculate the concentrations and the dynamics of concentration for potentially harmful compounds and assess the amounts and toxicity of accumulated compounds.

Kursus toimub "Software Foundations" materjalide põhjal, kus kaetakse Volume 1: "Logical Foundations" ja Volume 3: "Verified Functional Algorithms". Esimene raamat katab Coq-i algõpet ja loogika aluseid, teine tegeleb algoritmide korrektsuse tõestamisega. 

Peatükkide/teemade loetelu: "Logical Foundations": Basics, Induction, Lists, Polymorphism, Tactics, Logics in Coq, Inductively defined Propositions, Maps, Simple Imperative Programs, More Automation. "Verified Functional Algorithms": Basic Techniques for Permutations and Ordering, Insertion sort, Insertion Sort With Multisets, Selection sort, Search trees, Abstract data types, Runninc Coq programs in ML, Red-Black trees, Number Representations and Efficient Lookup Tables, Priority Queues, Binomial Queues, Programming with Decision Procedures
kirjeldus_en:
We use material from "The Software Foundations" series Volume 1: "Logical Foundations" and Volume 3: "Verified Functional Algorithms". Volume 1 is an intro to Coq and logic and Volume 3 deals with Verified Functional Algorithms.

List of chapters/topics: "Logical Foundations": Basics, Induction, Lists, Polymorphism, Tactics, Logics in Coq, Inductively defined Propositions, Maps, Simple Imperative Programs, More Automation. "Verified Functional Algorithms:: Basic Techniques for Permutations and Ordering, Insertion sort, Insertion Sort With Multisets, Selection sort, Search trees, Abstract data types, Runninc Coq programs in ML, Red-Black trees, Number Representations and Efficient Lookup Tables, Priority Queues, Binomial Queues, Programming with Decision Procedures
opitulemused_en:
- A student, that has completed the course:
- a) knows common concepts of logic and proving,
- b) is able to understands the meaning of propositions written in Coq,
- c) can prove simple propositions in Coq, and
- d) can write simple verified functional algorithms.

kirjeldus_et: Käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid: mikrobioloogia ajalugu, hüpoteesid elu tekke ja arengu kohta Maal, arhed ja bakterid kui kaks prokarüootide domeeni, prokarüootide tänapäevane klassifikatsioon, eu- ja prokarüootse raku võrdlus, hüpoteese eukarüootse rakku tekke ja eellaste kohta, arhede erilisus, prokarüootse raku detailsem iseloomustamine: membraanid, kest ja kapsel, piilid ja viburid, rakusisesed organellid ja varuained, endospoorid; rakkude liikumine ja paljunemine; keskkonnatingimuste (temperatuur, pH, rõhk, kiirgus, hapnik) toime mikroobirakule; konservandid, steriliseerimine ja desinfitseerimine; mikroorganismid looduse aineringetes; mikroorganismid meie igapäevases elus; mikroorganismide toitumine, toitumistüübid, aine- ja energiavahetus, suhkrute aeroobse ja anaeroobse katabolismi rajad, kemolitotroofia, bakteriaalne fotosüntees, anaeroobne hingamine. Bakterite genoomid ja koosluste metgenoomid. Inimese mikrobioom, bakterhaigused ja nende tekitajad.Bakteriofaagid ja nende arengutsüklid.
kirjeldus_en: The following subjects will be covered: history and milestones of microbiology; hypotheses on origin and evolution of life on Earth; archaea and bacteria as two prokaryotic domains of Life; the contemporary classification of prokaryotes; comparison of eukaryotic and prokaryotic cell types; specific features of archaea; closer characterization of the bacterial cell: membranes, cell wall, pili and flagella, intracellular inclusions, organelles, storage compounds, endospores; multiplication of bacteria, relationships with the environment (including the effects of temperature, pressure, pH, conservants and desinfectants, irradiation and oxygen on bacteria) and their role in nature. The following subjects will be addressed: energetics of bacteria, solute transport, synthesis of antibiotics and and resistance to them, specific modes of nutrition and metabolic pathways: fermentation of sugars, chemolithoautotrophy, bacterial photosynthesis, aerobic and anaerobic respiration etc. In lectures dedicated to virology, the genetic diversity and classification of viruses as well as principles of viral infection cycle on the examples of bacteriophages - viruses, infecting bacterial hosts will be covered.
opitulemused_en: - After the course, the students are expected to know basic data about history of microbiology, nature, evolution, size, shape, composition, structure, ways of motility and multiplication of prokaryotic cells. They should be able to compare pro- and eukaryotic cells and to characterize the effects of environmental factors on growth and multiplication of prokaryotes. The students are expected to link the obtained knowledge to everyday life. Students should be able to evaluate, understand and characterize the diversity of microorganisms with regard to energetic and metabolic processes. They should know basics of genetic diversity and systematics of the bacteriophages. Students should understand how microbes and microbial communities can be characterized on the basis of genomic and metagenomic DNA sequence data, they should know basic data about human microbiome and pathogenic to humans bacteria.

kirjeldus_en: The course deals, first and foremost, with the issues of web surveys that are different from other survey modes (CAPI, CATI, etc). The focus will be on the advantages and disadvantages of web surveys, the possibility of integrating web surveys with other survey modes, sample formation, devising and setting up the questionnaire for a web survey and response rate issues. The practical part of the course allows students to devise the research design of a web survey and set up the survey on the internet. The course takes place in a hybrid form, i.e. students can participate in lectures and practicals either in the classroom or via internet.

kirjeldus_et: Farmakognoosia on farmaatsiaharu, mis uurib ravimtaimi, drooge kui kuivatatud või värskeid taimi või nende osi, mida kasutatakse toorainena ravimpreparaatide ja ravimisarnaste preparaatide valmistamiseks; samuti taimse või loomse tooraine esmasel ümbertöötamisel saadud produkte nagu eeterlikud õlid, rasvõlid, vaigud jms., ning nimetatud looduslikus toormes sisalduvaid meditsiiniliselt kasutatavaid koostisainete gruppe ja individuaalseid ühendeid. Käsitletakse ravimtaimede klassifikatsiooni ja nomenklatuuri, toimeainete sisaldust mõjustavaid faktoreid, ravimtaimede kultiveerimist ja droogide kogumist, droogide kuivatamist, säilitamist ja kvaliteedi kontrollimist. Vaatluse alla võetakse mitmesuguste toimeainete (mitmesugused terpenoidid, kardiosteroidid, saponiinid, alkaloidid, loomsed droogid) klassifikatsioon, füsikokeemilised ja bioloogilised omadused ning neid aineid sisaldavad tähtsamad droogid.
kirjeldus_en: Pharmacognosy is a branch of pharmacy that investigates medicinal plants, herbs in form of dried or raw plant material or their parts, which are used as raw material in preparing pharmaceutical formulations or semimedicinal products; also products of first/basic reprocessing of plant or animal raw material, such as essential oils, fatty oils, resins, etc. and individual or groups of compounds from above mentioned raw material that are used in medicine. Classification and nomenclature of medicinal plants are discussed, as well as factors influencing content of active compounds, cultivation of medicinal plants and collecting herbs, drying, storing, and determining quality of herbs. Introduced are several active substances (misxcellaneous terpenoids, cardiac glycosides, saponines, alkaloids, animal products) in terms of their classification, physicochemical and biological properties, and more important herbs containing these active substances.

- a) has an overview about classification of herbs
- b) knows structures and general aspects of different groups of biologically active substances

- d) have skills for consult of customers in medicinal plants and herbal preparation studied

kirjeldus_en:
The Bosnian language for Beginners II course builds upon foundational skills to develop more advanced language proficiency. Students expand their vocabulary and deepen their understanding of grammar, including past and future tenses, complex sentence structures, grammatical categories and case system. The course emphasizes practical communication, enabling students to engage in conversations on topics like hobbies, work, travel, and expressing opinions. Reading and writing exercises focus on structured texts, such as essays and letters, helping students improve their written communication.
Listening activities feature authentic Bosnian audio materials, enhancing students' comprehension of moderately paced conversations. Cultural lessons provide insights into Bosnian traditions, social contexts, and etiquette, enabling students to communicate more effectively and respectfully. Through role-playing and discussion-based activities, students gain confidence in navigating real-life situations, such as making appointments and handling social interactions. By the end of the course, students will be able to communicate more fluently, understand intermediate-level texts, and confidently express themselves in a variety of contexts.

kirjeldus_en: Morphology is the subfield of linguistics dealing with the internal structure of words and ways of deriving words. This class is intended to deepen students' knowledge about and expose them to morphological phenomena from around the world. While working through the textbook with different topics every week, we will explore and compare morphological structures beyond just those we are familiar with in Estonian and English. In doing so, we will deepen our understanding of how morphology can work while improving our own analytical skills and our ability to analyze morphological structures in languages we study from a more general, typological perspective.

- 1) student must know theoretical and practical bases of bioindication
- 2) student must know the most important groups of organisms with bioindicational value, and possibilities as well as limits of different bioindicational methods.
- 3) at the end of the course, the student should be able to use one bioindicational (lichenoindication) method in practice. By this time, student must know the most important epiphytic lichens with lichenoindicational value, should be able to use basic method of epiphytic lichens' reseach and to implement the technique of quantitative methods (IAP and IP indices) of lichenoindication. At the end of the course, a lichenoindicational map of Tartu will be compiled based on the student's data.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab ülevaate peamistest teoreetilistest lähenemistest Euroopa Liidule ja eurointegratsioonile rõhuasetusega tänapäevastel politoloogilistel käsitlustel. 
Euroopa Liitu on nimetatud sotsiaalteaduste suureks mõistatuseks, kuna ta ei sobitu selgepiiriliselt  olemasolevatesse kontseptuaalsetesse kategooriatesse. EL asub rahvusvaheliste suhete ja võrdleva politoloogia ristumispunktis, kus omavahel võistlevad valitsustevaheline lähenemine (intergovernmentalism) ja rahvusülese valitsemise teooriad (supranational governance). Lisaks eelmainitutele leiavad kursuse raames käsitlemist mitmed teised suunitlused, alates funktsionalismist kuni ratsionaalse valiku, kahetasandiliste mängude, mitmetasandilise valitsemise ning konstruktivistlike teooriateni. Kursus
keskendub kolmele põhilisele küsimusele:
1) Mis on Euroopa Liit (rahvusvaheline organisatsioon, tehnokraatlik režiim, valitsustevahelise koostöö vorm, rahvusülene riigilaadne süsteem, föderatsioon, jne)?
2) Kuidas toimub Euroopa integratsioon ning kes või mis on integratsiooni mootoriks (liikmesriikide valitsused, rahvusülesed institutsioonid, jne)?
3) Millises suunas Euroopa Liit areneb ning mida võime Euroopa näite varal järeldada regionaalse integratsiooni ja/või globaalse valitsemise kohta laiemalt?
kirjeldus_en:
The course provides a critical overview of the main theoretical approaches to the European Union and the process of European integration, with an emphasis on contemporary political science theories. The EU has been widely regarded as a social science puzzle because it does not fit neatly into existing conceptual categories and disciplinary divisions. Scholars disagree about whether theories located in the International Relations or Comparative Politics discourses are better equipped to explain European integration; these tensions are also reflected in the rivalry between intergovernmentalist approaches and theories of supranational governance. In addition to these, the course covers a variety of other approaches from the three pre-theories (federalism, functionalism, and transactionalism) to neofunctionalism, the debate between liberal intergovernmentalism and supranationalism, neoinstitutionalism, constructivism and theories of Europeanization. Our discussion of the theories of integration focuses on four central questions:
1.	What is the EU (an international organization, a technocratic regime, a form of intergovernmental cooperation, a supranational state-like entity, a federation)?
2.	How does integration proceed and who or what drives integration (member-state governments, supranational institutions, interest groups, etc)?
3.	What patterns of interaction and influence characterize the relationship between the EU and the member states?
4.	How will the EU continue to evolve in the future and what does the European experience tell us about regional integration and supranational governance in general?

In terms of teaching and learning formats, the course emphasizes academic writing and is designed to prepare students for writing an MA thesis (especially the theoretical sections of the thesis).

2) Understanding the complex relationship between law, ethics, and the different interests at stake when it comes to animal welfare

4) Analysing future developments and perspectives concerning the protection of animals in today's globalized world.
5) Developing persuasive arguments

kirjeldus_et:
Maavarade ja kaevandamistehnoloogiate kursus annab geoloogia ja keskkonnatehnoloogia üliõpilastele vajalikud baasteadmised ja praktilised oskused ühiskonnale oluliste maavarade säästlikuks majandamiseks.

Ainekursus koosneb kolmest temaatilisest loengute-seminaride osast ning arvutipraktikumidest.

Esimene osa käsitleb maavarade geoloogia ja mäenduse aluseid sh maavarade kujunemist geoloogilistes protsessides, maavarade peamiseid uurimise- ja kaevandamise tehnoloogiaid ning kaevandamise keskkonnamõju. Käsitletakse rahvusvahelisi kokkuleppeid maavarade uurimisel ja varude hindamisel, ringmajandusele üleminekut ning Euroopa roheleppe põhimõtteid. 

Teine osa käsitleb põhiliste metalliliste, mittemetalliliste ja energeetiliste maavarade iseloomustust sh koostist ja kujunemist, ressursside levikut, töötlemist ja (taas)kasutamise võimalusi ning kaevandamise keskkonnamõju.

Kolmas osa annab ülevaate Eesti tänastest ja võimalikest tulevikumaavaradest, nende uurimisest ja kaevandamise tehnoloogiatest. 

Praktikumide käigus tutvutakse maapõue geoinfosüsteemidega ning lahendatakse maavara varude hindamisega seotud ülesandeid kasutades GIS-de võimalusi (tarkvara MapInfo, Datamine Discover, Q-GIS).
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides for students in Geology and Environmental Technology basic knowledge on the formation and exploration of mineral resources, their mining technologies and environmental impact. 

The course includes lectures and GIS classes to estimate the grade and volume of the different mineral deposits.

Lectures cover three main topics 
Part I. General geology of mineral resources and mining technologies are given: definition and economic-political importance of mineral resources, the nature and formation regularities of mineral resources in time and space and in geological processes, formation and classification of mineral resources, mineral prospecting and exploration methods, mining technologies and the impact of mining, manufacture and utilization on the environment.
Part II. The main metallic, nonmetallic and combustible mineral resources are characterized: composition, formation, economic-genetic types of deposits, occurrences and reserves, manufacture, enrichment and utilization.
Part III. Occurrences, exploration, mining, and utilization of mineral resources in Estonia are discussed. Main useful resources: peat, oil shale, limestone and dolostone, sand and gravel, crystalline rocks, clay, phosphorite, lake and sea mud, lacustrine lime. Requirements on the exploration, mining and utilization of mineral resources according to Estonian legislation.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Loengukursuse raames käsitletakse õiguse ajaloolist arengut, tema kohta sotsiaalses süsteemis ja ühiskondlike suhete regulatsioonis, mandri-euroopalikule õiguskultuurile omaseid põhimõisteid, õiguse süsteemi ja realiseerumist. Antakse ülevaade tööõiguse ja avaliku teenistuse põhimõistetest.
Riigikogu. Vabariigi Valitsus. Vabariigi President. Täidesaatva riigivõimu asutused. Kohtute süsteem. Kohalik omavalitsus. Riigikontroll. Õiguskantsler. Avaliku halduse põhimõisted. Haldusõiguse allikad ja põhimõisted. Halduskorralduse põhimõtted.
Antakse ülevaade Euroopa Liidu kujunemisest ning Eesti seotusest EL-ga. Kirjeldatakse peamisi otsustusprotsesse ning selgitatakse Eesti osalemist neis. Tutvustatakse Euroopa Liidu eelarve kujunemise ja kulutamise põhimõtteid. Antakse ülevaade peamistest poliitikatest ning nende mõjust Ühendusele, sh Eestile.
kirjeldus_en:
The course deals with the historical development of law, its place in the social system and within the regulations of social relations, the basic concepts of the legal culture of continental Europe, the system of law and its realization. The course gives an overview of the basic concepts of labor law and civil service.
Parliament. The Government of the Republic. The President of the Republic. Authorities of the executive power. Judicial system. Local government. Chancellor of Justice.  Basic concepts of public administration. Sources and basic concepts of administrative law. Principles of administrative management.
A short historical overview of the formation of the European Union and Estonia's accession to the EU. The main decision-making processes in the EU and Estonia's participation in these. The principles of the creation and spending of the budget of the European Union. The main policies and their impact on EU developments, including the impact on Estonia.

kirjeldus_en:
The course focuses on the principles governing groundwater flow and the investigation of its chemical composition in different types of rocks.
During the course, models and equations that reflect groundwater movement are characterized, and the assessment of filtration parameters is discussed. Additionally, natural and anthropogenic factors shaping the chemical composition and quality of groundwater are introduced.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. is able to explain the concepts and parameters characterizing an aquifer and understands how these are determined.
- 2. is able to describe groundwater flow in water-bearing formations and is familiar with the main equations used to describe groundwater movement.
- 3. understands the information required for groundwater modeling and is familiar with the groundwater modeling process.
- 4. understands the main factors and processes determining the chemical composition of groundwater and is capable of taking water samples if necessary.

kirjeldus_en:
Introduction. Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
Genetic drift & mutation. Molecular clock
Coalescence theory. 
Effective population size
Population subdivision. Heterozygosity & FST
Linkage disequilibrium, types of selection
Model of neutrality and selection tests
Inferring populations' demographic history
Seminars
opitulemused_en:
- *Knows how to postulate the basic population genetics hypotheses.
*Applies the knowledge, according to the necessity, for the cases related to the mutation genesis and the fate of mutations.
* Understands the essence of the Hardy-Weinberg Law, and exploits it for testing the zero-hypothesis, using the knowledge about natural selection, migration, assortative mating, inbreeding, population structure, and random genetic drift.
* Knows the properties of Wright-Fisher population. Knows how to find the probability of allele frequency change dependent on population size by the use of binomial equation. Is able to describe Markov Chains model of genetic drift.
* Understands the definition of effective population size through the behaviour of model population. Knows the main factors that influence effective populations size, Ne, and is able to find Ne if any of the assumptions are violated.
* Understands the concept of coalescence and the influence of demographic factors (Ne, structure) on the coalescence process. Knows how to find the probability of an exponentially distributed random event.
* Knows the beneficial features of mitochondrial DNA and Y chromosome that are applied in the population genetic research. Knows the basic properties of marker classes: haplotype, SNP, STR. Knows how to find coalescence age of a clade by i) average number of pairwise differences, ii) average mutational distance from founder haplotype.
* Has a general overview of the distribution of human global genetic diversity. Is able to name general methods of genomewide data analysis.

The group will be chosen in collaboration with the student's supervisor and will be approved by the lecturers of Practical Course of Species Diversity. kirjeldus_et: Keskkonnakeemia kursuses käsitletakse ümbritsevas keskkonnas toimuvaid keemilisi ja füüsikalisi protsesse ning vastastoimeid keskkonnas. Samuti käsitletakse õhus, vees ja pinnases toimuvate biokeemiliste protsesside iseloomu, saasteainete levikut ja sellest tulenevaid keskkonnaprobleeme. Keskkonnas toimuvate keemiliste protsesside käsitlemisel pööratakse erilist tähelepanu mikroorganismide vahendusel kulgevatele redoksprotsessidele, saasteainete biolagundatavuse kriteeriumide määramisele ning keskkonna tingimuste hindamisele, et mõista keskkonnas toimuvate integratiivsete protsesside olemust.
kirjeldus_en: Course of environmental chemistry is focused on chemical and physical processes in the environment, also distribution of pollutants between different compartments of environment. Special attention will be paid to the phase interactions between air, water and soil, microbial redox processes in the environment and criteria of biodegradation processes of different pollutants. Environmental chemistry course will give an outline of pollution problems and integrated processes in the environment.

kirjeldus_et: Kursusel käsitletakse metoodilisi ja teoreetilisi eeldusi islami ühiskondade (ja Iisraeli) uurimisel; demokraatia, autoritaarsuse, monarhia, teokraatia jne rolli MENA riikides; islamit (aga ka judaismi, kristlust jt) sise- ja välispoliitika, ühiskonna, õigusruumi jne mõjutajana; Iisraeli erilist rolli MENA poliitikas; religioosse fundamentalismi mõju; MENA ühiskondade suhet inimõigustega, eriti naiste õiguste dünaamikat; üksiknäidete varal "Araabia kevade" aegset ja järgset poliitilist ja ühiskondlikku olukorda.
opitulemused_en:
- The Student will:
*	apply theoretical approaches and critical comparative paradigms to the international politics of Middle East and North Africa,
*	compare several case studies, inter- and intra-state wars in the region and between regional actors and outside forces,
*	describe the relevance of political cultural parameters, historical context and social construction of states to their foreign policy behaviour,
*	identify the interplay of domestic, regional and global factors in the international relations of regional systems,
*	discover the preconditions for communitarian policies among states,
*	evaluate the cultural and ideological fabric of regional systems,
*	be able to communicate his/her understanding of knowledge about the topic in a concise and clear way bot in written and oral form.

Väike ülevaade asümptootikast -- mõjusus ja tsentraalne piiretroreem (Bernstein-von Mieses), deFinetti teoreem. Hierarhilised mudelid, näited. Sissejuhatus mitteparemeetrilisse Bayesi statistikasse (Dirichlet protsess, üldistatud Polya urn, Hiina restorani protsess jne). Näited.
kirjeldus_en: The course starts with the explanation Bayesian modeling (prior, posterior, marginal distribution, posteiror predicative distribution) followed by examples of standard parametric models (Beta-Bernoulli, Dirichlet-categorical, Polya urn, Gamma-Poisson, Normal and NIX-models, Gamma-exponential). The choice of priors (conjugate, non-informative, Jeffreys, proper and unproper, empirical) are discussed. Then an overview of some basic asymptotic results (posterior consistency, Bernstein-von Mieses theorem, deFinetti theorem). The idea of hierarchical models and some examples of standard hierarchical models are covered (latent Dirichlet allocation). Some Bayesian regression models are introduced. The course ends with introduction to non-parametric Bayesian models (Dirichlet process mixtures, Chinese restaurant process, etc).
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After passing the course, the student uderstands the fundamentals of Bayesian modeling and can apply standard models in practical data analysis.

nimi_en: Introduction to the History and Formation of the German Language
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab põhiteadmised saksa keele ajaloost ja kujunemisloost, keeleajaloolistest perioodidest ning dialektideks jagunemisest, kantselei- ja trükikeelte ning ühise kirjakeele arengust, kontaktkeeltest ning keelelistest laenudest, puristlikust liikumisest ja keelekorraldusest. oppejoud: Ants Kurg, Darja Lavõgina, Elin Org, Jaak Truu, Kalle Kilk, Katrin Õunap, Lili Azin Milani, Maris Alver, Neeme Tõnisson, Reedik Mägi, Tarmo Annilo, Urmo Võsa
kirjeldus_et: Loengukursuse raames käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid: eukarüoodi (inimese) ja prokarüoodi genoomi üldine struktuur ja selle uurimise meetodid, mutatsioonide tüübid, kuidas mutatsioonid tekivad ja mis tüüpi mutatsioon on mingi haiguse taga. Lisaks sellele vaadeldakse lähemalt epigenoomi, selle uurimise meetodeid ning epigenoomi muutuste seost haigustega. Järgmise tasemena käsitletakse transkriptoomi, selle regulatsiooni uurimise meetodeid ning samuti ka transkriptsioomi muutuste seost haigustega. Edasi vaadeldakse juba proteoomi ja selle uurimise meetodeid ning valkude tasemel toimunud muutuste seost haigustega. Eraldi tähelepanu on pööratud ka mikrobioomile, selle uurimisele ja seosele tervisega. Bioloogilise info eraldi tasemetega tutvumise võtab kokku metaboloomika, selle meetodid ja rakendused. Lisaks oomika alustega tutvumisele käsitletakse ka nende bioloogilise info kihtide uurimise rakenduslikku külge nagu näiteks genoomi editeerimist, geen-keskkond ja geen-geen interaktsioonide uurimist ning ka vähi-, reproduktiiv- ja farmakogenoomikat koos praktiliste näidetega.
kirjeldus_en: The course covers the following topics: general structure of eukaryotic (human) and prokaryotic genome and methods of its investigation, types of mutations, how mutations occur and what type of mutation is behind a disease. In addition, the epigenome, methods of its study, and the relationship of epigenome changes to diseases are looked at more closely. The next level is the method of transcriptome, its regulation as well as the relationship of transcriptome changes to diseases. Further, the methods of proteome and its research and the relationship of changes in protein levels to diseases are already being considered. Special attention has also been paid to the microbial genome, its research and its relation to health. Metabolomics science, its methods and applications summarize the separate levels of biological information. In addition to familiarizing with the basics of "omics", the applied aspects of studying these layers of biological information, such as genome editing, gene-environment and gene-gene interactions, as well as cancer, reproductive and pharmacogenomics, with practical examples, are also discussed.
opitulemused_en: - The student understands the different levels of biological information and understands the methods used to study them and the basics of analyzing the results obtained

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse käigus tutvutakse sponsorluse põhialustega, valdkonda puudutava terminoloogiaga ning erinevate erarahastusvõimalustega. 
Loengutes õpitakse koostama koostööpakkumisi võimalikele sponsoritele. Külalistena astuvad loengutes üles nii suurimad kultuuritoetajad kui ka rahastuste küsijad.
Käsitletakse vahendite hankimise erinevaid võimalusi ja meetodeid, tutvustatakse eelarve koostamist ning lahendatakse praktilisi ülesandeid, kuidas erinevate rahastajate poole pöörduda.
kirjeldus_en: The course will introduce the main principles of fundraising and sponsorship, the terminology concerning the field as well as an overview of the main possible sources for raising funds in Estonia and abroad will be introduced. In the lectures the students will learn to draw up applications for funds and cooperation proposals for prospective sponsors. Different possibilities and methods for raising funds in cultural organization and basis for drawing up a budget will be examined; the students will also gain knowledge how to approach different financers.
hindamise_meetod:
Lõplik hinne kujuneb eksami (45p) ja kodutööde (35p) ning loengutes ja seminarides osalemise (20p) aktiivsuse põhjal.

Hinne A = 5 (91p - 100p), suurepärane: üliõpilane valdab ainet suurepäraselt, annab esitatud
küsimustele põhjalikud vastused, suudab vabalt arutleda esitatud teemal tuues välja ka omapoolseid
seisukohti ja oskab neid argumenteerida, teab ja kasutab erialast mõistestikku;
Hinne B = 4 (81p - 90p), väga hea: üliõpilane valdab ainet väga hästi, suudab vabalt arutleda esitatud
teemade üle, valdab teemakohast mõistestikku.
Hinne C = 3 (71p - 80p), hea: üliõpilane valdab ainet ja erialast mõistestikku heal tasemel.

kirjeldus_et:
El curso de español A2.2–B1.1 ofrece un repaso y profundización de la gramática y el vocabulario, así como de las estructuras léxicas más frecuentes en contextos cotidianos y académicos. Se trabajan tiempos verbales como el pretérito perfecto, indefinido e imperfecto. Además, se estudian preposiciones, pronombres, adjetivos y conectores para mejorar la coherencia y cohesión en la comunicación oral y escrita. El curso también incluye actividades de comprensión lectora y auditiva, producción de textos y prácticas de conversación, con atención al enriquecimiento del léxico, expresiones idiomáticas y formas coloquiales del español, preparando al estudiante para interactuar con mayor fluidez y seguridad en distintos contextos.


Hispaania keele kursus A2.2–B1.1 pakub grammatika ja sõnavara kordamist ja süvendamist ning keskendub sagedasematele leksikaalsetele struktuuridele igapäevastes ja akadeemilistes kontekstides. Õpitakse tegusõnade ajavorme, nagu täisminevik (pretérito perfecto), lihtminevik (indefinido) ja kestev minevik (imperfecto). Lisaks käsitletakse eessõnu, asesõnu, omadussõnu ja sidesõnu, et parandada suulise ja kirjaliku suhtluse sidusust ja loogilisust. Kursus hõlmab ka lugemis- ja kuulamisoskuse arendamise tegevusi, tekstide koostamist ning suulist suhtlust, pöörates tähelepanu sõnavara rikastamisele, idiomaatiliste väljendite ja kõnekeelsete vormide tundmaõppimisele. Selline ettevalmistuse , mis annab enesekindluse erinevates olukordades vabalt suhelda.
kirjeldus_en: The A2.2–B1.1 Spanish course offers a review and deepening of grammar and vocabulary, as well as the most common lexical structures in everyday and academic contexts. It covers verb tenses such as the present perfect, preterite, and imperfect. In addition, prepositions, pronouns, adjectives, and connectors are studied to improve coherence and cohesion in both oral and written communication. The course also includes reading and listening comprehension activities, text production, and conversation practice, with a focus on expanding vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, and colloquial forms of Spanish, preparing students to interact with greater fluency and confidence in different contexts.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc. Can deal with most situations likely to arise whilst travelling in an area where the language is spoken. Can produce simple connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest. Can describe experiences and events, dreams, hopes & ambitions and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans.

kirjeldus_et:
Klassikalised avaliku võtmega krüptograafilised süsteemid on haavatavad kvantarvutuse arengute suhtes. Postkvantkrüptograafia (PQC) pakub lahendusi, mis arvatakse jäävat turvaliseks ka kvantvastaste olemasolul. See kursus annab põhjaliku sissejuhatuse peamistesse postkvantkrüptograafia esindajatesse, sealhulgas koodipõhisesse, võrepõhisesse ja räsi­põhisesse krüptograafiasse.

Kursusel on kaks suunda: matemaatika ja programmeerimine. Loengud on ühised, kuid ülesanded erinevad sõltuvalt valitud suunast. See võimaldab tudengil keskenduda oma eesmärkidele ning toetab interdistsiplinaarset õppimist.
kirjeldus_en:
Classical public-key cryptographic systems are vulnerable to the advances of quantum computation. Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) offers solutions that are believed to remain secure even in the presence of quantum adversaries. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the major representatives of post-quantum cryptography, including code-based, lattice-based, and hash-based cryptography.

This course will have two tracks: math and coding. The lectures will be shared, but the assignments will be distinct, according to your chosen track. This enables the student to focus on their objectives and promotes interdisciplinary learning.
opitulemused_en:
- After this course, successful students will be able to
- -understand the basic concepts and importance of post-quantum cryptography
- -learn post-quantum cryptography standardization efforts for encryption, key exchange, and signature schemes
- -comprehend post-quantum hard problems
- -learn different quantum safe algorithmic techniques and concepts for implementation
- -analyze and compare post-quantum cryptographic protocols in terms of security and performance.
