2. Välitöö. Külastatakse ehitusgeoloogia ettevõtte poolt läbi viidavat reaalset välitööd, kus tutvutakse peamiste uuringumeetoditega ja võetakse võimalusel pinnaseproove laboripraktikumide jaoks. Välitöö külastus kestab vähemalt neli tundi ja toimub tõenäoliselt väljaspool loenguaegu. Aeg lepitakse osalejatega eelnevalt kokku. Välitöö kohta koostatakse lühiraport.
3. Ehitusgeoloogilise uuringu aruande koostamine. Etteantud andmete ja digitaalsetest andmebaasidest-rakendustest kogutud info põhjal koostatakse aruanne ning kantakse tähtsamad tulemused seminaris ette.
4. Laboripraktikumid. Kolmes laboripraktikumis määratakse pinnaseomadusi ja lahendatakse vastavate omadustega seotud praktiline ülesanne.
Moodulid toimuvad osaliselt paralleelselt. Suurema osa aine mahust moodustab iseseisev töö erialaspetsialistide juhendamisel. Praktika toimub ülikoolisiseses õppekeskkonnas, kuid üliõpilasel on täita tavapärasest erinev roll spetsialisti ja laborandina. Praktika käigus lahendavad üliõpilased reaalseid ehitusgeoloogia ülesandeid, järgides valdkonna regulatsioone ja standardeid. Kursuse tulemusena esitatakse ehitusgeoloogilise uuringu aruanne, välitööde raport ja laboripraktikumide põhjal lahendatud ülesanded, millele üliõpilane saab tagasidet, et võimaldada tal analüüsida saadud erialast kogemust.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is composed of four separate modules: 1. lectures; 2. fieldwork; 3. compilation of an engineering geology investigation report; 4. laboratory practicum.
1. Theoretical and guest lectures. The theoretical lectures address the basic investigation methods in engineering geology and the key physical and mechanical properties of soils. The guest lectures provide insight into the everyday life of engineering geologists.
2. Fieldwork. The students visit real fieldwork with an engineering geology company to study the main investigation methods and to collect soil samples for laboratory practicum if possible. The fieldwork visit lasts at least four hours, and it probably takes place outside the fixed schedule. The time of visit is scheduled with the students. The students have to compile a short report about the fieldwork
3. Engineering geology investigation report. The students compile an investigation reported using data provided by the lecturer. The data is complemented by information collected by the students from digital spatial information databases. The most important results are presented in a seminar.
4. Laboratory practicums. Three laboratory tasks include the determination of different soil properties and solving a practical problem related to these properties.
The modules take place in parallel. Most of the curriculum is accomplished independently under the guidance of specialists. The internship takes place in an intra-university learning environment, but the students have to take the role of a specialist and a laboratory assistant. During the internship, students solve real engineering geology problems following the accepted regulations and standards of the industry. As a result of the course, a report of a construction geological survey, a report of fieldwork, and tasks solved on the basis of laboratory internships are presented, to which the student receives feedback to enable him to analyze the professional experience gained.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, a student:
- 1. Understands and can describe the main issues in engineering geology, the basic investigation methods, and their uses. A student employs theoretical knowledge in analyzing and solving engineering geological problems in specific geological and hydrogeological conditions.
- 2. Understands the concept and relations of physical and mechanical properties of soils, and can calculate soil properties that are used for construction design based on field- and laboratory studies.
- 3. Can find and organize relevant data from public digital spatial databases and combine this data with results of field- and laboratory studies. A student can compile a geotechnical model of the study area based on the gathered data.
- 4. Can draw digital logs, geological profiles, and location maps using drawing software.
- 5. Can compile a systematized report based on the above-mentioned information, and point out the main results in an oral presentation.
- 6. Has experience with the practical output of construction geology and is able to analyze and make sense of primary work experience.
- 7. Participates in laboratory group works.

kirjeldus_et: Tutvustatakse eriala aluseks olevaid teoreetilisi koolkondi ja lähenemisi noorsootöö arengus. Omandatakse süsteemne ülevaade põhimõistetest. Arendatakse tulemuslikkuse ja kvaliteedi hindamise aluseid.
kirjeldus_en: Introduction of theoretical schools that are the basis of the specialty, and the approaches to the development of youth work. Acquisition of the systematic overview of key concepts. Development of the basics of performance and quality evaluation.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Hindamisele pääseb kohustuslike tööde esitamisel ning osalusel ülesannete täitmisel.
hindamise_meetod:
Aine tulemus kujuneb kombineeritult hinnangutest ülesannete täitmisele: tähtaegsus, korrektsus ja sisuline tase ning hinnangust õppuri osaluse aktiivsusele: aktiivne kaasamõtlemine ja - rääkimine, osalemine aruteludes ja rühmatöös, arvamuste argumenteeritus.
Hindamine sisaldab vahehindamist - üliõpilane saab hinde iga iseseisva kirjaliku kodutöö kohta ja lõpphindamist, mis kujuneb saadutud hinnete, rühmatöö hindamise ja kollokviumil osalusehindamise kombinatsioonis.
Kokkuleppel õppejõuga on mõjuvate põhjuste olemasolul võimalik rühmatöös osalemine asendada iseseisva kirjaliku tööga, sel juhul arvestatakse lõpphindamisel vahehindeid ja täiendava iseseisva kirjaliku töö hinnet.

kirjeldus_en: The course consists of two modules. The first module provides an overview of ethical theories, moral relativism, moral dilemmas, and their relevance to the ethics of technology and professionalism. The second module comprises six seminars on topics from the following selection: biomedical technologies, populations and technology, sex and technologies, automation, AI and ethics, military technologies, cost of technologies, surveillance, and data ethics.

* Knowledge of ethical theories

pestitsiidide ja desinfektsioonivahendite, 
dopinguainete, mürkide, narkootikumide ja hallotsinogeenide, 
toiduainete ja toidulisandite keemiat; nende ainete koostist, omadusi, biosobivust, saamist ja kasutamist.
Külastatakse Eesti laboreid ja ettevõtteid, mis tegelevad bioaktiivsete ainete kasutamise ja/või tootmisega. Külaskäigud pakuvad võimalusi kontaktide loomiseks tulevase tööandjatega.
kirjeldus_en:
This course comprises the chemistry of  natural and artificial
fragrances and aromacompounds, 
drugs, vitamins, hormones, 
pesticides and disinfectants, 
doping substances, poisons, narcotics and hallucinogens
food and food additives;
their chemical composition, properties, bioactivity, preparation and use.
Laboratories and companies engaged in the use and/or production of bioactive substances in Estonia will be visited.
Visits offer opportunities to make contacts with a prospective employers.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has passed the subject:
- -can create links between bioactive substances in everyday life and their properties
- -has an overview of the binding of some bioactive substances in the body
- -knows the classes of the bioactive substances, their chemical composition and structure-properties relationships
- -knows the natural origin of some bioactive substances, their synthesis and industrial production
- -experiences and differentiates the effects of the chemical structure of bioactive substances with the help of the sense organs (with the student's informed consent)
- -participates effectively in group work and discussions
- -orientes in the regulation of some classes of bioactive substances (food supplements, pharmaceutics, etc.)
- -gets aware of the conduct of industrial processes and with some of the most important companies operating in the field in Estonia and elsewhere.

kirjeldus_en:
The course will cover the following chapters:

1. preparation of basic organic compounds

2. common transformations between organic compound classes

3. the chemistry of protecting groups

4. computer assisted organic synthesis

5. retrosynthetic analysis

6. organometallic methods

7. phase-transfer catalysis

8. photochemistry

9. electrochemical synthesis

10. non-conventional methods
opitulemused_en:
- The student who have passed the course:
- -	understands the basic concepts of organic chemistry methods,
- -	is able to comprehend the preparation and transformation of different classes of organic compounds,
- -	can describe several functional group protecting methods and their applications,
- -	is familiar with retrosynthesis concept,
- -	is able to implement retrosynthetic analysis on basic organic compounds to evaluate their different synthetic pathways,
- -	has a general overview of contemporary organic chemistry methods,
- -	knows how to search and analyze information from chemical databases to solve practice problems and is also able to share this information in writing as well as orally using different digital tools,
- -	can use chemical drawing programs to present practice problem solutions to other students.

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus tutvustatakse üliõpilastele, kuidas püstitada uurimisküsimust ja kuidas oma uurimisküsimusele vastus leida, kasutades olemasolevaid keelekorpusi või luues oma korpuse/tekstikollektsiooni. Käsitletakse küsimusi, kust saada vajalikke andmeid (sh sobiva korpuse/andmekogu valimine, oma korpuse kogumine, suuliste andmete kogumine) ning milliseid eetilisi ja õiguslikke aspekte peab andmekogumises ja -hoidmises arvestama (sh TÜ eetikakomisjonilt loa taotlemine, andmekaitseseadus, autoriõigus). Koostöös keeleressursside keskusega (CLARIN) tutvustatakse keeletöötlusevahendeid eesti keele ja teiste keelte töötlemiseks ja analüüsiks. Kasutatakse vabavaralisi või TÜle kasutatavaks tehtud korpuslingvistika töövahendeid (nt AntConc, NotePad++, SketchEngine jm). Lisaks tutvustame kursusel statistika olulisust keeleteaduses näidete kaudu ning tutvustame lihtsamaid statistilisi meetodeid. Oskus kasutada ja mõista deskriptiivse statistika baastermineid on oluline, et anda oma andmetest adekvaatne ja sisutihe ülevaade.
kirjeldus_en: Students are instructed how to come up with a feasible research question and how to get evidence and answers for their questions. The focus is on using corpora that are already available or compiling their own corpus/collection of texts. Issues that the course deals with include where to get the necessary data (including the selection of an adequate sample size, collecting spoken language data etc.) and which ethical and legal aspects need to be kept in mind (including getting permission from the Research Ethics Committee at Tartu University, GPDR, copy right issues etc.).  We introduce different resources for natural language processing for Estonian and other languages in co-operation with the Centre of Estonian Language Resources (CLARIN). We make use of the open source corpus linguistic tools (e.g. AntConc, NotePad++, SketchEngine). In addition, we focus on the importance of statistics via linguistic examples and we introduce the basics of statistical analysis. The skill to understand and use the basic terminology of exploratory statistics is important to give a comprehensive and adequate overview of ones data.

opitulemused_en:

- 1) has a knowledge about advantages and disadvantages of different methods in atmospheric  research - direct measurements, satellite remonte sensing and climate models;
- 2) knows the measuring principes and possibilities of environmental monitoring and can participate in related practical work
- 3) knows the methods for measurements of aerosol size distribution and concentrations
- 4) knows the principal concepts and quantities of radioactivity, biological effects of the ionising radiation, radiation pathways and formation of the radiation doze.
- 4) is familiar with practical work in atmospheric measurement station
- 4) can discuss about anthropogenic greenhouse effect and aerosol influence on climate;
- 5) has skills in data analysis used in atmosphere research.

kirjeldus_et:
This is a hands-on course that covers the most common web application vulnerabilities, their exploitation and mitigation techniques.

The course covers web architecture, HTTP/HTTPS, browser security policies, and major web vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection. It also addresses secure authentication, access control, tracking and fingerprinting, UI attacks, browser extensions, bot detection, and server-side flaws. Practical defense strategies are discussed throughout.

Every lecture includes homework, typically involving exploiting and fixing vulnerabilities.

Students are expected to have basic skills in web application development (HTML, JavaScript and PHP).

- - Analyze browser behaviors, tracking methods, and server-side vulnerabilities.

kirjeldus_et: Kolloidkeemia käsitleb reaalseid süsteeme, kus esineb märkimisväärne faasidevaheline piirpind. Kolloidsüsteemid on laialt levinud nii looduses kui ka tehnikas. Paljud elusorganismides kulgevad protsessid on samuti kolloidkeemilise iseloomuga. Kolloidkeemia kursuses tutvustatakse nende protsesside kulgemise tingimusi, olulisi seaduspärasusi ning piirpindadel toimuvate nähtuste seoseid teiste füüsikalis-keemiliste protsessidega. Tähelepanu pööratakse meid ümbritseva maailma nähtuste selgitamisele kolloidkeemia aspektist lähtudes.
kirjeldus_en: Colloid chemistry concerns real systems in which a large interfacial area exists. Colloidal systems are widely spread in nature and these are also used in various technologies. Many processes occurring in living systems are of colloidal origin. In this course it is intended to describe the conditions at which these processes proceed and how the surface phenomena are related to other physico-chemical processes. An emphasis is made to explain various phenomena occurring in the environment from the point of view of colloid chemistry.
opitulemused_en: - The major outcome is to understand the basic concepts of colloid science and to apply such knowledge in solving practical problems of colloid chemistry. The attendees of the course shall have acquired the knowledge to assess relationships between the interfacial phenomena and the properties of the adjacent phases. Students should be able to estimate the main factors that affect the stability of colloid systems.

opitulemused_en:
- After the course a student:
- 1. Understands the basic ideas and models of quantum mechanics and crystallography, necessary to understand the processes in materials on the atomic level.
- 2. Comprehends the structure and properties of solid materials of different level of ordering.
- 3. Comprehends the dynamics of crystals and the processes therein, their relation to the properties of materials.
- 4. Understands, how the phase composition and spatial structuring influences properties of materials.
- 5. Is able to solve the course-related problems.

kirjeldus_et: Õppimine on hariduses keskne mõiste ja närviteadusel on meie arusaamisele õppimisest ja õpetamisest ulatuslik mõju. On palju tegureid (näiteks bioloogilisi, keskkondlikke, inter- ja intrapersonaalseid), mis mõjustavad arengu ja õppimise dünaamilisi protsesse üle inimese elukaare. Ainekursuses arutletakse geneetiliste, bioloogiliste, psühholoogiliste, sotsiaalsete ja keskkondlike faktorite üle, keskendudes õppimise ja saavutustega seotud kriitilistele funktsioonidele erinevates tingimustes ja vanuserühmades. Käsitletakse õppimisprotsessi lihtsustavaid ja pidurdavaid tegureid kognitiivsete/afektiivsete konstruktide (tähelepanu, mälu, täidesaatvad funktsioonid, keel/kõne ja emotsioonid) võtmes ja komplekssetes protsessides nagu mõtlemine, lugemine ja matemaatika.
kirjeldus_en: Learning is central to education. Research in neuroscience has a huge impact on our understanding of learning and teaching. A lot of factors (e.g. biological, environmental, inter- and intrapersonal) affect the dynamic process of development and learning across the human lifespan. Fundamental genetic, biological, psychological, social, and environmental factors are discussed with an emphasis on critical functions related to learning and achievement across settings and age groups. Factors that facilitate or inhibit the learning process are studied when discussing key cognitive constructs (attention, memory, executive functions, language, and emotions) and the complex processes like thinking and reasoning, reading and mathematics.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: John Alexander Davison, Martin Zobel, Martti Vasar
kirjeldus_et:
TÄHELEPANU: kursusele registreerumise eelduseks on programmeerimiskeele R põhitõdede tundmine (koos R Studio-ga või ilma). Peaksite teadma järgnevat: andmete lugemine ja kirjutamine R-i abil; andmestruktuuride konstrueerimine ja manipuleerimine R-is (nt vektorid, andmestruktuurid, listid); R pakettide paigaldamine ja kasutamine; lihtsa graafika loomine põhi R või ggplot abiga.

24 tundi praktilist tööd
 
Praktilised sessioonid annavad teavet järgmistel teemadel
1) Meta-triipkoodistamise sekveneerimisandmete käsitlemine R-i abil. Kvaliteedikontrolli ja sekveneerimisandmete bioinformaatilise analüüsi lähenemisviisid. Bioinformaatilise andmeprogrammi näide R-s, mis kasutab DADA2.
2) Bioinformaatikast tulenevate koosluseandmete esialgne analüüs. Andmete kvaliteedikontroll, andmete uurimise põhilised lähenemisviisid.
3) Meta-triipkoodistamise andmete täpsem analüüs. Ühe- ja mitmemõõtmelise statistilise analüüsi lähenemisviisid.
4) Konsultatsioonisessioonid, kus üliõpilased saavad näitena tuua enda andmeid või esitada oma plaane andmete analüüsi läbiviimiseks ning saada tagasisidet ja juhiseid nii klassilt kui ka õppejõududelt.
kirjeldus_en:
PLEASE NOTE that familiarity with the basics of the R programming language (with or without R Studio) is a prerequisite for course registration. You should be familiar with: reading and writing data using R; constructing and manipulating data structures in R (e.g., vectors, data frames, lists); installing and using R packages; producing simple graphics with base R or ggplot. 

24 hours practical work

Practical sessions will provide information on the following topics
1) Handling metabarcoding sequencing data using R. Approaches to quality control and bioinformatic analysis of sequencing data. An example bioinformatic pipeline using DADA2.   
2) Primary analysis of community data resulting from bioinformatics.  Quality control of data, basic approaches to data exploration.
3) Advanced analysis of metabarcoding data. Approaches to univariate and multivariate statistical analysis.
4) Consultation sessions where students can bring their own data, or present their plans, and receive feedback and guidance from the class and lecturers.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of the course, the student
- - will be able to understand key aspects of the analysis of metabarcoding data
- - will have acquired the skills to apply different bioinformatic and statistical analyses of metabarcoding data
- - will have strategies for applying metabarcoding data analysis to their own research questions

kirjeldus_et: Loengukursus käsitleb genoomi ruumilist arhitektuuri ja sellest seost genoomi funktsiooniga; genoomi strukturaalset varieeruvust ja mobiilseid elemente; genoomi dünaamikat reguleerivaid protsesse - rekombinatsiooni ja geeni konversiooni, epigeneetilist komponenti; võrdlevat genoomikat; genoomi ja geenide funktsiooni reguleerimist mitte-kodeerivate RNAde (ncRNA), sealhulgas mikroRNAde (miRNA) poolt. Igale kursusel osalejale on kohustuslik (ja eeltingimuseks eksamile pääsemiseks) teha seminariettekanne lektorite poolt valitud viimaste aastate jooksul ilmunud genoomika alal oluliste teadusartiklite baasil, samuti retsenseerida kahe kaasõpilase ettekannet. Valitud teadusartiklid haakuvad vahetult loengute teemadega ning seminari eesmärk on arutleda viimaseid arenguid ja läbimurdeid valdkonnas. Seminaride materjalid kaasatakse kõigile kursuslastele kättesaadavate õppematerjalide hulka.
kirjeldus_en:
The lecture course is focused on spacial architecture of the genome and its association with genome function; genomic structural variation and mobile elements; dynamic processes affecting genome - recombination and gene conversion, epigenetic regulatory mechanisms; comparative genomics; regulation of genome and gene function by non-coding RNAs (ncRNA), including microRNAs (miRNA).
Every participant is obliged to give a seminar-presentation during the course as well as to analyze and give an opinion about the presentation of two fellow students. The presentation is based on publications selected by the course lecturers, which represent top papers in genomics during past years. The selected papers are directly related to the topics of the lectures and the aim of seminars is to discuss recent progress and breakthroughs in the field. Seminar presentations will be available to all course participants at the course website.

Ettekanne jaguneb: 15 min Sissejuhatus+Materjal/Metoodika; 15 min Tulemused ja Arutelu. Kui seminari ettekanne ei ole õppejõule ja kaastudengitele arusaadavalt ette kantud, läheb see kordamisele kas suulise ettekandena või eestikeelse kirjaliku referaadina, vastavalt nii kuidas loengukursuse ajaline määr võimaldab.

kirjeldus_en: The course provides theoretical and practical knowledge about pathological diagnostics of surgical, oncological and other gynecological and skin diseases, required for independent work as a general practitioner. In addition, a brief overview is given about cytopathology. The sources of theoretical knowledge are the textbooks and presentations, video lectures and self-assessment tests represented in the Moodle learning platform. For learning of microscopic alterations, the database of digital microscopy slides with tutorial videos is available in the Moodle, grouped according to the topics. In the seminars, discussions of independently learned materials takes place and drawing associations with clinical significance.
opitulemused_en: - The student who graduated the course getting at least the minimal grade: knows principles of tissue sampling, knows the causes and pathogenesis of diseases, is able to understand the meaning of histological diagnoses, understands the most important morphological changes of diseases, and as a result is capable of apply this knowledge in daily medical practice.

kirjeldus_en: During the course the students get an overview on the etiology and mechanisms of development of basic syndromes and diseases at the level of organism, tissue, cell, and molecules as well as on the effects of pathogenic changes on the functions of organism.

- The student who graduated the course:
- - Can explain changes in functions of human organ systems in the pathological processes and most common diseases both at the cell and at the level of the organism,
- - knows the mechanisms of development of disturbances caused by harmful factors,
- - knows and analyzes the main regulatory mechanisms that ensure the stability of the indoor environment

kirjeldus_et:
Magistriseminar koosneb järgmistest kohustuslikest osadest ja EAPdest:
(1) Seminaridest osavõtt (osalemine vähemalt 12 seminaril ühes semestris, s.o. 0.5 EAPd; 4 semestrit x 0.5 EAPd = 2 EAPd). Üliõpilase enda õppetooli seminarid on kohustuslikud; teiste õppetoolide ja botaanika/zooloogia osakonna seminarides tuleb (kooskõlastatult juhendajaga) nii palju osaleda, et ühes semestris oleks kokku osaletud vähemalt 12 seminaril. Sobilikud on ka väljaspool Tartu Ülikooli toimuvad erialased teaduskogunemised (need samuti eelnevalt kooskõlastada oma juhendajaga).
(2) Töörühma/õppetooli spetsiifilistes tööaruteludes osalemine (1 EAP). Kohustuslik on sealjuures üliõpilase magistritöö plaani arutamine (tööarutelu algab enda plaane tutvustava ettekandega). 
(3) Suulise ettekande tegemine enda magistritöö põhjal 1. õppeaasta kevadsemestril (2 EAPd). See võimaldab instituudi töötajatel ning ka kraadiõppuritel olla vastastikku kursis kõrvalerialal toimuva tööga, samuti kraadiõppurite teadustöö laiemat sisulist arutamist.
(4) Magistritöö eelkaitsmine 2 a. kevadsemestril (1 EAP).

EAPde arvestamiseks on äärmiselt oluline jooksvalt täita Magistriseminari aruannet. Aruande tabelisse märkida järgnev info: kuupäev, seminariliik (õppetooli/osakonna/mujal toimunud üritus), seminari pealkiri/teema, esineja nimi ja kestvus (tundides). Magistritööteemalised arutelud oma juhendajaga ja töörühma spetsiifilised arutelud märkida samuti sarnasel viisil aruandesse.

kirjeldus_en:
Master's Seminar contains the following parts and ECTS:
1) Attending to the seminars (at least 12 seminars in a semester; 4 semesters x 0.5 ECTS = 2 ECTS). The seminars of a student's chair are compulsory, the other seminars (seminars of other chairs and department of botany/zoology should be attended to gain at least 10 seminar visits (in total) in a semester. The scientific meetings held outside of Tartu University can also be visited, but they must be related to ecology and approved by the supervisor.
2) Attending to the workgroup/chair's work meetings (1 ECTS). It is compulsory to discuss the workflow of the student's thesis (in the first meetings, the student presents the work plan of the thesis)
3) Giving an oral presentation on the Master thesis in the 2nd semester (2 ECTS). 
4) The pre-defense of the Master thesis in the 4th semester (1 EAP).
 


It is very important to continuously record the visited seminars and other activities in the Master's seminar report. The following information should be included in a table of the report: date, type of the seminar (chair/department/other), title/topic of the seminar, name of the presenter and duration of the event (in hours). Discussions with the supervisor and other members of the workgroup should be reported in the similar way. 
The Master's seminar report should be sent at least two weeks before the end of the each semester to the email of Karin Kaljund (karin.kaljund@ut.ee) (in the Department of Botany) or to Margret Sisask (margret.sisask@ut.ee) (in the Department of Zoology).
opitulemused_en: - The MSc student will become familiar with current research questions in ecology. By the end of the course the student can analyze scientific literature, participate in scientific discussions and give scientific presentations on his/her speciality.

kirjeldus_et:
Aine koosneb kahest osast. Esimeses neist toimuvad loengud, mille käigus antakse ülevaade olulisematest teadusarvutusülesannetest, lahendusalgoritmidest ning arvutusmeetoditest. Tutvustatakse teadusarvutusklastrite (HPC) ja pilvekeskkondade põhilisi omadusi. Detailsemalt käsitletakse levinumaid/kättesaadavamaid tarkvaraprogramme ja teeke suuremahuliste andmete töötluseks ja visualiseerimiseks. 
Teine aine osa toimub probleemipõhise õppe vormis, kus mõneüliõpilaselised rühmad lahendavad tegelikke teadusprobleeme kirjutades lihtsamaid programme teadusarvutuslike ülesannete lahendamiseks ning kasutades levinumaid/kättesaadavamaid tarkvaraprogramme ja teeke suuremahuliste andmete töötluseks ja visualiseerimiseks. Kursus lõppeb ettekandeseminariga, kus rühmad esitavad ning analüüsivad oma projekti tulemusi.
kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of two parts. During the first one, an overview will be given of different problems, solution algorithms and data processing methods in scientific computing. Properties of high performance computing (HPC) clusters and clouds environments are introduced. Most used software packages for data processing and visualization are discussed in more detail.
The second part of the course is carried out in the form of problem based learning, when students in groups solve real scientific problems. Students write simple codes using widespread software packages for processing  and visualisation of very large datasets. The course is concluded with a seminar where students groups present and analyse their results.

opitulemused_en:

- To be familiar with main research methods in today's molecular biology and gene technology (isolation and purification of DNA and RNA, molecular diagnostics, PCR, sequencing) and can use these methods for practical applications.
- To know and apply in practice methods for quantifying and measuring the quality of nucleic acids.
- To be familiar with basics of data analysis and databases and knows how to use them in practice.

kirjeldus_en: Introductory course on the physical bases of modern remote sensing, methods used in remote sensing to solve geological problems and their application to the characterization and monitoring of the environment. In practice, data obtained by different remote sensing methods (lidar, RGB, multispectral etc.) are processed at various from handheld specimen to planetary scale.
opitulemused_en:
- After successfully passing the course, the student:
- 1. has an overview of modern remote sensing methods (active and passive monitoring) and their application possibilities in geology;
- 2. can use remote sensing data to characterize and monitor the geological environment;
- 3. has acquired skills with different methods used in remote sensing for geological applications
- 4. can use various software to process remote sensing data for geological information
- 5. has acquired basic image processing techniques:
- - Raster classification
- - Identifying changes
- - Calculation of different indicators / indices

kirjeldus_et: Kursus tutvustab tervisepsühholoogia mõistet ja olulisemaid ainevaldkondi: määratleb tervise, haiguse, tervisekäitumise ja tervise edendamise mõisted. Antakse ülevaade levinumate tervist kahjustavate käitumiste psühholoogilistest mehhanismidest, haiguskäitumise variantidest ja haigustega toimetulekust, samuti stressi ja stressiga toimetuleku mudelitest. Kursusel käsitletakse mitmeid psühholoogilisi sekkumisi, millega tervisekäitumist muuta.Vaatluse alla tuleb süvendatult mitu erinevat tervisekäitumise valdkonda koos vastavate sekkumistega. Viiakse läbi praktiline personaalne tervisekäitumise muutmise sekkumine, mille eesmärgiks on õppida mitmeid tehnikaid rakendama.
kirjeldus_en: The course introduces the concept of health psychology and main topics in the field: health, illness, health behaviours and health promotion. Common health compromising behaviours and their psychological explanations, various illness behaviours and management of illness will be reviewed, also the models of stress and coping. Various psychological interventions for health behaviours are introduced. The course focuses in depth on several health behaviours and their psychological interventions. Students carry out a personal practical experiment to learn to implement various health behaviour change techniques.
opitulemused_en:
- As a result of the course the student:
- - knows the main topics of health psychology
- - understands the basic biopsychosocial model of health
- - knows various psychological interventions for physical illnesses and knows how to implement them
- - can assess and consider the role of psychological factors in the prevention and influencing the public health

Students will learn the different types of processes in production and services, and the principles for choosing/designing the suitable management systems for them. Also, students will learn different types of supply chain and their functioning principles in the light of their applicability in practice with several examples. In addition, they will learn operation scheduling rules and their implementation.

Loengud, e-loengud ja iseseisev lugemine annavad teoreetilise tausta ja asetavad Eesti planeerimispraktika rahvusvahelisse võrdlusse. Läbi erinevate ülesannete viivad osalejad 4-5-liikmelistes gruppides läbi ühe valitud 2021. aastal valminud kohaliku omavalitsuse üldplaneeringu analüüsi ja töötavad välja selle KOVi planeerimisvaldkonna poliitikasoovitused. Kohtumised auditooriumis vahelduvad grippide e-õppe kohtumistega digitaalses koosloomekeskonnas (Miro vms. Kursuse peamine missioon on anda osalejatele tunnetus, kuidas toimub kohtade ruumiplaneerimine reaalses valitsemissituatsioonis - kuidas väärtuseid planeeringutesse ja ruumi viia ning milline on selles protsessis erinevate osapoolte roll.
kirjeldus_en: The course is divided into four sections: (a) spatial planning as a means to leading the way for change, (b) social expectations and values as the basis of spatial planning, (c) the dynamics between parties invlolved in planning and (d) putting the planning strategy into practice. In-person lectures, online lectures and independent reading materials provide a theoretical background and place Estonian planning practices onto an international comparison scale. Through different tasks, groups of 4-5 students will carry out an analysis of a local government Master Plan approved recently and elaborate policy recommendations for the respective municipality. Meetings in the auditorium are complemented by groups meeting via an online meeting platform (e.g. Miro). The mission of this course is to provide participants with a better understanding of how spatial planning plays out in real governance situations - how social values are brought into the planning process, and what is the role of every involved party in this process.
opitulemused_en: - After completing this course, the student is expected to: (1) understand the role of spatial planning in local and regional governance, and in leading and enabling social change; (2) identify the prevalence of widely established social values (or lack thereof) in spatial planning programmes and recognise the need for adaptability to changing social values; (3) is capable of accommodating spatial decisions with social expectations in a systematic, identifiable and inclusive way while taking different roles in the planning process; (4) is capable of critically analysing the reliability and performance of finalised spatial plans and spatial decisions outside the formal planning process.

- -Evaluate whether explainability is a requirement for an AI application and understand the various approaches for it
- -Understand the potential security and privacy risks of AI systems and remember the main legal obligations

kirjeldus_en: Throughout the course "Observation and Pedagogical Practice", the learner will visit a kindergarten and all three levels of schools (i.e. elementary, middle, and high school). During the visitations, the learner will look around the buildings, view lessons and learning activities done in those lessons, view various pedagogical situations, and get to know the learning process. At the end of the course, a study map will be presented analysing the specifics of the work of the different educational institutions and reflecting on the knowledge and experience acquired.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1) Has obtained an overview of the working process of schools and kindergartens (i.e. managing the study process, school/kindergarten teachers and their responsibilities, etc.).
2) Has developed their pedagogical self-consciousness.
3) Has learned to know the development environment of schools and kindergartens. Have observed various areas, and their peculiarities, in terms of schools and kindergartens.
4) Have observed pedagogical situations and relations. Have enhanced their self-reflection and analysis skills.

Terviseturismiasutused, -tooted, -teenused ja sihtkohad. Terviseturismi sihtkoha arendustegevuste planeerimine ja tegevuskava koostamine.
kirjeldus_en:
The concept of wellbeing (welfare, wellbeing, wellness). Society, country and economy of welfare. International models for measuring and evaluating welfare and quality of life. Approaches to health. Concept of holistic wellness. Dimensions and energy of wellness. Measuring and evaluating personal wellbeing. Wellness business, products and services. 
Approaches to health tourism, development and future trends. Framework and forms of health tourism: medical, spa, and wellness. The expectations, needs and wishes of health tourists. Institutions, products, services and destinations of health tourism. Planning and preparation of the activity plan for health tourism destination.

kirjeldus_et:
Praktikumi käigus käsitletakse atmosfääriaerosooli osakeste mõõtmespektri (suurusjaotuse) mõõtmise elektriliste, kondensatsiooniliste ja optiliste seadmete (spektromeetrite) tööprintsiipe ja ehitust, samuti mõõteprotsessi juhtimise ja andmetöötluse tarkvara; harjutatakse esitama mõõtetulemusi kahe- ja kolmemõõtmeliste graafikute ning pind-diagrammidena. Õpetatakse tulemusi tõlgendama aerosooli mõju seisukohalt ilmastikule, inimtegevusele ja elusorganismide  tervisele. 
Keskkonnadosimeetria sissejuhatavate materjalide läbitöötamise järel toimuvad arvutipraktikumid, kus vabavaralist kiirgusdooside hindamise tarkvara kasutades tehakse praktilise tööna läbi kiirgusdoosi hindamise protsess. Vaadeldakse mitut stsenaariumi - doosihinnang loodusliku kiirgusallika ja tehisliku kiirgusallika puhul.
kirjeldus_en:
During the course the measurement principes and construction of the electrical, optical and condensational spectrometers of the atmospheric aerosol particles as well as the software for their measurement control and data processing will be considered. Presentation of  the data in form of the two- and three-dimensional graphs and surface-diagrams will be also concerned. Students experience to interprete the effect of their measurement results on the weather, human activity and the health of living organisms. 
After the treatment of the introductive materials about the environmental dosimetry, the practical lessons will be provided. Using the free software for assessment of the radiation dozes, the practical assessment of the doze will be provided. Different scenaria will be considered: assessment of the doze by natural and artificial radiation sources.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completion of this course, the student is expected to:
- 1.	Know the measuring principes and possibilities of the electrical, condensational and optical devices for the measurement of the size spectrum and concentration of the atmospheric aerosol particles; the same about the mobility spectrometers of the charged particles (air ions).
- 2.	Be able to operate of the above-mentioned devices, know the software for the data processing, present the data graphically.
- 3.	Interprete the effect of the measurement results on the weather, human activity and the health of living organisms.
- 4.	Know the principal concepts, physical quantities and measurement units of the radioactivity and dosimetry of the environment.
- 5.	Know the biological effects of the ionising radiation, radiation pathways and formation of the radiation doze.
- 6.	Know the principles of the practical environmental monitoring and be able to participate in the monitoring activities.

Õpitakse, millised on õppetöö organisatsioonilised vormid ning missuguse eesmärgiga rakendatakse neid võõrkeele õppimisel. Üliõpilane õpib tundma ning rakendama erinevaid võõrkeele õpetamise meetodeid, tehnikaid ja mänge kuulamis-, rääkimis-, lugemis-, kirjutamisvilumuste kujundamiseks.

 Kursus lõpeb eksamiga.
kirjeldus_en: Students learn how to structure the process of teaching and learning foreign languages in contemporary school. Organizational formats of teaching and their application to the study of foreign languages. Students learn and apply various methods of teaching foreign languages, techniques and games to develop listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. They learn to analyse various textbooks of German and work out their own conception of teaching German on the basis of one topic in the textbook. The course ends with an exam.
opitulemused_en: - The students learn to structure the process of teaching and work out their own conception of teaching

Vocabulary: family and relatives, describing people, geography, politics, words for parts of the body

Regular and irregular verbs. The past tense. Present Perfect. Adjectives and adverbs. Expressions of time. Word order in subordinate clauses. The definite declension of the adjective in outline and adjectival nouns. Modal verbs. S-verbs: reciprocal, deponent and passive. Reflexive verbs and pronouns. Present and past participles. Comparison of adjectives. Transitive and intransitive verbs. Compound verbs. Affixation. Passives. Abbreviations.

- After passing the course student

kirjeldus_et: Kursusel tutvustatakse ja õpetatakse kasutama olulisemaid vanu kultuure ja keeli (eelkõige kreeka, ladina, heebrea (aga ka teisi semiidi keeli)) puudutavaid andmebaase ja programme, mis on vabalt ligipääsetavad ja mida üliõpilased saavad kasutada oma erialases uurimistöös. Suur rõhk on tekstide ja keele analüüsil (nt. andmebaasid, kust leida originaalkeeltes tekste, vahendid tekstide analüüsimiseks, keeleõppeks kasulikud programmid), ent vaadeldakse ka ajaloo ja (olme)kultuuri osas kasulikke andmebaase (nt. arheoloogilised leiukohad, antiikvaaside jms. andmebaasid), mis aitaksid tekstis esinevaid reaale mõista. Selgitatakse, mida peaks ise andmebaasi koostades silmas pidama, kuidas andmebaasi koostamist alustada.
kirjeldus_en: The most important free-access databases and programmes for doing research on ancient cultures and languages (mainly Greek, Latin and Hebrew (but also other semitic languages)) are introduced and explained, how to use them for students field of research. The emphasis is on the analysis of texts and languages (e.g. databases for finding texts in Greek, Latin and Hebrew, tools for analyzing texts, useful programs and databases for language studies etc.), but the databases of history, archaeology etc. are introduced, where students can find the realia occurring in texts, are also introducesd. In addition, some main principles, what to observe when one starts creating a database, are brought out and explained.

kirjeldus_et: Antakse süvendatud ülevaade kaasaegsetest elektrokeemilise kineetika teooriatest erinevate kiirust limiteerivate staadiumide (aeglane neutralisatsioon, rekombinatsioon, kristallisatsioon, massiülekanne, adsorptsioon) tingimustes ning elektrilise kaksikkihi ning metallide elektronstruktuuri mõjust laenguülekande protsessile kvantkeemia valguses. Põhjalikumat käsitlust leiab elektrokatalüüs. Loengutega paralleelselt toimuvad seminarid, kus toimub loengumaterjali arutelu ja eripraktikumid teoreetiliste teadmiste praktilise kasutamise õppimiseks.
kirjeldus_en: The basic modern conception of the mechanism of heterogeneous and electrochemical reactions, influence of nature of the rate-limiting step on the reaction mechanism will be discussed. The detailed analysis of slow charge transfer mechanism, electrochemical and chemical recombination mechanisms, electrocrystallisation process, influence of the heterogeneous adsorption step and homogeneous reactions in solution phase will be given. Some practical works will be made and results obtained will be analysed using various theoretical approximations.

- *Student has broadened his understanding of the most important electrochemical processes.

* suutervis

kirjeldus_en:
Detailed Course Content:
* Fundamentals of oral health.
* Selection and use of oral hygiene products.
* Techniques for effective oral hygiene.
* Daily oral care routines and their execution.
* Addressing patient resistance or refusal of oral care.
* Management of dry mouth.
* Coping with gag reflexes.
* Denture maintenance.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of this course, learners will be able to:
- * Understand the importance of routine oral hygiene practices.
- * Identify and recommend suitable methods, products, and tools for the prevention of oral and dental diseases.
- * Perform daily oral care procedures effectively.
- * Manage resistant or uncooperative behaviour in patients requiring oral care.
- * Analyse individual patient needs and adapt oral care strategies accordingly.
- * Instruct medical staff or family members on proper oral hygiene techniques for patients unable to care for themselves.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse raames tutvustatakse ruumilise mobiilsuse käsitlemise teoreetilisi ja metodoloogilisi aspekte ning selle seoseid info- ja kommunikatsioonitehnoloogia kasutusega. Vaadeldakse positsioneerimise uuringute ja asukohapõhiste teenuste rakendusi linnaplaneerimises, äris ja turismiuuringutes. Käsitletakse IKT-põhiste suurandmete kasutamise eetilisi küsimusi ning kultuurilist ja kontekstist tulenevaid erisusi.

Kursus koosneb 7 loengust (2x45 min), 2 praktikumist, 5 seminaritööst ja 5 seminarist. Iga loengu ja seminari kohta on Moodle'i keskkonda lisatud täiendav teksti- või slaidimaterjal.
kirjeldus_en:
The course introduces theoretical and methodological aspects of spatial mobility and its relation to information and communication technologies (ICTs). Lectures and seminars concentrate on mobility studies and mobile data used in geography, tourism and urban studies. Ethical issues in the use of ICT-based big data and differences arising from culture and context are addressed.

The course consists of 7 lectures (2x45 min), 2 practical sessions (2x45 min), five assignments and 5 seminars. Each lecture and seminar has an additional text or slide material available in the Moodle.

The topics of the course (content of the course might slightly change depending on students' progress):

   Introducing oneself,
   Colours and adjectives,
   Countries, nationalities and languages,
   Family and friends,
   Professions and occupations,
   Numerals, phone numbers, addresses,
   Studies,
   Daily routine,
   Favourite things to do,
   Leisure time and hobbies.

The student needs to register for the course after finishing the internship at the organisation. Internship must be coordinated with the supervisors via e-mail (journalism internship brit.laak@ut.ee, communication internship tiiu.taur@ut.ee. The student is responsible in finding a place for the internship.
In order to acquire 3 EAP the trainee period needs to last approximately 70 academic hours, compiling the internship report takes in general 9 hours, defending the report 1 hour. A portfolio of the practical assignments taken at the time of the internship is handed in together with the internship report. After finishing one's internship one needs to defend its results when orally presenting one's internship report in a seminar.

They will be engaged in different language learning activities, including holding meetings, composing e-mails, making phone calls, participating in discussions, and giving a short presentation. - 4) compose professional e-mails

Philosophical disagreements module:

9. Emotions

opitulemused_en:
- Learning outcomes relate to a particular module.
- 1. By the end of the argumentation module the student will have:
- * Acquired the fundamentals of argumentation theory and developed the ability to use these in an analysis of an argument.
- * Learnt to represent someone else's text and speech in such a way that the substantial points emerge clearly. The student is able to critically analyse that substantive part.
- * Acquired the basic knowledge of scientific thinking and methodology. The student is able to critically analyse one's own research methodology.
- 2. By the end of the philosophical disagreements module the student will have:
- * Understood the particularities of philosophical questions (in relation to the topics covered) and their interdisciplinary aspects and implications.
- * Acquired the capacity to position one's own research into the wider context of the history of ideas.
- * The ability to employ the concepts and theories from the course in the analysis of particular cases.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb rahvusluse ja rahvusliku liikumise mõisteid ning praktikat 18. sajandi lõpust kuni I maailmasõjani, võttes lähema vaatluse alla katoliikliku taustaga ja iseseisvat riiklust omanud ning omavahel seotud Poola ja Leedu ning luterliku taustaga ning varem naaberriikide provintside staatuses olnud Eesti ja Läti, mis vaadeldaval ajavahemikul kuulusid kõik Vene impeeriumi koosseisu.
kirjeldus_en: The course presents the concepts of nationalism and national movements in the eastern Baltic region and treats its influence on the development of society and culture from the late 18th century until World War I. The course will focus on the similarities and differences on Poland and Lithuania on one hand and Estonia and Latvia on the other. The former territories were Roman Catholic and had previous experience of independent statehood; the latter ones were provinces of foreign powers, sharing Lutheran cultural tradition. The whole region belonged to the Russian Empire.
opitulemused_en: - The student acquires systematic and comprehensive knowledge about the influence of nationalism on the development of society and culture from the late 18th century until World War I on the example of four countries of the eastern Baltic region (today's Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland). Knowledge about these developments will promote the understanding of the history of these countries and nationalities.

kirjeldus_et:
Aine annab ülevaate nahatöö põhimõtetest ja praktilistest oskustest, ühendades teoreetilise tausta ja käelise tegevuse.

Tutvumine nahatöö valdkonnaga, selle ajalooga ja tänapäevaste suundumustega. Teema mõistmise ja silmaringi laiendamise eesmärgil koostatakse lühike kirjatöö, mis käsitleb nahatöö traditsioone, materjalide päritolu või kestlikkuse aspekte.

Tutvumine erinevate nahkade ja nende omadustega. Õpitakse tundma nahatööks vajalikke tööriistu ning omandatakse oskus neid ohutult ja otstarbekalt kasutada. Praktikumide käigus harjutatakse naha ettevalmistamist ja põhilisi töövõtteid.

Projekt: Ese uuest materjalist
Valmistatakse nahast ese, kasutades uut materjali. Projekti käigus rakendatakse õpitud tehnikaid ja pööratakse tähelepanu töö kvaliteedile ning funktsionaalsusele.

Projekt: Ese taaskasutatud materjalist
Valmistatakse ese taaskasutatud nahast või nahajääkidest. Projekti eesmärk on arendada loovust ja kestlikku mõtteviisi, leides materjalile uue otstarbe.
kirjeldus_en:
The subject provides an overview of the principles and practical skills of leatherwork, combining theoretical background and manual activity.

Introduction to the field of leatherwork, its history and current trends. In order to understand the topic and broaden the horizons, a short written work is prepared that deals with leatherwork traditions, the origin of materials or aspects of sustainability.

Introduction to different leathers and their properties. Students learn about the tools necessary for leatherwork and acquire the skills to use them safely and effectively. During the practical sessions, students practice leather preparation and basic working techniques.

Project: Item from new material
A leather item is made using a new material. During the project, the learned techniques are applied and attention is paid to the quality and functionality of the work.

Project: Item from recycled material
A item is made from recycled leather or leather scraps. The aim of the project is to develop creativity and a sustainable mindset by finding a new purpose for the material.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- Recognizes the skins of different animals.
- Can choose the right leather for the job.
- Knows the tools needed for leather work and knows how to use them.
- Knows the possibilities of using and upcycling leather.

kirjeldus_et:
Maitse üle ei vaielda! Igalühel ju oma. Kuidas on aga nii, et kui ütlen, et miski on ilus, siis eeldan justkui, et ka teised peaksid nõusse jääma? Kuidas see, mis oma suures ilus on nii ülev, võib tekitada minus põhjatut õudu? Ja millest räägib Kant siis, kui ütleb, et ilu on otstarbeta otstarbekus? Ja siis, kui ta seda argumenteerides laseb  mängu tulla mängul?

Keskendudes "Otsustusjõu kriitikale", on seminaride sisuks nii ajalooline sissejuhatus esteetikasse kui ka sissevaade Kanti filosoofiasse. Kolmanda peateose ehk kolmanda kriitikana tuntud "Otsustusjõu kriitikas" (1790) teeb Kant katse viia oma filosoofia tervikliku süsteemina lõpetatusesse ehk siis näidata teoreetilise ja praktilise mõistuse süstemaatilist ühtsust. Otsustusjõud, mis on ühe tunnetusvõimena ka juba "Puhta mõistuse kriitikas" ja "Praktilise mõistuse kriitikas" kõne all, nihkub nüüd kolmandas kriitikas teoreetilise ja praktilise tunnetuse vahendajana fookusesse. Seejuures võtab Kant lähema uurimise alla kaks valdkonda: esteetika ning teleoloogilise lähenemise loodusele. Seminarides tuleb üksikasjalisemalt vaatlusele esteetika ehk siis see, kuidas Kant üritab mõtelda loodus(paratamatus)t ühitatavana vabadusega otsustustes ilu üle.

Samal ajal on ka tohutu infohulk meist vaid ühe näpuliigutuse kaugusel, kuid kaugeltki kogu see informatsioon ei ole õige. Seepärast on oluline, et igaühel meist oleksid põhiteadmised ravimite kohta, et oskaksime eristada tõde ja väära ning seeläbi kaitsta enda ja oma lähedaste tervist. kirjeldus_en: We all use medicines - you, me, our families, friends. The availability of medicines is good, their safety, effectiveness and quality is under strict control. At the same time large amounts of information is just beyond a click. Unfortunately not all of that information is true. Therefore, it is important for everyone to have a basic knowledge on medicines to be able to critically analyse this information and thereby protect one's health. And this course aims to give everyone such knowledge.
opitulemused_en:
- After the course the student:
- Knows the main periods in the history of medicines.
- Is aware of the main principles in medicines manufacturing and main dosage forms.
- Understands the composition of medicines and also the terms active substance and excipient.
- Is aware of how medicines act and knows the different routes of administration.
- Understands the concept of a pharmacy and the importance of consulting in pharmacy.
- Knows the main principles of medicines consumption.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Naiste rolli ümberkujundamine Vene impeeriumi kultuuris. Naine kui kultuuripoliitika objekt 18.-19. saj. Naise subjektiivsuse kujunemine, selle kajastamine kirjanduses. 19. sajandi vene naiskirjanike temaatiline ja žanriline repertuaar, nende loomingu retseptsiooni põhijooni.
kirjeldus_en: Transforming the role of women in the culture of the Russian Empire. Woman as an object of cultural policy in 18 and 19 centuries. The development of a woman's subjectivity, its reflection in literature. Thematic and genre repertoire of 19th century Russian women writers, the main features of the reception of their work.
opitulemused_en:
- The Student completed the cours
- 1. has acquired basic knowledge of the history of Russian women's literature and the work of 19th century female writers.
- 2. evaluates literary manifestations in their historical context, interprets them using the method of close reading;
- 3. identifies and analyzes the reflections of intra-cultural conflicts in the literature.
- 4. select, read critically, and use scientific sources based on the topic and goals of their examination paper.

1. Kombinatoorika. Permutatsioonid ja kombinatsioonid. Newtoni binoomteoreem. 
2. Automaatide teooria. Deterministlikud ja mittedeterministlikud lõplikud automaadid. Regulaaravaldised ja regulaarsed keeled.

kirjeldus_en:
1. Enumerative combinatorics. Permutations and combinations. Newton's binomial theorem.  Inclusion-exclusion principle.
2. Automata theory. Deterministic and non-deterministic finite automata.  Regular expressions and regular languages. Context-free languages.
3. Computability theory.  Turing machines undecidable problems. Equivalences between different models of Turing machines. SAT and Cook's theorem. Examples of NP-complete problems.

Kursuse käigus tutvustatakse linnaruumi analüüsi meetodeid, planeerimise teoreetilisi lähtekohti, Eesti planeerimissüsteemi ja õigusruumi. Omandatud teadmisi kasutatakse iseseisva planeeringu koostamisel konkreetse teema või piirkonna põhjal. Planeeringulahendus töötatakse välja rühmatööna, lahenduse tutvustamiseks ja edasiarendamiseks simuleeritakse avalikku arutelu koos rollimänguga. Kursuse raames viiakse läbi välitöid ja osaletakse reaalsete planeeringute menetlusprotsessis.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of different stages in composing spatial development plans. During the course, the methods of spatial analysis, theoretical approaches to urban and regional planning, the Estonian planning system and its legal aspects are introduced. The acquired knowledge is used in compiling a spatial plan for a specific area or topic. The planning proposal is developed as a group work and a simulation of public consultation as a roleplay is used to and defend the proposed plan. Throughout the course students conduct fieldwork and participate in the process of composing actual spatial plans.

kirjeldus_et:
Tudengid tutvuvad erinevate planeerimisteooriate ja meetoditega ning rakendavad neid teadmisi planeerimisprojektis grupitööna. Oluline osa grupitööst on õppida tegema koostööd ja osalema kommunikatsiooniprotsessis planeeringute koostamisel. Iga rühma planeerimisprojekti üldine teema on paika pandud õppejõudude poolt. Kursuse käigus tehakse välitöid ja toimub planeeringulahenduse avaliku arutelu simulatsioon, lõpus kaitstakse välja töötatud planeeringulahendust. Kursus on jaotatud kolme etappi (ruumilise planeerimise teoreetiline kontekst, analüüs, planeeringulahenduse ja -kaardi koostamine), mida annavad erinevad õppejõud. Statisilise analüüsi tulemusi õpitakse kasutama planeeringulahenduse põhjendusena.
1. Planeerimise olemus Lääne maailma kontekstis.
Esimeses etapis omandavad tudengid teadmisi planeerimise olemusest ja aktuaalsematest ruumilise planeerimise teemadest (nt jätkusuutlikkus, mobiilsus jm). Lisaks tutvutakse uurimisaluse piirkonna oluliste teemade, regulatsioonide ja planeeringutega. Töö käigus leitakse sobivad teoreetilised lähtekohad planeerimisprojekti lahendamiseks. Esimese etapi lõpuks sõnastatakse iga grupi/töörühma planeerimisprojekti peaeesmärk ja lähteülesanne.
2. Statistiline analüüs.
Teises etapis teostab iga grupp kvantitatiivse analüüsi, mis lähtub etteantud planeeringuprojekti teemast. Selleks kasutatakse statistilisi andmeanalüüsi meetodeid. Eesmärgiks on läbi viia empiiriline andmeanalüüs, et selle tulemusi rakendada planeerimisülesandes. Teise etapi lõpus esitavad tudengid enda analüüsi tulemusi.
3. Planeeringulahenduse koostamine
Kolmandas etapis töötatakse välja planeeringulahendused ja poliitikasoovitused põhinedes planeerimisprojekti lähteülesandele ja teostatud analüüsile. Koostatakse planeeringukaart koos seletuskirjaga.

NB! Eelnev kogemus GIS tarkvaraga (QGiS või ArcGIS) on vajalik.
kirjeldus_en:
Students will learn modern planning theoretical framework and methods, and apply this knowledge in preparing a planning project as a group work. The general topic of each group project is given by lecturers. During the course, fieldwork is done and a public discussion of the planning solution is simulated, at the end of the course the group work will be presented and defended. The course is divided into three stages (theoretical context of spatial planning, empirical analysis, preparation of a planning solution) and is taught by different lecturers. The results of the statistical analysis are learned to be used as a justification for the planning solution.
1. Contemporary spatial planning
In the first phase, students acquire knowledge of the basic concepts of planning and the most relevant topics in contemporary spatial planning (for example sustainability, mobility, etc.). In addition to this, students become acquainted with the main topics, regulations and spatial plans of the area under study. In the course of the work, suitable theoretical framework for solving the planning project are found. By the end of the first phase, the main goal and task of the Planning Project for each group are formulated.
2. Statistical analysis
In the second phase, each group performs a quantitative analysis based on their specific group-work task. This is done using statistical analysis methods. The goal is to conduct an empirical data analysis and implement the results in the Planning Project. At the end of the second phase, students present their analysis results.
3. Compilation of a spatial plan
In the third phase, the planning solutions and policy recommendations are developed based on the task of the planning project and the analysis performed. A planning map with an explanatory text will be prepared.


NB! Previous experience with GIS softwares (maps) is needed

- * Can collect, clean, structure, and prepare data for processing.
- * Can interpret and visualize data.
- * Can make predictions and recommendations based on different data models, including machine learning and neural network options.
- * Plans and implements simple data science projects.

kirjeldus_et:
Ökotehnoloogia (Ecotechnology, Ecological engineering) on selliste jätkusuutlike ökosüsteemide rajamine ja kujundamine, mis integreerivad inimühiskonda loodusega selliselt, et sellest on kasu mõlemale.
Kursuse ülesanne on anda ülevaade erinevatest ökotehnoloogiatest. Käsitletavad teemad: 

1. Ökotehnoloogia alused
• Ökotehnoloogia ja ökoloogilise inseneriteaduse põhimõtted
• Süsteemne ja ökosüsteemipõhine mõtlemine
• Looduspõhiste lahenduste raamistik 

2. Materjalide ja hoonete ökotehnoloogilised lahendused
• Jätkusuutlik arhitektuur ja ökoloogilised ehitusmaterjalid
• Hoonete energiatõhusus (passiivsed ja aktiivsed lahendused)

3. Vee- ja maastikusüsteemide ökotehnoloogiad
• Sademevee käitlus linnades, sinirohetaristud
• Tehismärgalad, reovee ökoloogiline  puhastamine
• Vee taaskasutus ja ringmajanduslik lähenemine, kompostimine

4. Looduspõhised lahendused ökoloogias ja põllumajanduses
• Ökosüsteemide taastamine
• Ökotehnoloogiad põllumajanduses, mulla tervis ja ringlust toetavad praktikad

5. Praktilised tegevused
• Grupitöö: linnaruumis ökotehnoloogiliste lahenduste kaardistamine ja uute soovituste väljatöötamine
• Teadusartikli analüüs ja esitlus
kirjeldus_en:
Ecotechnology (Ecotechnology, Ecological Engineering) refers to the design and construction of sustainable ecosystems that integrate human society with nature in ways that are mutually beneficial.
The purpose of the course is to provide an overview of different ecotechnologies. Covered topics include:

1. Fundamentals of Ecotechnology
• Principles of ecotechnology and ecological engineering
• Systems thinking and ecosystem-based approaches
• Frameworks for nature-based solutions

2. Eco-technological Solutions for Materials and Buildings
• Sustainable architecture and ecological building materials
• Energy efficiency of buildings (passive and active solutions)

3. Eco-technologies in Water and Landscape Systems
• Urban stormwater management and blue–green infrastructures
• Constructed wetlands and ecological wastewater treatment
• Water reuse and circular economy approaches; composting

4. Nature-based Solutions in Ecology and Agriculture
• Ecosystem restoration
• Ecotechnologies in agriculture, soil health and circularity-supporting practices

5. Practical Activities
• Group work: mapping eco-technological solutions in urban space and developing new recommendations
• Analysis and presentation of a scientific article

kirjeldus_et: Üliõpilased läbivad individuaalselt või rühmatööna probleemõppe, kus tuleb kasutada ruumiliste andmete analüüsi ühe konkreetse ökoloogilise küsimuse lahendamiseks. Iseseisvalt leitakse probleemi lahendamiseks sobilik metoodika, andmete vajadus, lahenduskäik ja tarkvara. Eelistatakse vabavaralise tarkvara kasutamist (nt. QGIs, R paketid), aga ei piirata kursust konkreetse tarkvaraga. Juhendajad annavad alguses ja vajadusel ka hiljem vihjeid optimaalse lahenduse leidmiseks. Kursuse lõpus esitatakse vormistatud lahendus kirjalikult ja tutvustatakse seda teistele. Samuti kommenteeritakse teiste üliõpilaste lahendusi.
kirjeldus_en: Students will do problem-based learning either individually or in groups. They solve a specific ecological question by using spatial analysis. Students will find the optimal solution by selecting available software and methodology. We prefer freeware use (e.g. QGIS, R packages), but there is no specific software required. Supervisors can give hints in the beginning and during the course if necessary to find optimal solutions in time. At the end of the course, the solution will be presented in written form, and it will be presented to other students. The works of other students or their teams will be commented on.
opitulemused_en: - The student who has passed the course (1) is able to use necessary background information to solve specific ecological questions; (2) is able to find optimal software for the specific question and is able to learn its usage independently at the necessary level; (3) is able to select and apply appropriate spatial analysis methodology; (4) is able to present results and justify selected techniques; (5) is orienting in main methodological aspects in spatial analysis applicable for ecological questions; (6) can make a self-assessment.

Õppekäigud toimuvad folkloristika eriala lõpetanute juurde, kes on valinud kasutada oma teadmisi ja oskusi väljaspool akadeemiat, luues ise oma ettevõtte või leides rakendust erineva profiiliga asutustest ja organisatsioonides (sh avalik sektor ja mittetulundusühingud). Seminarides lahendavad tudengid õppekäikudel käsitletud teemade ja loetud kirjanduse põhjal rakendusliku sisuga ülesandeid, milles harjutatakse sõnastama rakenduslikule folkloristikale omaseid uurimisküsimusi, valima vastuste leidmiseks sobilikke uurimismeetodeid ja rakendama tulemuste esitamise viise, mis arvestavad ka mitteakadeemilist auditooriumi.
kirjeldus_en: The course is composed of seminars and study visits to public sector institutions, small businesses and non-profit organizations, led by alumni of the Folklore Department who has decided to use their folkloristic knowledge and skills outside academia. In seminars students solve tasks of applied origin, based on their experiences in study visits and the course literature on applied folkloristics. The assignments encourage to formulate research questions specific to applied folkloristics, consider possible research methods and varied ways of presenting the results also for non-academic audiences.

-Süvaõppe töövoogude profileerimine ja arvutuslike pudelikaelade tuvastamine
-Andmeparalleelsus: DataParallel (DP) ja DistributedDataParallel (DDP)
-Mudeliparalleelsus ja kihtide jaotamine mitme GPU vahel
-Toruparalleelsus (pipeline parallelism) ja jõudeaja vähendamise tehnikad (pipeline'i "mullid", mikro-partitsioneerimine / micro-batching)

kirjeldus_en:
This class will include but not limited to the following topics:.
-Fundamentals of deep learning: neural networks, backpropagation, and training loops.
-Basics of parallel computing and GPU architectures.
-Matrix operations, SIMD/SIMT, and their role in parallelization.
-Profiling deep learning workflows and identifying computational bottlenecks.
-Data parallelism: DataParallel (DP) and DistributedDataParallel (DDP).
-Model parallelism and layer-wise distribution across GPUs.
-Pipeline parallelism and techniques to reduce idle time (pipeline bubbles, micro-batching).
-Hybrid parallelism strategies for scaling large models. 
- Hands-on PyTorch implementation of parallel training workflows.
-Final project: design, implement, and evaluate a distributed deep learning solution.

Praktika korraldus. 
Praktikat võib sooritada tõlkeoskust nõudval ametikohal, näiteks tõlkebüroodes, kirjastustes, kohtutes, muuseumides, turismiettevõtetes jne. Praktikakoha leiab üliõpilane üldjuhul ise ja enne praktikale asumist kooskõlastab selle ülikoolipoolse juhendajaga.
 
Praktika kestus on kuus (6) nädalat, maht 9 EAP. Seda ei pea tegema korraga, vaid koormus ja selle ajaline jaotamine on praktikandi ja praktikakoha kokkuleppe küsimus. Praktika jooksul tehtava tegeliku töö hulk ja mahu arvestuse meetod sõltub samuti kokkuleppest praktikakoha ja ülikoolipoolse juhendajaga.  
Tegevused: vastavalt spetsialiseerumisele suuline või kirjalik tõlkimine; sõltuvalt praktikakoha iseloomust muud tõlkimise ja tõlkekorraldusega seotud tööd, nt toimetamine, terminoloogiatöö, tõlkekorraldus, konverentsikorraldus, giiditöö jne
kirjeldus_en:
Organisation of traineeship 
Traineeship can be done at workplaces requiring translation skills, e.g. translation agencies, publishing houses, museums, tourism enterprises, etc. The place for the traineeship is generally found by the student, and before the beginning of the traineeship, the student obtains the consent of the supervisor from the university.

The duration of traineeship is six (6) weeks, its volume 9 ECTS. The traineeship need not be done uninterruptedly; the work load and timeplan are agreed between the trainee and the place of traineeship. The amount of the actual work done during traineeship and the method of its calculation are agreed between the place of traineeship and the supervisor from the university.
Activities: according to specialisation - interpreting or translation; depending on the traineeship place, other kinds of work related to translation and translation management, e.g. editing, terminological work, translation management, conference organisation, working as a guide, etc.
opitulemused_en:
- Learning outcomes. The student who has passed the traineeship
- is able to apply the knowledge in the speciality in the work situation, considering the social and cultural context
- is able to associate the earlier knowledge and skills with practical work tasks
- analyses his/her activity at solving practical problems of the speciality and is able to assess problems critically
- has experience in fulfilling concrete work tasks and action plan, and is able to constructively assess his/her achievements

kirjeldus_et: Kursus toimub üliõpilaste paaristööna. Eri emakeeltega üliõpilased moodustavad keeleõppetandemid, mille kumbki liige õpetab teisele liikmele oma emakeelt ja õpib ise oma paarilise emakeelt. Üks tandemis õpitavatest keeltest peab olema eesti keel, teine võib olla mistahes muu võõrkeel. Tandemid moodustatakse kursusele registreerunud üliõpilastest esimesel kokkusaamisel, võimalik on ka ise endale keeleõppepartner leida ja koos kursusele tulla. Üks tandemi liikmetest on eesti emakeelega, teine muu emakeelega. Iga tandem koostab endale individuaalse tööplaani, sõltuvalt keeleoskustasemest ja keeleõppe eesmärkidest. Õppetöö sisu ja vormi otsustavad tandemis osalejad koostöös aine õppejõuga. Kursusel osalemiseks on vajalik õpitava võõrkeele oskus suhtlustasemel. Kõik tandemid täidavad Moodle'is õpipäevikut, kuhu tuleb iga keeletunni kohta teha lühike sissekanne.
kirjeldus_en: During the course students work in pairs. Students with different native languages form language learning tandems where each member teaches the other their native language and learns the native language of their partner. One of the languages learned in the tandem must be Estonian, the other can be any other foreign language. The tandems are formed during the first meeting of the registered students, it is also possible to find one's own language learning partner and attend the course together. One member of the tandem is a native speaker of Estonian, the other member a native speaker of some other language. Each tandem makes their own individual study plan depending on their level of proficiency and language learning objectives. The contents and form of the learning will be determined collectively by the members of the tandem and the teacher. Language proficiency level sufficient to enable communication in the language to be learned is a prerequisite to attending the course. All tandems keep a study diary in Moodle where they must make a brief entry for each language class.

Projekti meeskonnas on kolm kuni 10 üliõpilast. Aine on osaliselt veebipõhine, Moodle'i keskkonnas on etappide kaupa välja toodud tegevused, mis on seotud nii projekti kui üliõpilase enda arengu analüüsimisega. 

Projekt viiakse üliõpilaste poolt üldreeglina ellu iseseisvalt. Õppijate iseseisvuse määr projekti elluviimisel räägitakse läbi projekti tellijaga/juhendajaga enne projekti algust.  Kogu projekti vältel on tagatud juhendaja ja/või tellija tugi.
Õppeaine raames on üliõpilasel kohustuslikud järgmised seminarid: 
1.	Sissejuhatav seminar (antakse ülevaade ootustest, arutatakse läbi projekti jaoks olulised punktid)
2.	vaheseminar(id) (toimub vahekokkuvõtete tegemine ja vahearuandlus)
3.	lõpuseminar (tulemuste ettekandmine ja arutelu, eneseanalüüside kokkuvõtted, tagasiside juhendajalt/tellijalt)

Kogemusest õppimise teadvustamiseks ning karjääri edendamiseks koostab üliõpilane lähtuvalt STARR metoodikast eneseanalüüsi. 
S (Situation) - situatsioon: kogemus(t)e kirjeldus, taustaandmete esitamine;
T (Task) - roll, vastutus: mis oli õppija ülesanne, mille eest vastutas selle ülesande raames;
A (Action) - tegevus: mida õppija tegi, miks just sellisel viisil;
R (Result) - tulemus: kuidas ülesanne õnnestus, milline oli teiste meeskonnaliikmete tagasiside;
R (Reflection) - refleksioon, analüüs: mida õppija sellest kogemusest õppis, mis olid tema hinnangul edutegurid, mis oli soovitud tulemuse mittesaavutamise põhjuseks, mida ta teeks edaspidi teisiti.

6 EAP mahus aine läbimisel on iseseisva töö maht 148 tundi,  3 EAP mahus aine läbimisel on iseseisva töö maht 70 tundi.
kirjeldus_en:
Projects are on   webpage (praktika.ut.ee) where the student has the opportunity to join a project team.

The project team consists of five to 10 students. The subject is partly web-based, and the Moodle environment outlines step-by-step activities related to analyzing both the project and the student's own development.

As a general rule, the project is carried out independently by the student's team. The level of students autonomy in the implementation of the project is discussed with the client/supervisor before the start of the project. Supervisor or client support is guaranteed throughout the project.

The following seminars are compulsory for the student:
1.	Introductory seminar (giving an overview of expectations, discussing essential points for the project, etc.)
2.	mid-term seminar (mid-term review and mid-term reporting)
3.	final seminar (presentation and discussion of results, self-assessment, feedback from supervisor/client).
The student prepares self-analysis based on STARR methodology to support learning from his/her experience and to improve his/her career.
opitulemused_en:
- Student:
1.	Understands the activities and problems related to project implementation.
2.	Plans the implementation of the project (the role of the project team, schedule, definition of resources).
3.	Implements project ideas and activities.
4.	Evaluates the results of the project and  own contribution.
5.	Evaluates own development in the process of project implementation.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
Participating in introductory, mid-term and in final seminar.
Submitting and defending a project plan.
Submitting a mid-term report.
Representing the project outcomes.
Writing and submitting self-analysis.
hindamise_meetod:
For pass-fail assesment you must:
1. Participate in three seminars (two seminars for 3 ECTS)
- Introductory seminar (giving an overview of expectations, discussing essential points for the project, etc.)
- mid-term seminar (mid-term review and mid-term reporting)
- final seminar (presentation and discussion of results, self-assessment, feedback from supervisor/client).
2. Write a self-analysis based on STARR methodology.

kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of the interrelations between measurements and economy: In macro level: National Measurement infrastructure, its economic effects, the main macroeconomic indicators in the main markets: money market, labour market, public sector. In Micro level: Costs of measurements and their estimation in firm level, investments, the principles of accountings and household theory.
opitulemused_en:
- Student understands
- -- role of measurements in different sectors of economy.
- -- costs of measurements and their estimation.
- -- the importance of the National Measurement infrastructure and its economic effect.
- Student:
- -- can work in a team - as a member and/or a team leader.
- -- is able to work according to deadlines and plan his/her work accordingly.
- -- is able to apply the obtained knowledge in practice.

kirjeldus_et:
"Rahvusvahelise julgeoleku" kursus tutvustab rahvusvaheliste suhete üliõpilastele julgeoleku-uuringute alavaldkonda. Kursus teeb sissejuhatuse mõnedesse kõige pakilisematesse julgeolekuprobleemidesse, mis iseloomustavad tänapäeva julgeolekukeskkonda, võtmekontseptsioonidesse, samuti julgeoleku-uuringute valdkonna kesksetesse teemadesse.
Puuduliku julgeoleku probleem ja riikide vajadus tagada oma julgeolek anarhilises keskkonnas on üks põhilisemaid väljakutseid, millega riigid silmitsi seisavad, ning see on üks rahvusvahelise poliitika põhilisemaid ja püsivamaid tunnuseid. Seetõttu on riikliku ja rahvusvahelise julgeoleku kaalutlused maailmapoliitika uurimise keskmes ja julgeoleku tagamine on nii teadusuuringute kui ka poliitika seisukohast tähelepanu vääriv teema.
Selle taustal on kursuse eesmärk võimaldada üliõpilastel orienteeruda praegustes rahvusvahelise julgeoleku alastes aruteludes. Selleks tutvustatakse esiteks mõningaid kõige pakilisemaid julgeolekuprobleeme, mis iseloomustavad tänapäeva julgeolekukeskkonda, ja teiseks antakse üliõpilastele analüütilised vahendid, et nad saaksid kriitiliselt tegeleda nende julgeolekuprobleemidega ja laiemate julgeolekupoliitikaga seotud debattidega.
kirjeldus_en:
The course "International Security" introduces students of International Relations to the more specialized sub-field of Security Studies. Towards this end, the course provides students with an introduction to some of the most pressing security challenges characterizing the contemporary security environment, key concepts, as well as central in the field of Security Studies.

The problem of insecurity, and the need for states to ensure their security in an anarchic environment, is one of the most fundamental challenges states face and it is one of the most fundamental and durable features of international politics. As such, considerations of national and international security are at the very heart of the study of world politics, and the quest for security commands attention both as a matter of research and policy.

Against this background, the course aims to enable students to navigate current debates about international security. It does so by, first, introducing some of the most pressing security challenges characterizing the contemporary security environment and, second, by equipping students with the analytical tools to critically engage with these security challenges and with wider debates about security policy.

Mõlema osa lõpphindamisel kasutatakse arvestuslikku hindamist, kuid praktikumide sooritamine on loengute kirjalikule arvestusele pääsemise eeltingimuseks. Kirjalikul arvestusel on võimalik saada maksimaalselt 40 punkti: 10 teooriaküsimust à 2p ja 5 ülesannet à 4p.
Kursuse käigus esitatakse ka 10 loenguülesannet, mille vastuseid saab esitada enne vastavat loengut ja mis igaüks annavad kuni 1 punkti.
