nimi_en: Testing and Investigation Methods in Materials Science
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: Aarne Kasikov, Heigo Ers, Marian Külaviir, Ove Korjus, Ove Oll, Rainer Pärna, Rait Kanarbik, Rasmus Palm, Tavo Romann
kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse math on 6EAP ja see toimub magistriõppe esimese aasta kevadsemestril. Kursus tutvustab 10-t materjalide uuringutes ja testimisel kasutatavat füüsikalist uurimismeetodit materjalide pinnaomaduste, koostise, struktuuri ja mehaaniliste omaduste määramiseks olles täienduseks kursuses "Uurimismeetodid materjaliteaduses, LTKT.01.001" käsitletule - viimane on soovitav, kuid mitte kohustuslik eelnevalt läbida. Kursus koosneb ühest sissejuhatavast loengust füüsikaliste karakteriseerimis- ja testimismeetodite aluste ja õppeaine struktuuri ning korralduse kohta, ja iseseisvast tööst, loengutest ning paraktikumist iga käsitletava meetodi jaoks. Enne seminare toimub iseseisev töö uute meetoditega teoreetiliseks tutvumiseks meetodit tutvustava ülevaate, soovitatava kirjanduse ja lisamaterjalide põhjal. Loengutes arutatakse läbi konkreetse meetodi tööprintsiibid ning meetodi rakendamiseks kasutatava aparatuuri võimalused, praktilise töö eesmärgid ning läbiviimise kord, k.a. tööohutus. Praktilised tööd toimuvad rühmatööna konkreetse ülesande lahendamiseks etteantud meetodit ja katseseadet kasutades, mille jaoks katseobjektid annab meetodit tutvustav õppejõud. Igal üliõpilasel tuleb sooritada vähemalt 7 praktilist tööd. Kursuse keskel ja lõpus on seminarid, kus üliõpilased tutvustavad kõiki kursuses käsitletud meetodeid ja oma praktiliste tööde tulemusi. Üliõpilased saavad punkte nii seminari vastuste kui prakiliste tööde ja ettekannete eduka sooritamise eest. Kursus on positiivselt sooritatud (arvestatud) kui üliõpilane on saanud vähemalt 11 punkti: 7 praktikumi ja 4 seminariettekande eest.
Kursuse jooksul tutvustatakse nelja materjalide testimise valdkonda ning eri meetodeid nii materjalide struktuuri, koostise kui ka piirpinna karakteriseerimisel.
kirjeldus_en:
The 6 ECTS course takes place in spring semester, introducing altogether 10 physical methods of characterization and testing of condensed materials. The methods cover study of surfaces, composition, structure and mechanical properties of the samples being complement to the course "Characterization Methods in Materials Science, LTKT.01.001" and the last is recommended but not required before taking the current course. Current course consists of an introductory lecture, and lectures and practical work for every studied method, and of independent working. In the introductory lecture main principles of materials characterization and testing methods and the regulation of the course are shortly introduced as well as the sources where the student can obtain main and additional information about the studied methods. As for every studied method main theoretical material, giving overview of the method and equipment used in practical work and some additional information, is added to the course page in Moodle, the students have to study these materials before the seminars. In lectures safety demands connected with the use of equipment during certain practical works is introduced. Every practical work starts with short introductory of emergency regulations in the lab and students sign a list that they are instructed about that, following the practical studies and testing in groups under general direction of the course instructors.
In the course the following methods will be introduced: element mapping, profilometry, ellipsometry, Raman spectroscopy, surface microscopy, impedance and SIMS. Large scale scientific facilities for research will also be introduced.
opitulemused_en: - After finishing the course, a student has overview of main methods of investigation, characterization and testing of modern materials and is able to find additional information from professional literature, journals as well as from professional webpages. He/she has got theoretical basis and first practical skills in several methods applied in materials science and technology, can utilize these in research and development in materials science and -technology, can recognize the need of the use of certain methods and choose optimal from them, that is to say can resolve the problems connected with materials studies during fixed time-scale and given information is able to give rational evaluation for the questions connected with investigations and testing of materials, can present the results both orally and in writing. Also, if needed, can use the methods for resolving special problems in other fields of science and technology.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Participation and completion of each of the 7 practical works and reports for each student. Presentation in each of the 4 seminars of the characterization method groups studied in the lectures.
hindamise_meetod: Every student must defend 7 practical work reports and complete 4 seminar presentations of the characterization methods. 1 point is awarded for each.

kirjeldus_et:
* Sissejuhatus krüptograafilistesse tõestustesse
* Krüptograafilisi omadusi kirjeldavate turvamängude formuleerimine EasyCrypt-is
* Kõrgtaseme tõestussammude formaliseerimine EasyCrypt-is
* Mis on Hoare loogika? Mis on tõenäosuslik Hoare loogika? Mis on relatsiooniline Hoare loogika?
* Kuidas kasutada tõestusassistenti väidete formaalseks tõestamiseks?
* Mis on alameesmärkide näitamiseks vajalikud tõestustaktikad?  
* Kuidas tõestada üksikuid tõestussamme  EasyCrypt-is?
kirjeldus_en:
* Introduction to cryptographic proofs and games
* How are games written in EasyCrypt
* How are high-level proof steps formulated in EasyCrypt
* What is Hoare logic? Probabilistic Hoare logic? Relational Hoare logic?
* How to use a theorem prover? (Applying tactics to a proof goal.)
* How to prove the individual proof steps in EasyCrypt?
opitulemused_en:
- The student will be able to
- * formulate cryptographic schemes in EasyCrypt
- * formulate the intermediate games in a cryptographic proof in EasyCrypt
- * state the relations between those games as lemmas in EasyCrypt
- * prove those lemmas using tactics relating to probabilistic Hoare logic and relational Hoare logic
- * read and write statements in Hoare logic and relational Hoare logic, and use them to reason about programs
hindamise_eeltingimused: 50% of the weekly homework points are required for admission to the final exam.
hindamise_meetod:
The student passes the course if he passes the final exam. The final grade consists to 60% of the final exam, and to 40% of the midterm.

Midterm exam: A practical exam on the computer where the students have to write EasyCrypt code
Final exam: A practical exam on the computer where the students have to write EasyCrypt code

To pass, the students need to be able to reason about simple programs in EasyCrypt, and to prove statement about games in which require only mechanical application of tactics (i.e., where no understanding of the game itself or of the invariants in it are required). Furthermore, the students should be able to write syntactically correct games given a pseudocode description of that game (for simple games).

kirjeldus_et: Kursus võtab vaatluse alla võrdleva poliitika, mis on poliitikateaduste üks suurimaid aladistsipliine, peamised teemad, teooriad ja mõisted. Ülevaade võrdleva poliitika põhiküsimustest annab tudengile arusaamise sellest, kuidas poliitilised protsessid ja nende erinevad osapooled erinevates riikides üle maailma tegutsevad ning millised tagajärjed nendel mustritel on demokraatiale, ühiskonnale ja majandusele. Olulise komponendina analüüsib kursus seda, millist mõju avaldavad poliitilistele süsteemidele tehnoloogilised muutused ning kuidas see seostub liberaalse demokraatia oleviku ja tulevikuga.
kirjeldus_en: The course examines the central themes, theories, and concepts of the contemporary study of comparative politics. By gaining a knowledge of key concerns in the field, students will develop an understanding of how political institutions, actors, and processes operate around the world and what implications these arrangements have on democracy, society, and the economy. Importantly, the course will discuss and critically assess the ways in which political systems are changing in the era of technological transformation and how these developments influence the present and the future of liberal democracy.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- At the end of the course, students will be able to (1) discuss the main theoretical and empirical debates of the key concerns of comparative politics; (2) explain the relationships between individuals, actors, and democratic processes across different political systems, (3) evaluate critically the challenges to liberal democracy in the digital era, and (4) analyse these issues comparatively.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
The formative assignment is group work. Students will submit a written research paper (6-7 pages) on one of the topics covered in the first half of the course, demonstrating both theoretical and empirical skills. Oral discussion of group assignments will follow. The formative assignment constitutes 30% of the final grade.

The summative assignment is an individual research paper (10 pages), written on one of the topics covered in the course, demonstrating both theoretical and empirical skills. The summative assignment constitutes 70% of the final grade.   

Grading criteria for both assignments are outlined in the assignment guidelines, available in Moodle.

Both assignments must be submitted by deadline. Late submissions will be penalised with the reduction of points. 

Re-submissions in order to improve the grade are not possible.
hindamise_meetod:
The maximum final result is 100 points. The student can receive up to 30 points for the formative and up to 70 points for the summative assignment. The final grade will be calculated as follows: 

91-100 points -> A 
81-90 points -> B 
71-80 points -> C 
61-70 points -> D 
51-60 points -> E 
0-51 points -> F

kirjeldus_et: Lausearvutuse põhimõisted: loogilised tehted, samaselt tõesed valemid, samaväärsed valemid, valemite järeldumine, täielik disjunktiivne normaalkuju. Hulgateooria põhimõisted: hulk, tehted hulkadega, seosed, ekvivalentsusseosed ja klassijaotused, hulga võimsus, järjestatud hulgad. Funktsiooni injektiivsus, sürjektiivsus, bijektiivsus. Arvuteooria põhimõisted: jaguvus, jäägiga jaguvus, aritmeetika põhiteoreem, algarvude hulga lõpmatus.
kirjeldus_en: Main notions of propositional calculus: tautology, logically equivalent formulae, disjunctive normal form of formulae. Set theory: Notion of a set, operations with sets, relations, relations of equivalence and partitions to the classes, cardinality of a set, ordered sets. Injective, surjective and bijective functions. Number theory: divisibility, division algorithm, fundamental theorem of arithmetic, infiniteness of the set of primes
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course students
- 1. explain main notions of propositional calculus, set theory and number theory
- 2. apply main notions of propositional calculus, set theory and number theory in solving simple problems
- 3. relate operations of propositional calculus with natural language propositions
- 4. explain different proof methods
- 5. use main notions of functions and relations in solving noncomplex exercises
- 6. explain main notions of cardinalities of sets and identifies the cardinalities of some sets
- 7. analyse and compile logic reasonings within the framework of course material

kirjeldus_et: Biogeograafia kui kaasaegse evolutsioonilise ja ökoloogilise teaduse olemus. Maa elukeskkonna jaotus, bioomid ja biogeograafilised regioonid. Biogeograafilised protsessid: liikide teke, väljasuremine ja levimine. Liikide ja koosluste leviku seaduspärad.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview about the modern biogeography as a highly interdisciplinary research field and introduces the main biogeographical concepts (such as biomes, biogeographical regions, the patterns of distribution of species and communities etc.) and processes (speciation, extinction, dispersal).
opitulemused_en: - After finishing the course successfully, the student can give an overview of the main trends and rules concerning geographic distribution and dispersal of organisms, has a knowledge of the main terms used in the biogeographic literature, can give an overview of the main research topics concerning distribution and dispersal of organisms, can raise, analyse and critically evaluate the hypotheses in the field of biogeography, can give an overview of the main methods and techniques that are used in biogeography, can apply the knowledge related to the distribution and dispersal of animals in the other fields (e.g. in conservation biology).

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate terviseökonoomika teoreetilistest alustest ja praktilistest rakendustest. Käsitletakse tervisekäitumise majanduslikke põhjuseid, tervisekindlustuse toimimispõhimõtteid, tervishoiuteenuste pakkumist ja nõudlust mõjutavaid tegureid ning tervishoiusüsteemide finantseerimise mudeleid. Kursus annab ülevaate ka tervisetehnoloogiate majandusliku hindamise (HTA) meetoditest. Kursus hõlmab loenguid, kus esitatakse teoreetilised käsitlused ja rahvusvahelised ning Eesti näited, ning seminare, kus üliõpilased analüüsivad tervishoiupoliitika teemasid ja esitlevad oma töid.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the theoretical foundations and practical applications of health economics. It covers the economic determinants of health behavior, the functioning principles of health insurance, the factors influencing the supply and demand of healthcare services, and the financing models of healthcare systems. The course also introduces methods for the economic evaluation of health technologies (HTA). It includes lectures presenting theoretical frameworks along with international and Estonian examples, as well as seminars where students analyze health policy topics and present their work.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student:
- Is able to explain the key concepts and theories of health economics.
- Is able to apply economic analysis methods to evaluate healthcare systems and health policies.
- Understands the mechanisms of health insurance and healthcare service financing, and their impact on the behavior of market participants.
- Is able to explain the impact of population aging, health technologies, and the development of personalized medicine on the healthcare system.
- Knows the main methods of health technology assessment and understands when to apply them.
- Knows main aspects of health care systems in Estonia and other developed countries

nimi_en: Overview of Public Communication and Media Regulation
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse esimeses loengus saavad üliõpilased ülevaate subjektiivsete õiguste tähendusest ning aines õpetatavate põhikontseptsioonide ühiskondlikust tähtsusest ja rollist informatsiooniliste põhiõiguste raames. Samuti tutvustatakse esimeses loengus aine korraldust ning aine läbimiseks vajalike ülesannete sisu. Sellele järgneb loeng "õiguse spikker mittejuristidele" ehk põgus ülevaade õigusharude ja -süsteemi toimimisest, Eestis kehtiva õiguse allikatest ning õigusterminoloogia leidmiseks ja mõistmiseks vajalikest tööriistadest.

Aine tuuma moodustavad neli teemaplokki: 1) avalik teave, 2) ajakirjanduslikud eriõigused, 3) isikuandmete kaitse ning 4) väljendusvabaduse ja au teotamise probleemide regulatsioon.

Igas teemaplokis toimub temaatiline loeng, millele järgneb seminar, kus arutatakse õpitut ning lahendatakse erinevaid ülesandeid
kirjeldus_en:
The course begins with a lecture that provides an overview of the meaning and role of subjective rights within the framework of informational fundamental rights. The first lecture also provides information about the organisational matters of the course as well as the nature of the tasks the completion of which is required for passing the course.

This is followed by a lecture titled "A legal cheat-sheet for non-lawyers", i.e. a brief overview of the functioning of the legal system and different branches of law, the sources of law applicable in Estonia, and the tools used to find and understand legal terminology.
The core of the course comprises four topic blocks: 1) public information, 2) journalists'
special rights, 3) personal data protection and 4) regulation pertaining to freedom of
expression and issues of defamation. 

Each topic block will have a thematic lecture, followed by a seminar where what has been learned will be discussed and various tasks will be solved.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- A. Knowledge. Students will acquire knowledge about the theoretical underpinnings of freedom of expression, the principles regulating public communication and the relevant legal resources as well as specific oversight mechanisms in use in our society.

B. Professional skills and competences. Within the framework of legal problems introduced during the course, students will acquire the skills required for recognising and applying the principles necessary for analysing (and resolving) situations that involve colliding informational fundamental rights. Overall, students will acquire an understanding of situations where a person's right to freedom of expression collides with other fundamental
informational rights.

C. General competences. Students develop a better understanding of different (socio-)legal texts, improve their ability to locate and use various legal resources, and further enhance their skill of self-reflection within the framework of topics covered during the course.

Teemad: meetrilised ruumid (koonduvus, näited (ka normeeritud ruum), struktuur), täielikud meetrilised ruumid (näited (ka Banachi ruum), põhiteoreemid), pidevad operaatorid (põhimõisted, Banachi püsipunkti printsiip).
kirjeldus_en: This is an introductory course in functional analysis, taught as the first half of "Functional Analysis I, MTMM.00.095" during the first 8 weeks. Topics: metric spaces (convergence, examples (including normed linear spaces), balls, open sets, closed sets, closure, interior) complete metric spaces (examples (including Banach spaces), main theorems), continuous operators (continuity criteria, Banach fixed point theorem).
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After passing the course students have acquired primary knowledge and skills of functional analysis. In particular, they know the following notions and main results concerning them: metric spaces (convergence, examples (including normed linear spaces), balls, open sets, closed sets, closure, interior), complete metric spaces (examples (including Banach spaces)), continuous operators (including Banach fixed point theorem).

kirjeldus_en: Practical classes in analytical chemistry. The focus is on giving the students practical experience on advanced methods of analysis: FT-IR, HPLC, LC, GC, AAS, AES (flame photometry), photometric and potentiometric analysis, different titration methods (acid-base titration, complexometry, coulometric KF titration, etc.) and sample preparation. - Student knows the principles and applications of gravimetric, titrimetric, photometric, chromatographic, AAS and AES analysis. 
Student knows the basics of sample preparation in chemical analysis. 
Student knows the concept of selectivity and the main ways of achieving it (separation, masking). 
Student knows the possible sources of uncertainty in analytical methods and ways of minimizing them. 
Student is able to correctly use the basic analytical chemistry labware (pipettes, volumetric flasks, burettes, balances, magnetic stirrers, heating equipment). 
Student can perform weighing and preparing solutions correctly. 
Student can carry out basic sample preparation for analysis. 
Student is able to carry out chemical analysis with and calculate results for gravimetric, titrimetric, photometric, gas and liquid chromatographic, potentiometric, infrared spectrometric, atomic absorption analysis and flame photometric analysis. 
Student learns to use various instruments of analytical chemistry and will acquire basic skills in setting up instruments, managing them and processing data with corresponding software. 
Student knows the main IT approaches in analytical chemistry. 
Student is able to prepare a plan for conducting the experiment based on the given instructions. 
Student is able to evaluate the results of practical work according to the given criteria.

Selleks arutleme esmalt kriminaalmenetluse olemuse üle ning käime läbi kõik kriminaalmenetluse etapid (kohtueelses menetluses ja kohtumenetluses), kus konkreetsed (põhi)õigused eelkõige päevakorda tulevad - jälitustegevus, ülekuulamine, vahistamine, süüdistuse esitamise üle otsustamine ja tõendite esitamine kohtuistungil. Jooksvalt proovime leida vastust ka küsimusele, millised (põhi)õiguste rikkumised on niivõrd rasked/olulised, et tingivad tõendite kasutamise keelu. Seega pöörame kursuse jooksul tähelepanu nii meid huvitavate (põhi)õiguste sisule kui ka sellele, kuidas tagada, et neid õigusi praktikas ka järgitaks. Kahtlustatavate ja süüdistatavate õigused sisustame kursusel Euroopa Inimõiguste Konventsiooni ja Euroopa Inimõiguste Kohtu praktikast, Eesti õigusaktidest ning Euroopa Liidu õigusaktidest lähtudes.
kirjeldus_en: This course focuses on questions what are the most important (human) rights in criminal proceedings and what are the consequences for violation of these rights. At first we discuss about nature of criminal procedure and then analyse step by step all important stages of the proceedings (from pre-trial investigation to the court proceedings) where concrete (human) rights arise - surveillance, interrogation, arrest and detention, decision to prosecute, and submission of evidence in the court room. In the course of this analysis we try to find an answer to the question what kind of violations are so important/severe that they result in prohibition to use evidence. Therefore, during the course we focus on the content of specific (human) rights as well as on how to guarantee that in practice these rights are followed. The (human) rights of suspects and accused persons in criminal proceedings are analysed in this course as they are provided in the European Convention on Human Rights, in the case law of the European Court of Human Rights, in Estonian law and in the EU law.

Kursus käsitleb keskkonna-, strateegilise- ja sotsiaalse mõju hindamise teooriat, metoodikat, regulatsiooni ja menetlust, sh tutvustatakse Natura hindamise põhimõtteid. Mõjude hindamise protsessi eesmärgiks on toetada haldusorganit arendusotsuse tegemisel, leides parimad ja põhjendatud lahendid arendusprojektide elluviimisel, kaasates võimalikult hästi erinevate huvigruppide arvamusi ja informeerides avalikkust võimalikest tegevustest. Mõjude hindamisel on rõhk projektide, ruumiliste planeeringute ja arengukavade hindamisel, avaliku sektori, arendaja, planeerija, eksperdi ja avalikkuse vahelisel koostööl, hindamise protsessil ja menetlusel. Kursuse käigus keskendume arendusprojektide keskkonnamõju hindamisele, mida viiakse läbi tegevusloa taotluse menetluse raames.
Kursuse teoreetiline ja praktiline osa on põimitud erinevate õppeülesannete kaudu. Neist keskne ülesanne on analüüsida mõjuhindamise aruandeid ja protsessi kursuse teoreetilises osas omandatavate teadmiste alusel. Auditoorsele tööle eelneb reeglina kodulugemisülesande täitmine.
kirjeldus_en: The course handles the theory, methods, legal aspects and practices of environmental-, strategic-, and social impact assessment, including insights into Natura assessment. On a wider scope, impact assessment is undertaken within strategic and spatial planning processes as well as in the case of development projects that are likely to have significant effects on the environment. Within the course we particularly concentrate on development projects. We link theoretical and practical parts of the course through several excercises where the main task is to analyse an environmental impact statement considering the theoretical knowledge obtained during the course. Before each lecture, students are supposed (as a rule) to read home reading material.

nimi_et: Välis-Eesti: peatükke paguluse ajaloost ja uurimisperspektiividest
nimi_en: Estonia in Exile: Histories and Research Perspectives
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb Välis-Eestit kui nähtust, mis kujunes teise maailmasõja aegse Läände põgenemise tagajärjel ja eksisteeris paralleelselt okupeeritud Eestiga. Kursuse käigus analüüsitakse Välis-Eesti kogukondlikke struktuure, kultuurielu ja välisvõitlust pöörates tähelepanu nii allikatele kui uurimisperspektiividele. Erinevate allikate ja uurimisteemade tervikuks sidumisel kasutatakse mitmekesiseid ülesandeid ning külalisesinejaid erinevatest mäluasutustest.
kirjeldus_en: The course examines Estonia in exile as a phenomenon that emerged as a result of the flight to the West during the Second World War and existed in parallel with occupied Estonia. Throughout the course, the communal structures, cultural life, and political activities of exile Estonians are analysed, with attention given to both sources and research perspectives. A variety of tasks and guest lectures from different memory institutions are used to integrate various sources and research topics into a coherent whole.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- knows which memory institutions hold archival material related to Estonians abroad and understands how the collections and have developed.
- discusses and argues about the internal and external tensions and key issues within different exile Estonian communities.
- makes connections between archival materials concerning exile Estonians and relevant literature.
- uses archival materials related to exile Estonians in a small-scale historical research project.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Üliõpilane võib praktika sooritada erinevates ettevõtetes ja organisatsioonides (ministeeriumid, ametid, kohalikud omavalitsused, pangad, ülikoolid; OÜ, MTÜ jt.), luua oma ettevõtte, osaleda uurimisgruppide töös või osaleda projektide elluviimisel. Praktika liigi valib üliõpilane  vastavalt oma arenguvajadustele ja lähtuvalt õppekava praktika eesmärgist. Praktika juhendajateks on ülikooli poolt praktika koordinaator ja ettevõtte poolne juhendaja. 
Pool aastat enne praktikat toimub eelseminar, kus informeeritakse üliõpilast ja antakse suund.
Majandusteaduskonnal on praktika ettevalmistamiseks kasutusel praktikaveeb - https://sisu.ut.ee/praktikamajanduses/avaleht ja praktika.ut.ee ning praktikale minekul juba Moodle kursus.
Praktika jooksul peab üliõpilane lähtuma Moodle`s püstitatud ülesannetest.
Ülesanded on: 1. Püstitama eesmärgi ja ülesanded; 2. Sõlmima lepingu; 3. Eneseanalüüs; 4. Tagasiside juhendajalt; 5. Lõpuseminar ja hinnang praktika protsessile. 
Praktika üheks oluliseks väljundiks on üliõpilase eneseanalüüs, mille käigus ta toob välja õpitu, oma tugevused ja nõrkused. Praktikajuhendaja (organisatsioonipoolse) tagasiside tema tegevusele on ka praktika kohustuslik osa.  Praktika lõpeb lõpuseminariga, kus toimub praktikal saadud kogemuse jagamine (osalevad kõik üliõpilased) ning antakse tagasiside ülikoolile praktika protsessist.
kirjeldus_en: Students can practice in different companies and organizations (ministries, agencies, local governments, banks, universities, OÜ, NGOs, etc.), set up their own company, participate in research groups or participate in projects. The student chooses the type of internship according to his / her developmental needs and outcomes of the curriculum. During the internship, the student has to follow the tasks set in Moodle. One of the essential outcomes of the internship is the student's self-analysis, in which he/she identifies what he/she has learned, his/her strengths and weaknesses, and the feedback of the supervisor (organization) to his/her activities. The internship ends with a closing seminar, where students shared the experience gained during the internship and give feedback to the university about the internship process.
hindamise_eeltingimused: Submission of internship report according to deadline is a prerequisite for getting to defence.

kirjeldus_et:
Käsitletavad teemad:
1. Sissejuhatus haiglafarmaatsiasse - üldiselt haiglaapteekidest ja nende tegevustest.
2. Ravimite teekond haiglasse - kuidas käib haigla varustamine ravimitega.
3. Ravimikäitlus osakondades - kuidas toetavad haiglaapteekrid arstide ja õdede tööd osakondades.
4. Riskiravimid - riskiravimid ja nende käitlemise erisused.
5. Ravimiuuringud - haiglaapteekri roll ravimiuuringutes.
6. Ravimiinfo kogumine - kvaliteetse patsiendipõhise raviminfo kogumine ja edastamine erinevate asutuste ja üksuste vahel.
7. Patsiendipõhine ravim - kuidas valmistatakse patsiendipõhiseid ravimeid haiglas.
8. Nukleaarmeditsiin ja radiofarmaatsia - millised on radiofarmatseutikumide käitlemise eripärad ja milline on haiglaapteekri roll selles.
9. Kaitseväe apteegi erisused - millised on kaitseväe alla kuuluva haiglaapteegi tegevuste erisused.
10 Ravimitega seotud tarvikud - milliseid ravimite manustamisega seotud tarvikuid ja miks on vaja.
11. Haiglaapteegi kvaliteedijuhtimine - millele peab mõtlema, et haiglaapteegi tegevus oleks kvaliteetne.
12. Apteegi väljatöötamine - kaasaegse haiglaapteegi tegevuse planeerimine.
kirjeldus_en:
Topics covered:
1. Introduction to hospital pharmacy - generally about hospital pharmacies and their activities.
2. Medicines' journey to the hospital - how is the hospital supplied with medicines.
3. Medication handling in the wards - how do hospital pharmacists support the work of doctors and nurses in the wards.
4. Risk medicines - risk medicines and the differences in their handling.
5. Drug research - the role of the hospital pharmacist in drug research.
6. Collection of drug information - collection and transmission of high-quality patient-specific drug information between different institutions and units.
7. Patient-specific medicine - how patient-specific medicines are prepared in the hospital.
8. Nuclear medicine and radiopharmacy - what are the specifics of handling radiopharmaceuticals and what is the role of the hospital pharmacist in this.
9. Distinctions of the pharmacy of the Defense Forces - what are the differences in the activities of the hospital pharmacy under the Defense Forces.
10 Accessories related to medicines - which accessories related to the administration of medicines and why are needed.
11. Quality management of the hospital pharmacy - what needs to be considered in order for the operation of the hospital pharmacy to be of high quality.
12. Development of a pharmacy - planning the operation of a modern hospital pharmacy.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the subject, the student:
- Can describe the main, additional and support activities of a hospital pharmacy, taking into account the size and profile of the hospital.
- Can describe the coherence of hospital pharmacy activities with other hospital specialties.
- Can describe the possibilities of specialization of a hospital pharmacist within the specialty.
- Can point out the differences between a hospital pharmacy and a community pharmacy.

nimi_en: Two Ways to Modern State: Prussia vs England
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus koosneb 7 loengust ja 3 seminarist, mis käsitlevad võrdlevalt 16.-19. sajandi Preisimaa ja Inglismaa ajaloo peamisi poliitilisi sündmusi, majanduslikke arenguid ja sotsiaalajalugu.
kirjeldus_en: The course consists of seven lectures and three seminars which deal comparatively with the main political events, economic and social processes in the history of Prussia and England from the 16th century to the beginning of the 20th century.
opitulemused_en:
- As a result of the course students are able to
- 1) explain the main historical events of the history of Prussia and England.
- 2) understand better the historical background of political, economic and social processes in Prussia and England.
- 3) analyse critically two seemingly different ways to modern state where one resulted in the Third Reich and the other in the British exceptionalism.
- 4) understand better the early modern and modern history of Europe.

nimi_et: Sissejuhatus kognitiivsesse humanitaariasse: meel ja tekst
nimi_en: Introduction to Cognitive Humanities: Minds and Texts
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kuidas mõjutavad väljamõeldud maailmad meie mõtteprotsesse ja maailmataju? Miks me hoolime väljamõeldud tegelaste saatusest? Kuidas võib lugu äratada meie kujutlusvõimet või meid pisarateni liigutada? See kursus tutvustab õpilastele kognitiivsete humanitaarteaduste põhimõisteid, uurides autorluse, tegelaste kujutamise ja lugemise kognitiivseid mõõtmeid. Uurime, kuidas kirjandus- ja narratiiviuuringud võivad mõjutada kognitiivteaduste empiirilisi uuringuid ja neist omakorda mõjusi saada, soodustades viljakat interdistsiplinaarset dialoogi. Realistliku ilukirjanduse, muinasjuttude, spekulatiivsete narratiivide ja eksperimentaalsete narratiivide uurimise kaudu arendavad õpilased kriitilise oskuse, et mõista tekstide ja mõtteprotsesside vastastikust mõju.
kirjeldus_en: How do fictional worlds engage our minds? Why do we care about the fate of fictional characters? How can a story spark our imagination or move us to tears? This course introduces students to core concepts in cognitive humanities, exploring the cognitive dimensions of authorship, characterisation, and reading. We will examine how literary and narrative studies can both inform and be informed by empirical research in cognitive science, fostering a productive interdisciplinary dialogue. Through case studies spanning realist fiction, fairy tales, speculative narratives, and experimental narratives, students will develop a critical toolkit for understanding how texts and mind interact.
opitulemused_en:
- This course bridges narrative and cognitive science, offering tools to analyse fiction - from realism to fairy tales to experimental narratives - and to understand how texts engage readers, authors, and characters.
- On successful completion of the course, students will be able to:

1) Identify and describe central theories and concepts in cognitive humanities as they apply to literature and textual analysis. 

2) Analyse how cognitive processes - such as imagination, empathy, mind reading, creative cognition - are represented, produced, and experienced in texts.

3) Apply cognitive approaches to a range of fictional genres, articulating the distinctive ways each genre engages the mind.

4) Critically assess and synthesize theoretical perspectives, integrating them into their own research and interpretation of literary and cultural works.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab avara ülevaate optilise spektroskoopia olemusest ja rakendustest. Kirjeldatakse põhilised spektroskoopilised nähtused, nende spektraalkarakteristika seos aine ehitusega ja tüüpilised mõõtetehnikad. Käsitletakse levinud spektraalaparatuuri tööprintsiipe. Teoreetilist osa toetavad mõningad demokatsed.
kirjeldus_en: The course gives a broad overview of optical spectroscopy and its applications. The main spectroscopic phenomena, relation of the spectra to the structure of matter and typical measurement techniques will be described. The operating principles of popular spectroscopic apparatus will be covered. The theoretical part is supported by a few demonstrations.

opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student knows (and can apply in basic situations):
- 1. The relation between spectroscopy and optics.
- 2. The common spectral coordinates (wavelength, wavenumber, frequency, energy), correspondingly convert the position and width of spectral line.
- 3. The transmission, reflection and absorption coefficients and corresponding spectra, employ Bouguer'-Lambert-Beer law.
- 4. The distinction between thermal radiation and luminescence.
- 5. The concepts of fluorescence quantum yield, excitation spectrum and decay time constant.
- 6. The elementary processes between radiation (photons) and matter (atoms) and qualitatively their (dis)similarities, basic properties of atomic spectra.
- 7. The simplest models of molecules and the relation to fluorescence, infrared absorption and Raman-scattering.
- 8. Spectral features of optical radiation sources (halogen, xenon and deuterium lamp, spectral lamps and lasers) and corresponding applications in spectroscopy,
- 9. The function and operating principle of general-purpose spectral apparatus (monochromator, spectrophotometer, spectrofluorimeter); the meaning of dispersion, resolution and spectral slit, and the relations between the quantities.
- 10. The responsivity and spectral response of a detector and the working principles of the most common optical detectors (photomultiplier, photodiode, CCD).

kirjeldus_et: Antud kursus tutvustab tudengitele avaliku poliitika kujundamise protsessi. Kursus lähtub oma ülesehituses avaliku poliitika astmelisest mudelist ning käsitleb tsükli kõiki etappe, sh. päevakorra kujunemine, poliitikaanalüüs, poliitikate disain, elluviimine ja hindamine. Kursus ei keskendu ühelegi konkreetsele valdkonnapoliitikale, vaid annab üldised teadmised avaliku poliitika mõistmiseks ja uurimiseks mistahes harupoliitika valdkonnas. Tudengitel on võimalus siduda kursuse käigus omandatud materjal neile huvipakkuva valdkonnapoliitika analüüsimiseks semestri jooksul esitatavate kodutööde käigus. Lisaks loengutele on aine struktuuri integreeritud tudengite poliitikakujundamise projektide valmimist toetavad praktikumid, mis arendavad osaliste teadmisi ja oskusi poliitikaanalüüsi meetodite, poliitikapaberite kirjutamise ja huvikaitse strateegiate vallas.
kirjeldus_en: This is a BA-level course that introduces students to the public policymaking process. The course follows the stages model and discusses each stage of the policy cycle in detail including agenda setting, policy analysis, policy design, implementation, and evaluation. There is no specific policy focus to this course, rather the goal is to provide students with the general knowledge and skills necessary for understanding the policy process in any policy area. In the course assignments, students are encouraged to apply the acquired material to examining a particular sectoral policy of their interest. In addition to lectures, the course includes practicums that develop necessary skills and knowledge for students' individual policy projects across the topics of policy analysis methods, policy writing, and advocacy strategies.

kirjeldus_en: During the course, an overview will be given of the main geophysical and cosmic objects, their evolvement and development, and physical methods used to investigate those. The following topics are discussed: a) origin and evolution of the large-scale objects; b) physical properties and chemical composition of the Earth's interior, atmosphere and oceans; c) Sun and other solar system components, d) physics of stars, our Galaxy, other galaxies and the whole Universe. The connections of large-scale physics course with the other courses of the physics bachelor programme are also presented.

2) teenuseid valitsevate ministeeriumite ja osutavate rakendusasutuste juhtumite ja kasutuslugude tutvustamine läbi avaliku sektori külaliste.

1) the first part covering service types, regulations, design and technical service arhitecture 
2) the second part examining actual domain specific use problems from a ministerial as well as service owning institutions point of view with the help of invited quests.

The first part does this through examples of different service, the second part looks at direct practical expectations and problems that a service centered public administration systems entails.

Kursusel käsitletakse, kuidas andmestumine mõjutab sotsiaalseid suhteid, institutsioone, võimustruktuure ja ühiskondlikke protsesse nii indiviidi, organisatsiooni kui ka ühiskonna tasandil. kirjeldus_en: This course provides a sociological overview of the development of the datafied society and the main theoretical and methodological approaches used to study it. It examines how datafication shapes social relations, institutions, power structures, and broader societal processes at the individual, organizational, and societal levels. Special attention is given to the sociological opportunities and risks associated with the collection, use, and interpretation of (big) data. Students develop a critical understanding of the theoretical, methodological, and interpretive challenges embedded in datafication and learn to situate these processes within social practices and wider cultural developments.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate merearheoloogiast, selle ajaloost ning arengust tänapäevaseks akadeemiliseks distsipliiniks. Loengutes käsitletakse merearheoloogia erinevaid uurimisvaldkondi ning kasutatavaid meetodeid, samuti tutvutakse tähelepanuväärsete uurimisprojektidega ning leidudega kogu maailmast. Olulise valdkonnana leiab käsitlemist mereline kultuuripärand ning selle uurimise, säilitamise ja kaitsmisega seostuvad probleemid ja väljakutsed. Kursus koosneb loengutest ning praktilistest seminaridest, mis osaliselt viiakse läbi Tallinnas, Eesti Meremuuseumis.
kirjeldus_en: This course introduces the discipline of maritime archaeology. It covers the history and development of maritime archaeology as an academic discipline. It explores its topics and methodologies of research, as well as a variety of case studies of maritime archaeological research from around the world and introduces the various issues and challenges of the management of maritime cultural heritage in the modern world. In addition to lectures, practical seminar/sessions will be held in the Estonian Maritime Museum, in Tallinn.
opitulemused_en: - After completing the course, the students should know what maritime archaeology is, its history and development as an academic discipline, as well as the methodologies, topics, and settings of research that it covers. Moreover, the participants of this course will be able to list a variety of case studies of shipwrecks, coastal and submerged sites or other types of maritime cultural heritage from around the world. They will also have the knowledge of where to look for further resources if they want to conduct deeper research on a specific region or subject of maritime archaeology. Finally, the students of this course will be able to understand the main issues, debates and challenges in the preservation and management of maritime cultural heritage in the modern world.

Globaalne tervis on teadusala, mis tegeleb tervise edendamisega ning võrdõiguslikkuse tagamisega tervishoius ülemaailmsel tasandil. 
See uus globaalse tervise kursus on koostöö projekt Brno Masaryki ülikooli ning Tartu Ülikooli vahel.
Antud valikkursuse eesmärkideks on jagada teadmisi, treenida tudengite analüütilist mõtlemist ning kutsuda esile huvitaid arutelusid erinevatel globaalse tervisega seonduvatel teemadel. Innovatsioon ja koostöö on olulised märksõnad, et kirjeldada seda kursust, kus Masaryki ja Tartu tudengid õpivad samal ajal koos, olles ühendatud videokõne kaudu üksteisega. Selle kursuse õppejõud on samuti mõlemast ülikoolist, lisaks on kavas kutsuda  külalisõppejõude eri teemadel vestlema.
Tšehhi ja Eesti tudengid saavad sel kursusel koos õppida ning koos ka kursuse lõputööd, globaalse tervise projekti, koostada.
kirjeldus_en:
Global Health is a discipline that places a priority on improving health and achieving equity in health for all people worldwide. 
This new Global Health course is a collaboration project between the Masaryk University in Brno, Czechia and the University of Tartu, Estonia. 
This elective course aims to share knowledge, train analytical thinking skills, and spark exciting discussions among learners about the vast array of topics related to global health. Innovation and collaboration are keywords used to describe this course as student cohorts in Masaryk and Tartu university will be studying together being connected in class via a video stream. The teachers and tutors for this course are from both universities with additional expert guest speakers being invited for specific seminars of this course. 
Students from Czechia and Estonia participating in this Global Health course are guided to collaborate closely with each other throughout the duration of the course. They will also be working in mixed groups for planning and writing their final course assignment- a global health project.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Learners have knowledge to describe the history, values, and functions of global health.
- 2. Learners have obtained practical skills and knowledge to apply in health project planning and management.
- 3. Learners can analyse health systems and policies from an equity and human rights' viewpoint.
- 4. Learners can explain how social, economic, environmental, and cultural determinants contribute to population and individual health.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Alexander Kmoch, Anto Aasa, Evelyn Uuemaa, Holger Virro, Jeonghwan Choi, Kajetan Marcin Chrapkiewicz, Pamela Maricela Guaman Pintado
kirjeldus_et:
Kursus tutvustab Python- ja R-skriptimiskeskkondadega töötamise põhimõtteid, oskusi ja tööriistu. Kursus on jagatud kahte ossa: esimeses keskendutakse Pythonile ja teises R-ile.
Varasem programmeerimiskogemus ei ole kohustuslik, kuid on väga soovitatav (eriti Pythonis). Ilma varasema koodikirjutamise kogemuseta tudengid peavad olema valmis panustama ülesannete täitmiseks märkimisväärselt lisatööd ning soovitatavalt tutvuma Pythoni põhialustega juba enne kursuse algust. Kui teil pole üldse varasemat koodikirjutamise kogemust, siis palun kontakteeruge enne kursust Alexander Kmochiga ( alexander.kmoch@ut.ee), kes saab soovitada materjale.
Pythoni osa algab keskkonna seadistamisega kasutades conda/mamba tööriistu, liikudes edasi keerukamate ruumiandmestruktuuride ja operatsioonidega shapely ja geopandas teekide abil. Tudengid õpivad töötama koordinaatsüsteemide ja transformeerimisega, ruumipäringute ja ümberklassifitseerimise meetoditega. Kursus jätkub keerukamate ruumianalüüsi meetoditega, sealhulgas punktimustrite ja  LiDAR-andmete töötlemine.
Lisaks pannakse rõhku rasterandmete käsitlemisele kasutades rasterio ja xarray teeke, ning ruumiandmete staatilisele visualiseerimisele matplotlibi abil ning interaktiivsele kaardistamisele foliumiga. Pythoni osa sisaldab ka lihtsamat geograafilist modelleerimist masinõppe (otsustusmets)  abil.
R-i osa algab RStudio keskkonna installeerimise ja seadistamisega ning pakettide haldamise tutvustamisega. Kursus tutvustab R-i ruumianalüüsi ökosüsteemi, keskendudes vektorandmete töötlemisele ja kaardi kujundamise tööriistadele. Kursus hõlmab rasterandmete analüüsi ja ruumilist interpoleerimist. Erilist tähelepanu pööratakse mobiilsusanalüüsile, näidates R-i võimalusi GPS- ja mobiilsusandmete töötlemisel ja analüüsil.
Kogu kursuse vältel juhendatakse tudengeid kasutama versioonihaldust GitHubi abil ning looma analüüsi töövooge vastavalt FAIR põhimõtetele.
kirjeldus_en:
The course introduces concepts, skills, and tools for working with the Python and R scripting environments. The course is split in two parts, starting with Python and in the second part working with R.'

While prior programming experience is not mandatory it highly preferred (esp. Python). Students without any prior coding experience will have to be ready to put significant extra work into the assignments and already should engage in Python basics before the start of the course (please inquire ahead of time alexander.kmoch@ut.ee ).

The Python part starts off with environment configuration using conda/mamba, progressing to advanced spatial data structures and operations through the shapely and geopandas libraries. Students learn to work with coordinate reference systems, followed by implementation of spatial queries and reclassification methodologies. Then the course continues with complex spatial analysis  including point pattern analysis and processing of LiDAR data.
Additional emphasis is placed on modern raster data handling using rasterio and xarray, complemented by both static visualization techniques via matplotlib and interactive mapping solutions via folium. The Python section also includes the application of machine learning to spatial modelling, with a focus on Random Forest implementations for spatial prediction.

The R part also starts with installing and configuring the RStudio environment and package management. The course then introduces R's geospatial ecosystem, focusing on vector data manipulation and introductory cartographic techniques. The curriculum encompasses raster data analysis and spatial interpolation. Special attention is given to mobility analysis, demonstrating R's capabilities in processing and analyzing GPS and mobility data.

Throughout the course, students are guided to use version control using GitHub and to make their analytical workflows adhering to FAIR research principles (findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable).
opitulemused_en:
- Knows basic concepts and tools for working with the Python and R scripting environments.
- Has the ability to critically evaluate and select appropriate computational methods and practical Python and R libraries for typical scientific and applied geospatial analysis.
- Is able to solve common geospatial data-related tasks using Python and R.
- Demonstrates competency in developing reproducible research workflows adhering to FAIR principles and produce clear documentation of methods in the Python and R scripting environments.

- 4) be able to plan and implement the use of the learned methods in teaching,
- 5) be able to analyze the use of the methods.

The course takes place as a workshop on June 15-18, 2026. The student is expected to read through the required literature before the workshop and post one question per text in Moodle forum. The workshop comprises 6 seminars and practical work on a research vessel, where students' active participation is expected, as well as 4 public lectures.

- * is familiar with some aspects of the history of ocean study and can discuss them with fellow students in seminars, as well as ask relevant questions of a specialist,
- * is acquainted with the technical specifics and difficulties of hydrography.

kirjeldus_et: Kasutatakse erinevaid õpetamismeetodeid. Mitu korda nädalas oodatakse õpilastelt tööd ettevalmistatud kliinilise juhtumi materjali ja kliiniliste andmetega. kirjeldus_en:
Different teaching methods are used. Several times a week, students are expected to work on prepared clinical case material and clinical data. Students are expected to present their findings individually and also as members of their group. Based on practical examples, the module thus provides an overview of how clinical nutritionists can contribute to the optimisation of treatment regimens by using and applying their knowledge. As before, learners are tested informally with short interactive quizzes. 
Metabolic syndrome, obesity and diabetes together form an international epidemic. This module considers their effects on clinical nutrition. The specifics of sports medicine and advice for athletes are also discussed.
opitulemused_en:
- The student completing the module:
- * understands the problem of malnutrition in obesity
- * understands the pathophysiology of metabolic syndrome
- * is able to apply this knowledge in devising suitable diets for these patients
- * is familiar with the nutritional challenges of high-level sports
- * is fully aware of the management of food allergies and anorexia nervosa

The course is divided into three 
cycles.
1. Machine elements. Overview of the working principles of he elementary mechanisms. Also getting acquainted with the spectrum of components that are used for building the mechanisms: Drives, actuators, transmissions and everything  else that is between and around.
2. Manufacturing techniques. Overview of the methods that are used for making the machine components. Majority of the technologies that are used for making the machine components will be discussed.
3. Engineering materials. Properties of the materials used in machine building. Ferrous and non-ferrous metals, plastics, composite materials, wood etc. Also, the processes for producing blanks and other bulk materials for further processing. There will be a final course work where on has to develop a mechanism for solving a practical problem.

kirjeldus_et:
Kaasaegne pangandus on keeruline ja mitmetahuline valdkond. Panga juhtimisel on väga suur roll finantsvälistel aspektidel, nagu nt õigus, infotehnoloogia ja küberturvalisus, turundus ja suhtlus. Aine on üles ehitatud LHV Panga juhtide külalisloengutele, mille raames käsitletakse tänapäeva panga tegevusega seotud iseärasusi. Õppeaine väärtus seisneb selles, et panga juhtimist käsitletakse ettevõttepõhisest vaatest ning erialaseid teadmisi mitteomavale osalejale hoomataval tasemel. Praktikute külalisloenguid tasakaalustatakse rahandusteoreetilise käsitlusega, mille loovad TÜ majandusteaduskonna õppejõud (jooksvalt koos LHV külalislektorite etteastega).
Kursuse raames selgitatakse, millised on panga funktsioonid ja roll majandussüsteemis, milles seisnevad panga finantsjuhtimise eripärad, milliseid teenuseid pank pakub. Samuti antakse ülevaade õiguslikest, infoturbe ja turunduslikest aspektidest, mis on lahutamatud osad tänapäeva panga tegevusest.
kirjeldus_en:
Contemporary banking is a complex and multi-faceted area; non-financial aspects, such as legislation, ICT and cybersecurity, marketing and communication play very significant role in the management of the bank. The course is built upon guest lectures of managers of LHV Pank in the framework of which peculiarities of functioning of a modern bank are considered. 
The value of the course is that the management of the bank is considered from the company-based perspective; the course is organized on the level accessible to participants not having specialized knowledge.
Guest lectures of practitioners are balanced by financial theoretical approach delivered by lecturers of School of Economics and Business Administration (together with lectures of the representatives of LHV).
During the course, several issues will be under consideration: functions of a bank and role in economic system, peculiarities of financial management of the bank, services offered by the bank. Also overview of legal, security and marketing aspects that are inseparable parts of a modern bank's business.

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse jooksul tutvustatakse anglistika eriala üliõpilastele digihumanitaaria algtõdesid, sh erinevaid statistilisi analüüsimeetodeid. Kursuse nurgakiviks on erinevad võimalused, kuidas kasutada infotehnoloogiat inglise keele, kirjanduse ja kultuuri teaduslikes uurimustes. Kursuse raames arutletakse infotehnoloogia mõjust anglistika eriala erinevatele tahkudele: peamiselt inglise keele uurimisele, sh inglise keele õppimisele ja õpetamisele, aga ka inglise keelt kõnelevate maade kirjanduse ja kultuuri uurimisele. Lisaks aruteludele teoreetilistel teemadel ja vastava teaduskirjandusega tutvumisele, antakse üliõpilastele praktilisi teadmisi, kuidas keeleteaduslikke, kultuurilisi ja kirjanduslikke andmeid automatiseeritult töödelda. Kursuse selgrooks on uurimistöö plaani koostamine, mille rõhuasetus on andmetel ja meetoditel (sh uurimisküsimuse sõnastamine, andmete kogumiseks ja analüüsimiseks vajalike meetodite valimine).
kirjeldus_en: The course introduces the basics of digital humanities, including computing and statistics to the students of English. Different ways in which computers can be used as tools for scholarly research will be looked at. One of the topics covered includes the definition of digital humanities and its impact for the various aspects of English studies: mainly English linguistics, including teaching and learning English, but also the literature and culture of English-speaking countries. In addition to the discussion of theoretical issues, students are provided with practical knowledge of automated data analysis of linguistic, cultural and literary data. The backbone of the course is designing a project proposal with a focus on data and methods (e.g. formulating a research question, choosing the appropriate methods for data collection and data analysis).
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of the course, the students are able to:
- - analyse and compare different definitions of digital humanities
- - name and apply digital tools for literary, cultural and linguistic analysis
- - choose an appropriate design for data collection and data analysis based on the research question
- - compose a research project proposal and assess the validity of a fellow student's project
- - apply digital tools for developing self-regulated learning skills (e.g. project management tools to plan the stages of research and a Gantt chart to draw a timeline of their research)

kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the aims and methods of developing psychological skills in sport. Learners will practice basic psychological skills and learn how to teach them to others. During the course, psychological skills training programs will be developed, and assessments of their effectiveness will be planned.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- .1.	explain the aims, principles, and limitations of basic psychological skills training in the context of developing and supporting athletic performance,
- 2.	select appropriate methods for developing basic psychological skills,
- 3.	design intervention programs for developing basic psychological skills in sport setting,
- 4. apply the main techniques of learning and teaching basic psychological skills,
- 5.	plan the assessment of the effectiveness of a psychological skills training program.

Participants learn about drone construction, operating principles, the use of necessary equipment, and maintenance. In the practical part, students practice drone control in a simulator and learn the safe handling, preparation, and flying of a Tinywhoop drone in acro mode with FPV view. The course concludes with participation in the Delta X competition.
opitulemused_en:
- - Knows the construction and operating principles of a drone and is able to perform troubleshooting on the drone and its equipment when necessary.
- - Follows good practices of drone aviation, legal regulations, and the principles of safe operation.
- - Applies learned flying skills when navigating courses of varying complexity.
- - Analyses and improves personal flying skills based on received feedback.
- - Applies the knowledge and skills acquired in the course in a drone sport competition.

Kursusel tutvustatakse arvutivõrgu ehitamise põhimõtteid jälgides "kihilist" mudelit (ISO OSI 7-kiline
mudel) ja kasutatav selle alusel TCP/IP protokollistik.
Tutvustatakse erinevaid andmeedastusvahendeid traadiga ja traadita arvutivõrkudes.
Detailselt käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid:
adresseerimine, marsruutimine, kapseldamine, töökindlus, veaparandus, VLAN ja VPN võrk.
Käsitletakse tuntud protokolle (IP, ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, STP) ja protokollipõhiseid teenuseid (DNS,
DHCP, SMTP, IMAP, HTTP, FTP).
kirjeldus_en:
The course introduces the principles of computer network construction by observing a "layered" model
(ISO OSI 7-layers model) and using a TCP/IP protocol set based on it.
Various types of data transmission media in wired and wireless computer networks are considered.
The following topics are discussed in detail:
addressing, routing, encapsulation, reliability, error correction, VLAN ja VPN network.
Well-known protocols (IP, ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, SMTP) and protocol-based services (DNS, DHCP,
SMTP, IMAP, HTTP, FTP) are considered.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- knows the basic concepts and basic components of TCP/IP networks, ISO-OSI model, well-known protocols, Ethernet and other standards.
- connects network devices to the network and creates a functioning computer network
- can configure routers and switches at an elementary level.

nimi_et: Kvantitatiivse andmeanalüüsi alused humanitaarteadlastele ja rakendustarkvara R
nimi_en: Basics of Quantitative Data Analysis for the Humanities with R
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursusel tutvutakse kvantitatiivsete andmeanalüüsi meetoditega, kasutades tarkvara R. Kursuse sihtgrupp on humanitaar- ja sotsiaalalade tudengid. Tutvutakse statistilise mudeldamisega humanitaarias, eelkõige tekstiandmeid kasutades. Esmalt antakse ülevaade mudeldamisstrateegiatest ning statistilise mõtteviisi alustest. Seejärel keskendutakse kvantitatiivse analüüsi ja mudeldamise olulisematele meetoditele: regressioonile, klassifikatsioonile ja hüpoteeside kontrollimisele. Lisaks tutvustatakse keerukamate meetodite, nagu näiteks mitmetasemeliste mudelite kasutamist.
kirjeldus_en:
This is an introductory course in quantitative methods implemented in the programming language R . It is directed to students and scholars in humanities and social sciences, with a focus on linguistics research.
We provide an introduction to statistical modeling, with a focus on humanities, and in particular in linguistic research. We start by introducing conceptual background on general strategies on modeling and basics of statistical thinking. Then, we focus on the most relevant methods for quantitative analysis and modelling, namely regression, classification, and hypothesis testing. We also introduce more advanced (not meaning harder!), altough essential techniques such as multilevel models.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing this course, the student:
- - Has acquired a basic intuition in statistical thinking
- - Has acquired the basics of the programming language R and is able to import data into it
- - Is able to choose and execute simple descriptive statistical methods depending on the type of data, use simple statistical tests and visualize data
- - Comprehends that one does not necessarily need numerical data to use quantitative methods
- - Comprehends the difference between  sample and population, percent and absolute frequency, correlation and causation
- - Has delved into a particular method of choice and used it to analyse their own (or a provided) dataset, and is able to validate, visualize and interpret its results.

kirjeldus_et: Kursusel käsitletakse leksikoloogia uurimisvaldkondi, vaadeldakse inglise keele sõnavara struktuuri ja arengut. Lähemalt käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid: sõnatuletus, tähenduse muutumine, laensõnad keeles, sõnaloome; leksikaalsed suhted: sünonüümia, antonüümia, hüponüümia, kollokatsioon; fraseoloogia; sõnavara psühholingvistilisi ja sotsiolingvistilisi aspekte.
kirjeldus_en: The course deals with the structure and the development of the English lexicon. The following topics will be covered: the foreign and the native element in the English vocabulary, word-formation processes in English, meaning change: metaphor, metonymy, polysemy, homonymy; meaning relations: hyponymy, synonymy, opposition, meronymy, syntagmatic relations: collocation, idioms and other fixed expressions, methods for investigating vocabulary.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who has completed the course
- - knows the more important concepts in English lexicology and is able to provide examples in order to illustrate them
- - has a general understanding of the etymological layers of English vocabulary;
- - explains the main reasons of changes in the vocabulary (semantic shift, idiomaticity, archaisms and neologisms, loans)
- - analyses English vocabulary from the perspective of word-formation, semantic change and paradigmatic and syntagmatic relations
- - knows the most important research methods for the study of English vocabulary

nimi_et: Hölderlin ja Heidegger: päästab luule filosoofia?
nimi_en: Hölderlin and Heidegger: Can Poetry Save Philosophy?
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Martin Heidegger on öelnud, et pärast seda, kui Hölderlini luule talle "vältimatuks saatuseks" sai, "polnud miski enam endine". Seminarides katsuksimegi uurida, kuidas sääraselt Hölderlini luulesse kätketud pöördeliselt keelekogemuselt saab üldse võimalikuks mõtlemine. Kõigepealt tähenduses, kuidas luule ja filosoofia vahekorda mõistis Hölderlin ise ja talle kaasaegne filosoofia (Kant, saksa idealism), ning seejärel tähenduses, kuidas Heidegger mõtelda püüdis kahekõnes Hölderlini luulega. Arutluse alla võtaksime filosoofiliste kirjatööde fragmendid, mis noor Hölderlin üheskoos oma sõprade, toona filosoofilise teekonna alguses seisnud Schellingi ja Hegeliga või siis üksinda oli kirjutanud, ning tema proosa ("Hyperion") ja luule. Uurides Heideggeri käsitlusi nagu loengukursus "Hölderlini hümnid "Germaania" ja "Rein"" ja ettekanne "Hölderlin ja luule loomus", pingutaksime mõista, kas luuletaja lausutu tõesti saab päästa meid, teistlaadse mõtlemise algusesse juhatades justkui.
kirjeldus_en: Martin Heidegger has said that after Hölderlin's poetry became his "inevitable fate", "nothing was the same". In these seminars, we will try to explore how such a pivotal linguistic experience in Hölderlin's poetry can make thinking possible at all, first in the sense of how Hölderlin himself and his contemporary philosophy (Kant, German Idealism) understood the relationship between poetry and philosophy, and then in the sense of how Heidegger tried to think in dialogue with Hölderlin's poetry. We will discuss the fragments of philosophical writings that the young Hölderlin wrote on his own or with his friends Schelling and Hegel, who were at the beginning of their philosophical journey, as well as his prose ("Hyperion") and poetry. By studying Heidegger's approaches, such as in the lecture course "Hölderlin's Hymns "Germania" and "The Rhine"" and in the paper "Hölderlin and the Essence of Poetry'" we would be endeavouring to understand whether the poet's utterance can really save us, by leading us to the beginning of a different kind of thinking.

nimi_en: Observation Practice in Social Work or in Social Policy
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Vaatluspraktika moodustab esimese osa sotsiaaltöö ja sotsiaalpoliitika valikmoodulites superviseeritavatest praktikatest ning see on suunatud sotsiaaltöö vaatlemisele.
Vaatluspraktika käigus täidab tudeng järgmised ülesanded:
1. Tutvub temaatilise kirjandusega (k.a. seadused, määrused, artiklid, arengukavad jne).
2. Tutvub asutuse põhikirjaga ja töökorraldusega.
Töömeetodid: iseseisvad tööülesanded, seminarid.
Vaatluspraktika koht ja aeg:
Praktika toimub kas ühes või maksimaalselt kahes erinevas kohas. Enne praktika algust tuleb üliõpilasel praktika koha ja sealse juhendaja suhtes kokku leppida oma ülikoolipoolse juhendajaga. See toimub praktika seminaridel.
Reeglina ei tohi praktikat sooritada enne esimese kursuse lõpetamist.Vaatluspraktika jaoks on eelduseks kohustusliku alusõppe läbimine. 
Praktika koha leidmine ning töötingimused:
Iga üliõpilane on ise vastutav praktikakoha leidmise eest. Sotsiaalpoliitika õppetooli õppejõud aitavad luua sidemeid ning vahendada tööandjate ja üliõpilaste huvisid. 
Juhendamine:
Praktika juhendajateks on kaks inimest: ülikoolist ja praktika kohast. Töökohapoolne juhendaja on vastutav praktika sisulise poole eest ning praktika lõppemisel täidab tema hindamislehe.
kirjeldus_en: During first field practice student gets overview about the organisation, its main regulations, rules, norms, clients, problems. Students meets clients or explores process of social policy. During four weeks student observes the client s, their main problems and solutions for the target groups. `To observe`doesnt mean that student cant participate but the participation is based on the trust between practice supervisor and student and also depends on the place where observational practice is going to happen. Student is obliged to to reflect upon the process during the field practice.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
1. Tudeng esitab praktika tööplaani ülikoolipoolsele juhendajale kas elektrooniliselt või paberkandjal 1 nädal enne praktikale asumist. Praktika plaanis on kirjas praktikale asumise koht ja aeg ning juhendaja nimi. Lisaks sõnastab tudeng tööplaanis praktika eesmärgid. Plaani vormistuslikud nõuded: 1 lk, kiri 12, reavahe 1,5.

Lisaks annab ülevaate praktikal toimunust ja lisab omapoolse hinnangu praktikal oldud asutusele ja oma tööle antud asutuses. Vormistuslikud nõuded: (7-10 lk.,  kiri 12 ja reavahe 1,5). Kursuse jooksul käsitletakse moeetenduse planeerimise etappe alates kontseptsiooni loomisest kuni tehnilise ja logistilise teostuseni, sh lava-, valgus- ja helilahendused ning tagalava töökorraldus. Õppetöö keskmes on projektipõhine meeskonnatöö, kus üliõpilased õpivad rollijaotust, koostööd ja praktilist korraldustööd. Omandatud teadmisi rakendatakse OmaMoe etenduse ettevalmistamisel ja läbiviimisel. Aine lõppeesmärk on arendada üliõpilaste võimet analüüsida moeetenduse korraldusprotsessi, hinnata selle tugevusi ja tuvastada parenduskohti.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides a comprehensive overview of the fashion show as a cultural and marketing event, as well as the principles of its organization. Throughout the course, students examine the stages of planning a fashion show—from developing the concept to technical and logistical execution, including stage, lighting, and sound design, as well as backstage management. The learning process focuses on project-based teamwork, where students practice role distribution, collaboration, and practical organizational tasks. The acquired knowledge is applied in the preparation and execution of the OmaMoe fashion show. The ultimate aim of the course is to develop students’ ability to analyze the fashion show organization process, evaluate its strengths, and identify areas for improvement.

kirjeldus_en: The course gives an overview of the main topics in the field of cultural and social anthropology. As the course is designed especially for the students of theology and religious studies, the relations between peoples worldviews, behaviour and social organization of a society are studied. In addition to the lectures where audio-visual materials are also used the students will participate in seminars on the basis of given literature.
opitulemused_en:
- The student:
- is familiar with the main characteristics of the description of culture in anthropology,
- recognizes the connections between the social organization af a given society and peoples wordview therein,
- connects theoretical knowlegde with one's own experiences,
- describes the possibilities and tensions of a communication between different worldviews.

kirjeldus_en: The course on digital technologies is aimed at students from all possible disciplines. Goal of the course is to give an overview on how the digital information and information processing leads to modern technological and business landscape of the world.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has completed the course shall:
- -Understand the essence of digital technologies, their relationships and ever faster development
- -Recognises and understands the most important terms, knows their meaning and relationships
- -Can estimate the size of the "digital footprint"
- -Can separate the concepts of an idea, algorithm, software code and programme, and working technology
- -Understands the difference in between data and database, and software layers
- -Can separate different levels of abstraction (e.g. physical, logical, application level, etc)
- -Understands the working principles of the Internet, info and telecommunications solutions from the perspective of a non-technical user
- -Can explain in elementary manner the concepts like information. data, database, algorithm, software, code, programme, computer network, query, information security, etc.
- -Understands the need for cybersecurity and can protect oneself at elementary level
- -Can discuss intelligently about the potential business use cases of an ICT solution
- -Can explain the opportunities for  digitalisation in their own specialty area
- -Is motivated, interested and has positive attitude towards opportunities of digitalisation

nimi_en: Counselling of Over-the-counter Medicines and Other Pharmacy Goods in a Community Pharmacy
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Proviisoriõppe neljanda kursuse lõpetamise järel saavad üliõpilased üldapteegis praktiseerida oma teadmisi ja oskusi käsimüügiravimite ja teiste apteegikaupade kasutamise nõustamisel. Nõusolek valikaine ajal üliõpilast juhendada ning valikaine läbimine kooskõlastatakse apteegi juhataja ja Tartu Ülikooli farmaatsia instituudi poolse juhendajaga. Üliõpilasel on valikaine läbimisel apteegis juhendaja, kellega koos teostatakse käsimüügiravimite alast nõustamist. Piisavate teadmiste olemasolul ja pärast vastavate teadmiste kontrollimist juhendaja poolt võib üliõpilane teisi apteegikaupu väljastada ka iseseisvalt. NB! Valikaine ei asenda kohustusliku õppeaine Apteegipraktika käsimüügiravimite ja teiste apteegikaupade moodulit!
kirjeldus_en:
After completing the fourth year of the pharmacy curriculum, students can practice their knowledge and skills at community pharmacy in counselling of the use of over-the-counter medicines and other pharmacy goods. Consent to supervise the student during the elective and passing the elective is coordinated with the head of the pharmacy and the supervisor of the Institute of Pharmacy of the University of Tartu. 
During the elective, the student has a supervisor in the pharmacy and they together provide counseling on over-the-counter medicines. If the student has sufficient knowledge and after checking the relevant knowledge by the supervisor, the student may also dispense other pharmacy goods independently.
NB! The optional course does not replace the modules of over-the-counter medicines and other pharmacy goods in the compulsory subject Pharmacy Practice!
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course the student has
- - improved knowledge and skills about commonly used over-the-counter medicines and other pharmacy goods,
- - ability to councel different groups of patients on the details of the use of different over-the-counter medicines and pharmacy goods,
- - ability to use various sources of information and quickly find additional information about the details and use of over-the-counter medicines and other pharmacy goods.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab põhjaliku ülevaate kaasaegsest veebiarendusest, keskendudes Reacti ja Vue.js raamistikele. Õppijad omandavad praktilisi oskusi dünaamiliste üheleheliste veebirakenduste (SPA) loomiseks, kasutades komponentidel põhinevat arhitektuuri, olekuhaldust, kliendipoolset suunamist ja API-de integreerimist. Kursus on jagatud kaheks võrdseks osaks: esimene pool keskendub React-ile, teine Vue.js-ile. Kursuse läbimisel suudab õppija iseseisvalt arendada ja juurutada kaasaegseid veebirakendusi mõlemas raamistikus.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides a comprehensive introduction to modern front-end web development with React and Vue.js. Students will acquire practical skills in building interactive and modular single-page applications (SPAs) using component-based design, state management, client-side routing, and API integration. The course is divided into two equal parts: the first half focuses on React, the second on Vue.js. By the end of the course, students will be able to develop, structure, and deploy modern web applications independently using both frameworks.
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of this course, students should be able to:
- •	Can set up and configure front-end projects using both React and Vue.js.
- •	Can create reusable and modular components using JSX (React) and template syntax (Vue).
- •	Understands and applies state management, routing, and lifecycle methods in both frameworks.
- •	Is able to build forms with validation and connect applications to external APIs.
- •	Can manage global state using Context API or Redux in React and Pinia in Vue.
- •	Can deploy modern web applications using tools such as Firebase or Vercel.
- •	Is able to evaluate and compare different front-end frameworks for project-specific needs.

kirjeldus_et:
Õppeaine eeldab üliõpilase põhjalikumat tutvumist mingi asutuse või organisatsiooni tööga, kus leidub sotsioloogile / sotsiaalvaldkonna analüütikule või spetsialistile sobivat erialast tegevust ning iseseisva(te) ülesande/-annete täitmist.
Põhiosa praktikast võib olla tehnilise iseloomuga, kuid praktika peab sisaldama ka analüütilist komponenti, st praktika sisu ei saa olla ainult tehniline töö, vaid peaks sisaldama ka analüütilise väljundi tootmist või vähemalt metodoloogilist panust. Tehnilise iseloomuga ülesannete puhul tuleb praktikandil aru saada, mis on teostatava tegevuse sisuliseks väljundiks (nt mille jaoks andmed kogutakse: mingi arengukava koostamiseks, detailplaneeringu tegemiseks, tellitud rakendusuuringu jaoks vms) ja seda väljundit ka praktikaaruandes iseloomustada.

Praktika eeldab praktikabaasi tegevusest ülevaate saamist, kuid ei eelda tingimata regulaarset kohalolekut (sageli pole see ka tehniliselt võimalik, kuna eriti väiksemates praktikabaasides võib küllalt palju tööd toimuda kaugtöö põhimõttel). Küll aga on kohalolek soovitatav, sest enamasti saab praktikant nii selgema ülevaate praktikabaasi tööst, võimalusel tuleks osaleda kõigis ühistegevust nõudvates üritustes (koosolekud, arutelud, seminarid, presentatsioonid).

Enne praktikategevuste algust tuleb praktikandil koostöös juhendajaga koostada ja esitada praktikaplaan. Praktikaplaani õigeaegne koostamine ja esitamine mõjutab praktika lõpphinnet. Täpsemad juhised praktikaplaaniks koostamiseks ja muud nõudmised praktika läbimiseks jaoks on üleval Moodle's.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
* Praktikaplaan (vajalik praktika eesmärgistatud läbimiseks, võimalike probleemide vältimiseks; esitada enne praktikaülesannete täitmise alustamist)
* Praktikategevused (tööülesanded, vaatlus, kohtumistel osalemine jne) umbes kolme täistöönädala ulatuses (120 tundi)
* Seminarides osalemine või seminari väljundi täitmine
* Praktikaaruanne
* Praktikaaruande kaitsmine
* Praktikabaasipoolse juhendaja hinnang (vorm Moodle-s)

At the end of the practical training student(s) will submit the report of the practical training research, that includes also self-analysis. In addition to that student(s) will submit the assessment by the institution on his/her performance during the practical and feedback on the practical training process. The practical training will finish with the defence of the report of the practical training work. The format of the internship report may derive from the form of the internship organization or may be in the form of a logbook that describes the activities undertaken and the skills applied during the practical training according to the sample given. In addition to the report the student is expected to submit other materials, that would enable to understand and evaluate his or her practical training.
