kirjeldus_en: The course covers theories from the micro- or individual technology level to the macro- or socio-technical systems level, consistently relating them to current issues. Topics include defining technology and innovation; technological determinism; the social construction of technology; technology as part of networks of actors; path dependence and lock-in; unintended consequences of technology and their prevention; the impact of technological innovation on the natural environment and sustainability; democratic control over technology; system innovation and socio-technical transitions; agriculture, industry and the information society.

- Has an overview of the main theories explaining the development of technology.
- Can apply these theories to critically understand technologies and technological development.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus õpetab  kristalliliste ainete struktuuride määramist kasutades  röntgendifraktsiooni meetodit, mudelite koostamist  struktuuriparameetrite täpsustamiseks ja arvutuste läbiviimist kasutades kaheetapilist ja Rietveldi meetodit arvutiprogrammide AXES, FULLPROF, GSAS, SIRPOW abil. Õpetatakse faasiüleminekute ja soojuspaisumistegurite määramist kasutades termoröntgenograafilist analüüsi.  Tutvutakse röntgenpeegelduse meetodiga siledate pindade ja õhukeste kilede tiheduse, kareduse ja paksuse määramiseks. Õpitakse nanoosakeste suuruse ja kuju määramist kasutades nii difraktsioonijoone kuju analüüsi polükristalliliste ainetel kui ka röntgenhajumise meetodit mittekristallilistel (amorfsete, kolloidsete või polümeeride) ainetel.
kirjeldus_en: The course teaches the methods of X-ray crystal structure determination whereas the main attention is paid on the crystal model building for refinement of structure parameters by two-stage and Rietveld methods that are based on the computer programs AXES, FULLPROF, GSAS and SIPROW. Students learn  preparation of samples and performing experiments of thermal X-ray diffraction analysis for investigation of phase transitions and determination of thermal expansion coefficients. The principles and experimental realizations of X-ray reflection analysis for characterization of thin films and surfaces in terms of surface density, roughness and film trickness are presented. The methods of diffraction peak shape analysis and small angle X-ray scattering for determination of nanoparticle shape, mean size, size distribution, and lattice deformation for crystalline but also noncrystalline (amorphous materials, colloids, polymers) materials are taught.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Knows what kind of refinement methods are use for fitting of diffraction patterns. Can use the methods and different mathematical functions for fitting. Knows how to use the refined parameters for describing crystal structure of materials.
- 2. Has good skills, compared with other refinement methods, in using of Rietveld analysis for refinement of crystal structure parameters. Knows how to use different kind of residual errors for describing the quality and precision of refined parameters.
- 3. Knows the principles of different kind of quantitative phase analysis methods and can use Rietveld method for calculation of mass concentration of different phases in a compound.
- 4. Knows basic notions used for determination and presentation of electron density map and Patterson map in crystals. Can use program GFOUR from package FULLPROF for calculation of electron density and Patterson maps of crystals.
- 5. Knows principles of high temperature X-ray diffraction analysis (HT-XRD) and can determine linear expansion coefficients of materials by using HT-XRD method.
- 6. Knows principles of X-ray reflection analysis (XRR) for characterization of surfaces and thin films. Can calculate roughness and mass density of surfaces but also thickness of thin film by fitting of XRR patterns. Can perform XRR analysis on diffractometer SmartLab.
- 7. Can estimate crystallite size and lattice strain from X-ray diffraction peak shape analysis.
- 8. Knows principles of small angle X-ray scattering analysis for calculation of radius of gyration of scattering particles and size distribution function of particles. Can perform SAXS analysis on diffractometer SmartLab.

For the journalism internship the student can register for the Voluntary Individual Internship after having passed the following courses: Basics of Journalism and Interviewing Techniques. 
The student needs to register for the course after finishing the internship at the organisation. Internship must be coordinated with the supervisors via e-mail (journalism internship brit.laak@ut.ee, communication internship kulliki.seppel@ut.ee. The student is responsible in finding a place for the internship. 
In order to acquire 3 EAP the trainee period needs to last approximately 70 academic hours, compiling the internship report takes in general 9 hours, defending the report 1 hour.  A portfolio of the practical assignments taken at the time of the internship is handed in together with the internship report. After finishing one's internship one needs to defend its results when orally presenting one's internship report in a seminar.
opitulemused_en:
- -	The student knows some of the techniques used when working as a journalist/ communication specialist
- -	Has some practical experiences in the field of journalism/communication
- -	The students: ability of self-reflection and their ability to critically assess one's professional development shall improve through compiling and defending the internship report.

kirjeldus_et: Loengukursus annab kosmoloogia teoreetilise aluspõhja, tutvustades gravitatsiooniteooriat ja selle rakendusi Universumi kirjeldamiseks. Alustame kõverruumi geomeetriast ja tensorarvutusest, toome sisse Einsteini võrrandi ja tuletame siit Universumi standardmudeli omadused. Peatume lühidalt Universumi algusel ja inflatsioonistaadiumil. Kirjeldame varast nukleosünteesi, kiirgustasakaalu ajastut ja rekombinatsiooni. Anname häritusarvutuste alused Einsteini gravitatsiooniteoorias, kirjeldame tihedushäirituste arengut ja tihedushäirituste ja reliktfooni häirituste vaadeldavaid omadusi. Kirjeldame tumeaine ja tumeenergia probleeme. Anname ülevaate kosmoloogilistest vaatlusprojektidest, ja kirjeldame lühidalt alternatiivseid kosmoloogilisi teooriaid.
kirjeldus_en: The lectures will give basic facts of cosmological theory, introducing the theory of gravitation and its applications for describing the universe. We start with describing the geometry of curved space and tensor calculus, introduce the Einstein equation and apply it to derive the properties of the standard FRW model of the universe. We describe shortly the beginning of the universe and the inflation stage. We describe the early nucleosynthesis, the epochs of radiation equilibrium and recombination. We give the elements of perturbation calculus in the theory of gravitation, describe the evolution of density perturbations and deduce the observational properties of the density and CMB perturbations. We describe the properties and theories for dark matter and dark energy.  We give a review of cosmological observations and describe shortly alternative cosmological theories.
opitulemused_en:
- The successful student knows theory of gravitation and cosmological models, knows the nature of the CMB and its origin and the origin of the large-scale structure, knows what is inflation and how to determine cosmological parameters.

She/he can describe mathematically the expansion of the universe, its constituent components,  perturbations of the physical fields, the properties of the observed structure, can solve Einstein equations for the smooth universe and for the evolution of perturbations, understands goals of cosmological observational projects.

kirjeldus_et:
See kursus annab ülevaate viimastest arengutest digivalitsemise valdkonnas. Eesmärk on pakkuda teoreetilist alust praktiliste juhtumite analüüsimiseks. Kursus tutvustab tehnilisi lahendusi nagu pilveteenused, veebiplatvormid, geoinfosüsteemid, asjade internet ja digitaalsed kaksikud. Süvenetakse digivalitsemisse veebi-, mobiili- ja hübriidsetes online-offline kontekstides.

Käsitletakse erinevaid valitsemistehnoloogiaid, nagu e-tervishoid, e-riigirahandus, digitaalselt toetatud õiguskaitse ning nutikad linnad. Tutvutakse valitsemise läbipaistvuse põhimõtetega avatud andmeplatvormide kaudu ning vastutuse mehhanismidega, kasutades selliseid digivahendeid nagu e-jälgija, e-audit ja e-järelvalve.

Erilist tähelepanu pööratakse suurandmetele ja ennustavale analüütikale, masinõppele ning suurtele keelemudelitele kui teedrajavaile katsetele tuua tehisintellekt valitsemisse. Kursusel hinnatakse kriitiliselt nende tehnoloogiate potentsiaali avaliku halduse reformimiseks või häirimiseks.

Uuritakse Eesti, Ukraina ja Põhjamaade digivalitsemise ja nutika linna juhtumeid. Samuti vaadeldakse äärmuslikke digiautokraatia näiteid. Kokkuvõttes aitab kursus õppijal orienteeruda e-valitsemises teadliku kodanikuna ning loob aluse teaduslikuks, poliitikakujunduslikuks või ettevõtlusega seotud karjääriteeks digivalitsemise valdkonnas.
kirjeldus_en:
This course will overview recent developments in the realm of digital governance. It aims to provide a theoretical foundation for the analysis of practical cases. The course outlines technical solutions such as cloud services, online platforms, geographic information systems, internet of things, and digital twins. It will dive into digital governance in web, mobile, and hybrid online-offline contexts.

It will look into such gov tech as e-health, e-public finance, digital-powered law enforcement, and smart cities. We will familiarise with the principles of government transparency via open data platforms and government accountability via such digital tools as e-tracker, e-audit, and e-oversight.

We will devote special attention to big data and predictive analytics, machine learning and large language models as pioneering efforts to introduce artificial intelligence to governance. We will critically assess the potential of these technologies to reform and to disrupt public administration.

We will examine digital government and smart city cases of Estonia, Ukraine, and Nordic countries. Also, we will investigate the extreme cases of digital autocracies. In sum, the course will help navigate e-governance as a citizen and establish a basis for scientific, policy-oriented, or business professional paths in digital governance.

Seitsme päeva jooksul kogutakse peamiselt rühmatööna loodusest selgrootuid, omandatakse enam kasutatavad püügi- ja prepareerimistehnikad ning tutvustatakse loodusvaatlusandmebaaside kasutamist, peetakse ettekandeid liigirikkamatest putuka- ja limusterühmadest, koostatakse putukate ja limustekollektsioonid ning kollektsioonimäärajad ja testitakse omandatud teadmisi putukaseltside määramise võistlusel, viktoriinil ning arvestusel. Motivatsiooni suurendamiseks toimub kogu välipraktikum rühmatööna võistlusformaadis.
kirjeldus_en: The field course aims to refine and broaden the knowledge of invertebrates obtained in lectures and practical sessions by means of direct observation practices in wildlife. During the one week time participants collect the insects, molluscs and other invertebrates from the field, learn the principal collection and preparation techniques and the use of databases of occurence data, set up their own collections and collection keys, have the presentations about some most species-rich invertebrate groups and test their newly acquired knowledge in insect order determination competition, in trivia game and in oral exam. To increase the motivation of participant the course is mainly operating in group-work and competition mode,

student knows the essential safety requirements for working in a laboratory,
student is able to correctly use the basic labware,
can perform basic experimental work in laboratory 
can solve mathematical problems connected with these problems, 
is able to present experimental results both in written and oral form, to critically analyze them, to interpret them, to draw corresponding conclusions, and to make connections,
students understand chemical principles of practical works.

The student's written, and oral expression skills will be developed as part of the practice of reproaching and answering practical assignments. Teamwork planning and teamwork skills will be developed.
Mathematical competence, analytical skills, and the ability to make inferences are developed.

kirjeldus_et: Kui me praegu räägime infoajastust, siis oleks mõistlik vaadelda kogu maailma lähtudes informatsioonimõistest. Arusaadavalt on tegemist ühe looga, mida me jutustame maailmast. Selles loos on kogu füüsikalise, bioloogilise ja sotsiaalse maailma peamiseks tegijaks on informatsioon. Nii me käsitlemegi informatsiooni füüsikalist tähendust, info rolli eluslooduses ja lõpuks ka ühiskonnas. Kursuse käsitlusraamistikuks on nn uus informatsiooniline lähenemine, mille korral loetakse kõikide protsesside aluseks informatsiooni.
kirjeldus_en: If we are talking about the information age now, it would be wise to look at the whole world in terms of information. Understandably, this is one of the stories we tell about the world. In this story, information is the main factor in the entire physical, biological and social world. This is how we deal with the physical meaning of information, the role of information in wildlife and, ultimately, in society. The treatment framework of the course is the so-called new information approach, in which information is considered to be the basis of all processes.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student:
- Can define and explain different approaches to the term "information"
- Can identify information processes in natural and social systems
- Can describe the historical development of information management
- Understands the role of information processes in the development of the world and societies

kirjeldus_et: Loengukursuse esimeses osas käsitletakse biosüstemaatika aluseid ja näidatakse taksoni nimede olulisust eluslooduse kommunikatsioonis. Kursusel osalejad õpivad tundma kuidas toimub uute taksonite kirjeldamine, eluslooduse klassifikatsiooni koostamine ja milleks kasutatakse eluslooduse nomenklatuuri koodekseid. Kursuse teine osa käsitleb bioloogia andmete haldust. Biosüstemaatika osas saadud teadmised aitavad mõista eluslooduse klassifikatsioonide ja taksoni nimede rolli andmehalduses. Üliõpilased õpivad koostama projekti andmehaldusplaani, mis annab üldise raamistiku kuidas ja mis tüüpi andmeid projekti tarvis kogutakse. Teise etapina õpitakse andmete toimetamist ja jagamist teiste (harrastus)uurijatega. Sellele järgneb andmeanalüüsi etapp ning andmete publitseerimine masinloetava andmekogumina. Viimane on väga tähtis etapp kuna bioloogias hakkavad publitseeritud ja DOI (Digital Object Identifier) baasil tsiteeritavad andmekogumid mängima üha olulisemat rolli. Andmete elutspkli viimase etapina õpitakse andmekogumi arhiveerimist ning seda kuidas juba arhiveeritud andmekogumit edasi arendama hakata.
kirjeldus_en: The basics of biosystematics, importance of taxon names in wildlife communication, describing new taxa, compiling a wildlife classification, wildlife nomenclature codes. The second part of the course deals with data management in biology.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who pass a course:
1) knows the basics of taxonomy
2) is able to read and understand the classification of taxa
3) understand the importance of taxon names in the communication and data management
4) is aware of OPEN and FAIR data
5) understand the scientific data life cycle
6) knows how to find data in data repositories
7) is able to manage data in PlutoF platform

oppejoud: Anneli Saro, Elo-Hanna Seljamaa, Ergo-Hart Västrik, Janek Kraavi, Kristel Kivari, Rebeka Põldsam, Ülo Valk
kirjeldus_et: Kursuse esimese pooles vaadeldakse mitmeid tänase ühiskonna ja kultuuri kokkupuutepunkte: juttu tuleb identiteediproblemaatikast, keskkonna (looduse) ja kultuuri-kunsti suhetest, piiride ületamisest, soo ja seksuaalsuse küsimustest, traditsiooni ja tänapäeva omavahelistest seostest. Eraldi teemadena mõtestatakse subkultuuri tähendust ja uue vaimsuse olemust ja selle laia leviku põhjusi. Kursuse teises pooles käsitletakse sajandialguse (massi)kultuuri suuri troope (kloonid, inglid, vampiirid jne).  Kuruse teises pooles tehakse seminari vormis sissejuhatus põhiliste kunstivaldkondade trendidesse, teemadesse ja tehnikasse. Kursuse lõpus vaadeldakse kultuuritööstuse toimemehhanisme ja selle näitena peatutakse pikemalt populaarkirjanduse ja teleseriaalide valdkonnal.
kirjeldus_en: At the beginning of the course, the connections between modern society and culture are examined: for example, the problem of identity, the relationship between the environment (nature) and culture-art, transgressions, gender and sexuality issues, as well as the meaning of subculture and the nature of the new spirituality are discussed. The second half of the course deals with the major tropes of the (mass) culture at the beginning of the century (zombies, angels, vampires, etc.) and provides an introduction to the trends, themes and techniques of the main art fields. At the end of the course, the mechanisms of the culture industry are examined, and as an example, the field of popular literature and television series will be discussed at length.
opitulemused_en:
- A student
- - can relate to current topics, ways of thinking and metaphors of contemporary culture
- - understands the nature of modern subculture and the logic of mass culture
- - can make sense of personal cultural experience in a more analytical context
- - gain experience in how to analyze contemporary works of art and contemporary narratives
- - has an overview of the topics, techniques and trends of the most important art fields (art, literature, film, theater, etc.) in the 21st century

kirjeldus_en: The target group of the course is Master students, PhD students, who are interested in computational imaging technologies, with a focus on  bioimaging. First part of the course is to provide theoretical background for computational imaging. Second part of the course is to develop next generation computational imaging systems for the applications to computer graphics, remote sensing and robotics vision.

- - Acquire theoretical knowledge and practical knowledge in computational imaging with focus on bio-imaging.
- - Develop next-generation computational imaging systems for imaging around corners and through scattering media etc.
- - Develop machine learning algorithms for representing and processing signals.
- - Applications to computer graphics, remote sensing, and robotic vision

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Õppeaine käsitleb suveräänsuse ja riigiga seonduvaid ideid nende ajaloolises kontekstis, toetudes poliitilise mõtte ajaloo kesksetele tekstidele varauusajast tänapäevani. Kursus arendab filosoofiliste tekstide lugemise ja tõlgendamise oskust, keskendudes riigivõimu, õiguse, õiguste, vägivalla ja biopoliitikaga seotud küsimustele ja sidudes need tänapäeva väljakutsete ja probleemidega nagu hädaolukord, rahvatervis, terrorism, sõda jm nii totalitaarsetes kui demokraatlikes riikides.
kirjeldus_en: The course focuses on the ideas of sovereignty and the state in a historical context by reading central texts in the history of political thought from early modern to contemporary times. In addition to developing the skills relevant for understanding, interpreting, and reflecting on texts, seminars focus on state power, law, rights, violence, and biopolitics with respect to contemporary examples of the state of emergency, public health, terrorism, and war in totalitarian and democratic states.

Simply stated, in a research project this amounts to the separation of theory from object. Object selection in semiotic descriptions should be narrow enough that the researcher can exhaustively describe its relevant features to the degree that whatever claims are made about said features are persuasive. kirjeldus_et: Kursus loob sissejuhatuse soo ja seksuaalsuse ning feministliku antropoloogia valdkondadesse. Tugineme erinevatest kultuurilistest ja ajaloolistest kontekstidest pärinevatele materjalidele, mis käsitlevad kriitiliselt soo tähendust ühiskonnas. Alustame tekstidega queer-teooriast ja feminismi ajaloost seoses pöördega transnatsionaalsete feminismide poole. Jätkame arengutega feministliku antropoloogia ja seksuaalvähemuste temaatikat puudutava antropoloogia valdkondades. Kursuse jooksul puutume kokku küsimustega soo materialiseerumisest; LGBT aktivismist; soo, rassi ja klassi intersektsionaalsusest; transsooliste subjektide käsitlustest; seksuaalsetest subkultuuridest, ja kehalisusest, toetudes eetilistele suundumustele feministlikust ja queer-teooriast.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an introduction to the field of gender, sexuality and feminist anthropology. We draw from materials on various cultural and historical contexts, which critically deal with the meaning of gender in society. We begin with texts on queer theory and the history of feminism with a shift towards transnational feminisms, moving on to the emergence of feminist anthropology and queer inquiries in the field of anthropology. We engage with the questions of materialization of gender, LGBT activism, intersectionalities of race, class and gender, perspectives on transgender subjects, sexual subcultures and embodiment, drawing on ethical insights from feminist and queer theory.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completing the course, the student will be able to:
- 1. The student has an introductory knowledge of the history and current scholarly engagements in the field of anthropology of gender and sexuality, and is able to draw connections to the contemporary societal processes and phenomena.
- 2. The student understands analytical possibilities at the intersection between queer theory and anthropology.
- 3. The student is capable of analysing issues of gender, sexuality, and embodiment in neoliberal and postcolonial contexts, using critical vocabulary obtained during the course.

kirjeldus_et:
Antakse ülevaade peamistest kontseptsioonidest ruumiandmete veebis esitamiseks, hõlmates nii ruumiandmete geoportaale, standardeid ja veebiteenuseid. Õpitakse kasutama veebiteenuseid töölaua GIS-keskkondades ja keskendutakse OGC standardite praktilisele rakendamisele.
Varasem programmeerimiskogemus ei ole kohustuslik, kuid on soovitatav. Ilma eelneva koodikirjutamise kogemuseta tudengid peavad olema valmis pühendama märkimisväärselt lisatööd ülesannete täitmiseks ning soovitatavalt tutvuma Pythoni/programmeerimise põhialustega enne kursuse algust (lisainfo: alexander.kmoch@ut.ee). Ideaalis tuleks see kursus läbida koos kursusega LTOM.02.041.
Kursus annab oskuse ruumiandmete metaandmete haldamiseks, hõlmates kataloogiteenuseid ja metaandmete loomist rahvusvaheliste standardite alusel. Õpitakse kasutama GeoServerit ruumiandmete veebis avaldamiseks, kasutades WMS-funktsionaalsust ja kaartide kujundamist SLD-stiilide abil. Lisaks õpitakse andmemodelleerimise kontseptsioone, sealhulgas GML-i ja UML-i, rõhutades INSPIRE-ühilduvust ja XML-skeeme. Praktikumides õpitakse kontseptsioone rakendada rakendada WFS-teenust koos kohandatud GML-skeemiga.
Õpitakse veebitehnoloogiate (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) aluseid, et seda hiljem kasutada andmete esitamiseks veebis. Praktiliste sessioonide käigus WMS, GeoJSON, REST API-d. Kursus lõpeb pilvepõhiste ruumiandmete kontseptsioonide tundma õppimisega: STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs), kaasaegsete andmete otsingu- ja juurdepääsuvõimalustega ning serveripoolse WebGIS-i rakendamisega pygeoapi abil.
Oluline osa kursusest on veebikaardi loomise projekt, kus tudengid rakendavad oma kursuses omandatud teadmisi tervikliku veebipõhise ruumiandmete rakenduse arendamisel. Kursuse vältel pannakse rõhku arusaamisele traditsioonilistest ruumiandmete infrastruktuurist üleminekule kaasaegsete pilvepõhiste lähenemisteni, valmistades tudengeid ette nii olemasolevate kui uute ruumiandmete veebitehnoloogiate kasutamiseks
kirjeldus_en:
The course covers foundational concepts of geodata on the web, exploring spatial data portals, standards, and services. Students learn to work with web services in desktop GIS environments, and focus on practical implementation of OGC standards. 
While prior programming experience is not mandatory it is highly preferred. Students without any prior coding experience will have to be ready to put extra work into the assignments and already should engage in Python/programming basics before the start of the course (please inquire ahead of time alexander.kmoch@ut.ee ). Ideally, this course is taken together with LTOM.02.041.

The course will cover geospatial metadata management, including catalogue services and metadata creation based on international standards.
Building on database fundamentals, students explore GeoServer for spatial data publication, using WMS functionality and map styling using SLD styling. The course will cover data modeling concepts including GML and UML, with particular emphasis on INSPIRE compliance and XML schemas. Practical sessions reinforce these concepts through hands-on implementation of a WFS service with a custom GML schema.

Students learn about the foundational web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Through practical sessions, students learn to integrate various data delivery methods including WMS, GeoJSON, REST APIs, and vector tiles (MVT). The course will explore of cloud-native geospatial concepts, including STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs), modern data search and access patterns, and exploring a server-side WebGIS implementation through pygeoapi.

A significant component of the course is dedicated to the web mapping project where students apply their knowledge in developing a comprehensive web-based geospatial application. Throughout the course, emphasis is placed on understanding the evolution from traditional SDIs to modern cloud-native approaches, preparing students for both current and emerging geospatial web technologies.
opitulemused_en:
- *	Demonstrate handling of web-based geospatial concepts and technologies. They will understand and implement OGC web services and standards and cloud-native geospatial technologies for mapping, visualising, discovering and sharing spatial datasets.
- *	Have proficiency in spatial metadata management
- *	To know which technologies and services to use for which use cases e.g. visualising spatial data on the web vs analysing feature data.
- *	Have practical skills in both consuming and providing geospatial web services and develop a web mapping application, while understanding the theoretical frameworks that underpin these technologies.

Nende kaudu tutvustatakse ühiskondades olulisi keskkonnaga seotud tegevusi, ideoloogiaid ja praktikaid, keskkonna sotsiaalset ja kultuurilist mõõdet, ühiskondlike protsesside mõju keskkonnale ning keskkonnaprotsesside tagajärgi inimkonnale ja konkreetsete piirkondade elanikele.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of environmental anthropology, focusing on anthropological approaches to nature, ecology, and environmental change. It introduces key historic theories and debates, and contemporary multispecies and posthuman perspectives. Through ethnographic case studies, the course examines how environmental problems such as climate change, pollution, resource extraction, and ecological degradation are experienced, interpreted, and contested across different social and cultural contexts. Special attention is paid to power relations, knowledge systems, and conflicts surrounding environmental governance and sustainability at local, regional, and global levels.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursuse esimeses pooles tutvutakse eesti talupoja maailmakäsitusega modernismieelsel ajal ja moderniseerumise algusajal ning allikatega, mille põhjal saab neid teemasid käsitleda. Arutletakse selle üle, mil moel mõjutasid talurahva elu seadused, regulatsioonid, mõisnike käsud, luterlik õpetus, rahvakombed ja -uskumused ning lojaalsus suguvõsale. Kursuse teises pooles käsitletakse kultuuri, folkloori ja kultuuripärandi mõistete ning etnograafiliste meetodite toel eelkõige identiteediga seotud protsesse tänases Eestis, mida kujundavad ränne, suurenenud mitmesus ja ebavõrdsus ning info- ja kommunikatsioonitehnoloogiad.
kirjeldus_en: The first half of the course introduces to students the world view of Estonian peasants before modernization and in the early modern period and gives an overview of the sources that can be used to explore these topics. The influence of laws, regulations and orders given by the landlords, of Lutheran teaching, folk customs, folk belief, and family loyalty on the life of the peasantry will be discussed. The second half of the course uses the concepts of culture, folklore and cultural heritage for ethnographic explorations of identity-related processes in contemporary Estonia as it is being shaped by migration, increased diversity and inequality as well as information and communication technologies.
opitulemused_en: - Upon successful completion of the course, students will be familiar with concepts, sources and approaches for conceptualising past and present societies through the lens of culture and have practiced using them individually as well as in a group-work setting. Learners are able to distinguish between pre-modern and modern features and to place historic sociocultural processes in Estonia in the broader European context. They also know how to research processes and topics related to identity and migration ethnographically, placing Estonia in the global context characterised by rapid circulation and diversification of people, ideas, objects and information. Students have developed skills required to work with scholarly texts and to express themselves orally and in writing.

kirjeldus_en: The main periods of European theatre history and dramaturgy (the classical antiquity, the middle ages, early modernity, romanticism) are treated. Students write an indepedent assignment on one outstanding drama text considering its historical and aesthetics contexts.

Kursus tutvustab mikrokontrollerite programmeerimise aluseid ja keskendub praktilistele rakendustele Arduino abil. Põhiteemad hõlmavad muutujate, juhtimisstruktuuride, massiivide, katkestuste ning riistvarakomponentide, nagu LED-id, nupud, ekraanid ja prototüüpplaadid, kasutamist.

- - design and execute practical solutions integrating software and hardware concepts.

- * choose and apply correct statistical test to investigate relation btw two variables
- * interpret linear regression model

The course connects knowledge on economic development and regional characteristics with specific cultural aspects.

kirjeldus_en: Overview about multifaceted approach of well-being, theories and different ways of measuring it at the individual and societal level will be given on the course. Well-being in different life domains, such as work, residence, safety, health etc., and their measurement are addressed. It will be possible to get to know how well-being is being measured in different population groups (e.g. children, elderly), regionally and cross-nationally. Predictors and outcomes of well-being are introduced.

- .Student passing this course:
- *       knows well-being multifaceted approach and related concepts (e.g. happiness, quality of life, satisfaction with life).
- *       knows main theories of well-being, including life domain based theories
- *       can bring forth and differentiate indicators' types and their use.
- *       knows the most important indicators of well-being (including life domain based indicators), their possibilites of use and ways of construction.
- *       knows the most important regional, cross-national and population-based well-being indicators, their possibilites of use and ways of construction.
- *      knows the predictors of well-being (including in different life domains).
- *      knows the outcomes of well-being.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Alastair Forbes, Mai Rosenberg, Raili Müller
kirjeldus_et: Kasutatakse erinevaid õpetamismeetodeid. Mitu korda nädalas oodatakse õpilastelt tööd ettevalmistatud kliinilise juhtumi materjali ja kliiniliste andmetega. Õpilastelt oodatakse oma järelduste esitamist individuaalselt ja ka oma rühmaga. Praktiliste näidete põhjal annab kursus seega ülevaate, kuidas kliinilised toitmisspetsialistid saavad oma teadmisi kasutades ja rakendades kaasa aidata raviskeemide optimeerimisele. Nagu varemgi, testitakse õppijaid mitteametlikult lühikeste interaktiivsete viktoriinidega. Siin õpetatakse vedeliku tasakaalu põhimõtteid. Kaalutakse maksa- ja neerupuudulikkusega seotud seisundeid. Uurida nende mõju toitumisseisundile ja alatoitumise mõju haigustele.
kirjeldus_en: Different teaching methods are used. Several times a week, students are expected to work on prepared clinical case material and clinical data. Students are expected to present their findings individually and also as members of their group. Based on practical examples, the module thus provides an overview of how clinical nutritionists can contribute to the optimisation of treatment regimens by using and applying their knowledge. As before, learners are tested informally with short interactive quizzes. The principles of fluid balance are taught here. Conditions associated with hepatic and renal insufficiency are considered for their effects on nutrition and for the effects of malnutrition on the underlying disease.
opitulemused_en:
- The student completing the module:
- * knows about alcohol and its effects on metabolism and nutrition in health and disease
- * understands the nutritional consequences of liver and kidney disease
- * understands the nutritional consequences of abnormal fluid balance in human disease
- * is able to develop a suitable dietary regimen for patients with liver and kidney disease

The subject is introducing the practical work in the radiological department. The students follow the choice, planning, performance of the investigation, the reconstruction process and archiving of the images performed by radiology technicians and radiologists. 
The student follows the radiologist on call consulting radiology technicians and planning and performing the radiological investigations in the emergency department.

- 3.	The student understands the importance of the optimal planning of  investigations in different organ pathology dependant how most optimally and rapidly reach the diagnosis based on radioprotection, age and other risks.

kirjeldus_et:
Keskkonnakeemia kursuses käsitletakse ümbritsevas keskkonnas toimuvaid keemilisi ja füüsikalisi protsesse ning vastastoimeid keskkonnas. Samuti käsitletakse õhus, vees ja pinnases toimuvate biokeemiliste protsesside iseloomu, saasteainete levikut ja sellest tulenevaid keskkonnaprobleeme. Keskkonnas toimuvate keemiliste protsesside käsitlemisel pööratakse erilist tähelepanu mikroorganismide vahendusel kulgevatele redoksprotsessidele, saasteainete biolagundatavuse kriteeriumide määramisele ning keskkonna tingimuste hindamisele, et mõista keskkonnas toimuvate integratiivsete protsesside olemust.
Juba ammutuntud ja läbiuuritud saasteainete käsitlemisel arvutatakse tasakaalulisi kontsentratsioone, õkotoksikoloogilisi näitajaid ning töötlemisparameetreid (3 kohustuslikku kodutööd) ning arutatakse arvutustulemuse mõju keskkonnale. Lisaks viimastele diskuteeritakse globaalsete keskkonnaprobleemide ning moodsate saasteainete leviku ja mõju üle, et arendada erialalist teemapõhist arutelu- ja analüüsioskust. Viimast hinnatakse ka eksamil.
Kursuse käigus koostab üliõpilane mõistekaardi, mille koostamiseks järjestatatakse loovalt, loogiliselt ja jälgitavalt läbianalüüsitud info.  Mõistekaardi koostamisel hinnatakse ka selle tehnilist lahendust.
kirjeldus_en:
Course of environmental chemistry is focused on chemical and physical processes in the environment, also distribution of pollutants in environment. The nature of biochemical processes in air, water and soil, the spread of pollutants and the resulting environmental problems are also addressed. When dealing with chemical processes in the environment, special attention shall be paid to redox processes through micro-organisms, the setting of criteria for the biodegradability of pollutants and the assessment of environmental conditions in order to understand the nature of integrative processes in the environment.
Equilibrium concentrations, ecotoxicological parameters and treatment parameters (3 mandatory homework) are calculated and the effects of the calculation on the environment are discussed when dealing with pollutants that have already been known and studied. In addition to the latter, global environmental issues and the spread and impact of modern pollutants will be discussed in order to develop professional thematic discussion and analysis skills. The latter is also assessed in an exam.
During the course, the student compiles a concept map, for the creation of which the analyzed information is arranged creatively, logically and traceably. When compiling a concept map, its technical solution is also evaluated.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate Aafrika lähiajaloo probleemidest: Aafrika koloniaalajastul, võitlus sõltumatuse eest ning iseseisvunud riikide majandus- ja poliitilised probleemid: majanduslik mahajäämus, poliitiline ebastabiilsus, riigipiiride küsimus jne. Käsitlemist leiavad ka peamised konfliktikolded, Aafrika senised saavutused ja Aafrika osa globaliseeruvas maailmas. Samuti antakse ülevaade tähtsamate riikide ajaloost. Sealhulgas pikemalt peatutakse Lõuna-Aafrika Vabariigi ja Etioopia ajalool.
kirjeldus_en:
The course gives an overview of the problems of African contemporary history: Africa in the colonial period, the struggle
for independence and the political and economical problems of the independent states: the economic backwardness, political instability, the question of nation-state boundaries etc.
The main African conflicts, the achievements of Africa up to the present and the part Africa has in the globalization are discussed as well. Also the history of the most influential African states are introduced, focusing more on the history of Republic of South Africa and Ethiopia.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has passed the course:
- - knows African contemporary history
- - can relate it to the World history

kirjeldus_et: Iga õppepäev sisaldab erinevaid õpetamismeetodeid. Mitu korda nädalas oodatakse üliõpilastelt tööd ettevalmistatud kliinilise juhtumi materjali ja kliiniliste andmetega. Üliõpilastelt oodatakse oma järelduste esitamist individuaalselt ja ka oma rühmaga. Praktiliste näidete põhjal annab kursus seega ülevaate, kuidas kliinilised toitumisspetsialistid saavad oma teadmisi kasutades ja rakendades kaasa aidata raviskeemide optimeerimisele. Nagu varemgi, testitakse õppijaid mitteametlikult lühikeste interaktiivsete viktoriinidega. See moodul hõlmab enamiku hingamisteede ja neuroloogiliste haiguste toitumist. Nad on rühmitatud, kuna nendes tingimustes esineb sageli hüpermetabolismi, kuid kursusematerjal hõlmab ka neid haigusi, kus hüpermetabolism pole peamine omadus.
kirjeldus_en: Each day of study includes a mix of teaching methods. Several times a week, students are expected to work on material and clinical data of prepared clinical cases. Students are expected to present their findings individually and also as members of their group. Based on practical examples, the course thus provides an overview of how clinical nutritionists can contribute to the optimisation of treatment regimens by using and applying their knowledge. As before, learners are tested informally with short interactive quizzes. This module covers the nutrition of most respiratory and neurological diseases. They are grouped together largely because there is hypermetabolism in these conditions, but the course material also covers those diseases where hypermetabolism is not the main feature.
opitulemused_en:
- The student completing the module:
- * understands the pathophysiology associated with hypermetabolism
- * is able to apply this knowledge in understanding the pathophysiology of respiratory and neurological diseases and severe burns
- * understands the science behind the difficulty of assessing the energy needs of these patients
- * knows the necessary nutritional interventions

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus koosneb erinevatest loengutest, seminaridest ja grupitöödest, mida viivad läbi antud uurimisvaldkonnaga tegelevad eksperdid TÜ genoomika instituudist.

1. Biopangad (struktuur, tüübid, õiguslikud alused, kasutamine.
2. Meditsiiniline genoomika (süsteemigenoomika, funktsionaalne genoomika, farmakogenoomika, genoomika rakendamine meditsiinis).
3. Populatsioonigenoomika inimese demograafilise ajaloo ja loodusliku valiku mõju uurimisel inimese tänase geneetilise mitmekesisuse alusel.
4. Geneetiline epidemioloogia.
5. Metagenoomika (inimese mikrobioomiuuringud, mikro- ja metagenoomika andmeanalüüs, iidsed patogeenid).
6. Vana DNA uuringud (arheogenoomika minevikusündmuste erialadeülesel uurimisel, populatsioonide demograafiline ajalugu ja selle seosed keskkondlike muutustega genoomika, arheoloogia ja keeleteaduse perspektiivis).
7. Metaboloomika.
8. Funktsionaalne genoomika.

Kursus tutvustab TÜ GI suuremahulisi genoomika-alaseid teadusprojekte ja annab ülevaate Eesti geenivaramu kasutajaportaali võimalustest ja arendustest.

Kursus annab võimaluse tutvuda teadusprojekti kirjutamise ja taotlemise alustega edasiseks iseseisvaks teadustööks peale doktorikraadi kaitsmist.
kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of various lectures and seminars conducted by different experts of UT Institute of Genomics.

1. Biobanks (structure, types, legal bases, implementation.
2. Medical Genomics (system genetics, functional genomics, pharmacogenomics, translation to medical outcome).
3. Population Genomics (inferring past demographic and selection events from present-day genetic variation).
4. Genetic Epidemiology.
5. Metagenomics (relationships between human microbiome and health, applications of microbiome in medicine, ancient pathogens and metagenomics).
6. Ancient DNA Studies (archaeogenomics and transdisciplinary studies of past, using data of ancient DNA, archaeology and linguistics).
7. Metabolomics.
8. Functional Genomics.

The course introduces large-scale genomics research projects at the University of Tartu and provides an overview of the functionalities and developments of the Estonian Biobank's user portal.

The course provides an opportunity to become acquainted with the fundamentals of writing and applying for research projects for further independent research after defending a doctoral degree.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student has:
- Basic knowledge of main directions and developments in genomics in the following fields:
1. Biobanks
2. Medical Genomics
3. Population Genomics
4. Genetic Epidemiology
5. Metagenomics
6. Ancient DNA Studies
7. Metabolomics/Proteomics
8. Functional Genomics

The student has familiarized themselves with the basics of designing and writing a research project and with the aspects of its assessment.

The knowledge and skills acquired from theoretical lectures and reading tasks are practically applied for conducting qualitative research: students plan the research (formulate the aim of the research and research questions), conduct data collection, use thematic and content analysis methods and write a short report.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has completed the course
- - Knows the main characteristics of a qualitative research method and can make an argumentative choice for it based on the research problem and the theoretical paradigm
- - Follows the ethical principles of qualitative research in research planning, data collecting and data analysis and is aware of the researcher's responsibility
- - Knows different qualitative data collection methods and uses them
- - Can use the basic methods of qualitative data analysis and write the analysis
- - Knows how to evaluate results of qualitative analysis

kirjeldus_et:
Erinevad allikad ennustavad, et 2030. aasta lõpuks jõuab nutikate ja võrku ühendatud seadmete hulk 50-100 miljardini. Seoses hiljutise suure hinnalangusega võrgutehnoloogiates ja juhtmevabade mikrokontrollerite, andurite, aktuaatorite suurenenud kättesaadavusega on antud valdkonnas potentsiaal massilisteks ärivõimalusteks ja innovatsiooniks. See on Asjade Interneti tärkamine.

Antud aines uurime lähemalt, mida hõlmab endast Asjade Internet ning selle taga olevad jõud, selle mõju. Kogeme seda praktiliselt, ehitades ning leiutades uusi seadmeid. Õpime ka, kuidas integreerida neid seadmeid süsteemidesse ja võrkudesse. Süsteemidisainil on oluline osa selles õppeaines.

Kuna disainiprotsess on keeruline, vaatame praegusi masinaside (machine-to-machine) suhtlustehnoloogiaid kui ka raamistikke ning raamistike arendamist. Katame  ka majanduslikke väljavaateid selles valdkonnas, proovime neid ka ennustada. Õpime kriitiliselt reflekteerima, hindama ning rakendama olemasolevaid lahendusi enda innovatiivsete lahenduste realiseerimiseks.

Praktikumides vaatame nii väikesemahulisi tee-seda-ise (DIY) lahendusi, mida võiks kasutada ära meie vahetus keskkonnas, kui arutame ka võimalikke rakendusi ja mõju tööstuses. Kogu klassiruumis toimuv töö, sh nii luhtumised kui ka edulood dokumenteeritakse isiklikus portfoolios, mida saab ära kasutada tulevikus tööotsinguil ning mis on ka põhiliseks hindamise aluseks aines.

Aine hõlmab järgnevaid tehnoloogiaid: ESP8266/ESP32 arendus, Arduino, Kommunikatsiooniprotokollid (RS232,  I2C, SPI, MQTT, HTTPS), NodeRED, IoT, IoTempower.
kirjeldus_en:
Depending on the sources, 50-100 billion smart and networked connected devices are expected to be in use by the end of 2030. Due to recent massive price decreases in connectivity technology and availability of wireless microcontrollers, sensors, and actors, this area has potential for massive economic opportunity and disruption. This is the rise of the Internet of Things.

In this class, we will further investigate what the Internet of Things entails and its driving forces and impact. We will experience this hands-on by building and inventing new devices. We will also learn how to integrate and network these devices into systems. System design will be a significant part of this class.

As this design is a difficult process, we will look at the current machine-to-machine communication technologies as well as frameworks and framework development. We will also cover and try to forecast economic opportunities in this domain. We will learn to critically reflect, assess, and employ the solutions available to develop our own creative solutions.

In our practical labs, we will look both at small DIY solutions which could be employed and enrich our direct environment, but also discuss potential industrial applications and impact. All in-class work including failures and successes will be recorded in a personal portfolio, which may serve as a reference for future job applications and will be the main element of assessment.

The class covers the following technologies/technology stacks: ESP8266/ESP32 development, Arduino, Communication protocols (RS232,  I2C, SPI, MQTT, HTTPS), NodeRED, IoT, IoTempower.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who successfully completes the course:
- -Can design, assemble, and build IoT system prototypes involving sensing and actuating devices.
- -Knows how to ensure scalability to a large number of devices in an IoT system, considering energy efficiency and ease of management.
- -Is able to use IoT Integration systems to rapidly prototype and monitor IoT systems.

hindamise_meetod: To pass the course 70% of the respective in-class tasks have to be successfully covered and assessed in the portfolio.

kirjeldus_en: The subject focuses on providing students with the necessary leadership and communication skills for future natural and exact science teachers, an understanding of the nature of science, and an overview of modern teaching methods in teaching natural and exact science in a general education school. Special attention is paid to the learner's own development, supporting self-analysis and self-management skills. The whole learning process is supported by the Moodle course and includes practical activities that enable collaboration and support creativity in order to understand the essence and specifics of teaching and to support the learner's own development.
opitulemused_en:
- 1. The learner is aware of and values the profession of natural and exact science teacher, together with the knowledge, skills and attitudes required.
- 2. The learner has developed the necessary presentation and leadership skills for the teacher through practical activities that support creativity.
- 3. The learner is aware of modern approaches to teaching at the basic school and upper secondary school level.
- 4. The learner has developed the necessary self-management skills and the ability to plan their future careers.

Reading and writing different file types, compiling different dictionaries (frequency, collocations), and applying simple language processing methods. Simple web scraping (concepts, necessary packages, HTML parsing). Encodings.

- - knows how to use nested data structures and for-loops

- - learns how to perform simple operations on strings and texts
- - learns to write regular expressions
- - learns how to read data from a corpus, compile different dictionaries (frequency, collocations) and apply basic language processing methods
- - learns simple web scraping

kirjeldus_et: Kõrgema matemaatika kursus, milles käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid: maatriksid, determinandid, lineaarvõrrandisüsteemid, funktsioonid, funktsiooni piirväärtus ja pidevus, jadad, funktsiooni tuletis ja diferentsiaal, määramata integraal, määratud integraal, päratud integraalid, lineaarsed I järku diferentsiaalvõrrandid, vektorid ruumis, skalaarkorrutis, vektorkorrutis, sirgeda ja tasandid ruumis, kompleksarvud.
kirjeldus_en: Linearalgebra. Functions, limits and continuity. Derivatives and applications of derivatives. Antiderivatives, linear first order differential equations. Definite integrals and their applications, improper integrals. Vectors in space, their dot and vector product. Lines and planes in space. Complex numbers.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing this course the student:
- 1. Knows definitions of matrix, inverse matrix; is able to multiplicate matrices and find inverse matrix. Knows properties of determinants, is able to evaluate determinants.
- 2. Is able to solve systems of linear equations.
- 3. Knows the definition of the function and general classes of functions and their graphs.
- 4. Is familiar with the main properties of the limit, is able to find limits. Knows, what is continous function.
- 5. Is familiar with the notions of the derivative, the differential; is able to find derivatives and differentials; knows the most important applications of derivatives.
- 6. Knows the l'Hospital rule and knows how to use it;
- 7. Knows how to investigate functions, when they are decreasing/increasing and curved/concave.
- 8. Knows, what is antiderivates and how to find them in simpler case.
- 9. Is able to solve linear first order ordinary differential equations.
- 10. Knows, what is a Riemann sum and how to calculate it.
- 11. Knows applications of definite integral.
- 12. Knows, what is improper integral and how to find it.
- 13. Is able to find vectors dot product, cross product, triple product in space and knows their applications.
- 14. Is able to construct equation formulas for lines and planes in space, find their position.
- 15. Knows complex numbers, their algebraic, geometric and trigonometric formulas, unary and binary operations of them, knows the Euler Formula.
- 16. Chooses suitable mathematical conceptions (formulae) for problems, and applies these conceptions while solving problems.

kirjeldus_et:
Kestlik hambaravi on tänapäeva tervishoiu oluline osa, mis keskendub keskkonnasäästlikkuse ja ühiskondliku vastutuse integreerimisele hambaravi praktikas. Kursuse eesmärk on anda ülevaade kestliku hambaravi põhimõtetest, sealhulgas energia- ja ressursitõhususest, jäätmete ning süsiniku jalajälje vähendamise võimalustest hambaravikliinikutes.
Kursus hõlmab teemasid, nagu hambaravi süsiniku jalajälje hindamine, materjalide elutsükli analüüs, jäätmekäitlus, patsiendi ja personali keskkonnateadlikkuse suurendamine ning roheliste algatuste elluviimine igapäevases töös. Osalejad saavad teadmisi ja praktilisi tööriistu, kuidas rakendada oma igapäevapraktikas keskkonnasäästlikke meetodeid, vähendades samal ajal kulusid ja tõstes kliiniku mainet.
Kursus valmistab hambaarste ja hambaravi spetsialistid ette teadlike ja vastutustundlike otsuste tegemiseks, et saaksite vähendada oma praktika keskkonnamõju ja panustada kestlikumasse tervishoidu.
kirjeldus_en:
Sustainable dentistry is an essential part of modern healthcare, focusing on integrating environmental sustainability and social responsibility into dental practice. This course aims to provide an overview of sustainable dentistry principles, including improving energy and resource efficiency, reducing waste, and minimizing the carbon footprint within dental clinics.
The course covers topics such as assessing the carbon footprint of dental care, analyzing the life cycle of materials, managing waste, increasing environmental awareness among patients and staff, and implementing green initiatives. Participants will gain knowledge and practical tools on how to apply eco-friendly methods in daily practice, reducing costs while enhancing the clinic's reputation.
Ultimately, this course prepares dentists and dental professionals to make informed and responsible decisions to lessen their practice's environmental impact and contribute to a more sustainable healthcare system.
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, students will be able: 
- to understand and apply the principles of sustainable development in their daily dental practice 
- will be aware of their role in protecting the environment and will be able to make informed choices that contribute to the sustainability of the dental sector

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus jaguneb temaatiliselt kolmeks:
1) Institutsioon - mis roll on ajakirjandusel ja kommunikatsioonil ühiskonnas.
2) Uudise alused ehk kust tuleb uudiste kontseptsioon ning kuidas uudisväärtuslikku materjali leida ja vormistada lugudeks.
3) Töörutiinid ja igapäevapraktikad ehk kuidas töötavad ajakirjandusväljaanded ning kuidas see on oluline kommunikatsioonitöös.

Loengu- ja kodutöödes:
*Harjutatakse iganädalaselt eesti ja välisuudiste süstemaatilist ja pidevat jälgimist.
*Kinnistatakse loengutes omandatud faktiteadmisi iganädalase kohapealse teadmistekontrolliga, mis aitab valmistuda lõpueksamiks.
*Õpitakse ära tundma uudisväärtuslikku materjali fookuse leidmise, uudisloo plaani koostamise ja uudise kirjutamise kaudu.
*Harjutatakse teksti toimetamist.
*Proovitakse toimetada uudist erinevatele platvormidele. 

Igal kohtumisel on põgus teadmistekontroll, loengu osa ning praktiline ülesanne või kohtumine külalisesinejaga.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is thematically divided into three:
1) Institution - what is the role of journalism and communication in society?
2) The basics of news, i.e., where does the concept of news come from and how to find newsworthy material and shape it into stories.
3) Work routines and daily practices, i.e. how newsrooms function and how this is important in communication work.

In lectures and homework:
*Students practice ystematic and continuous monitoring of Estonian and foreign news is practiced weekly.
*The factual knowledge acquired in the lectures is fixed with a weekly on-site knowledge test, which helps to prepare for the final exam.
*Students learn to recognize newsworthy material by finding a focus, planning a news story, and writing a news story.
*Students practice editing.
*Students exercise to repackage the news for different platforms.

Each meeting has a short knowledge test, a lecture part, and a practical task or meeting with a guest speaker.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student:
- 1) understands the role of journalism and communication in society,
- 2) recognizes newsworthy information,
- 3) is used to systematically follow the news in Estonia and abroad,
- 4) knows how to format newsworthy information into news and press releases in text-based media, radio and television.

Õppijad harjutavad psühholoogilisi põhioskusi  ja õpivad nende õpetamist teistele. Kursuse käigus töötatakse välja psühholoogiliste oskuste treenimise programme ja planeeritakse nende mõjususe hindamist.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the aims and methods of developing psychological skills in sport and performance. Students will practice basic psychological skills and learn how to teach them to others. During the course, psychological skills training programs will be developed, and assessments of their effectiveness will be planned.
eeldusained: (SVPH.00.073 "Spordi- ja soorituspsühholoogia") VÕI (KKSP.03.047 "Sissejuhatus spordi- ja liikumispsühholoogiasse")
opitulemused_en:
- Students will be able to
- 1.	explain the aims, principles, and limitations of basic psychological skills training in the context of developing and supporting athletic and other types of performance,
- 2.	select appropriate methods for training basic psychological skills,
- 3.	design intervention programs for developing basic psychological skills in their primary performance setting,
- 4.	apply the main techniques of learning and teaching basic psychological skills,
- 5.	plan the assessment of the effectiveness of a psychological skills training program.

hindamise_meetod:
Hinne kujuneb järgmiselt: 
1. Individuaalse valmisoleku testid kuni 15 punkti. 
2. Meeskondliku valmisoleku testid kuni 7 punkti. 
3. Praktilised ülesanded praktikumides kuni 14 punkti. 
4. Meeskondliku vaimsete oskuste arendamise sekkumiskava koosamine ja kaitsmine kuni 21 punkti. 
5. Individuaalne kirjalik juhtumianalüüs kuni 25 punkti. 
6. Meeskonnasise vastastikhndamine kuni 13 punkti. 

Kokku on kursuse vältel võimalik koguda 100 punkti ja kogutud punktisumma avaldub hindena järgnevalt: 
A (90-100 p) - õppija valdab suurepäraselt psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu planeerimise, läbiviimise ja hindamise oskusi ning orienteerub väga hästi psühholoogilist treeningut puudutavates mõistetes ja faktiteadmistes. 
B (80-89 p) - õppija valdab väga hästi psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu planeerimise, läbiviimise ja hindamise oskusi ning orienteerub hästi psühholoogilist treeningut puudutavates mõistetes ja faktiteadmistes. 
C (70-79 p) - õppijal on psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu planeerimiseks, läbiviimiseks ja hindamiseks piisavad oskused ning ta omab olulisi teadmisi psühholoogilist treeningut puututavate mõistete ja faktide kohta.
D (60-69 p) - õppija oskused psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu planeerimisel, läbiviimisel ja hindamisel on rahuldavad, tema teadmised psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningust on fragmentaarsed. 
E (50-59 p) - õppija psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu alased oskused on tagasihoidlikud ja tema teadmised teemast on kasinad. 
F (49 või vähem punkti) - õppija oskused ja teadmised on adekvaatse psühholoogiliste oskuste treeningu kavandamiseks ja hindamiseks ebapiisavad.

nimi_en: Europe-Centred World System in the 1500s-1600s: Expansion, Integration, Crisis
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus antakse süvendatud ülevaade Lääne- ja Kirde-Euroopa tuumik- ja olulisemate perifeersete riikide poliitilistest, ühiskondlikest ja majanduslikest protsessidest varauusajal. Loengutes käsitletakse Euroopa kahe majandusregiooni - Vahemeri ning Põhja- ja Läänemeri - kujunemist, peamisi arengujooni ja allakäiku põhjusi; majanduskeskuste nihkumist Vahemerelt Põhjamerele; Euroopa-keskse maailma kujunemist; Lääne-Euroopa erinevate mereriikide (Madalmaad, Inglismaa ja Prantsusmaa) mõju maailma majandusele, sh kaubandusele ja meresõidule; koloniaalmaailma tekkimist; rahvusriikide sünde ja üleminekut riigi- ja rahamajandusele; hindade revolutsiooni, selle põhjusi ja laiemat mõju riikide majandusele; peamisi majandusliku mõtte suundi.
kirjeldus_en: It gives an overview of the economic, social and political developments in the core and some most important peripheral states in western and north-western Europe in the Early Modern Age. It focuses on two European economic regions - Mediterranean and North and Baltic Sea region. It discusses their rise, essential features and the reasons for their decline. Other topics include the shift of economic centres from South to North (North Sea region); the rise of Europe-centred world system; the impact of the Netherlands, Great Britain and France on world economy (trade and seafaring); the beginning of the colonial era; the emergence of nations states and their transition to state and money economy; price revolution, its causes and effects on the economy, and the evolution of economic thought.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- The student has a deeper understanding of Western and North-Eastern-European core and major peripheral states and their political, social and economic processes during the Early Modern Period (16th-17th century).

nimi_et: Eesti poliitika: ideed, institutsioonid ja ajalugu
nimi_en: Estonian Politics: Ideas, Institutions and History
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab ülevaate sellest, kuidas on arenenud poliitilised süsteemid, institutsioonid ja ideoloogiad Eesti alal 19. sajandi II poolest kuni 2000. aastate alguseni. Kursuse käigus püütakse mõista tänase Eesti riigi ja ühiskonna kujunemislugu.
Kesksete teemade hulgas on eesti rahvusliku liikumise areng ja rahvusriigi idee muutumine, poliitiliste ideoloogiate retseptsioon, poliitiliste erakondade kujunemine ja areng, eri poliitilised süsteemid ja demokraatia debatid, õigusliku järjepidevuse ideed ja Eesti kui siirderiik. Igal nädalal on tudengitel võimalus süveneda ka ühte konkreetsesse juhtumiuuringusse, mis aitab üldteemat sügavamalt mõista.
kirjeldus_en:
The course provides an overview of how political systems, institutions and ideologies have developed in the Estonian territory from the second half of the 19th century to the early 2000s. Overall, the course seeks to understand the history of the formation of the Estonian state and society today.
Among the central themes are the development of the Estonian national movement and the evolving idea of nation-statehood, the reception of political ideologies, the formation and development of political parties, different political systems and debates on democracy, ideas of legal continuity, and Estonia as a transition state. Each week, students will also have the opportunity to delve deeper into a specific case study, which will contribute to a deeper understanding of the overall theme.

kirjeldus_et: See kursus katab retoorika, kontrastse retoorika ja kriitilise kontrastse retoorika ning koostamisteooria ja -praktika teemad. See käsitleb inglise keele ja teiste keelte (võrdlev aspekt) eneseväljenduse võrdlemisega seotud küsimusi. See lähtub erinevatest retoorikaga, tähendusega, strukturalismiga, keelega, teadusega ja fiktsiooniga seotud teooriatest ja filosoofiatest. Esimeseks lahkumispunktiks on retoorika üldine mõistmine ja selle roll tähenduse ehituses kõnes ja tekstis. Puudutab mitmekultuurilisust, mitmekülgsust, translinguaalsust, võrdlevat keelt, fiktsiooni ja tähendust.
kirjeldus_en: This course will cover the topic of Rhetoric, Contrastive Rhetoric, and Critical Contrastive Rhetoric and Composition theory and practice, Artificial intelligence rhetoric. It covers issues related to comparing self-expression in English vs other languages (comparative aspect). It departs from various theories and philosophies related to rhetoric, meaning, structuralism, language, science, and fiction The first departure point is to understand rhetoric in general and the role it plays in constructing meaning in speech and text. Touches on multiculturalism, multilingualism, translingualism, comparative language, fiction, and meaning.
opitulemused_en:
- - Develop students' understanding of rhetoric as a field of study and its relevance to contemporary communication practices
- - Enhance students' ability to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of spoken and written arguments
- - Foster students' ability to construct compelling arguments in both oral and written forms
- - Encourage students' critical thinking skills and ability to engage in constructive dialogue with diverse perspectives

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse eesmärk on anda ülevaade ja põhiteadmised Norra ajaloost, Norra kultuurist ning selle arengust kuni tänapäevani. Kursus selgitab Norra kultuuri peamisi aspekte ja käsitleb nende väljendumist kirjanduses, keeles, kunstis ning teistes kultuuri- ja ühiskonnavaldkondades. Üliõpilastel on võimalus esitleda teemasid, mis on seotud nende enda huvidega.
Kursus pakub üliõpilastele süstematiseeritud ülevaadet protsessidest, mis on sajandite jooksul kujundanud Norra vaimset ja kultuurilist arengut. Lähenemine on mitteametlik ja võrdlev ning kursus hõlmab selliseid teemasid nagu Põhjala mütoloogia, religioon, kunst, õigussüsteem ja erinevad kirjandusžanrid.
kirjeldus_en:
The aim of the course is to provide an overview and fundamental knowledge of the history of Norway, Norwegian culture, and its development up to the present day. The course explains key aspects of Norwegian culture and explores their expression in literature, language, art, and other fields of culture and society. Students will have the opportunity to present topics related to their own interests.
The purpose of the course is to offer students a systematised overview of the processes that have shaped the intellectual and cultural development of Norway over the centuries. The approach is informal and comparative, and the course covers elements such as Norse mythology, religion, art, the legal system, and a variety of literary genres.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course the student
- - has acquired culture-specific knowledge about Norway and Norwegian society,
- - understands key historical events and cultural developments that have shaped modern Norway,
- - can apply knowledge of Norwegian culture in an academic context.

kirjeldus_et: See kursus on mõeldud üliõpilastele, kes on huvitatud kosmosetehnoloogiast ja satelliitide ja maapealsete süsteemide küberturvalisuse rakendustest. Kursuse jooksul omandavad üliõpilased teoreetilised teadmised kosmosetehnoloogiaga seotud küberturvalisuse probleemide kohta, õpivad rakendama turvalisuse kavandamise põhimõtet, omandavad teadmisi küberturvalisuse meetodite kohta ja tutvuvad praeguste kosmosesüsteemide küberturvalisuse tipptasemel meetoditega. Lisaks lahendavad üliõpilased kord kahe nädala jooksul Space Cyber Range'is praktilisi harjutusi.
kirjeldus_en: This course is for students interested in space technology and cybersecurity applications for satellite and ground systems. During the course, students will gain theoretical knowledge about space technology-related cybersecurity problems, learn how to apply the security-by-design principle, acquire knowledge in cybersecurity methods, and become familiar with current state-of-the-art methods for space system cybersecurity. In addition, students will participate in bi-weekly practical exercises based at the Space Cyber Range.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing this course, the participants will have knowledge in
- - cybersecurity basics
- - satellite system cybersecurity basics
- - ground station cybersecurity basics
- - cyber attack threats and vectors
- - cyber defence principles, incident response, and penetration testing
- - cryptography methods
- - latest cybersecurity trends and practical experience in
- - communicating with the satellite
- - scheduling communication with a satellite
- - probing the mission control system for information
- - finding proof of the system being attacked and hacked
- - investigating attacks on the ground station and satellite
- - preventing future attacks and hardening the system

Kursus annab ülevaate liikuvuse ja transpordiplaneerimise olulisematest teemadest: ruumiline planeerimine versus transpordiplaneerimine, transpordigeograafia ja modelleerimine, liikuvus ja kättesaadavus jt. Antakse ülevaade säästlikest liikumisviisidest ja inimmõõtmemise linnaruumi planeerimisest. Liikuvuse ja transpordiplaneerimist käsitletakse seoses füüsilise ja sotsiaalse keskkonnaga ning hinnatakse mõjusid keskkonna ja inimese tervisele ning ebavõrdsusele.  
Kursuse käigus analüüsitakse liikuvusuuringuid, planeeringuid ja strateegiaid ning koostatakse rühmatööna liikuvusuuring ja liikuvuslahenduse plaan.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of the most important topics of mobility and transport planning: spatial planning versus transport planning, transport geography and modeling, mobility and accessibility, etc. An overview of sustainable mobility and urban spatial planning is provided. Mobility and transport planning are linked to the physical and social environment and the effects on the environment and human health, as well as inequalities are assessed. During the course, mobility studies, plans and strategies are analyzed and a students prepare mobility study and mobility solution plan as a groupwork.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus koosneb loengutest, seminaridest ja iseseisvast tööst (sh seminari ettevalmistamine). Käsitletakse bakterite taksonoomilisi rühmi, klassifitseerimise teoreetilisi aluseid ja mikroobide identifitseerimist. Antakse ülevaade kaasaegsest süsteemist ja mikroobide mitmekesisusest. Seminarides koostab iga üliõpilane ettekande uue bakteri või arhe liigi (või perekonna) kirjeldamise kohta ja kannab selle ka ette. Iga üliõpilane on retsensendiks ühele kaasüliõpilase ettekandele. Ettekanne koostatakse võõrkeelse (enamasti inglisekeelse) teadusliku artikli baasil. Selleks pannakse Moodle kausta artiklid, mille hulgast üliõpilased saavad endale valida teema. Üliõpilane võib artikli ka ise otsida.
kirjeldus_en: The course consists of lectures and seminars. Overview of the diversity of bacteria will be given. Principles of phylogenetic systematics of prokaryotes as well as tests and characteristics for classification and identification will be introduced. For that, seminars will be held. At the seminars, every student makes a presentation on description of a new taxon (species or genus) of bacteria or archaea. Presentations should rely on a scientific paper. Respective material (publications) will be uploaded to Moodle. Students may also search the material for presentation themselves. The presentations will be evaluated and students participate in the evaluation.

opitulemused_en: - The students get the overview of principles and methods of characterization and classification of prokaryotes, bacteria and archaea. Additional experience on preparing a slideshow and presenting it at the seminar are obtained.

nimi_en: Optimization for Robot Motion Planning and Control
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Amith Manoharan, Arun Kumar Singh, Simon Idoko
kirjeldus_et:
Kursusel käsitletakse teoreetilist ja programmeerimisalust matemaatilise optimeerimise teooria kasutamist roboti liikumise planeerimisel ja juhtimisel.
Kursusel tutvustatakse optimeerimisteooria matemaatilisi kontseptsioone ja kuidas see seostub robotiga
juhtimisega. Kursusel õpetatakse kirjutama koode optimeerimise probleemide lahendamiseks  Pythoni-põhiste arvalgebra teekide kasutamisel. Kursusel on ainult ülesanded, projektid ja seminarid. Tavalisi eksameid ei tehta.
kirjeldus_en:
The course will introduce mathematical concepts of optimization theory and how it relates to robot
control and machine learning. The course will teach how to write codes for solving optimization
problems using Python-based numerical algebra libraries. The course will only have assignments,
projects and seminars. There will be no conventional exams.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. Learn different optimization techniques such as gradient descent, quadratic
programming, Gauss- Newton method etc.
2. Formulate robot motion planning and control as optimization problems and use different
optimizers on that.
3. Learn to use different open-source optimization solvers.
4. Learn to use Python (Numpy, Jax) to solve optimization problems.
5. Test motion planning algorithms in simulation and hardware.
hindamise_meetod:
Grading will be done based on assignments, projects and seminar performances. Each
assignment/project/seminar will carry points, and the grading will be decided on the total points
accumulated throughout the semester.

nimi_en: Hands-on-Training on Optical Instrumentation: Imaging systems, Interferometry and Holography
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Agnes Pristy Ignatius Xavier, Aravind Simon John Francis Rajeswary, Francis Gracy Arockiaraj, Shivasubramanian Gopinath, Vijayakumar Anand
kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab praktilise väljaõppe optomehaaniliste komponentide kasutamiseks optiliste seadistuste - pildindus- ja holograafiasüsteemide ning interferomeetrite - ehitamise ja optimeerimise ning nendega mõõtmiste tegemise kaudu.
kirjeldus_en:
The course will provide hands-on training on opto-mechanical components, building optical set ups such as imaging and holography systems and interferometers, optimizing them and making measurements.
The course is predominantly experimental with informative lectures to describe the theory and concepts of the respective optical instrumentation.
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, the student has
- *	Knowledge on safely handling optical components and light sources.
- *	Knowledge on the functions of various light sources, passive and active optical components.
- *	Knowledge of various opto-mechanical components.
- *	Skills to build optical setups using optical and opto-mechanical components on optical table.
- *	Knowledge and skills to build a microscope, telescope, interferometers and holography system on optical table.
- *	Knowledge and skills to make measurements using image sensor and extract useful information.

Võtab analüüsi alla erinevad aktuaalsed biokeemiaga seotud teemad ning püüab avada õppijate aktiivsel osalusel nende keemilise olemuse. Toob esile nende protsesside kirjeldamiseks ja uurimiseks vajalikud seosed teiste keemia ja füüsika kitsamate erialadega. kirjeldus_en:
The course gives a general understanding of biochemical reactions and pathways. The main attention will be paid to the involvement of other fields of chemistry and physics in biochemical studies.	
Highlights the connections between other fields of chemistry and physics with biochemical processes. The exact topics of the seminars will be decided at the very beginning of the semester, based on the topics currently on the agenda in society, and which are related to bioorganic chemistry.
.
opitulemused_en:
- The student who passed the course successfully:
- -	Has a systematic knowledge of the structures of the main biomolecules and is able to evaluate their chemical properties.
- -	knows general pathways of biomolecule metabolism;
- -	Knows basic chemical and biological principles of metabolism and is able to use this knowledge in the analysis of various biochemical processes
- -	Can present and defend the results of these analyzes to the wider public.
- -	Has knowledge about the latest trends in the applications of biochemistry and biotechnology in industry and everyday life.

kirjeldus_en:
Course Topics:

Introduction to Positive Psychology
Cultural Differences
Measurement and Classification in Positive Psychology
The Impact of Culture on Strength Development and Living a Good Life
The Good Life Across the Lifespan
Positive Emotions and Happiness
The Nature and Role of Emotions
Self-Efficacy, Hope, and Optimism
Wisdom and Courage
Mindfulness, Flow, and Spirituality
Empathy and the Ego
Close Relationships and Their Role in Well-Being
Avoiding the Bad and Promoting the Good
Education and Work in the Context of Positive Psychology
The Future and Perspectives on Well-Being
The Body in Positive Psychology
Applications and Interventions
opitulemused_en:
- Course Objectives:
- 1) Understand the foundations and theoretical frameworks of positive psychology
Students will explain what positive psychology is, how it differs from traditional psychology, and identify its main research areas (e.g., well-being, strengths, optimism, meaning).
- 2) Analyze the components of well-being and flourishing from a scientific perspective
Students will be able to describe and compare models such as subjective well-being and psychological well-being, and understand how these relate to quality of life and mental health.
- 3) Apply knowledge to assess human strengths and virtues
Students will learn about methods for assessing strengths and be able to discuss how developing strengths supports flourishing.
- 4) Critically evaluate positive psychology interventions and applications
Students will analyze which interventions (e.g., gratitude exercises, optimism training) are scientifically validated and in which contexts they are effective.
- 5) Integrate positive psychology knowledge into personal and professional development
Students will reflect on how the course content can help shape their lifestyle, work practices, or relationships to promote well-being and meaningfulness.

kirjeldus_en: The course provides an overview of neurological patient's mental health problems, neurological problems caused by substance abuse, specifics of nutrition, speech therapy treatment and additional treatment methods in neurological physiotherapy. The course deepens practical skills and knowledge of interventions for chronic neurological diseases and discusses their impact on patients' important others.
opitulemused_en:
- A student
- 1. Can recognize the most common mental health problems that accompany neurological diseases in both the patient and their important others and is able to intervene if necessary.
- 2. Understands the importance of teamwork and the treatment methods of different specialists in neurological physiotherapy.
- 3. Uses evidence-based and the latest intervention strategies in neurological physiotherapy.
- 4. Knows and analyzes various complementary therapies used in neurological physiotherapy.
- 5. Critically evaluates neurological patient's therapy plan.
- 6. Plans and documents patient therapy of progressive or chronic neurological disease using evidence-based physiotherapy.
- 7. Describes and applies assessment and intervention methods (including facilitation techniques for transfers) in patients with stroke and Parkinson`s disease.
- 8. Describes the differences in physiotherapeutic intervention of stroke patients with and with-out pusher-syndrome.
