kirjeldus_et:
Raviainete metabolism on nende keemiline muundumine elusorganismis. Selle lõppeesmärgiks on enamasti lipofiilsete kehavõõraste ainete muutmine paremini kehast väljaviidavateks polaarsemateks ühenditeks. Metabolismi kiirus on üks tähtsamaid tegureid, mis määrab ära ravimite toime kestuse ja intensiivsuse. 
Kursuse käigus tutvutakse raviaine biotransformatsiooniga inimese organismis. Käsitletakse metabolismireaktsioonide mehhanisme nii keemilise reaktsiooni kui organsüsteemi tasandil.
kirjeldus_en: Drug metabolism is the biochemical modification of pharmaceutical substances by living organisms. This is a form of xenobiotic metabolism that often converts lipophilic chemical compounds into more readily excreted polar products. Its rate is an important determinant of the duration and intensity of the pharmacological action of drugs. During the course students are introduced to the biotransformation mechanisms in human organism focused both on chemical reactions and organ systems.

opitulemused_en:
- The student that graduated the course
- - knows the main biotransformation pathways of pharmaceutical substances
- - is able to forecast accordingly to chemical structure of the molecule the possible metabolic changes of a pharmaceutical substance
- - understands the influence of different factors on the metabolism of pharmaceutical substances
- - applies the obtained information in professional communication with patients and specialists

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab sissejuhatava  ülevaate tänapäeva astronoomiast, rõhutades muu hulgas selle ajalugu ja kultuurilist tähendust. Ilma keeruka matemaatikata saab ettekujutuse, millised on planeedid ja nende kaaslased, tähed ja täheparved, galaktikad ja nende parved; kui suur  ja vana on Universum jne. Räägime tähtede erilisest rollist Universumis, aga ka sellest, et me näeme ja tunneme vaevalt 5 protsenti Universumi tegelikust koostisest. Mõtiskleme elu  võimalikkusest Universumis, aga ka ohtudest elule. Samas näivad looduse konstandid ja seadused kuidagi eriliselt sobivat selleks, et Universumis -- või hoopis multiversumis? -- saaks tekkida mõistusega Vaatleja ehk inimene. Räägime astronoomiast Eestis ja mujal maailmas  ning sellest, kuidas astronoomilised teadmised varjatult meie igapäevaelus esinevad.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an introductory overview of our present knowledge about the Universe, in particular historical and cultural context of astronomy. Without sophisticated mathematics, a basic knowledge about planets, stars, stellar clusters, galaxies etc. will be given. We will  tell about specific role of stars in the Universe, while we actually know only 5 per cent of the real content of the Universe. We will discuss possibility of life in the Universe as well as threats to the life. The constants and laws of the nature, however, seem specially favourable for emerging life and conscious human observer in the Universe -- or perhaps in the multiverse? We will also tell about astronomy in Estonia and other countries and about hidden role of astronomy in everyday life.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After the course the student:
- has basic knowledge about structure, size, evolution of the planets, stars, galaxies etc.
- understands the nature of astronomy as a science and its methods and facilities
- knows historical background of astronomy
- is prepared to contemplate on the role of life and man in the Universe

Learners are given basic knowledge of the need and principles of ensuring the safety of the working environment.

Peamised vestlus- ja grammatikateemad: 

Harjutame palju reaalseid suhtlusolukordi, arendame sõnavara, mida võid vajada "kohe täna" Rootsi õppima v elama asudes ning Rootsit külastades.

kirjeldus_en:
In addition to the textbook materials and activities, we focus on everyday language use and practise vocabulary you need when settling in Sweden for studies, business or life. Also vocabulary for work situations, Business Swedish and communication will be practised.

Vocabulary: family and relatives, describing people, shopping, writing a letter, customs and traditions, sports. The Swedish culture and society. We shall also learn some introductory basics in Swedish business culture and business vocabulary, discuss the Swedish meeting style, and watch and analyse some relevant videos and video-clips along the way.

Grammar: irregular verbs; Preteritum, Perfekt, Pluskvamperfekt - formation and use. Adjectives and adverbs. Expressions of time. Word order in subordinate clauses. The definite declension of the adjective in outline and adjectival nouns. Modal verbs. S-verbs: reciprocal, deponent and passive. Reflexive verbs and pronouns. Present and past participles. Comparison of adjectives. Transitive and intransitive verbs. Compound verbs. Affixation. Passives. Abbreviations.

Analüüsitakse füsioloogiliste ohutegurite mõju füsioteraapia protsessile ning tutvutakse ergonoomiliste kohanduste ja tööfüsioterapeutiliste lahendustega. Antakse ülevaade tööga seotud skeletilihassüsteemi kaebustest, nende füsioterapeutilisest käsitlusest, käeteraapia baastehnikatest ning töötervishoiu ja tööalase rehabilitatsiooni korraldusest Eestis.
kirjeldus_en: The course "Occupational Physiotherapy Master's Course" focuses on the ergonomic assessment of the work environment as well as working postures and movements, work-related hazards, and appropriate assessment tools. The course analyses the impact of physiological risk factors on the physiotherapy process and introduces ergonomic adaptations and occupational physiotherapy solutions. An overview is provided of work-related musculoskeletal complaints, their physiotherapeutic management, basic hand therapy techniques, and the organisation of occupational health and vocational rehabilitation in Estonia.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course, the student:
1. Analyses workplace hazards and employees' working postures and techniques during study visits using observation and standardised assessment tools, critically and evidence-based applying the collected information.
2. Analyses and integrates comprehensive knowledge of occupational and work environment hazards, assessment of specific risks, ergonomic adaptations, risks arising from different types of work, and the organisation of occupational health services and vocational rehabilitation in Estonia.
3. Communicates professional knowledge in a visually structured and target-group-adapted format, demonstrating digital competence and justifying content choices based on relevant sources.
4. Synthesises and presents orally the results of workplace assessments and applied intervention proposals, demonstrating professional argumentation and discussion skills.
5. Critically reflects on basic hand therapy assessment and intervention techniques, analysing their applicability, limitations, and relevance in the context of the learner's professional development.

kirjeldus_en: The course consists of the theoretical and practical parts. The theoretical part will concentrate on the general cultural scene, including architecture and the figurative arts, to provide a background for literary developments which will facilitate the analysis of chosen representative texts with the aim of showing how the two are interrelated and how literary trends and styles evolve. Respectively, the exam also consists of the theoretical and practical parts. The course is richly illustrated with pictorial material. All the course materials can be found at sisu.ut.ee/pilvirajamae.
opitulemused_en: - Having taken the course, the student will be able to distinguish between the different styles and trends of the period in their historical context and locate them in the general cultural scene of the period the integral part of which they are. The student will be able to recognize different styles and characteristics of the period under discussion based on the texts discussed in class. The student will have mastered the necessary terminology, having made notes in class and read the textbooks. The student will also be able to analyze the literary texts of the period and produce academic texts.

teoreem; Jordani lemma. Antakse ülevaade resiidide teooria rakendustest.
kirjeldus_en: This is a traditional undergraduate course with some emphasis on physical applications. Specific features of functions defined in the complex plane are explained: the notions of limit, continuity and derivative are given, and their relationship explained. The necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the derivative are stated and proved. One can get an idea how fundamental theorem of integral calculus can be extended to complex functions. The relevant theorems are stated and proved: Cauchy-Goursat' theorem for simply and multiply connected domains; Cauchy integral formula and its extensions; Cauchy's residue theorem; Taylor's theorem; Laurent's theorem; Jordan's lemma. An overview of the applications of the residue theorem is given.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing this course, the student:
- 1. Knows the basic notions of the theory: interior, exterior and boundary point; neighborhood and deleted neighborhood;  connected set; closed and open set; closure; bounded and unbounded set; accumulation point; point at infinity.
- 2. Is able to calculate the limit and the derivative of a function of complex variable.
- 3. Knows what are elementary functions in the complex plane, and what are their main properties.
- 4. Has an idea of the concept of analyticity and the properties of analytic functions.
- 5. Knows what are Riemann sphere and Riemann surface.
- 6. Knows the main properties of conformal mapping.
- 7. Knows the basic principles and important theorems of integration in the complex plane (Cauchy-Goursat' theorem, Taylor's theorem, Laurent's theorem, Cauchy integral formula, Cauchy's residue theorem, Jordan's lemma).
- 8. Can classify the isolated singularities of analytic functions.
- 9. Knows the applications of residue theorem: calculation of improper integrals, Fourier' integrals, indented paths.

- Knows the specific characters and health risks of physical activity in athletes of different age and medical conditions

- Knows general acting principles in case of accidents and sudden illness
- Is able to render first aid in case of injuries, be able to dress a wound, to stop bleeding and to splint fractures
- Is able to render first aid in case of freezing and burn damages and intoxication
- Is able to render first aid in case of shock and be able to resuscitate

oppejoud: Anna Aret, Erko Jakobson, Indrek Kolka, Mihkel Pajusalu, Peeter Tenjes, Rain Kipper
kirjeldus_et: Kursus põhineb doktorandi iseseisval tööl, mille maht on umbes 2000 lehekülge või 468 tundi, jagatuna kolme raamatueksami vahel. Juhendaja(d) ja tudeng valivad iga eksami jaoks raamatu (või hulk artikleid). Kui raamat ei ole varem raamatueksamiks kasutatud, peab vastava osakonna juhataja selle heaks kiitma. Galaktikate ja kosmoloogia ning tähefüüsika osakonna tudengite puhul on üheks raamatueksamiks nõutud  Carroll & Ostlie raamat "An Introduction to Modern Astrophysics", välja arvatud juhul, kui juhendaja ja osakonnajuhataja on kokku leppinud teisiti. Ühe raamatueksami võib asendada teemakohase 6 EAP kursusega, kui see on eelnevalt heaks kiidetud peamise juhendaja poolt.
kirjeldus_en: The course is structured around independent work by the PhD student, amounting to approximately 2000 pages or 468 hours, divided across three book exams. The supervisor(s) and the student selects a book (or a set of articles) for each exam. If the book has not been previously used for the book exam, it must be approved by the head of the department the student belongs. One book exam can be replaced by a relevant 6-ECTS course, subject to approval from the main supervisor.

kirjeldus_en: Application of knowledge of the functional anatomy of skeletal muscles in the planning and implementation of massage procedures using a variety of massage techniques.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course, the student:
- 1. Explains the theoretical foundations of massage and the principles of classical massage.
- 2. Analyses the physiological effects and mechanisms of massage and evaluates its indications and contraindications within the context of physiotherapy.
- 3. Applies knowledge of functional anatomy of the skeletal muscles in the planning and implementation of massage interventions.
- 4. Performs massage techniques purposefully, based on the patient’s condition and functional needs.
- 5. Works ergonomically and in an environmentally responsible manner, adhering to occupational safety and hygiene requirements.
- 6. Identifies, analyses, and critically appraises relevant scientific literature, and develops and implements an evidence-based massage protocol, conducting patient interviews and documentation in accordance with principles of confidentiality and professional ethics, and engaging in effective collaborative work in pairs.

kirjeldus_et: Praegu on lasermeditsiini vallas üks kiiremini kasvavaid valdkondi lasertehnoloogia dermatovenereoloogias. Nahaarsti käes olev laser võimaldab teha nii täpseid manipulatsioone, mida varem teha ei saanud. See seisnes selektiivse fototermolüüsi teooria väljatöötamises, põhinedes laservalguse energia selektiivsel neeldumisel rakkude poolt, mis viib bioloogiliste koekomponentide hävimiseni, kahjustamata ümbritsevaid struktuure. Soovitud efekti saavutamiseks peab arst õigesti valima sobiva valguse lainepikkuse, kokkupuute kestuse ja piisava kiirguse intensiivsuse. Kvalifitseeritud dermatoveneroloogi ettevalmistamine on võimatu ilma mitmete kaasaegsete tehnikate, sealhulgas lasertehnoloogia põhitõdede valdamiseta. Kuigi laseri kasutamisega dermatoloogias on suurepäraseid tulemusi saavutatud, on see spetsiaalne ravimeetod pidevas arengus. Praeguseks on väljatöötamisel uued seadmed erinevate haiguste raviks, samas kui juba kasutusel olevad laserid on muutunud turvalisemaks, efektiivsemaks ja kasulikuks ka paljude muude häirete ravis. Aine läbimisel õpitakse erinevaid tehnikaid kasutades lasereid dermatoloogias. Selle aine eesmärk on tõsta dermatoveneroloogide erialase ettevalmistuse taset Eestis.
kirjeldus_en: Currently, one of the fastest growing areas in laser medicine is laser technology in dermatovenereology. A laser in the hands of a dermatologist allows for such precise manipulations that could not be done before. It consisted in the development of the theory of selective photothermolysis, based on the selective absorption of laser light energy by cells, which leads to the destruction of biological tissue components without damaging the surrounding structures. To achieve the desired effect, the doctor must correctly choose the appropriate light wavelength, exposure duration and sufficient radiation intensity. It is impossible to prepare a qualified dermatovenerologist without mastering several modern techniques, including the basics of laser technology. Although excellent results have been achieved with the use of lasers in dermatology, this special treatment method is in constant development. Currently, new devices are being developed to treat various diseases, while the lasers already in use have become safer, more effective and useful in the treatment of many other disorders. During the course, you will learn different techniques using lasers in dermatology. The purpose of this subject is to raise the level of professional training of dermatovenerologists in Estonia.
opitulemused_en: - As a result of the course, students understand the role of laser medicine in dermatological practice, the essence of the interaction of laser radiation with biological tissues, know about the main laser procedures used to correct and treat vascular malformations, skin neoplasms, pigment disorders, scarring of the skin, tattoo removal and artificial pigment , treatment of hair diseases, as well as other laser therapeutic procedures in dermatology.

- Describes a person, living conditions and daily activities in simple but coherent sentences, using basic linking words (e.g. but, because, then).
- Writes simple, coherent texts (e.g. a description of their home), using the grammar learned in the course (e.g. postpositions).
- Understands simple texts on everyday topics (e.g. health, home), is able to convey the content of what was read and provide a summary.

kirjeldus_et:
Õppeaine käsitleb tehnilise joonestamise aluseid ja kujutava geomeetria põhimõtteid, keskendudes tehniliste jooniste koostamisele ning masinaehituses kasutatavatele ISO standarditele. Kursuse raames tutvustatakse projekteerimistarkvara SolidWorks ning selle kasutamist 3D mudelite ja tehniliste jooniste loomiseks.

Lisaks antakse ülevaade ka teistest joonestus- ja modelleerimistarkvaradest, nagu Onshape ja FreeCAD. Põgusalt käsitletakse ka rahvusvaheliste joonestusstandardite erinevusi, sealhulgas ISO ja ANSI lähenemisi (nt esimese ja kolmanda nurga projektsioon).

Praktiliste tööde käigus arendatakse ruumilist mõtlemist, modelleerimisoskust ning tehnilise dokumentatsiooni koostamise võimekust. Õppeaine hõlmab ka mõõtevahendite (nt nihkaliiber) ning 3D-printimise põhialuste tutvustamist. Õppetöö korraldus ja ülesannete esitamine toimub Moodle’i keskkonna vahendusel.
kirjeldus_en:
The course introduces the fundamentals of technical drawing and descriptive geometry, with an emphasis on ISO standards used in mechanical engineering. Students learn how to create and interpret technical drawings and how to support the design process using computer-aided design tools.

The main software used in the course is SolidWorks, which is applied for creating 3D models and generating technical drawings. In addition, a brief overview of alternative CAD tools such as Onshape and FreeCAD is provided. Differences between major drafting standards, including ISO and ANSI (e.g. first-angle and third-angle projection), are discussed at an introductory level.

Practical assignments focus on developing spatial reasoning, modelling skills, and the ability to produce clear technical documentation. The course also introduces basic measurement techniques using a vernier caliper and fundamental principles of 3D printing. Learning materials, assignments, and submissions are managed via the Moodle learning environment.

kirjeldus_et:
Eesti keele kursus on esimeseks etapiks riigikeele eksami ettevalmistusele C1 tasemel. Kursusel arendatakse vestlus-ja argumenteerimisoskust, rikastatakse sõnavara, harjutatakse sobivat kõneregistrit; tutvutakse kirjutamistesti struktuuriga ning harjutakse kirjutusülesandeid, arendatakse õigekirja; kuulatakse erineva sisu ja funktsiooniga tekste, täidetakse valikvastustega kuulamisülesandeid; arendatakse üldist lugemisoskust ja eesmärgipärast lugemist. 
Õpik:
M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed" õpik ja töövihik
Teemad: 
1) Võõrkeelte õppimine. Grammatika: rõhuliited -ki, -gi, kord-liitsõnad 
2) Saatused, elulood ja kannapöörded. Grammatika: liht- ja täisminevik, tingiv kõneviis.
3) Kehakeel ja välimus. Grammatika: mitmuse käänded, tud-kesksõna.
4) Ametid ja töökohad. Grammatika: umbisikuline tegumood, ühendtegusõnad abisõnaga ära.
kirjeldus_en:
The course in Estonian is the first stage in the preparation for taking the National Advanced Estonian Language Test (C1). During the course the students will develop their conversation and reasoning skills, extend their  vocabulary, practice choosing a proper register of speech, study the structure of the written test and practice writing tasks (paying attention to the spelling), listen to different text types and do multiple choice listening tasks, develop general reading skills and reading for a purpose.
Study book:   
M. Kitsnik, L. Kingisepp "Avatud uksed" study book and workbook
Topics: 
1. Studying foreign languages. Grammar: suffixes of stress -ki, -gi, kord-compound words 
2. Destinies, biographies and about-turns. Grammar: past simple, present perfect, subjunctive mood.
3. Body language and appearance. Grammar: plural cases, past participle.
4. Jobs and professions. Grammar: Passive Voice, linking verbs with the particle ära.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who has passed the course will have been prepared for taking the National Advanced Estonian Language Test (C1) by practicing all four language skills.
- Speaking: He/she can communicate spontaneously by using grammatically correct language and proper register (might still use the avoidance strategy); understand oral speech in detail; express emotions and point out most important aspects; clearly express his/her ideas and opinions and present complicated arguments for and against a given statement.
- Writing: He/she can express his/her ideas and viewpoints in writing; write long personal letters and relate them to received information, write formal letters (CV, application, summary etc.), is good at grammar and is able to write correctly and understandably.
- Listening: He/she undestands oral texts on topics that are related to social life, academic world or work; understands the content of linguistically complicated lectures, presentations ets and professional discussions; is able to follow the conversation of native speakers; understands recordings and media files about professional work or studies.
- Reading: He/she can independently find specific information in the text by using ancillary materials, understand the content of news, articles and reports; understand text that are not related to his/her profession by using special dictionaries; can get primary as well as secondary information out of the texts read.

nimi_en: Type Theory and Computer Formalization of Mathematics
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Tüübiteooria uurimisobjektiks on formaalsed tüüpide süsteemid, mis on ühest küljest loogilised süsteemid, kus saab matemaatilisi teooriaid arendada, ning on teisest küljest arvutuslikud süsteemid, kus saab programme kirjutada. Tüübiteooria seisukohast on matemaatiliste väidete tõestamine sama, mis programmide kirjutamine, ning seetõttu on võimalik tüübiteoorial põhinevas programmeerimiskeeles kirjutada tõestuseid, mida arvuti saab kontrollida.

Kursuses vaatame lihtsamaid loogilisi süsteeme, nagu lausearvutus ning esimest järku loogika, ning näitame, et need on samad, kui teatud tüübisüsteemid. Vaatame ka keerukamaid sõltuvate tüüpidega süsteeme, mis on väljendusrikkamad ning mugavamad matemaatika arendamiseks, ja kus saab töötada ilma hulgateooriat sisse toomata.

Osade loengute asemel on arvutipraktikumid, kus õpime tõestusassistendis defineerima lihtsamaid matemaatilisi struktuure ning nende kohta väidete tõestamist.
kirjeldus_en:
Type theory studies formal systems of types. One one hand, these are logical systems in which one can develop mathematical theories. On the other hand, these are computational systems in which one can write programs. From the point of view of type theory, proving mathematical statements is the same as writing programs. Therefore, one can use a programming language which implements a consistent type theory to write proofs that a computer can check.

In this course, we will look at simple logical systems, like propositional calculus and first order logic, and show that they are the same as certain type systems. We will also consider more complex dependent type systems which are more expressive and more convenient for formalizing mathematics, and in which one can work without introducing set theory.

Some lectures are replaced by practical sessions in which we learn how to use a proof assistant to define simple mathematical structures and prove statements about them.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who has passed the course will have an understanding of:
- * propositional calculus,
- * first-order logic,
- * λ-calculus,
- * simple type theory,
- * dependent types,
- * how to use a proof assistant to prove simple statements.

See kursus keskendub sügav tehisnärvivõrkude vaatevinklist masinnägemise ülesannetele, nagu pildi klassifikatsioon, objektide tuvastamine ja segmenteerimine. kirjeldus_en: From recognising number plates to detecting highly invasive renal masses, computer vision algorithms have become a key driving force behind many areas vital for modern society, including transportation, medicine, e-commerce, art, and entertainment. Deep neural networks are at the heart of this progress. This course will dive into the core computer vision tasks such as image classification, object detection, and segmentation from the perspective of deep neural networks. We will review the main architectures, training pipelines, and performance metrics used in these tasks. Additionally, we will explore more advanced computer vision topics, such as image generation, attention and transformers, and self-supervised and weakly supervised learning. Students will gain the practical skills necessary to complete a real-life computer vision project.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course the students will: 
-possess a profound understanding of the most fundamental computer vision and deep learning concepts, including image classification, object detection, and segmentation, as well as their applications in modern society.
-be acquainted with the main principles of advanced computer vision topics such as image generation, attention and transformers, and self-supervised and weakly supervised learning.
-understand the main characteristics of state-of-the-art deep neural network architectures used in computer vision tasks, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), region-based CNNs, and vision transformers.
-gain a hands-on experience with the training pipelines and performance metrics commonly used in computer vision tasks within a framework of a real-life computer vision project.
-gain the ability to analyze, interpret and communicate the results of computer vision projects in a clear and concise manner.

kirjeldus_et:
Pakume nelja laiemat praktika teemat: kultuurivahendus, ürituste korraldamine, praktika koolides, assisteerimispraktika. Praktikat saab teha individuaalselt või rühmades.   

1. Kultuurivahenduse praktika: keele-, kirjanduse-, kultuuri- ja ühiskonnategelastega seotud erialaste tekstide koostamine, nt Wikipedia artiklid, blogipostitused jms. (Vastutavad õppejõud: Pilvi Rajamäe, Eva Rein) 

2. Ürituste korraldamine: erialaste olümpiaadide, konverentside, seminaride, kultuuriürituste (tähtpäevad, filmiõhtud) jms korraldusmeeskonnas osalemine. (Vastutavad õppejõud: Katiliina Gielen, Jane Klavan, Raili Marling) 

3. Praktika koolides: inglise keele ja ingliskeelse kultuuriruumi alaste teadmiste rakendamine keeleõppijate toetamisel ja suunamisel, koolides ingliskeelse kultuuriruumiga seotud ürituste korraldamine, huviringide juhendamine, õpetajate assisteerimine. (Vastutavad õppejõud: Anneli Sigus, Ülle Türk, Natalja Zagura) 

4. Assisteerimispraktika: anglistika osakonna õppejõudude abistamine õppetöö läbiviimisel (iseseisvate tööde tagasisidestamine, materjalide ettevalmistamine, konsultatsioonid, rühmatööde toetamine, jne.) ja teadustöö tegemisel (andmete kogumine, sisestamine, analüüsimine, jne.). (Vastutavad õppejõud: Djuddah Leijen, Liina Tammekänd, Reeli Torn-Leesik)
kirjeldus_en:
We offer four options for completing the training: cultural mediation, organizing events, traineeship at schools, assisting at university. The traineeship can be completed individually or in teams.  

1. Cultural mediation: creation of field specific texts (e.g. Wikipedia articles, blog posts, etc.) related to prominent figures from English-speaking countries. (Lecturers: Pilvi Rajamäe, Eva Rein) 

2. Organizing events: participation in the organizing committees for field specific olympiads, conferences, seminars, cultural events, and other events. (Lecturers: Katiliina Gielen, Jane Klavan, Raili Marling) 

3. Traineeship at schools: application of field specific knowledge and skills in supporting and guiding language learners at schools, organizing events, activities and hobby groups at schools, assisting teachers. (Lecturers: Anneli Sigus, Ülle Türk, Natalja Zagura)  

4. Assisting at university: assisting the lecturers at the English department in teaching-related activities (giving feedback, creation of materials, tutoring, supporting group work, etc.) and research (data collection, data analysis, etc.). (Lecturers: Djuddah Leijen, Liina Tammekänd, Reeli Torn-Leesik)
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of the traineeship, the student:
- - applies their field specific knowledge and skills in completing practical tasks
- - communicates in appropriate, field specific English
- - collaborates with others; manages time, themselves and other people
- - develops their creativity and entrepreneurship

kirjeldus_en: The course takes the form of seminars (30 hours) and independent work (48 hours). The course covers the practical aspects of English syntax and morphology. During the course, the following topics are covered: verbs (helping verbs and lexical verbs), tenses, non-finite verb forms (infinitive, participles), modal verbs, passive and causative, conditional sentences, verb complementation.

- On successful completion of the course, the student:
- - memorizes the English terminology necessary for analysing linguistic structures
- - analyses and explains the use of linguistic structures by referring to the appropriate grammar rules and using the appropriate terminology
- - is aware of their strengths and weaknesses in English grammar and is able to find additional sources for developing their grammar skills
- - forms grammatically correct language structures in English

Planning of material and work flows in a way that improves the natural environment. Designing and maintaining a good work environment. Occupational hygiene. Ergonomics. Mental and technical aspects of occupational safety. Workwear and dressing for work. Respect for tools. Elements of skills information. Home as a workplace. Sectoral examples of the organisation of workshops and work environments, visits to workplaces.

kirjeldus_et:
Teoreetilise keemia korral on tegemist teadusvaldkonnaga, mis käsitleb arvutusmeetodeid ja nende kasutamist keemiliste protsesside käsitlemisel, lähtudes nii füüsikalistest lähenemisest, kui andmepõhisest lähenemisest.

Käesolev kursus baseerub konkreetsete uurimisülesannete analüüsil ja arvutusmeetodite ning lähenduste lahtiseletamisel. Vaadeldakse valikut järgnevatest teemadest:

- keemia andmekogude virtuaalne sõelumine (sh. rakendused ravimiarenduses)
- füüsikalist, keemiliste, biokeemiliste, biomeditsiiniliste, toksiliste omaduste kirjeldamise ja prognoosimise lahendused
- keemilise reaktsioonivõime ja elektronstruktuurist lähtuvate omaduste arvutamine
- materjalide omaduste arvutuslik kirjeldamine
- makro- ja biomolekulaarsete interaktsioonide modelleerimine (sh arvutuskeemia ravimiarenduses)
- keemiainformaatika (chemoinformatics), tehisintellekti ja/või masinõppe rakendused keemias
- erinevate teoreetilise keemia meetodite (kvantmehhaanika, kvantkeemia, molekulaarmehaanika, molekulaardünaamika, molekulaarsildamine, keemiainformaatika, jne.) omavaheline kombineerimine
- jne.
kirjeldus_en:
Theoretical chemistry is a field of science that deals with computational methods and their use in the treatment of chemical processes, based on both a physical approach and a data-driven approach.

The lecture course is based on analysis of specific research tasks, and on explaining calculation methods and approximations used in the framework of theoretical chemistry. A selection of the following topics will be considered:

- virtual screening of chemical databases (incl. applications in drug design)
- description of physical, chemical, biochemical, biomedical and toxic properties, solutions for their estimation
- calculation of chemical reactivity and properties origin from the electron structure of chemical entities
- computational analysis of properties of materials
- modeling of macro and molecular interactions (incl. computational chemistry in drug design)
- cheminformatics, artificial intelligence and/or machine learning in chemistry
- combining various theoretical chemistry methods (quantum mechanics, quantum chemistry, molecular mechanics, molecular dynamics, molecular docking, cheminformatics, etc.)
- etc.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student has an overview and knowledge of the application of modern theoretical and computational chemistry methods in describing chemical processes and explaining the phenomena of chemistry.
- Within the framework of the transferable competencies, the student is able to critically analyze the scientific literature, compile a summary, prepare and make a presentation, know Estonian language professional terminology, develop a scientific discussion and answer questions during discussion, and participate in teamwork.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus annab sissejuhatuse andmestiku analüüsi ja tõenäosusteooria põhialustesse. Õppetöö algab andmete kogumise, korrastamise ja kirjeldamise tehnikatega, sealhulgas sagedustabelite, keskväärtuste ja hajuvusmõõtude arvutamisega. Seejärel liigutakse tõenäosusteooria põhimõistete juurde, tutvustades juhuslikke sündmusi, tõenäosuse mõistet ja tinglikku tõenäosust.

Edasi käsitletakse juhuslike suuruste jaotusi, jaotusfunktsioone ning keskväärtuse ja standardhälbe mõisteid. Kursus tutvustab ka klassikalisi tõenäosusjaotusi, nagu binoom-, Poissoni- ja normaaljaotus, ning Moivre–Laplace’i valemeid binoomjaotuse lähendamiseks. Lõpuks vaadeldakse korrelatsiooni ning statistilise andmetöötluse tulemuste tõlgendamist.

Kursus on üles ehitatud praktiliste ülesannete lahendamisele, et toetada omandatud teadmiste rakendamist reaalses andmetöötluses.
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides an introduction to data analysis and the fundamentals of probability theory. The course begins with techniques for collecting, organizing, and describing data, including the use of frequency tables, measures of central tendency, and measures of dispersion. It then introduces the core concepts of probability theory, such as random events, the concept of probability, and conditional probability.

The course continues with the study of probability distributions of random variables, distribution functions, and the concepts of expected value and standard deviation. Classical probability distributions such as the binomial, Poisson, and normal distributions are presented, along with the Moivre–Laplace formulas used to approximate the binomial distribution. The course concludes with an overview of correlation and the interpretation of statistical data analysis results.

The course is structured around solving practical problems to support the application of acquired knowledge in real-world data analysis.
opitulemused_en:
- A student who completed the course:
- - knows the basic concepts of probability theory and mathematical statistics
- - applies the basic results of probability theory in solving various problems
- - uses simpler techniques of statistical data processing to interpret the obtained results.

Praktikumi käigus lahendatakse ülesandeid nii koos õppejõuga kui ka iseseisvalt.

Kursuse jooksul toimub kaks kontrolltööd, mille eesmärk on hinnata üliõpilase arusaamist põhiteemadest ja oskust rakendada omandatud teadmisi.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppeaste: bakalaureuseõpe, doktoriõpe, integreeritud bakalaureuse- ja magistriõpe, magistriõpe, rakenduskõrgharidusõpe
kirjeldus_et: Kursus algab ülevaatega Taiwani kino ajaloost ja arengust, millele järgneb valitud teoste vaatamine ja kriitiline analüüs. Õppetöö toimub üle nädala ning igal kohtumisel vaadatakse üks film, millele järgneb õppejõu juhitud põhjalik analüüs. Erilist tähelepanu pööratakse narratiivile ning teostega seotud ajaloolistele, poliitilistele ja kultuurilistele küsimustele. Kursus käsitleb ka filmide tootmistausta ja laiemat sotsiaal-poliitilist konteksti Taiwani tollases ühiskonnas. Üliõpilastelt eeldatakse aktiivset osalemist linastusele järgnevates aruteludes ning regulaarsete filmiarvustuste ja reflektsioonide esitamist Moodle'i keskkonnas.
kirjeldus_en:
This course begins with an overview of the history and development of Taiwanese cinema, followed by the screening and critical analysis of selected films. One film will be screened each week. After each screening, the instructor will offer an in-depth analysis of the film's narrative, with particular attention to the historical, political, and cultural issues it engages. The course will also examine each film's production background and the broader socio-political context of Taiwan at the time of its making. In-class discussion will be incorporated when time permits. 

Students are required to engage after-screening discussion and submit weekly film reflection and review on Moodle.
opitulemused_en:
- After attending this course, students are expected to
- 1. Develop an in-depth understanding of Taiwan cinema and its historical development.
- 2. Understand significant socio-historical events in Taiwan and their subsequent impacts as represented in films.
- 3. Learn to appreciate the diversity of Taiwanese culture and everyday life as portrayed through cinema.
- 4. Find out the beauty of Taiwan through films.

Course participation 20%

kirjeldus_et: Kursus annab ülevaate valitud teooriatest sotsiaalse mälu ja kultuuripärandi uurimise interdistsiplinaarses vallas. Muuseume, kultuuripärandi ja mälupaikade mitmekülgsete näidete varal käsitletakse kultuuripärandi ja mälu loomise protsesse rahvusvahelisel, rahvuslikul, kogukondlikul ja indiviidi tasandil ning nende lõikepunktides. kirjeldus_en: This course introduces the participants to some of the main theories in the interdisciplinary fields of social memory and cultural heritage. The processes of creating cultural heritage and memory are explored at international, national, local, communal and individual levels as well as at their intersections, drawing on a range of examples from museums, heritage and memory sites. Students are acquainted with methods for studying heritage fields and learn to apply them in case studies. Thematic foci, approaches and case studies explored vary from year to year.

kirjeldus_en: This course gives an overview of the methods used in career guidance and counselling (tests, nonparametric assessment methods, interviews, workshops, lectures). The theoretical part is followed by the application of skills during self-analysis, case-studies and also includes the oppurtunity for voluntary supervised practice. The participation impoves students' skills of information-gathering (about opportunities, skills, constraints), self-analysis and career planning. The course also prepares students for work in the field of career guidance.
opitulemused_en:
- The student is familiar with the main assessment methods of career-counselling and s/he knows how to use self-analysis and exploration of the (work) opportunities in career planning.
- S/he knowls how to analyze different cases and is ready to implement main methods of career counselling.

kirjeldus_en:
Reporter's internship provides students with practical experience in a newspaper, radio or television station. Internship consists of: 1) 4-week practical training in the press or electronic media 2) defence of one's internship report and portfolio at the seminar. 
A third year bachelor student of journalism and communication who has specialized on media and communication module acquires during at least four-week-long practical training his/her first experience of working as a communication assistant, becomes acquainted with communication management of one organization, practices applying elementary communication analysis methods, practices analysis based solving of communication problems and reflects his/her professional development

kirjeldus_et: Kursuse käigus saate uusi teadmisi rahvastiku protsesside ja asumipõhise ruumilise planeerimise seostest linnades. Arutluse alla tulevad asumipõhine linnaplaneerimine, inimeste igapäevased tegevusruumid, ebavõrdsuse nõiaring ja öko-sotsiaalne paradoks. Kursus asumipõhisele linnaplaneerimisele, ebavõrdsusele, igapäevasele liikuvusele ja perede tegevusruumidele. Kursuse käigus omandate erinevaid praktilisi oskusi, sh rahvastikuprognooside koostamine. Kasutame interaktiivseid õppemeetodeid ning kursus lõppeb linnaekskursiooniga ning aitab selle linna juhtumiuuringu näitle mõiste 15-minutilise linna planeerimisega seotud võimalusi ja väljakutseid.
kirjeldus_en: During the course, you will gain new understandings on the nexus between population processes and neighbourhood-based spatial planning in urban areas. We will discuss concepts such as neighbourhood based urban planning, activity spaces of families, vicious circles of segregation and eco-social paradox. The course focusses on inequality, mobility and daily activity spaces. It is a hands-on course where you can also discover urban phenomena by yourself, and share real-life experiences with fellow students. The course will encourage interactive learning methods, and it ends with a guided tour in urban neighbourhoods to experience the case study city and its advances and challenges in planning a 15 Minute City.
opitulemused_en:
- 1)	Understands the connection between demographic changes and neighbourhood-based urban planning.
- 2)	Masters the fundamental concepts of population and location-based urban planning.
- 3)	Connect urban planning with people's daily mobility needs between key locations (home, school, work, leisure).
- 4)	Is equipped with various analytical skills, including the ability to create neighbourhood-based population forecasts and to measure spatial inequality.
- 5)	Has acquired practical knowledge about the success stories and challenges of 15 Minute City planning.

Kursus jagatakse kaheks ligikaudu võrdseks osaks. Esimeses pooles tutvustatakse masinõppe ja süvaõppe põhialuseid. Arutame teemasid nagu sobiva treeningandmestiku koostamine, närvivõrkude ehitusplokid, algoritmid, mis võimaldavad meil neid tõhusalt treenida, ja muud sarnast. Vaatleme ka mitmeid edukaid süvaõppe arhitektuure, nagu ResNet, LSTM, Transformer, VAE, GAN jt, ning uurime nii seda, milliseid probleeme need suudavad lahendada, kui ka seda, mis muudab need nii tõhusaks.

Kursuse teises pooles keskendume süvaõppe mudelite konkreetsetele rakendustele laias molekulaarbioloogia valdkonnas. Vaatame, kuidas süvaõpe on muutnud valgustruktuuride modelleerimist, sealhulgas tuntud mudeleid nagu AlphaFold. Käsitleme süvaõppe kasutamist valkude inseneritöös, valkude omavaheliste interaktsioonide ennustamises, ravimite disainis ja muudes valdkondades. Kursust läbib ühine teema: kuidas esitada bioloogilisi molekule andmestruktuuridena, mis sobivad süvaõppeks, ning kuidas arvutinägemise, loomuliku keele töötlemise ja tugevdamisõppe põhimõtted aitavad edendada molekulaarbioloogiat.

Lisaks loengutele sisaldab kursus nii praktilisi arvutitunde kui ka artikliklubi (journal club) elemente. Viimastes loengutes käsitleme ka tehisintellektiga seotud uusi küsimusi ja muresid, et laiendada tudengite arusaamist teemast.

Kuigi kursusel puuduvad ametlikud eeltingimused, eeldatakse siiski, et tudengitel on mingil määral (soovitavalt rohkem kui pelgalt algtasemel) programmeerimisoskusi või kogemusi Pythonis.
kirjeldus_en:
The course is going to be divided into two approximately equal halves. In the first half, basic principles of machine learning and deep learning will be introduced. We will discuss topics such as how to design an appropriate training data set, what components neural networks are built from, what algorithms allow us to train them efficiently and so on. We will also consider some successful deep learning architectures such as ResNet, LSTM, Transformer, VAE, GAN and others, and look at both what kinds of problems they can solve as well as what makes them very effective at doing so.

In the second half of the course, the attention will shift to specific applications of deep learning models in the broad field of molecular biology. We will look at how deep learning revolutionised protein structure modelling, including famous models such as AlphaFold. We will consider the use of deep learning in protein engineering, protein interaction prediction, drug design and others. A common theme throughout the course will focus on ways in which we can represent biological molecules as data structures amenable to deep learning, and how lessons from computer vision, natural language processing and reinforcement learning help advance molecular biology.

In addition to taught lectures, the course will contain both computer practical and journal club elements. In the final lectures, we would also address some of the recent considerations and concerns about AI, aiming to broaden students' understanding of the topic.

Note that, even though there are no formal course prerequisites and requirements for this course, the students are expected to have some (preferably beyond simply basic) level of programming skills or experience in python. I would also highly recommend taking the Introduction to Data Science course (LTAT.02.002, or similar) beforehand.

The main part of your assessment will be based on a project that you should conduct and present at the end of the semester: 80% final presentation.
The remaining 20% of the final assessment will come from the smaller tasks during the course, such as homeworks and/or discussions of primary literature.

See kursus võtab erineva fookuse, kuna see käsitleb eetilisi küsimusi, mis on seotud meie suhetega moraalsete agentide ja subjektidega, kelle eluetapp (noored, eakad), kaugus (väga kauged tulevased põlvkonnad) või meist erinev bioloogiline olemus (mitteinimloomad, keskkond) toob välja  erilisi probleeme nii individuaalse kui ka ühiskondliku tegevuse tasandil.
kirjeldus_en: Philosophical ethics has mostly focused on what is right and wrong in relationships between human adults and has taken this as the starting point for thinking about relationships with other kinds of moral agents and patients. This course takes a different focus since it addresses ethical questions involved in our relationship with moral agents and patients whose life stage (young, elderly), remoteness (very distant future generations), or different biological nature (non-human animals, the environment) raises special issues at the level of both individual and societal action.

- By the end of the course, students:
- * have mastered the tools offered by contemporary ethics to address urgent ethical questions of today's world,
- * have practiced reading and written and oral communication skills to conduct reasoned debate,
- * can transfer these skills over to both research and non-academic contexts.

kirjeldus_et:
Õppeaine uurib, kuidas seaduste, määruste ja organisatsiooniliste poliitikate keele tõlgendamine võib varieeruda sõltuvalt kontekstist, milles neid loetakse ja rakendatakse. Näiteks võivad ametnikud ja politseinikud sama seadust tõlgendada erinevalt; ettevõtte finantsosakonna ja turundusmeeskonna liikmed võivad ettevõttesisesest reeglist aru saada erinevalt. See, kas regulatiivset dokumenti mõistetakse selle koostajate kavatsusele vastavalt, sõltub paljust enamast kui vaid tekstist endast - organisatsioonilised ja institutsionaalsed struktuurid võivad süstemaatiliselt kujundada tõlgendamist viisil, mis toob kaasa düsfunktsionaalseid tulemusi. 
Kursus ühendab iseseisva töö - lugemiste ja analüütiliste refleksioonide kaudu - koostöise õppevormiga, mille keskmes on semestripikkune uurimisprojekt ja juhendaja poolt juhitud seminarid. Tudengid töötavad kogu semestri jooksul samades uurimisrühmades, uurides ühiselt nende endi valitud päriselulist juhtumiuuringut. Rühmad on üles ehitatud nii, et iga liige saab panustada oma tugevuste kaudu - olgu need analüüs, kirjutamine, uurimistöö või koordineerimine - ning üheskoos kujundada tervikliku analüüsi.
kirjeldus_en:
This course explores how the interpretation of language in laws, regulations, and organizational policies can vary depending on the context in which they're read and applied. For instance: a law might be interpreted differently by civil servants and police officers; a company rule might be understood differently by members of the finance department and the marketing team. Whether a regulatory document is understood in the way its writers intended depends on much more than the document itself - organizational and institutional structures can systematically shape interpretation in dysfunctional ways. 
The course combines individual preparation - readings and analytical reflection completed independently - with collaborative learning through a semester-long team research project and instructor-led seminars. Working in the same research team throughout the semester, students collaboratively investigate a real-world case study of their choosing. Teams are structured to allow members to contribute according to their strengths - whether through analytical work, writing, research, or coordination - while building a cohesive analysis together.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:
- LO1: Identify and analyze how linguistic features (semantic ambiguity, pragmatic underdetermination) create interpretive openness in legal texts.
- LO2: Conduct integrated two-level analysis connecting linguistic context and organizational/institutional structures in shaping legal interpretation.
- LO3: Evaluate and propose both textual and contextual interventions to address dysfunctional interpretations of legal norms.
- LO4: Apply these analytical methods to real-world cases through collaborative research projects.
hindamise_eeltingimused:
To qualify for final assessment, teams must:

* Submit the complete final report (including the executive summary).

* Participate in the critical discussion session at the end of the course, demonstrating understanding of their analysis.

Failure to meet either requirement results in no final grade being awarded.

Teams are expected to communicate openly about workload distribution and ensure balanced participation. Instructors may adjust individual grades only in exceptional cases of non-participation.
hindamise_meetod:
The final result is based on a team case study project (maximum 70 points). Teams develop the project through three checkpoints and submit a complete final report with a 3-page executive summary. Only the final report receives a numerical grade; checkpoints and discussion performance may reduce the score through penalties.

The report and summary are graded together on seven criteria (10 points each):

- Identify a dysfunctional interpretation.

- Define and explain dysfunction.

- Categorize the interpretation (semantic or pragmatic) and justify.

- Integrate linguistic and contextual analysis.

- Assess textual solutions.

- Assess contextual solutions.

- Provide a justified recommendation.

Each criterion receives a score (0-10) multiplied by a clarity factor between 0 (incomprehensible) and 1 (perfectly clear).

Deductions:
- Missed or late checkpoints: -9 points each (-27 max). These are ungraded but required for feedback and progress.
- Discussion session (comprehension check): At semester's end, teams join a critical discussion of their case study, with peers having read the summary and instructors the full report. If the team cannot adequately explain its analysis, penalties apply:  Minor -5; Moderate -15; Substantial -30; No understanding -55.

If no team member can explain the work, the maximum deduction applies. All members normally receive the same grade, though instructors may adjust an individual's result in cases of non-participation.

To pass the course, a student must receive at least an E grade.

During field trips, students will learn about forest site types, successional stages, methods of stand formation, and inventory techniques.

- understands the different forest uses
- has an overview of basic inventory and monitoring techniques

See kursus pakub sissejuhatust Java programmeerimisse, keskendudes põhikontseptsioonidele, andmetüüpidele ja objektorienteeritud programmeerimise põhimõtetele. Kursus on mõeldud algajatele ning hõlmab olulisi programmeerimiskonstruktsioone, nagu muutujad, avaldised, tingimuslauseid, tsüklid ja funktsioonid. Osalejad omandavad praktilise kogemuse Java standardsete andmetüüpide ja -struktuuridega ning õpivad neid tõhusalt kasutama.
Suur osa kursusest on pühendatud objektorienteeritud programmeerimisele, käsitledes selliseid põhikontseptsioone nagu kapseldamine, abstraktsioon, pärilus ja polümorfism. Õpilased õpivad kirjutama hästi struktureeritud Java programme, rakendama meetodite ülekirjutamist ja ülekoormamist ning analüüsima olemasolevat koodi. Kursus rõhutab ka algoritmide arendamist ja probleemilahenduse oskusi, aidates osalejatel kujundada ja vormindada Java lahendusi praktiliste ülesannete jaoks.
Kursuse lõpuks suudavad õppijad mõista ja muuta Java programme, selgitada nende täitmist ning täiustada nende funktsionaalsust. Lisaks saavad nad kogemuse väiksemate Java-põhiste projektide kallal meeskonnatöös, valmistades neid ette edasiseks õppeks ja tarkvaraarenduseks.
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides an introduction to Java programming, focusing on fundamental concepts, data types, and object-oriented principles. Designed for beginners, the course covers essential programming constructs such as variables, expressions, conditionals, loops, and functions. Participants will gain hands-on experience with Java’s standard data types and structures, learning how to manipulate them effectively through standard programming operations.
A significant portion of the course is dedicated to object-oriented programming, exploring core concepts such as encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, and polymorphism. Students will learn how to write well-structured Java programs, implement method overriding and overloading, and analyze existing code. The course also emphasizes algorithm development and problem-solving skills, guiding participants in designing and formatting Java solutions for practical tasks.
By the end of the course, students will be able to understand and modify Java programs, explain their execution, and enhance their functionality. Additionally, they will gain experience working collaboratively on small Java-based projects, preparing them for further learning and application in software development.

Keskendutakse apokalüptika juurtele Mesopotaamia tekstides ning selle õitsengule hilises juudi pseudepigraafias (nt Eenoki raamat, Aabrahami testament, Iiobi testament jne). kirjeldus_en: To learn about the apocalyptic genre and its main theological, narrative and social functions in the ancient (Mesopotamian, Jewish, early Christian) context. To learn to identify and analyse key motifs of apocalyptic texts (e.g. cosmic duality, demonology and historical determinism). To explain the origins of ancient apocalyptic texts and to apply source criticism in dating and assessing authorship of these texts.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course, the student is able to:
- Characterize the apocalyptic genre and its main theological, narrative, and social functions within the contexts of Antiquity (Mesopotamian, Jewish, and early Christian).
- Identify and analyze the key motifs of apocalyptic texts (e.g., cosmic dualism, angelology, ex eventu prophecy, and historical determinism).
- Explain the origins and role of ancient apocalyptic texts during periods of crisis and demonstrate the ability to apply source criticism for dating and evaluating the authorship of these texts.
- Present and argue on the subject matter, either in writing or orally, utilizing correct academic terminology.

nimi_en: Origami and Mathematics: The Art and Science of Folding
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus "Origami ja matemaatika: voltimise kunst ja teadus" tutvustab origamit kui interdistsiplinaarset tööriista, mis ühendab loovust, matemaatilisi kontseptsioone ja probleemilahendamise oskusi. Kursus uurib origami ajaloolist ja kultuurilist tausta, selle matemaatilisi aluseid, sealhulgas sümmeetriat, geomeetrilisi kujundeid ja algoritme, ning praktilist rakendust disainis, inseneriteadustes ja teadusuuringutes. Läbi praktiliste ülesannete ja loovprojekti saavad üliõpilased kogemuse voltimise protsesside mõistmiseks ja kasutamiseks nii esteetilistes kui ka funktsionaalsetes kontekstides. Kursuse eesmärk on arendada üliõpilaste ruumilist mõtlemist, analüüsioskusi ja loovat lähenemist, pakkudes võimalust uurida, kuidas kunst ja teadus saavad üksteist täiendada.
kirjeldus_en: The course "Origami and Mathematics: The Art and Science of Folding" introduces origami as an interdisciplinary tool that integrates creativity, mathematical concepts, and problem-solving skills. It explores the historical and cultural background of origami, its mathematical foundations—including symmetry, geometric shapes, and algorithms—and its practical applications in design, engineering, and research. Through practical tasks and a creative project, students will gain experience in understanding and applying folding processes in both aesthetic and functional contexts. The course aims to enhance students’ spatial reasoning, analytical skills, and creative approaches, offering opportunities to explore how art and science complement each other.

nimi_en: TUNE: Traditional Music Beyond Borders, Online Course
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppejoud: Cätlin Mägi, Kelly Kaur, Marko Mägi
kirjeldus_et:
See kursus pakub teoreetilise ja praktilise sissejuhatuse valikusse Euroopa regionaalsetesse muusikatraditsioonidesse.
Kursusel käsitletavad teemad hõlmavad:
Instrumentaalset ja/või vokaalset repertuaari ning esitusviise.
Erinevate kohalike ja regionaalsete muusikatraditsioonide ajalugu ja struktuure (rütmilised, meloodilised, harmoonilised ja/või vormilised aspektid).
Traditsioonilise/rahvamuusika antropoloogiat ja sotsioloogiat.
Muusika transkribeerimist.
Etnomusikoloogilist uurimistööd.
Läbiva vaatenurga kaudu arendavad üliõpilased võimet kriitiliselt reflekteerida traditsioonilise/rahvamuusika rolli üle ajaloolistes ja tänapäevastes ühiskondades ning selle potentsiaali haridusliku vahendina mitmekesisuse ja sallivuse väärtuste edendamisel.
kirjeldus_en:
This course provides a theoretical and practical introduction to a selection of European regional music traditions. 
Topics covered in the course include: 
Instrumental and/or vocal repertoire and performance techniques 
History and structures of music from various local/regional traditions (rhythmic, melodic, harmonic, and/or formal aspects) 
Anthropology/sociology of traditional/folk music 
Organology 
Music transcription 
Ethnomusicological research 
From a transversal point of view, students will develop the ability to reflect critically about the role of traditional/folk music in historical and contemporary societies and its potential as an educational tool in the values of diversity and tolerance.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- After passing the course student
Following completion of the course, the student should have the following learning outcomes defined in terms of knowledge, skills, and general competence: 
Knowledge 
Has theoretical and practical knowledge about traditional music from other cultures, including instruments, repertoire, genres, terminology, traditional vocal and/or instrumental performance techniques and their historical and cultural context 
Skills 
Can analyse and perform traditional instrumental/vocal music from other cultures 
Can describe, share, and teach aspects of their own musical tradition to others 
Can critically reflect on the roles and functions of traditional music in society 
General Competence 
Can reflect on their own musical practice and present their own ideas in written and/or oral form 
Can collaborate in an international and multilingual team environment 
Can use relevant digital resources and tools in their academic and musical practice 
Can plan and carry out tasks and projects alone or as part of a group, in accordance with ethical requirements and principles

kirjeldus_et:
Lõpueksam koosneb praktilisest osast (50%) ja suulisest komplekseksamist (50%). Positiivse eksamitulemuse saamiseks on vaja sooritada-teostada mõlemad eksami osad. Praktiline töö on stuudios või kontserdil läbi viidud salvestus, selle materjali töötlus, miksimine ja masterdamine. Kokkuleppel erialajuhiga võib praktline osa olla ka mõni muu erialane projekt, aga seejuures kehtib nõue, et lõppresultaat peab olema taasesitatav ja dokumenteeritav. Projekti kohta tuleb koostada 2-3 lk pikkune kirjalik kokkuvõte. Lõpueksami praktiline osa tuleb esitada kaks kalendrinädalat enne suulise eksami tähtaega Moodle keskkonda vastavale kursusele.

Suuline eksam koosneb viiest küsimusest ja võtab kokku helitehnoloogia eriala ainetes õpetatud teadmised ning oskused nii stuudio kui ka kontserdite helindamise vallast.

Küsimuste valdkonnad: Helistuudio struktuur (salvestusseadmed ja muu aparatuur); helisalvestuse digitaalsed formaadid, failitüübid ja järeltöötlemise vahendid; mikrofonide tüübid ja mikrofonitehnikad; heli omadused, iseloomustavad suurused ja levimine õhus; passiivsed ja aktiivsed kõlarisüsteemid ning nende kasutusvaldkonnad; digitaalsete ja analoog mikserpultide eripärad ja omadused; digitaalsete helipultide heli edastus protokollid; helitehnilise raideri koostamine ja selle lugemine.
kirjeldus_en:
The final exam consists of a practical part (50%) and an oral comprehensive exam (50%). In order to obtain a positive exam result, it is necessary to pass both parts of the exam. Practical work is a recording carried out in a studio or at a concert, the processing, mixing and mastering of this material. By agreement with the subject manager, the practical part may also be some other professional project, but the requirement is that the final result must be reproducible and documented. A 2-3 page written summary of the project must be prepared. The practical part of the final exam must be submitted two calendar weeks before the oral exam deadline to the corresponding course in the Moodle environment.

The oral exam consists of five questions and summarizes the knowledge and skills taught in the subjects of the audio technology specialty in the field of both studio and concert sound recording.

Question areas: Sound studio structure (recording devices and other equipment); digital formats, file types and post-processing tools for sound recording; microphone types and microphone techniques; sound properties, characteristic sizes and propagation in the air; passive and active speaker systems and their areas of use; characteristics and features of digital and analog mixing consoles; audio transmission protocols of digital audio consoles; compiling and reading a sound recording.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student is ready for independent professional work
- After passing the course student
- Is ready for independent professional work, including in an international environment;
- Has a good understanding of the specifics of different audio recording systems and is able to apply them in different recording situations;
- Has in-depth knowledge of audio recording and processing
- Has the knowledge and skills to develop the sound engineering solution needed for a concert or performance and is able to manage the process and perform sound direction
- Is able to continue their studies at the next level of education
- Orients himself/herself in professional literature

E (kasin) - Projektis on vigu, esineb suuri puudujääke projekti läbiviimises. Lõpp-produkt on nõrga kunstilise tasemega, helitehniline teostus on kasin.

nimi_en: America and Eastern Europe in the 20th Century
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Esimese maailmasõja ajal ja järel lagunes neli impeeriumi. Nende positsioonid võeti osaliselt üle Suurbritannia, Prantsusmaa, Jaapani ja Ameerika Ühendriikide poolt. Ühtlasi toimus katse muuta seniseid rahvusvahelisi suhteid ning rajada uus maailmakord. Selles protsessis oli kõige aktiivsem USA. Kursus annab ülevaate muutustest Ida-Euroopas pärast Esimest maailmasõda keskendudes mõne näite toel enesemääramise ning riigikujunemise protsessidele.
kirjeldus_en: Four empires collapsed during and after World War I. Their positions were partially taken over by Great Britain, France, Japan and the United States. At the same time, there was an attempt to change the existing international relations and establish a new world order. The USA was the most active in this process. The course provides an overview of the changes in Eastern Europe after the First World War, focusing on the processes of self-determination and state formation with the help of some examples.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- - is able to distinguish and characterize periods and key issues in the history of US foreign policy through the perspective of Estonia and Eastern Europe
- - is able to highlight the role of the United States in shaping international relations in the 20th century
- - will be able to distinguish the contribution and meaning of the USA in the history of Eastern Europe after the First World War
- - acquires knowledge and skills to analyze the differences in US relations with the Baltic states compared to other Eastern European countries
- - acquires a detailed overview of the central problems in Eastern Europe that have affected international relations in contemporary history

nimi_en: Expressing the Inexpressible through Words. Additions to the Depicting of Era-specific Human Archetypes in Literature
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppeaste: bakalaureuseõpe, doktoriõpe, integreeritud bakalaureuse- ja magistriõpe, magistriõpe, rakenduskõrgharidusõpe
kirjeldus_et:
Loengute põhiteema on ajastu väljendamine inimese kaudu ehk inimese väljendamine sõnakunsti abil. Iga ajajärk sünnitab omaenda erilise inimtüübi ja kuni seda inimtüüpi pole sõnastatud, ei tunta teda reaalelus ära. See on väljendamatu, kuid ootab ometi väljendamist.  

20. sajandi erinevate kümnendite mõningate kirjandusteoste põhjal tulevad jutuks ajastupõhised inimtüübid, nende väljendamine kunstis, inimese muutumine ja muutumatus.
kirjeldus_en:
The central theme of the lectures is the expression of an era through and individual or the expression of an individual through the art of words. Each era creates its distinctive human archetype, and until that archetype is articulated, it is not recognized in real life. It is inexpressible yet awaits expression. 
Based on certain literary works from the different decades of the 20th century, the discussions will focus on era-specific human archetypes, their depiction in art, and human transformation and constancy.

kirjeldus_et:
Õppeaine raames tehakse esmalt sissejuhatus lepingute eripäradesse erinevates jurisdiktsioonides (sh common law, civil law riigid; Lääne- ja Ida-Euroopa; Põhjamaad), tutvustatakse lepingute ülesehitust ja peamisi osi, tüüptingimuste kasutamist, vormi ja allkirjastamist, mudeldokumentide kasutamist, läbirääkimiste taktikat, tehniliste lahenduste kasutamist ning peatutakse levinud vigadel lepingute koostamisel.

Seejärel õpitakse lepingute koostamist M&A tehingu ja startup-ettevõttesse tehtava riskikapitaliinvesteeringu näitel. Selleks antakse ülevaade tehingu protsessist ja tehingu elluviimiseks vajalikest lepingutest, õpitakse koostama konfidentsiaaluslepingut (NDA), kavatsuste protokolli (LOI) ja Term Sheet-i, osa müügilepingut (SPA), investeerimislepingut (IA / SA), osanike vahelist lepingut (SHA) ning põhikirja (AOA).

Viimastes seminarides antakse ülevaade kinnisasjadega seotud lepingute sõlmimisest, õpitakse koostama üürilepingut, hüpoteegi seadmise lepingut ning muid asjaõiguslepinguid, ehitus- ja projekteerimislepingut, laenu- ja tagatislepinguid.
kirjeldus_en:
The course first introduces the specificities of contracts in different jurisdictions (including common law, civil law countries; Western and Eastern Europe; Nordic countries), the structure and main elements of contracts, the use of standard terms, form and signature, the use of model documents, negotiation tactics, the use of technical solutions and common mistakes in drafting contracts.

The drafting of contracts will then be taught using the example of an M&A transaction and a venture capital investment in a start-up company. To this end, you will be given an overview of the transaction process and the contracts required to complete the transaction, learn how to draft a Confidentiality Agreement (NDA), a Letter of Intent (LOI) and Term Sheet, a Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA), an Investment Agreement (IA/SA), a Shareholders' Agreement (SHA) and Articles of Association (AOA).

The last seminars will provide an overview of the drafting of contracts relating to real estate, the drafting of leases, mortgages and other contracts in rem, construction and design contracts, loan and surety and guarantee agreements.

hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
oppeaste: bakalaureuseõpe, doktoriõpe, integreeritud bakalaureuse- ja magistriõpe, magistriõpe, rakenduskõrgharidusõpe
oppejoud: Heikki Junninen, Mait Sepp, Piia Post, Velle Toll
kirjeldus_et: Sisuteemad on globaalse soojenemise põhjused, kliimamuutuse mõjud loodusele ja inimühiskonnale ning oskuste arendamine kliimamuutuse leevendamiseks ja selle mõjudega kohanemiseks. Põhiosas toetub kursus EMP programmi KLIIMATEADLIK projekti raames loodud eestikeelsele õppevahendile "Kliimamuutuste ABC", kuid juurde on loodud õpiobjektid Moodles, et täiendada materjale konkreetsete ülesannetega elust enesest. Õppetöö viiakse läbi pööratud klassiruumi võtmes e tudengid loevad ise kodus põhimaterjali peatükkide kaupa või vaatavad mingit internetiloengut või populaarteaduslikku filmi. Igal korral on üks teema arutluse all. Selle ümber on üles ehitatud kohapealsed diskussioonid. Üliõpilased on jagatud erialaliselt mitmekesisteks rühmadeks. Soodustatakse ökoloogilise maailmavaate ja keskkonnahoidlike käitumismustrite arengut ja kliimateadlikkuse kujunemist.
kirjeldus_en:
The course covers the following content areas: the causes of global warming, the impacts of climate change on nature and human society, and skill development for climate change mitigation and adaptation. The main reference for the course is the Estonian-language educational resource "Climate Change ABC," created as part of the EMP (Environmental Management and Policy) program's CLIMATE-AWARE project. In addition, Moodle's online learning materials complement the content with practical, real-world tasks.

The teaching methodology follows the flipped classroom approach, where students study assigned chapters or watch internet lectures and popular science videos at home. Each session focuses on a specific topic, around which on-site discussions are organised. Students are divided into diverse groups based on their academic backgrounds.
opitulemused_en:
- Student who has completed the course:
- 1. Understands how climate forms and why climate is changing.
- 2. Can describe both the global and local impacts of climate change.
- 3. Knows what measures need to be taken for climate change mitigation and adaptation.
- 4. Can critically analyse Estonian climate and energy policy based on materials published in the media and climate policy foundational documents.
- 5. Has collaborated with fellow students to analyse the impacts of climate change from their own disciplinary perspective.

- understands how the example of engaging in entrepreneurship influences the quality of teaching and educational work
- knows how to engage, inspire, and support students in developing an enterprising attitude
- knows how to provide initial guidance to students in engaging with age-appropriate entrepreneurship

nimi_en: Conspire: Conspiracy Theories and Radicalization Risks in Europe
hindamisskaala: Eristamata (arv, m.arv, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus uurib vandenõuteooriate sotsiaalseid, psühholoogilisi ja kultuurilisi mõõtmeid, keskendudes nende mõjule tervisele, demokraatlikule osalusele ja avalikule kommunikatsioonile. Üliõpilased analüüsivad, kuidas vandenõunarratiivid kujunevad, levivad ja mõjutavad nii individuaalset kui ka kollektiivset käitumist. Videoõppematerjalide, arutelude, juhtumianalüüside ja kursuse lõpus toimuva interaktiivse mängu kaudu omandavad osalejad tööriistad, mis võimaldavad vandenõulist mõtlemist mõista ning sellele informeeritult, eetiliselt ja konstruktiivselt reageerida. Kuue mooduliga ülesehitus toetab paindlikku iseseisvat õppimist koos juhendatud kriitilise analüüsiga.
kirjeldus_en: This course explores the social, psychological and cultural dimensions of conspiracy theories, with a particular focus on their impact on health, democratic participation and public communication. Students will examine how conspiracy narratives emerge, spread and influence both individual and collective behaviour. Through video lectures, discussions, case studies and an interactive final game, the course provides analytical tools for understanding and responding to conspiracy thinking in informed, ethical, and constructive ways. The six-module structure supports flexible, self-paced learning combined with guided critical engagement.
hindamise_meetod: Kursuse lõpptulemus põhineb kõigi nõutud tegevuste edukal täitmisel, sealhulgas videomaterjalide läbimisel, testide sooritamisel, foorumiaruteludes osalemisel ning kohapealsel osalemisel mängus "Conspirology".

- -	applies digital humanities data analysis methods

* Introduction to Imaging Technology

*Intensity Transformations and Spatial Filtering
*Image Bit-planes Manipulation
*Colorimetry: Colour Perception

- Knowledge and understanding
- On completion of the course, students should have a foundational understanding of digital image processing concepts, such as image representation, enhancement, segmentation, and analysis techniques.
- Skills and abilities
- On completion of the course the student should:
- • be able to structure and conceptualize an image processing solution from an image-based problem description, identifying relevant processing techniques and steps.
- •  be able to independently develop an algorithm to address an image-based problem of limited scope.
- • be able to develop a solution to a programmable image-based problem of limited scope using the concepts, components and Python programming tools used in the course.

kirjeldus_en: This course covers the fundamentals of data analytics and its applications in the business context . The course will cover the essentials of data analysis methods and tools, foundations of data visualisation, decision-making under uncertainty and practical business data analytics. The course will conclude with a recap and Q&A session.

kirjeldus_et:
Aine raames käsitletakse efektiivse kommunikatsiooni teoreetilisi tööriistu ja praktilisi näiteid keskkonnavaldkonna kommunikatsioonist avalikus- ja erasektoris ning meedias. Rühmatöö käigus harjutavad üliõpilased ise läbi ühe olukorra, kus on vaja rakendada keskkonna-alast kommunikatsiooni. Aine läbinud üliõpilased orienteeruvad kommunikatsioonivaldkonnas, oskavad valida sobivad lähenemisviisid sõltuvalt auditooriumist, oskavad ära tunda olukordi, kus neid püütakse proovile panna ja reageerida vastavalt olukorrale.

Õppeaine on mõeldud Bioloogia ja ökoinnovatsiooni magistriõppekava üliõpilastele, aga seda võivad huvi korral läbida ka teiste õppekavade ja õppeastmete üliõpilased. Õppeaine ei eelda spetsiifilisi teadmisi, aga vajalik on valmisolek aktiivseks seminarides osalemiseks ja rühmatööna päris elus ette tuleva keskkonnakommunikatsiooni teemalise olukorra lahendamiseks.
kirjeldus_en:
The course covers theoretical tools and practical examples of effective communication in the field of environment within the public and private sectors, as well as in the media. During group work, students practice through a scenario that requires the application of environmental communication. Students who complete the course will navigate the field of communication, choose appropriate approaches depending on the audience, recognize situations where they are being tested, and respond accordingly.

The course is aimed for master students of Biology and ecoinnovation, but interested students from other fields and study levels are also welcome. The course does not require specific skills and knowledge, but it is expected that participants are active in seminars and ready to solve a real-life situation as a part of the group work task.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- 1. understands the importance of communication in solving environmental problems
- 2. knows the specific characteristics of communication in the field of environment
- 3. understands the importance of knowing your audience and can prepare communication strategies based on the audience
- 4. can explain complex environmental topics in an understandable way without oversimplifying
- 5. can differentiate between good and bad communication, recognize demagogy and biased presentation of information
- 6. is able to find common ground with different stakeholders and appreciates the diversity of values
- 7. has confidence in expressing their own opinion and in defending it
- 8. has an overview of the institutions and people who have experience in experimental communication and knows who to turn to for advice

Grammar topics covered during the course include: conditional structures, verb and adjective patterns, gradability, modal verbs, passive voice, nominalization.

kirjeldus_en: Completion of the course provides an overview of techniques that a dentist can apply in daily practice to prevent malocclusions. The course is structured as a series of lectures, after which participants must complete independent work, either in the form of a homework assignment or a test. Participants can listen to the lectures at their own pace. The course is considered complete when all tests and assignments have been successfully completed.
opitulemused_en:
- By the end of this course, students will be able to:
· Understand the causes and types of malocclusion.
· Identify early signs of malocclusion in patients.
· Implement preventive measures to avoid the development of malocclusion.
· Educate patients and caregivers about the importance of oral health in preventing malocclusion.

kirjeldus_en: The course is divided into modules, each focusing on the key oral-health changes and challenges typical of a specific age period, from pregnancy to adulthood. The course also provides guidance on where to find more detailed, evidence-based information in Estonian when further work is needed. The practical homework tasks help learners apply the knowledge gained in real-life situations.
opitulemused_en: - Upon successful completion of the course, the learner will understand the main factors associated with different stages of a child's development that influence oral health. The learner will also be able to locate reliable sources of information on how to act when problems arise. The practical homework assignments provide experience in oral-health counselling.
