- 1. teab Euroopa Liidu Roheleppe põhieesmärke, sisu, valdkondi ja nende alaeesmärke
- 2. tunneb põhilisi arengutrende strateegia eesmärkide saavutamiseks
- 3. tunneb Roheleppe toetavaid mehhanisme ja strateegiaid
- 4. tunneb kliimaneutraalusega seonduvaid valdkondi
- 5. mõistab keskkonnamuutusi esilekutsuvaid protsesse
- 6. teab Roheleppe eesmärkide saavutamiseks vajaminevaid tegevusi Eestis
- 7. mõistab ühiskonna ressursikasutuse ja ressursside rohemajanduse omavahelisi seoseid.
opitulemused_en:
- Successful student:
- 1. knows the aim and content of the European Green Deal, policy areas, and targets
- 2. knows the trends of acquiring the main targets of the Deal
- 3. knows the supporting policies and mechanisms of the Deal
- 4. knows the content and policies of climate neutrality
- 5. knows processes related to environmental changes
- 6. knows the main targets and activities in Estonia to support the Green Deal aims
- 7. understands the relationship between societal resource usage and green economics.

kirjeldus_et:
This course covers the basic concepts and techniques of probability and statistics, starting with probability theory and Bayes' theorem. Students will also learn about diagnostic tests and how to apply them. The course then delves into types of data, including numeric and non-numeric data, and explores main descriptive statistics such as mean, standard deviation, and quartiles. Students will also learn how to choose proper visualization depending on the type of data (histograms, bar charts, and box plots).
The course then investigates random variables and discrete and continuous distributions. Students will learn about binomial, Poisson and normal distributions along with standard deviation and standard error, sample mean, prediction interval, and confidence interval. Students will learn how to compare means and percentages, and will be introduced to statistical hypothesis testing, including test statistics and p-values. 
The course will then explore two-sample t-tests, both paired and unpaired, and how to compare percentages in two populations. 
Finally, students will learn about the chi-square test, and measures of correlation. Throughout the course, students will engage in practical applications of these concepts to real-world problems, enabling them to apply basic statistical methods to analyze data and communicate their findings.

- After passing the course students will have basic understanding of probability and statistics and also have enhanced their proficiency in transferable skills.
- Learning outcomes related to the subject:
-	Understand the concept of probability and its applications.
-	Explain Bayes’ theorem and its role in diagnostic testing and apply Bayes rule to real life problems.
-	Differentiate between numeric and non-numeric data.
-	Understand and calculate main descriptive statistics: (mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, median, quantiles)

-	Understand continuous distributions, particularly the normal distribution and its properties.

-	Understand the need for statistical testing.
-	Formulate hypotheses, choose and apply appropriate statistical test and interpreting results.
-	Perform hypothesis testing for single proportion and difference of two proportions.
-	Perform hypothesis testing of the mean: one-sample t-test, paired data and independent samples.
-	Understand the chi-square test and its applications for testing independence in two-way tables and testing goodness of fit.
-	Understand the concept of correlation and measure of correlation.

-	Cultivate collaborative abilities, including team building, delegation, and understanding shared responsibilities.
-	Enhance problem-solving skills through brainstorming, analytical thinking, and adaptability when working with others.
-	Learn to allocate tasks efficiently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines as part of a team effort.
-	Gain leadership experience by taking charge when needed and motivating fellow team members.
-	Practice positive social interactions within a collaborative context.
-	Hone negotiation skills and influence others constructively during group decision-making.

kirjeldus_et: Tõenäosteooria elemendid. Suurte arvude seadus.  Optimiseerimismeetodid. Bayesi statistika ja regularisatsioon. Ülesobitamise seos mitmese testimisega. Masinõppe diagnostika. SLT ja NFL teoreemid ning nende järelmid praktikas. Klasterdamisalgoritmid ja segujaotused. EM-algoritmid. Data augmentation. Mitmemõõtmelisuse needus ja selle vähendamiseks kasutatavad projektsioonid. Autoenkooderid. Kernelid. Graafilised mudelid. Adversarial learning.
kirjeldus_en:
- Elements of probability theory. Law of large numbers. 
- Bayesian statistics and regularisation. 
- Multiple hypothesis testing as the main cause of overfitting. Diagnostic methods. Scaling laws. 
- Common data distributions and their priors.
- Sequence models and time series predictions.
- Multivariate normal distributions and affine data projections. 
- Clustering algorithms and mixture distributions. 
- Autoencoders. Esemble methods. Adversarial learning.

kirjeldus_et: Kursusel arendatavate aspektide hulka kuuluvad info hankimine ja analüüsimine, täpsete ja asjakohaste sõnumite loomine, oma meedia tarbimise harjumuste teadvustamine ja sotsiaalne vastutus. Ehkki rõhk on suurem kaasaegse ajakirjanduse tööviisidel ja oskustel, on kogu info asjakohane ja kasulik ka teiste erialade professionaalidele, kellel vaja olla meedia- ja infotarbimisoskustega kaasajas. Kursust juhivad eksperdid ajakirjanduse, meediauuringute ja kommunikatsiooni erialadelt, kuid kaasatakse ka praktilisemaid näiteid ning eksperte teistelt erialadelt - juura, keeleteadused, semiootika. See tagab osalejatele põhjaliku ülevaate teemast, selle hetkeprobleemidest ning võimalikest lahendustest.
kirjeldus_en: The course will develop students in accessing information, analyzing it, creating one's own message, reflecting one's consumption and being socially responsible. There will be a special emphasis on the work and skills of contemporary journalism but "MEDI" is relevant for most professions who have to constantly update their digital/media and information literacy competences. The course will be led by scholars and lectures from the fields of journalism, media studies and communication, but will alsol engage empirical examples, scholars and practitioners from different fields (e.g. law, linguistics, semiotics) in order to provide nuanced overview of the field, current problems and possible solutions.
opitulemused_et:
- Õppeaine edukal läbimisel üliõpilane:
- ·   	On tuttav infoühiskonna levinumate teooriate ja kontseptsioonidega ning oskab ära tunda ja analüüsida infohäirete tavapärasemaid tunnuseid
- ·   	Omab ülevaadet ajakirjanike tööprotsessidest, rollidest ja ametialastest nõudmistest tänapäevastes meediasüsteemides
- ·   	Mõistab infohäirete võimalikke tagajärgi mikro-, meso- ja makrotasandil
- ·   	On tuttav kaasatud teemade sõnavaraga, suudab arutada ja kriitiliselt analüüsida levinumaid kaasaegse infoühiskonna ja mediatiseerumise probleeme
- ·   	Suudab iseseisvalt otsida ning leida lisainfot infoühiskonna kontseptsioonide kohta
- ·   	Oskab kasutada vähemalt kolme erinevat "infoajakirjanduse" meetodit, saab aru nende kasutusviisidest erinevates kontekstides
- ·   	Kasutab kompetentselt mitmeid e-õppe võimalusi, on kasutanud e-õppe platvorme koos- ja rühmatöödeks.
- ·   	Suudab analüüsida ja (teatud määral) luua ajakirjanduslikku väärtust omavat meediasisu
- ·   	Oskab leida, arendada ja kasutada meedia-/info-/digiteadlikkuse teemalisi õppematerjale mitmetele sihtrühmadele
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course, the student:
- Is familiar with more common theories and everyday concepts of information society and knows how to recognize and analyze (the dominant signs of) information disorders,
- has an overview the work processes, roles and professional demands of journalists in contemporary media systems,
- understands the potential effects of information disorder - on micro, meso and macro levels,
- Is  familiar with the vocabulary on related topics, is able to discuss and critically analyse some of the contemporary issues of the information society and mediatization processes,
- has the skills to independently seek additional information related to the information society concepts,
- uses at least three different methods from "data journalism", understands their uses in different contexts,
- can use various e-learning opportunities and is reflexive about the experience, has used e-learning platforms for cooperation and group-work,
- is able to analyse and (to a certain extent) create media content that have journalistic value,
- can find, develop and use study materials for various stakeholders and target groups within the framework of media/information/digital literacies.

kirjeldus_en:
"Development of new drug to treat infectious diseases and other conditions is currently facing both unprecedented opportunities and challenges; the later having more significant effect. Few drug reaching market, increasing prices of novel drug has generated negative image of pharmaceutical industry that has far reaching consequence. It is crucial that students in Bioengineering curriculum have objective understanding of the technologies and challenges in drug development. 

Part of course dedicated to principles of drug development will provide overview of drug development process and its different stages. Main goals and challenges associated with each of stage will be highlighted. Special cases (such as orphan drug development) will be analyzed, Students are expected to analyze "real life" situation in drug development by analyzing of pipelines of pharmaceutical companies. Practical training includes hands-on "
opitulemused_en: - Students have theoretical understanding and practical experience about different approaches of drug design and early (discovery and preclinical) stages of drug development

During the practical part both theoretical and practical experience on the specific field will be obtained as at least one-month full job in particular enterprise. Obtained theoretical and practical experience will be summarized in written report. The project has to be defended in open discussion of seminar classes.

- Aine läbinud üliõpilane:
- 1. on omandanud erialase praktilise töökogemuse
- 2. oskab töötada meeskonnas
- 3. kohaneb igapäevase töörutiiniga
- 4. omab ülevaadet konkreetsest ettevõttest, selle töökeskkonnast, turupotentsiaalist, karjäärivõimalustest selles ettevõttes,selle ettevõtte juhtimise praktilistest külgedest üldiselt

- Kursuse läbinud üliõpilane:
- -tunneb haruldasi muldmetalle ja nende omadusi
- -tunneb haruldaste muldmetallide olulisemaid ühendeid ning nende omadusi
- -on omandanud põhiteadmised haruldaste muldmetallide toormetest, tootmisest ja kasutamisest
- -on teadlik haruldaste muldmetallide mõjust keskkonnale ja elusorganismidele

opitulemused_en:
- The student who has passed the course:
- -knows what are the rare earth elements and their properties
- -knows the most important compounds of the rare earth metals and their properties
- -has acquired basic knowledge about finding, obtaining, producing and using rare earth metals and their compounds
- -has acquired basic knowledge about the effect of rare earth metals and their compounds on the environment and living organisms.

Õppija arendab laboratoorse töö oskusi ja oskab planeerida, kirjeldada, dokumenteerida ja kasutada kaasaegseid infotehnoloogilisi lahendusi parima tulemuse saamiseks.
kirjeldus_en: Several organic synthetic experiments will be carried out within this practical course. Students will be study the main methods of synthesis, separation, purification and analysis of organic compounds and/or materials and laboratory equipment. The student develops skills mostly in laboratory practical work and is able to plan, describe, report the experimental work and also able to use modern IT to reach to best results.
opitulemused_et:
- Praktikumi läbinud üliõpilane:
- -oskab juhendamisel ohutult teostada lihtsamaid sünteese laboris
- -kirjeldab suuliselt/kirjalikult tehtavat praktilist tööd ja sellest tulenevaid riske, millest lähtub eksperimendi läbiviimise ajaplaneerimine
- -koostab ja kasutab laboriaparatuuri erinevate praktiliste tööde teostamiseks
- -otsib erialastest andmebaasidest orgaaniliste ainete keemilisi ja füüsikalisi omadusi
- -teab peamisi orgaaniliste ühendite eraldamise ja puhastamise viise
- -oskab sünteesida juhendi järgi lihtsamaid orgaanilisi ühendeid
- -oskab kasutada lihtsamaid analüüsimeetodeid orgaaniliste ühendite iseloomustamiseks (ainete sulamis- ja keemistemperatuur, planaarkromatograafia)
- -oskab nii kirjalikult kui suuliselt kirjeldada läbiviidud eksperimenti ja anda hinnangut saadud tulemustele
- -oskab täita laboripäevikut ning koostada kirjalikult orgaanilise sünteesi aruandeid (sh struktuuri joonistamise tarkvara kasutamine).
opitulemused_en:
- Student:
- -is able to safely perform simplest syntheses in the laboratory under supervision
- -is able to describe orally/written the practical work and the possible risks, thus can plan the time of the experiment
- -is able to design and use the basic laboratory equipment to perform various practical work
- -can use chemistry databases to find the chemical and physical properties of organic substances
- -knows the basic methods of isolation and purification of organic compounds
- -can synthesize the simplest organic compounds according to the instructions
- -can use simpler analytical methods to characterize organic compounds (melting and boiling points of substances, thin layer chromatography)
- -can describe the performed experiment both in writing and orally and give an evaluation of the obtained results
- -can correctly complete a lab notebook and prepare the written reports on organic synthesis (including the use of structure drawing software)

kirjeldus_en:
The course covers the following topics:
-	Philosophical and historical foundations of cognitive-behavioural theory 
-	Cognitive-behavioural theoretical framework
-	The evidence base for behavioural change and its limits 
-	Cognitive-behavioural case formulation
-	Counselling relationship in cognitive-behavioural intervention 
-	Functional behavioural analysis
-	Cognitive intervention strategies and techniques
-	Behavioural intervention strategies and techniques

- -	selgitab kognitiivsete ja käitumuslike sekkumiste kesksete strateegiate mehhanisme ja muutuse protsesse
opitulemused_en:
- Students will grasp the essential principles of cognitive-behavioral theory and the associated mechanisms of change. They will comprehend the influence of cognitions on the development and maintenance of emotional and behavioural responses to life events.
- - discusses the philosophical and historical foundations of cognitive-behavioural theory
- - defines the cognitive-behavioural theoretical framework
- - provides examples demonstrating the effectiveness of cognitive-behavioural change mechanisms
- - comprehends the principles of cognitive-behavioural case formulation
- - describes the characteristics of an effective counselling relationship in cognitive-behavioural intervention
- - explains the key mechanisms and change processes of cognitive and behavioural interventions

nimi_en: Synthetic Biology and Industrial Cell Factories
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
oppejoud: Kaspar Valgepea, Livia Matt, Nastassia Shtaida, Pavle Krsmanović, Siim Salmar
kirjeldus_en:
General topics: fermentation technologies, sustainable bioprocessing, bioprocessing for industrial production of chemicals, fuels and proteins; gas fermentation technologies, synthetic biology solutions for reaching biosustainability goals, biomass as a local resource, wood chemistry.
The course also provides insight into the contemporary use of synthetic biology tools for cell factories based on prokaryotic and eukaryotic organisms (bacteria, yeast, CHO cells, insect cells, algae, plants) in e.g. food, chemical and pharmaceutical industries. Manifold opportunities of anaerobic and aerobic production of biological compounds (metabolites, proteins, polymers, etc.) will be discussed and the major producing organisms and the technologies underlying their use and exploitation will be introduced. Also alternative methods for production of bio-based chemicals will be discussed (green chemistry).

Kursus annab praktilisi näiteid toitmisspetsialistide tegevusest ja nende rollist ravimeeskonnas. Kasutatakse erinevaid õpetamismeetodeid. Mitu korda nädalas oodatakse õpilastelt tööd ettevalmistatud kliinilise juhtumi materjali ja kliiniliste andmete kallal. Üliõpilastelt oodatakse oma järelduste esitamist individuaalselt ja ka oma rühmatööna. Praktiliste näidete põhjal annab kursus seega ülevaate, kuidas kliinilised toitmisspetsialistid saavad oma teadmisi kasutades ja rakendades kaasa aidata raviskeemide optimeerimisele. Õppijaid testitakse  lühikeste interaktiivsete testide abil, kus vastuste analüüsil on suur roll. Selle etapi eesmärk on suurendada enesekindlust probleemide  lahendamisel.   Üliõpilasele tutvustatakse makro- ja mikrotoitaineid ning nende peamisi biokeemilisi omadusi. Demonstreeritakse ja analüüsitakse toitumise sõeluuringuid ja hindamise meetodeid ning keha koostise määramise meetodeid.
Toitumisalase sekkumise põhimõisteid tutvustatakse koos praktiliste võimalustega.

The module provides practical examples of the activities of nutritionists and their role in the treatment team. Different teaching methods are used. Several times a week, students are expected to work on prepared clinical case material and clinical data. Students are expected to present their findings individually and also as members of their own group. Based on practical examples, the course thus provides an overview of how clinical nutritionists can contribute to the optimization of treatment regimens by using and applying their knowledge. Learners are tested using short interactive tests, in which the analysis of answers plays an important role. The aim at this stage is to increase confidence in solving problems. The student is introduced to macro- and micronutrients and their main biochemical properties. There will be demonstration and analysis of methods for screening and assessing nutritional status and methods for determining body composition.
The basic concepts of nutrition intervention are introduced together with the practical possibilities.

1) the theory, logic and methods to establish causality behind impact assessment/evaluation
2) application of the methods on actual use cases and the interpretation of the results

This is followed by a practical task where students have to use the same analytical approach to go through the steps needed to conduct an impact assessment for a defined problem. 
For selected examples, an actual data driven impact assessment will be conducted in class and the results interpreted.

kirjeldus_et: Kursus käsitleb erakondi kui organisatsioone, nende omavahelisi suhteid ning nende teekonda valimistest valitsusse esindusdemokraatia kontekstis. Kursus annab ülevaate erakondade kui poliitiliste organisatsioonide ülesehitusest ja arengust. Muuhulgas keskendutakse sellele, kuidas erakondade tegevus on tänapäeval riigi poolt reguleeritud ja riigist sõltuv ning kuidas erakonnad täidavad demokraatlikus riigis demokraatlikku funktsiooni. Vaadatakse seda, kuidas erakonnad omavahel suhestuvad ning millised on nende strateegiad valimistel. Heidetakse pilk sellele, kuidas valimised on demokraatlikes riikides korraldatud ning kuidas nad määravad ära demokraatliku valitsemise protsessi. Kursuse viimane osa on pühendatud Eesti erakondade, nende arengu ja omavaheliste suhete ning Eesti valimiste ülesehituse tundma õppimisele.
kirjeldus_en: The course considers parties as organizations, their relationships with each other, and their journey from elections to government in the context of representative democracy. The course provides an overview of the structure and development of parties as political organizations. Among other things, it focuses on how the activities of parties are regulated and dependent on the state and how parties fulfill a democratic function in a democratic state. It examines how parties interact with each other within a political system and what their strategies are in elections. It is examined how elections are organized in democratic countries and how they determine the process of democratic governance. The final part of the course is dedicated to learning about Estonian parties, their development and the relationships between them, and the structure of Estonian elections.
opitulemused_et:
- Kursuse edukal läbimisel on üliõpilane võimeline:
- 1. Eristama erakondi teistest kodanikuühiskonna organisatsioonidest ning kirjeldama nende spetsiifilist iseloomu.
- 2. Hindama erakondade ja valimiste rolli esindusdemokraatia toimimises.
- 3. Mõistma valimissüsteemide ülesehitust ning nende seost parteipoliitikaga.
- 4. Iseloomustama Eesti erakondade arengut ning Eesti valimissüsteemi toimimist kõikide valimiste lõikes.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon successful completion of the course, the participants should be able to:
- 1. Differentiate the specific nature of political parties as opposed to other civil society organizations.
- 2. Evaluate the role that political parties and elections play in the functioning of representative democracy.
- 3. Comprehend the basic structure of electoral systems and how they relate to party politics.
- 4. Characterise the development of Estonian parties and the functioning of the Estonian electoral system across all types of elections.

kirjeldus_et:
Poliitiline osalus uurib, kuidas inimesed mõtlevad, tajuvad ja käituvad poliitilises protsessis ja poliitika suhtes. Kursus käsitleb peamisi poliitilise osaluse ja käitumise uurimisvaldkondi nagu avalik arvamus, poliitiline teadlikkus, erinevate toimijate (alates kodanikust kuni poliitilise eliidini) osaluse strateegiad, vormid ja viisid, kultuuri ja meedia mõju poliitilisele käitumisele, eliidi mõju massile ja vastupidi.  
Kursus juhatab laiahaardeliselt sisse poliitikas osalemise, poliitilise käitumise ja poliitika kogemise erinevatesse vormidesse (mis motiveerib olema erakonna liige, kes ja kuidas esindab minu huve poliitikas, milliseid strateegiaid kasutada organisatsioonilistes võimusuhetes, kuidas aitab ekspert-staatus tõejärgses avalikus arvamuskujunduses, kuidas mõjutada poliitilist eliiti jms) läbi toimijate praktiliste kogemuste, kaalutluste ja valikute poliitilise osaluse institutsioonides.
Kursus arendab empiirilise andmeanalüüsi oskusi, millega uurida erinevate toimijate, eliidi ja massi poliitilist osalust ja käitumist.
kirjeldus_en:
Political participation explores how people think, perceive, and behave in the political process and in relation to politics. The course covers the main areas of study of political participation and behavior such as public opinion, political awareness, strategies, forms and ways of participation of various actors (from the citizen to the political elite), the influence of culture and media on political behavior, the influence of elites on the masses and vice versa.  
The course introduces various forms of political participation, political behavior, and experience of politics (what motivates me to be a member of a political party, who and how represents my interests in politics, what strategies to use in organizational power relations, how expert status helps in post-truth public opinion-making, how to influence the political elite, etc.) based on the empirical study of practical experiences, considerations, and choices of actors and institutioins of political participation.
The course develops empirical data analysis skills with which to study the political participation and behavior of various actors, elites, and masses.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursuse eesmärk on tutvustada traditsioonilisi avaliku võtme krüptosüsteeme ja kvantkindlaid võrepõhiseid krüptosüsteeme. Sellel kursusel vaatleme avaliku võtmega krüptosüsteeme, mis põhinevad täisarvu faktoriseerimise probleemil ja diskreetse logaritmi probleemil erinevate rühmade lõikes. Arutame avaliku võtme krüptosüsteemi rakendamiseks vajalikke algoritme. Arutame raskete probleemide lahendamist. Vaatleme postkvantkrüptograafiat keskendudes võredele. Pakume üksikasju kvantkindlate krüpteerimisskeemide, võtmekapseldamise mehhanismide ja digitaalallkirja skeemide kohta.
Kursusel käsitletakse järgmisi teemasid: täisarvu faktoriseerimise probleem, RSA krüptosüsteem, diskreetse logaritmi probleem, Diffie-Hellmani võtmevahetus vahetus, täisarvu faktoriseerimise ja diskreetse logaritmi probleemi lahendamine, elliptilise kõvera krüptograafia, algoritmid RSA rakendamiseks, Diffie-Hellmani võtmevahetus ja ECDSA, sissejuhatus postkvantkrüptograafiasse, võrepõhisesse krüptograafiasse.
kirjeldus_en:
The aim of this course is to present traditional public key cryptosystems and quantum-safe lattice-based cryptosystems. In this course, we review public key cryptosystems based on integer factorization problem and discrete logarithm problem over different groups. We discuss the required algorithms to implement a public key cryptosystem. We give a discussion on solving the hard problems. We review post-quantum cryptography by focusing on lattices. We provide details for quantum-resistant encryption schemes, key encapsulation mechanisms, and digital signature schemes. 
The course covers the following topics: integer factorization problem, RSA cryptosystem, discrete logarithm problem, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, how to solve integer factorization and discrete logarithm problem, elliptic curve cryptography, algorithms to implement RSA, Diffie-Hellman key exchange and ECDSA, introduction to post-quantum cryptography, lattice-based cryptography.
opitulemused_et:
- -mõistma avaliku võtme krüptograafia põhimõisteid ja tähtsust
- -genereerima avaliku võtme krüptosüsteemide parameetrite komplekte
- -analüüsima ja võrdlema avaliku võtme krüptimise, võtmevahetuse ja digitaalallkirja skeeme, võttes arvesse keerukust ja arvutuslikult rasket probleemi
- -õppima tundma postkvantkrüptograafia standardimise jõupingutusi krüptimise, võtmevahetuse ja allkirjaskeemide jaoks
- -võrdlema võrepõhiseid krüptosüsteeme turvalisuse ja jõudluse osas.
opitulemused_en:
- -understand the basic concepts and importance of public key cryptography
- -generate the parameter sets for the public key cryptosystems
- -analyze and compare public key encryption, key exchange and digital signature schemes by considering the complexity and performance
- -learn post-quantum cryptography standardization efforts for encryption, key exchange and signature schemes
- -compare lattice-based cryptosystems in terms of security and performance.

kirjeldus_en:
The course consists of two main parts:

Seminars, which take place every other week. In the seminars, central texts of European intellectual history are discussed (Aristotle, Cicero, Machiavelli, Montaigne, Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau). Short presentations on the texts are given during the seminars. Before each seminar, a preliminary assignment must be completed (questions and answers related to the text).

Video lectures "History of European Ideas", which provide broader knowledge of central themes and authors in European intellectual history.

To complete the course, students must participate in the seminars, complete the preliminary assignments and a presentation, and pass a written exam that covers the material from both the seminars and the video lectures.

kirjeldus_et: Sini-rohetaristud (infrastruktuurid) pakuvad teostatavat, ökonoomset ja väärtuslikku lahendust kliimamuutustega silmitsi seisvatele linnapiirkondadele. Kursus annab ülevaate BGI-dele ja nende funktsioonidele linnakeskkonnas. Tutvustab BGI-de põhimõtteid ja rakendusi ning nendega seadusandlust. Kursusel käsitletakse kliimamuutusi ja nende tagajärgi, üleujutusriske ja nende ohjamist ning saastekontrolli, kasutades keerukaid jätkusuutlikke lähenemisviise. Kursusel kirjeldatakse kliimamuutustega kohanemise meetmeid, säästva linnakuivendussüsteemi (SUDS) põhimõtteid, tutvustatakse erinevaid SUDSi lahendusi sademevee ja üleujutusriski maandamiseks. See kursus näitab, kuidas BGI tehnikad toimivad ja kuidas nad saavad kaasa aidata kliimamuutustega kohanemise strateegiale.
kirjeldus_en: Blue-Green Infrastructures offer a feasible, economical, and valuable solution for urban regions facing challenges of climate change. This course gives an overview of BGI-s and their functions in urban environment. Introduces principles, applications, and policies of and related to BGI-s. The course deals with climate change and its consequences, with the flood risks and its management and with pollution control using complex sustainable approaches. The course describes measures to climate change adaption, principles of sustainable urban drainage systems (SUDS), introduces different SUDS solutions for stormwater and flood risk management. This course demonstrates how BGI-s techniques function and how they can contribute to climate adaptation strategy.
opitulemused_et:
- Õpilane:
- * teab BGI-de määratlust ja erinevaid tüüpe.
- * tunneb ära BGI-de parimaid tavasid.
- * mõistab BGI-de kasutamise eeliseid (veega, kliimamuutustega kohanemise ja bioloogilise mitmekesisusega (ökosüsteemi teenused), esteetilisusega ja ühiskondliku kasuga seotud eelised).
- * teab BGI-de eduka rakendamise põhimõtteid, erinevaid elemente ja funktsioone.
- * tuvastab BGI-de omadusi, mis muudavad need ideaalseks lahenduseks kliimamuutustega kohanemisel.
- * omab ülevaadet BGI-de väljakutsetest ja takistustest tihedas linnakeskkonnas.
- * mõistab laiaulatusliku BGI kavandamise ja rakendamise strateegia väljatöötamiseks kavandatud planeerimisprotsessi.
- * teab, kuidas integreerida BGI-id ringmajandusse.
opitulemused_en:
- Student:
- * knows the definition and different types of BGI-s.
- * recognises the best practices of BGI-s.
- * understands the range of benefits (water-related, climate change adaptation and biodiversity (ecosystem services), aesthetic, and societal) of using BGI-s.
- * knows the principles of successful implementation of BGI-s and various elements and functions of BGI-s.
- * identifies the characteristics of BGI-s that make them ideal for climate change adaptation.
- * has overview of the challenges and barriers to implementation BGI-s in dense urban area.
- * understands the planning process designed to develop a comprehensive BGI-s planning and implementation strategy.
- * knows how to integrate BGI-s to the circular economy.

kirjeldus_et: Antud kursuse eesmärgiks on: (1) Anda teoreetilisi teadmisi epilepsia diagnoosimise kriteeriumidest ja diferentsiaaldiagnoosist. (2) Kirjeldada epileptiliste hoogude sümptomeid ja semioloogilisi tunnuseid ning erinevate epilepsia liikide diagnostilisi meetodeid ja kriteeriume. (3) Kursus annab tudengitele baasteadmised epilepsia patogeneesist, farmakoloogilisest ja mitte-farmakoloogilisest (kirurgilisest, VNS) ravist. (4) Tudengid saavad praktilisi teadmisi, kuidas eristada epileptilisi ja mitte-epileptilisi hoogusid.
kirjeldus_en: The objectives of above mentioned course are: (1) To provide theoretical knowledge on basic criteria of diagnosis and differential diagnosis of epilepsy. (2) To describe symptoms, semiology of epileptic seizures, diagnostic tools and diagnostic criteria of different epilepsy types. (3) The course gives students basic knowledge of pathogenesis of epilepsy, pharmacological and non-pharmacological (surgical, VNS) treatment of epilepsy. (4) To develop practical skills to differentiate between epileptic and non-epileptic attacks.
opitulemused_et: - Kursuse läbijad: 1. Omavad põhiteadmisi epilepsia etioloogiast ja epidemioloogiast; 2. Tunnevad epileptiliste hoogude põhilisi semioloogilised tunnuseid; 3. Oskavad eristada põhilisi epileptilisi sündroome vastavalt ILAE (Rahvusvaheline Epilepsiavastane Liiga) klassifikatsioonile; 4. kirjeldus_en: Linear algebra. Functions, limits and continuity. Derivatives and applications of derivatives. Antiderivatives, linear first-order differential equations. Definite integrals and their applications, improper integrals. Vectors in space, their dot and vector product. Lines and planes in space. Complex numbers.
opitulemused_et:
- Selle kursuse läbinud üliõpilane:
- 1. Teab maatriksi, pöördmaatriksi mõistet ja oskab teostada tehteid maatriksitega ning leida pöördmaatriksit. Oskab arvutada n-ndat järku determinanti, teab determinantide põhiomadusi.
- 2. Oskab lahendada lineaarseid võrrandisüsteeme. Teab Gaussi meetodit.
- 3. Teab funktsiooni mõistet, funktsioonide liigitust. Oskab ära tunda põhiliste elementaarfunktsioonide  graafikuid.
- 4. Oskab arvutada piirväärtust ja teab piirväärtuse põhiomadusi. Teab pideva funktsiooni mõistet.
- 5. Teab tuletise ja diferentsiaali mõisteid; teab tuletise põhilisi omadusi ja oskab neid leida; teab tuletise ja diferentsiaali tähtsamaid rakendusi;
- 6. Teab L'Hospitali reeglit ja oskab seda rakendada;
- 7. Oskab uurida funktsiooni ja teab, mis on kasvavad/kahanevad, kumerad/nõgusad funktsioonid;
- 8. Teab algfunktsiooni mõistet ja oskab leida määramata integraali lihtsamal juhul;
- 9. Oskab lahendada I järku lineaarseid diferentsiaalvõrrandeid.
- 10. Teab, mis on Riemanni summa ja määratud integraal ning oskab neid arvutada.
- 11. Tunneb määratud integraali rakendusi.
- 12. Teab päratu integraali mõistet ja oskab neid leida.
- 13. Oskab leida ruumivektorite skalaarkorrutist, vektorkorrutist, segakorrutist ning teab nende rakendusi.
- 14. Oskab koostada sirgete ja tasandite võrrandeid ruumis ning leida nende vastastikust asendit.
- 15. Teab, mis on kompleksarv, selle algebraline, geomeetriline, trigonomeetriline kuju, oskab teostada tehteid kompleksarvudega, teab Euleri valemit.
- 16. Valib ülesannete lahendamiseks sobivad matemaatilised kontseptsioonid (valemid) ning rakendab neid ülesannete lahendamisel.
opitulemused_en:
- After passing this course the student:
- 1. Knows definitions of matrix, inverse matrix; is able to multiplicate matrices and find inverse matrix. Knows properties of determinants, is able to evaluate determinants.
- 2. Is able to solve systems of linear equations.
- 3. Knows the definition of the function and general classes of functions and their graphs.
- 4. Is familiar with the main properties of the limit, is able to find limits. Knows, what is continous function.
- 5. Is familiar with the notions of the derivative, the differential; is able to find derivatives and differentials; knows the most important applications of derivatives.
- 6. Knows the l'Hospital rule and knows how to use it;
- 7. Knows how to investigate functions, when they are decreasing/increasing and curved/concave.
- 8. Knows, what is antiderivates and how to find them in simpler case.
- 9. Is able to solve linear first order ordinary differential equations.
- 10. Knows, what is a Riemann sum and how to calculate it.
- 11. Knows applications of definite integral.
- 12. Knows, what is improper integral and how to find it.
- 13. Is able to find vectors dot product, cross product, triple product in space and knows their applications.
- 14. Is able to construct equation formulas for lines and planes in space, find their position.
- 15. Knows complex numbers, their algebraic, geometric and trigonometric formulas, unary and binary operations of them, knows the Euler Formula.
- 16. Chooses suitable mathematical conceptions (formulae) for problems, and applies these conceptions while solving problems.

kirjeldus_et: Lühikursus jaguneb praktiliseks osaks ja iseseisvaks tööks. Praktiline osa kestab ühe nädalavahetuse päeva, mille jooksul õpetatakse vaatlema Tartu kesklinna soontaimede, sammalde ja samblike elurikkust ning märkama seda loovaid komponente (õpe toimub ka vihmase ilma korral). Päeva teises pooles näidatakse nende organismirühmadega varjatult seotud elurikkuse laboratoorseid uurimisvõimalusi Oecologicumi õppehoones ning vabavormilise loenguna tutvustatakse elurikkuse uuringutega seotud huvitavaid seikasid. Iseseisva tööna esitab tudeng nädala jooksul teemakohase essee ning teeb nõuetekohaselt vähemalt 10 erineva liigi vaatlust Tartu linnast (PlutoF GO rakenduse kaudu). Kursus lõpeb kokkuvõtva seminariga.
kirjeldus_en: The course is divided into a practical part and independent work. The practical part lasts one weekend day, during which participants are taught to observe the richness of vascular plants, bryophytes and lichens in the centre of Tartu and to learn the components that create/support the richness (study tour takes place also in a rainy weather). The second half of the day will take place in Oecologicum, where lab methods to survey organisms interacted with plants will be introduced; also a free-form lecture is given related to interesting facts about biodiversity research. As an independent work, during the week the student submits an essay on the pre-defined topic and submits proper observations of at least 10 different species from the city of Tartu (via the PlutoF GO app). The course ends with a concluding seminar.

kirjeldus_et:
Digitaalne keskkond on kultuuri ja kirjanduse uurimist kiiresti muutnud. See tähendab kultuuriandmete säilitamist ja esitamist või digidokumendi olemuse mõistmist uutmoodi, automaatset tekstianalüüsi, keerukate kultuurisüsteemide arvutimodelleerimist või andmetundlikke teooriaid (nt kultuurievolutsiooni teooria). Paraku on praegu kombeks, et kõik häguste piiride ja ebaselge definitsiooniga on "digitaalne".
Kursus on mõeldud üliõpilastele teejuhiks selles valdkondadeüleses maailmas, mis hüpleb toimetamisteooriate, geograafiliste infosüsteemide, arvutilingvistika, meediauuringute ja võrguteaduse vahel. Olemata kaugeltki ammendav, annab kursus ülevaate digihumanitaaria peamistest teemadest, lähenemistest ja ideedest, pöörates tähelepanu ka kultuuriandmete ja tekstianalüüsi ajaloole.
kirjeldus_en:
Digital environment rapidly changed the traditional framework in the studies of culture and literature. It could be new ways of storing and representing cultural data or understanding the nature of a digital document; an automated text analysis or computer modeling of complex cultural systems under the emerging data-sensitive theories (as the theory of cultural evolution). No doubt the "digital" became a new norm with blurry borders & elusive definition.
The course is planned to provide students with a roadmap in this essentially trans-disciplinary world, that jumps between editorial theories, geographic information systems, computational linguistics, media studies and network science. Far from being exhaustive, this course will overview major fields, approaches and ideas in DH while paying slightly more attention to historical cultural data & text analysis.

kirjeldus_en:

* String manipulation
* Loop directives.
* Data structures
* Command line

- * kasutab programmi loomise arendamise täistsüklit: algoritmi ja programmi loomine, testimine, muutmine, täiendamine
opitulemused_en:

- * know and use the primary programming constructions: variable, expressions, assignment statement, loop, functions, recursion, data exchange with the user and files
- * know the primary data types and structures (integers and floats, boolean values, strings, lists etc) and use them for standard operations (addition, subtraction, indexing etc)
- * analyses and explains in detail the control flow of a program and creates a descriptive algorithm
- * use the full cycle of software development: creation of the program and algorithm, testing, modification and improvement of the program

nimi_en: History of Life: Mechanisms and Patterns of Evolution
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Pärast selle kursuse läbimist peaksid Sa mõistma, et Maa ja elu ajalugu ei ole olnud lihtne sirgjooneline teekond, vaid sedavõrd keerukas ja kompleksne protsess, et kuitahes põhjalikuna loodud ülikoolikursuse käigus sellele heidetud pilk on ikkagi võrreldav vaid läbi lukuaugu piilumisega.
kirjeldus_en: After completing this course you should have understood that the history of Earth and life was not a nice straightforward road but a process with such a complexity that however in-depth university course would still be comparable with prying into a keyhole.
opitulemused_et:
- See kursus
- * inspireerib esitama küsimusi meid ümbritseva elurikkuse päritolu kohta
- * annab oskuse ühendada vaade kaasaegsele elule vaatega ammukadunud maailma
- * aitab õppida nägema, kuidas peegelduvad tänases maailmas sadade miljonite aastate tagused mustrid
- * suunab vältima inimesekeskset vaatepunkti meie planeedile, kuid
- * aitab märgata, kuidas on evolutsioonilised protsessid seotud meie enda liigi ja tsivilisatsiooniga
- * õpetab, kuidas ühendatakse elu ajaloo mõistmiseks paljude erinevate teadusharude meetodeid ja kontseptsioone
opitulemused_en:
- This course
- *	inspires to ask questions about the origin of the modern biological diversity
- *	teaches how to join the view on modern life with the view on the life that has disappeared long time ago
- *	directs to notice how the million-year-old evolutionary patterns are reflected in the modern world
- *	advises to avoid the anthropocentric view on our planet, but
- *	helps to notice how the evolutionary processes are connected with our own species and our civilization
- *	shows how the methods and concepts of different disciplines are employed to understand the history of life

kirjeldus_et: Ainekursus loom raamistiku areneva poliitoloogia distsipliini arusaamiseks - aine keskel on biopoliitika ja biovõim, selle põhitõed, argumendid ja teoreeline taust. Biopoliitilise lähenemise kaudu püüame mõistma, uurida ja leida seoseid Euroopa praeguse poliitiliste arengute vahel, alustades sisserändest ja populismist kuni koronaviiruse pandeemiani. Kursuse käigus selgitatakse kuidas võiksid biopoliitilised teadmised olla seitud geopoliitika, kultuuriuuringute ja avaliku haldusega ning kuidas sellest võib olla abi muutuste jälgimisel liberaalses maailmakorras.
kirjeldus_en: The main goal of the course is to set a framework for understanding and exploring the main arguments in the growing scholarship on biopolitics and biopower, and relate them to the current political developments in Europe, including the immigration debate, the phenomenon of populism, and the corona virus pandemic. The course explains how biopolitical knowledge might be linked to geopolitics, cultural studies, and public administration, and how it can be helpful in tracing the transformations within the liberal international order.

kirjeldus_en: The course is designed for students of curriculum "Information Society and Social Well-being", but it is also recommended to other students who study social sciences. - -	oskab kasutada erialast keelt

kirjeldus_et: Kasutatakse erinevaid õpetamismeetodeid. Mitu korda nädalas oodatakse õpilastelt tööd ettevalmistatud kliinilise juhtumi materjali ja kliiniliste andmete. Üliõpilastelt oodatakse oma järelduste esitamist individuaalselt ja ka oma rühmaga. Praktiliste näidete põhjal annab kursus seega ülevaate, kuidas kliinilised toitmisspetsialistid saavad oma teadmisi kasutades ja rakendades kaasa aidata raviskeemide optimeerimisele. Nagu varemgi, testitakse õppijaid mitteametlikult lühikeste interaktiivsete viktoriinidega.  Metaboolne reaktsioon stressile on suur osa sellest, mis määratleb haigusega seotud alatoitumise. Moodul keskendub aspektidele, mis on kliinilises praktikas kõige olulisemad.
kirjeldus_en: Different teaching methods are used. Several times a week, students are expected to work on prepared clinical case material and clinical data. Students are expected to present their findings individually and also as members of their group. Based on practical examples, the module thus provides an overview of how clinical nutritionists can contribute to the optimisation of treatment regimens by using and applying their knowledge. As before, learners are tested informally with short interactive quizzes. The metabolic response to stress is a large part of what determines disease-related malnutrition. The module focuses on the aspects that are most important in clinical practice.
opitulemused_et:
- Aine läbinud üliõpilane:
- * teab metaboolse reageerimise põhimõtteid stressile
- * teab insuliiniresistentsuse tähtsust
- * oskab neid teadmisi rakendada vähihaigete, operatsioonil olevate ja kriitilise abi osakonnas olevate patsientide toitmisalases juhtimises
opitulemused_en:
- The student completing the module:
- * knows the principles of metabolic response to stress
- * knows the importance of insulin resistance
- * is able to apply this knowledge in the nutritional management of patients with cancer, having surgery, and in the emergency department

kirjeldus_et:
Praktikumis harjutatakse tekstülesannete lahendamist, andmete leidmist tekstist ning valemite koostamist teksti põhjal. Harjutatakse definitsioonide loomist nii klassikalise geneetika mõistete järgi, kui ka juhuslikult valitud objektidele, nähtustele ja seostele. 
Tekstülesanded on koostatud klassikalise geneetika põhjal järgnevatel teemadel: mono- ja dihübriidne ristamine; geenide koostoime tunnuse määramisel; suguliitelised tunnused; aheldunud geenid; segatüüpi ülesanded. Kasside karva värvuse geneetiline määratus.

Koduse tööna on vaja määrata kassi karvastiku värvuse ja mustri geneetiline määratus kümnel kassil. Selle abil õpitakse geenide koostoimet ning õpitakse välistamise tehnikat.

Praktikumis lahendatakse näidisüledandeid. Põhiline õppimine toimub iseseisvalt kodus, lahendades selleks ülesandeid "Geneetika ülesannete" kogumikust ja e-testidest. Iga teema kohta on Moodle's koostatud e-test, mis peab olema sooritatud järgmiseks praktikumiks100 protsendile. Testi saab teha enne tähtaega nii palju kordi ja nii kaua, kui on 100 % saavutamiseks vajalik. E-testide abil toimub praktikumis kuuldu kinnistamine ning õppimine. 

Eksamile pääsemiseks on vajalik sooritada kõik e-testid ja määrata iseseisvalt 10 kassi genotüüp. Lõplik hinne kujuneb eksami hindest.
kirjeldus_en:
The class practices solving problem tasks, finding data in the text, and compiling formulas based on the text. The creation of definitions based on the concepts of classical genetics as well as randomly selected objects, phenomena and connections is practised.

Text assignments are based on classical genetics on the following topics: mono- and dihybrid crossing; genes interaction; X-chromosome linked characteristics; linked genes; varied tasks, and genetic determination of cat hair colour.

It is necessary to assess the genes of colour and pattern of the cat's coat for ten cats. This task is used to study gene interactions and to learn exclusion techniques. 

In the class, sample tasks are solved. Basic learning takes place independently at home, solving tasks from the collection of "Geneetika ülesanded" and e-tests. An e-test has been compiled for each topic in Moodle. The results of each e-test must be 100 % correct. The test can be performed as many times and for as long as is necessary to reach 100% before the deadline. E-tests are for studying and recording what has had heard in class.

To pass the exam, it is necessary to perform all e-tests and determine the genotype of 10 cats independently. The final grade is the grade of the exam.

Teemade hulka kuuluvad: määratud ja määramata vorm, artiklite kasutamine, verbid (nt partikkelverbid), ajavormid, modaalsus, passiiv, rootsi/norra/taani fraseoloogia, sõnajärg pealauses ja kõrvallauses, jms. Teoreetiliste selgituste ning praktiliste harjutuste toel süvendatakse arusaama rootsi/norra/keele tüpoloogilistest iseärasustest võrdluses teiste keeltega.
kirjeldus_en: The course introduces the typical problem areas in Swedish / Norwegian / Danish grammar - particularly from the perspective of language learners with Estonian as their first language. Topics include: definiteness and article use, different kind of verbs (eg particle verbs), tenses, modality, passive, Swedish / Norwegian / Danish phraseology, word order in a main clause and in a subordinate clause, etc. Understanding of the typological features of Swedish / Norwegian / Danish in comparison with other languages will be deepened with the support of the theoretical explanations and practical exercises.

opitulemused_en: - At the completion of the course the student has in-depth knowledge of specific issues of the Swedish / Norwegian / Danish grammar and is able to explain them to others; is able to analyze the contrastive grammatical issues (eg to compare the different Scandinavian languages and Estonian); is aware of the most common grammatical problems in the acquisition of Swedish / Norwegian / Danish as a second language and is able to avoid them in his use of language.

kirjeldus_et:
Kursus õpetab nägema silmale sageli varjatud, kuid biosfääri toimimisel oluliste organismirühmade funktsiooni, ehitust ja elutegevust. Kursus koosneb loengutest ja seminaridest.
Kursuse kohustuslik osa on referatiivne seminaritöö ja selle ettekandmine, mille läbi arendatakse kirjalikku ja suulist eneseväljendus- ja esinemisoskust ning esineja tagasisidestamist läbi kiituse ja kriitika. Tudengite seminariettekanded toimuvad loenguaegadel, algavad 7-8 loengu ajal ja võtavad seejärel ca pool iga loengu ajast. 
Peamised õppematerjalid on lektori koostatud elektroonilised konspektid ja loenguslaidid. Seminaritöö sooritamine eeldab paari enda poolt valitud või etteantud teadusartikli läbitöötamist.
kirjeldus_en: The course is an eye-opener to understand the hidden, often enigmatic life of algae, their structure, function, and role in the ecosystem. The course starts with lectures, and proceeds intermingled with seminars. A mandatory part of the course is written seminar work, which also has to be presented as an oral talk (max 10 min). This trains writing and presentation skills, as well as giving feed-back to others presentations. The course material is made available electronically. The seminar work requires analysis of a few regular research papers, which can be chosen by the student, or will be given by the tutor.
opitulemused_et:
- 1. Sõnastab vetikate olemuse, erinevused ja ühisosa teiste organismirühmadega
- 2. Nimetab olulisemaid vetikate suur-rühmi, nende ehituslikke, füsioloogilisi ja ökoloogilisi eripärasid
- 3. Kirjeldab vetikate rolli Maa biogeokeemias ja biosfääri kujundamisel
- 4. Kirjeldab vetikate toimimist veekogude ökosüsteemi osana
- 5. Nimetab olulisemaid erinevusi veekogude ja maismaa ökosüsteemide toimimises
- 6. Oskab hinnata vetikatega seotud terviseriske ja keskonnaprobleeme
- 7. Nimetab vetikate eeliseid biotehnoloogia, energia- ja toiduainete tootmise valdkondades
opitulemused_en:
- 1. Understand the very nature of algae, what distincts them from other organism groups, and what are the common features
- 2. Name the main groups of algae, their structural, physiological and ecological features
- 3. Describe the role of algae in global biogeochemistry and in the formation of biosphere
- 4. Describe the functioning of algae as part of aquatic ecosystem
- 5. List the fundamental differences between the functioning of aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems
- 6. Evaluates the health and environmental risks caused by algae
- 7. Describe the potential of algae in biotechnology, energy and food production

nimi_en: Semiotic Approach to Misinformation and Information Influence Activities
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et:
Kursus koosneb 8 temaatilisest plokist: 
1. Võtmemõisted ja kesked uurimisprobleemid 
2. Desinformatsiooni kriitiline uurimine 
3. Afektiivne tähendusloome, levinumad tajuvead (kognitiivsed nihked) ja nende (ära)kasutamine infomõjutustegevuses
4. Strateegilised narratiivid, ajaloonarratiivide ja vandenõunarratiivide kasutamisest infomõjutustegevuses
5. Infomõjustegevus ja huumor 
6. Infomõjutustegevus ja AI (külalisõppejõud Auli Viidalep)
7. Eetiline infomõjutustegevus
8. Kokkuvõte
kirjeldus_en:
The course comprises 8 thematic blocks:

1.	Key concepts and central research problems.
2.	Critical examination of disinformation.
3.	Affective meaning-making, common cognitive biases, and their exploitation in information influence activities.
4.	Strategic narratives, the use of history narratives, and conspiracy narratives in information influence activities.
5.	Information influence activities and humor.
6.	Information influence activities and AI (guest lecturer Auli Viidalep).
7.	Ethical aspects of information influence activities.
8.	Summary.
opitulemused_et:
- Aine läbinud üliõpilane:
- 1. Orienteerub infomõjutustegevuse kvalitatiivsete uuringutega seonduvas mõisteväljas ja peamistes uurimisprobleemides
- 2. Oskab kursuse tutvustatud kontseptuaalseid raamistikke oma varasemate teadmistega siduda ning kriitiliselt analüüsida
- 3. Oskab iseseisvalt konkreetsete mõjutuskampaaniate ja väärinfo tekstide analüüsimiseks vajalikke (akadeemilisi) materjale leida
- 4. Rakendab omandatud teadmisi konkreetste tekstide analüüsis.
opitulemused_en:
- The student:
- 1. Navigates the conceptual field and main research problems related to qualitative studies of information influence activities.
- 2. Is able to connect the conceptual frameworks introduced in the course with their prior knowledge and critically analyze them.
- 3. Can independently find the necessary (academic) materials for analyzing specific influence campaigns and misinformation texts.
- 4. Applies the acquired knowledge in the analysis of specific texts.

All major spelling and grammar topics are covered, including declension, conjugation, sentence structure, etc. Special attention is paid to the differences between Estonian and English. Throughout the course, students engage in reading, conversation, discussion, writing short dialogues and texts, and listening to/watching topic-related materials. 
The study material has been prepared by the University of Tartu Estonian language teachers and can be purchased at the beginning of the course.

Students who have missed or failed the test(s) can have another try during the semester (on two Fridays, dates to be announced during the semester) and at the end of the semester. - 4. Knows the underlying and main problems of the green turn.

Kursus algab Harlem Renaissance'i ja Zora Neale Hurstoniga, keskendudes 1910. aastate Harlemile New Yorgis, et vaadata teatrit, muusikat, kunsti ja kirjandust. Seejärel liigub kursus luuletajate juurde, ning lõpeb põlisameerika kirjandusega. Kirjandustekst asetatakse oma ajastu kultuurikonteksti, kuid peamiselt tõlgendatakse teksti kirjanduskriitiliste vaatenurkade valguses.
kirjeldus_en: The course provides an insight into twentieth century American literature. The course starts with Harlem Renaissance and Zora Neale Hurston, beginning from the 1910s Harlem in New York to look at theatre, music, art and literature. The course then traces how poetic forms and themes evolve throughout the century in response to social upheavals. The course will then explore Native American literature and culture and its role in the making of contemporary U.S.A. The texts will be analysed with different literary theories while bearing in mind their cultural context.

hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Kursus keskendub üleminekuprotsessidele, moderniseerumise ajaloole, globaliseerumisele, piirkondade jaotamisele, mis on seotud ELi laienemisprotsessi ja naabruspoliitikaga. Kursus kajastab konkureeriva regionalismi väljakutseid Euroopa ja Euraasia kontekstis. Kursus vältel vaadeldakse  praeguste ja tulevaste kandidaatriikide kui ka naaberriikide väljavaateid, probleeme ja väljakutseid.
kirjeldus_en: The course focuses on the transition processes, history of modernisation, globalisation, regionalisation and conditionality connected to the EU enlargement process and neighbourhood policy. It also reflects on the challenges of competing regionalisms in the European and Eurasian contexts. The course conceptually and analytically discusses the perspectives, problems and challenges of current and prospective candidate states as well as neighbourhood countries. It relates the latter to the zero-sum game dynamics of competing regionalisms, by looking at specific cases. In particular, the course will focus on the history of the enlargement process; theories, processes, and institutional & legal framework of the EU neighbourhood policy (with a focus on Eastern Partnership); case studies of success and failure of competing regionalisms; and recent developments and potential future trajectories.

- rakendada illiberalismi teooriaid ja kontseptsioone

- teha kindlaks ja hinnata vastastikust mõju territoriaalse konteksti ja europariseerumisprotsessi rollis
- välispoliitiliste tagajärgede problematiseerimist
- hinnata kriitiliselt arenguid kandidaatriikides, partnerriikides ja laiemas Euroopas
opitulemused_en:
- After passing the course student
- By the end of the course students are expected to:
- historically, conceptually, and theoretically frame the process of enlargement
- distinguish between different types of enlargement and different degrees of success in europeanization
- contextualize the various declinations of the phenomenon in different geo-territorial contexts
- identify and assess trends of mutual influence across the territorial contexts and role of the Europeanization process
- assess perspectives and problems of the EU candidate and neighbourhood policy target countries
- problematize the foreign policy implications
- critically assess the developments in the candidate countries, partners, and Wider Europe

oppejoud: Ahmed Wael Fouad Soliman, Mohamed Maher Zenhom Abdelrahman, Radwa Mohamed El Emam El Shawi
kirjeldus_et: Nüüdisajal on masinõppe süsteemid kasutusel pea igas valdkonnas, näiteks reklaaminduses ning kasutajakäitumise analüüsimises. Kõrgekvaliteetsete masinõppe süsteemide loomine on üldiselt iteratiivne, keeruline, ning ajakulukas protsess, mille käigus katsetakse erinevaid algoritme ning hüperparameetrite konfiguratsioone. Viimastel aastatel on tekkinud mitmed meetodeid ning raamistikke, mis proovivad efektiivselt lahendada CASH (Combined Algorithm Selection and Hyper-parameter tuning) probleemi. Raamisteke eesmärgiks on vähendada inimese rolli süsteemide loomisel, pakkudes masinõppe võhikule domeenieksperdi funktsionaalselt. Lisaks eelpoolmainitule tutvustab see kursus ka tipptasemel AutoML algoritme.
kirjeldus_en: Nowadays, machine learning techniques and algorithms are employed in almost every application domain (e.g., financial applications, advertising, recommendation systems, user be- havior analytics). In general, the process of building a high-quality machine learning model is an iterative, complex and time-consuming process that involves trying different algorithms and techniques in addition to having a good experience with effectively tuning their hyper-parameters. Thus, there was a crucial need for automating the process of building good machine learning models. In the last few years, several techniques and frameworks have been introduced to tackle the challenge of automating the process of Combined Algorithm Selection and Hyper-parameter tuning (CASH) in the machine learning domain. The main aim of these techniques is to reduce the role of human in the loop and fill the gap for non-expert machine learning users by playing the role of the domain expert. In this course, you will learn and understand the ideas behind state-of-the-art AutoML approaches.
opitulemused_en:
- On successful completion of this course, students should be able to:
1. Demonstrate knowledge of the emerging AutoML techniques.
2. Understand the various capabilities of explainability techniques to increase trust in the AutoML process.
3. Identify possible design decisions and procedures in the application of ML. 
4. Evaluate the design decisions made.
5. Implement efficient optimizers for AutoML problems, such as hyperparameter optimization.
6. Increase the efficiency of AutoML via a multitude of different approaches.

Ülevaade paralleelsuse mudelitest: deklaratiivne, sõnumiedastuse, jagatud olekumudelid. Paralleelprogrammeerimiskeelte kontseptsioonid: puhtad funktsioonid, ühekordselt omistatavad muutujad, andmevoopõhine täitmine, futuurid, rohelised lõimed.
kirjeldus_en: Parallel programming classification and techniques: instruction-level, data and task parallelism; implicit and explicit parallelism. Overview of concurrency models: declarative, message-passing, shared-state. Concepts of concurrent programming languages: pure functions, single assignment variables, dataflow driven execution, futures, green threads.

- -Arusaam paralleelprogrammide võimaluste ja piirangute vastavusest

- -Classify languages according to their support for parallel programming
- -Implement parallel programs in different programming languages, using their features as appropriate
- -Understand how the programs relate to the possibilities and limitations

kirjeldus_et:
Aines käsitletakse 1) erineva iseloomuga kehalise koormuse mõju organismi talitluse: raku, koe, elundi, elundkonna ja keha kui terviku tasandil; 2) treenitusseisundi tekkimise ja arendamise füsioloogilisi mehhanisme erineva suunitlusega treenituse korral; 3) erinevate spordialade treeninguprotsessi iseärasusi füsioloogilistest aspektidest lähtudes; 
4) keskkonnatinguimuste mõju organismi koormustaluvusele ja treeningu efektiivsusele.
kirjeldus_en: The main areas covered by the course are: 1) the effects of exercise on body functions at the level of cell, tissue, organ, organ system and organism as a whole; 2) physiological mechanisms of long-term adaptation to training; 3) physiological aspects of the specificity of training process in different sports; 4) the impact of environmental factors on physical performance capacity and efficacy of training.
opitulemused_et: - Ainekursuse läbinud üliõpilane:
opitulemused_en:
- The student who has completed the course understands:
- skeletal muscle energy metabolism at rest and during exercise depending on the intensity and duration of exercise  
- the impact of acute exercise on different physiological functions depending on the intensity and duration of exercise
- basic physiological mechanisms of fatigue
- the basic physiological mechanisms of adaptation to chronic training loads with different orientation,
- the impact of nutritional factors on acute exercise performance and on the outcomes of prolonged training programs
- age-dependent aspects of exercise and training
- the impact of environmental factors and that of acclimation/acclimatization physical performance
- the relationships between nutrition, physical activity, bodyweight and body composition,

and is able to evaluate:
- the impact of different acute training loads on human body on the basis of physiological responses to these 
  loads
- the adequacy of planned exercise interventions with different purposes (recreation, rehabilitation, promotion of general 
  health, improving physical performance, improving athletic performance)     
- the expediency and nature of using nutritional interventions for improving the efficacy of planned exercise interventions  
  depending on the goals of these interventions
- the conformity of the planned training programs to the person's age, state of health and physical ability

kirjeldus_et: Loengutes käsitletakse ehitusgeoloogia uurimismeetodeid, pinnase füüsikalisi ja mehaanilisi omadusi, pingejaotust pinnases. Vaadatakse ehitusgeoloogilisi nähtusi ja probleeme - vajumeid, tugevust, maalihkeid, põhjaveega seotud küsimusi, reostust - ning õpitakse neile lahendusi leidma. Teoreetiline osa on põimitud loengus lahendatavate arvutus- ja probleemülesannetega ning näidetega praktikast. Iseseisva tööna lahendavad üliõpilased koduseid töid, koostavad ühe juhtumianalüüsi artikli põhjal kirjaliku kokkuvõtte ning esitlevad seda seminaris. Kursus lõppeb kirjaliku eksamiga.
kirjeldus_en: The course includes introduction to investigation methods in engineering geology, physical and mechanical properties of a soil, and stress distribution in the ground. Different engineering geology related problems (settlement, strength issues, slope instabilities, groundwater issues, and pollution) and solutions are discussed. Practical tasks and examples are embodied in theoretical lectures. Individual tasks include homework exercises, compilation of a summary about a scientific case study paper and oral presentation in seminar. The course ends with a written exam.

opitulemused_et:
- Aine läbinud üliõpilane:
- 1.	Kirjeldab ehitusgeoloogia kui valdkonna tegutsemisulatust ning peamisi ehitusgeoloogilisi probleeme; iseloomustab ehitusgeoloogilisi uuringumeetodeid ja nende kasutamist piiravaid tegureid.
- 2.	Selgitab pinnaste füüsikaliste ja mehaaniliste omaduste sisu ja omavahelisi seoseid ning oskab pinnaseid nende omaduste põhjal ära tunda ning võrrelda.
- 3.	Kirjeldab põhjavee liikumise seaduspärasusi, oskab ette näha põhjaveega seotud probleeme ehitusgeoloogias ja pakkuda neile välja lihtsamaid lahendusi.
- 4. Iseloomustab põhjavee- ja pinnasereostuse olemust, levikumehhanisme ning reostuse likvideerimismeetodeid.
- 5.	Selgitab, mis on ja millest sõltuvad pinnase pingejaotus, vajumid ja tugevus ning oskab lihtsates tingimustes neid arvutada.
- 6.	Oskab välja tuua, milliseid ehitusgeoloogilisi probleeme võib erinevate geoloogiliste ja hüdrogeoloogiliste tingimuste juures esineda ning pakkuda välja põhimõttelisi lahendusi neile probleemidele.
opitulemused_en:
- After completing the course a student:
- 1. Can describe the field of engineering geology, main engineering geology related problems, and the main investigation methods and their limitations in engineering geology.
- 2. Understands and is able to explain the concept and relations of physical and mechanical properties of a soil, and is able to identify and compare different soil types based on these properties.
- 3. Can describe the concepts of groundwater movement, and is able to detect and solve basic groundwater related problems in engineering geology.
- 4. Can describe the concept of groundwater and soil pollution, its distribution mechanisms and main remediation methods.
- 5. Understands and is able to describe the concept of stress distribution, settlement and strength in soil, and can calculate these parameters in simple conditions.
- 6. Can identify and describe potential engineering geology related problems in different soil and groundwater conditions and offer basic solutions to these problems.

kirjeldus_et:
Kestlik hambaravi on tänapäeva tervishoiu oluline osa, mis keskendub keskkonnasäästlikkuse ja ühiskondliku vastutuse integreerimisele hambaravi praktikas. Kursuse eesmärk on anda ülevaade kestliku hambaravi põhimõtetest, sealhulgas energia- ja ressursitõhususest, jäätmete ning süsiniku jalajälje vähendamise võimalustest hambaravikliinikutes.
Kursus hõlmab teemasid, nagu hambaravi süsiniku jalajälje hindamine, materjalide elutsükli analüüs, jäätmekäitlus, patsiendi ja personali keskkonnateadlikkuse suurendamine ning roheliste algatuste elluviimine igapäevases töös. Osalejad saavad teadmisi ja praktilisi tööriistu, kuidas rakendada oma igapäevapraktikas keskkonnasäästlikke meetodeid, vähendades samal ajal kulusid ja tõstes kliiniku mainet.
Kursus valmistab hambaarste ja hambaravi spetsialistid ette teadlike ja vastutustundlike otsuste tegemiseks, et saaksite vähendada oma praktika keskkonnamõju ja panustada kestlikumasse tervishoidu.
kirjeldus_en:
Sustainable dentistry is an essential part of modern healthcare, focusing on integrating environmental sustainability and social responsibility into dental practice. This course aims to provide an overview of sustainable dentistry principles, including improving energy and resource efficiency, reducing waste, and minimizing the carbon footprint within dental clinics.
The course covers topics such as assessing the carbon footprint of dental care, analyzing the life cycle of materials, managing waste, increasing environmental awareness among patients and staff, and implementing green initiatives. Participants will gain knowledge and practical tools on how to apply eco-friendly methods in daily practice, reducing costs while enhancing the clinic's reputation.
Ultimately, this course prepares dentists and dental professionals to make informed and responsible decisions to lessen their practice's environmental impact and contribute to a more sustainable healthcare system.
opitulemused_et:
- Õppeaine läbinud üliõpilane:
- mõistab kestliku arengu eesmärkide olulisust
- on teadlik hambaravi valdkonnas kestliku arengu põhimõtetest
- teab, kust leida tõenduspõhist tervise- ja keskkonnainfot ning oskab seda kriitiliselt hinnata
- oskab muuta oma tegevusi keskkonna- ja tervisesõbralikumaks ning vastutustundlikumaks
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, students will be able: 
- to understand and apply the principles of sustainable development in their daily dental practice 
- will be aware of their role in protecting the environment and will be able to make informed choices that contribute to the sustainability of the dental sector

It will also focus on the development of practical skills in the analysis of Estonian language corpora in order to answer (mainly linguistic) research questions.

- - oskab päringute tulemusel saadud keeleainest esmaselt töödelda,
- - oskab valida uurimisküsimustele vastamiseks sobivad andmed ja tööriistad.
opitulemused_en:
- Upon completing the course, the student
- - knows the basic concepts of corpus linguistics,
- - knows the main branches and applications of corpus linguistics,
- - is familiar with the main Estonian language corpora,
- - is able to perform queries through the interfaces of corpora,
- - is able to use corpus source files,
- - is able to use existing applications for compiling their own corpus,
- - is able to process query results,
- - is able to select the appropriate data and tools for specific research questions.

Kursuse lõpus valmistavad õliõpilased iseseisvalt ette ühe teemaploki, mida saaks kasutada üldhariduskoolis praktikumi läbi viies.
kirjeldus_en: The purpose of the course is to introduce future chemistry teachers ways to make chemistry lessons more attractive, for example using virtual reality, the idea of flipped classroom, escape rooms and etc. The university students go through the seminar materials by themselves in the form of practical work. In the end of the course each university student prepares a topic set which can later be used to conduct a practicum in a general education school.

- Kursuse läbinud üliõpilane
- 1. teadvustab katsete sooritamise ja õpikule alternatiivsete meetodite vajalikkust keemia õpetamisel üldhariduskoolis,
- 2. oskab kasutada ohutult kemikaale ning töövahendeid katsete sooritamisel ja hinnata katsete ajalist ja majanduslikku aspekti,
- 3.oskab rakendada oma teadmisi koolikeemia probleemide selgitamisel ja koostada vastavaid praktilisi ülesandeid õpilastele,
- 4.oskab seostada koolikeemias käsitletavaid probleeme argielu ning teiste loodusteaduste probleemidega.
opitulemused_en:
- Student, who has completed the course
- 1. acknowledges the importance of performing experiments as well as using alternative theoretical materials besides a text book to teach chemistry in a general education school,
- 2. knows how to use chemicals and test equipment safely while performing an experiment and is able to evaluate the time span and economical aspect of performable experiments,
- 3. is able to use their knowledge to solve school chemistry problems and can compose corresponding practical exercises for students,
- 4. is able to associate the problems in school chemistry with everyday life and other scientific problems.

kirjeldus_en: The course helps to better understand the relationship and developments between language and society in the Nordic countries as well as the place of different Scandinavian languages in the globalized world. Additionally, it develops the capacity to carry out independent research.

- - tunneb sotsiolingvistika peamiseid uurimisvaldkondi ja metoodilist raamistikku;

- - on võimeline iseseisvas mini-uurimuses rakendama sotsiolingvistika meetodit.
opitulemused_en:
- After participating in the course, the student:
- - has an understanding of the main research areas and methodological framework of sociolinguistics
- - understands the essence and importance of language variation and change in the Nordic countries and the interrelationship between different Scandinavian languages
- - is able to apply sociolinguistic methods in an independent mini-research paper.

kirjeldus_et: Loengute ja praktikumide käigus käsitletakse vajalikke tehnilisi aspekte difraktsiooniliste optiliste elementide projekteerimiseks optiliste väljade genereerimiseks erinevate rakenduste jaoks.
kirjeldus_en: The lectures and computational lab sessions will cover the necessary engineering aspects for designing diffractive optical elements for generating optical fields for various applications.
opitulemused_et:
- Kursuse läbinud üliõpilane:
- - saab aru skalaardifraktsiooni formuleerimisest ja kiire levimisest,
- - oskab kujundada nii binaarseid kui ka mitmetasandilisi võresid, Fresneli tsooni läätsi, aksikoone, keerisegeneraatoreid ning analüüsida MATLABi jõudlust ja tõhusust.
- - oskab projekteerida multifunktsionaalseid difraktsioonilisi optilisi elemente ja holograafilisi optilisi elemente MATLABis.
- - oskab kavandada lihtsaid optilist kiirt kujundavaid elemente kasutades arvutusalgoritme ja rakendada neid MATLABis.
- - omab teadmisi levinumate aberratsioonide kohta difraktsiooniliste optiliste elementide projekteerimisel ja tehnikatest nende minimeerimiseks.
- - oskab luua kohandatud difraktsioonilise optilise elemendi kujundust litograafia failivormingus, mis on sobib valmistamiseks.
opitulemused_en:
- At the end of the course, the student has
- - an understanding of scalar diffraction formulation and beam propagation.
- - the skills to design binary as well as multilevel gratings, Fresnel zone lenses, axicons, vortex generators and analyze the performance and efficiency in MATLAB.
- - the skills to design multifunctional diffractive optical elements and holographic optical elements in MATLAB.
- - the capability to design simple beam shaping elements using computational algorithms and implement them in MATLAB.
- - gained knowledge in common aberrations in designing diffractive optical elements and techniques to minimize them.
- - the skills to create a design for a custom diffractive optical element in lithography file format ready for fabrication.

kirjeldus_en:
Kursus annab ülevaate peamistest inimese tunnetust ja käitumist suunavatest ja reguleerivatest teguritest spordi ja muude oskuste meisterlikule sooritamisele orienteeritud valdkondade kontekstis. Käsitletakse tunnetuspsühholoogia peamisi valdkondi (tähelepanu, mälu, õppimine, mõtlemine), emotsioonide ja motivatsiooni seoseid, inimese arengut ja individuaalseid erinevusi, grupiprotsesse ja juhendamist ning eestvedamist, psühholoogiliste oskuste treenimise aluseid, liikumisega seotud tervisekäitumist ja sooritust takistavaid tegureid. Teemade käsitlemisel lähtutakse liigutusoskuste omandamise ja reguleerimise seisukohalt olulistest probleemidest.
 	This course provides an overview of the main factors that regulate human cognitive and behavioral processes in sport and other fields oriented to mastering performance skills. Main issues of cognitive psychology (attention, memory, learning, thinking), associations between emotions and motivation, human development and individual differences, group processes, instruction, and leadership, bases of psychological skills training, exercise-related health behavior, and factors inhibiting performance are focused on. Aspects relevant for understanding the acquiring and regulating motor skills are accentuated.
opitulemused_et:
- Kursuse lõpetamisel õppija:
- 1.	kirjeldab spordi- ja soorituspsühholoogia teemade ulatust ja sisu
- 2.	demonstreerib baasteadmisi spordi- ja sooritusspsühholoogia uurimismeetodite alal
- 3.	analüüsib oskuste õppimist ja ekspertsuse arengut mõjutavaid bioloogilisi, arengulisi, motivatsioonilisi, sotsiaalseid ja keskkondlikke tegureid
- 4.	selgitab oskuste sooritamist mõjutavaid psühholoogilisi protsesse ja kirjeldab nende omavahelisi seoseid soorituse kontekstis
- 5.	mõistab sooritusoskuste arengut pidurdavate ja realiseerimist takistavate tegurite toimemehhanisme ja kirjeldab nende avaldumise riski vähendamise võimalusi
- 6.	selgitab kehalise aktiivsuse mõju vaimsele tervisele ja heaolule
- 7.	oskab luua harjumuse kujundamise plaani
opitulemused_en:
- Students will be able to
- 1.	describe a wide range of topics covered by sport and performance psychology
- 2.	demonstrate a basic understanding of research methods and design in sport and performance psychology
- 3.	analyses biological, developmental, motivational, social, and environmental factors affecting the development of skills and expertise.
- 4.	explain psychological processes affecting performance and describes their interrelations in the context of performance
- 5.	understand the modes of action of factors inhibiting the development of performance skills and hindering skill mastering, and relate prospects to reducing the risk factors
- 6.	demonstrate understanding of how physical activity influences mental health and well-being
- 7.	design plans for habit development

nimi_en: The Baltics in the International Relations of the Baltic Sea Region 1558-1920
hindamisskaala: Eristav (A, B, C, D, E, F, mi)
kirjeldus_et: Baltikum on olnud sajandeid kohaks, kus on põrkunud Läänemerd ümbritsevate riikide ambitsioonid ning kontroll Baltikumi üle peegeldas suuresti võimusuhteid kogu Läänemere regioonis. Valikkursus keskendub kolmele olulisemale piirkonnas aset leidnud konfliktile. Nendeks on esiteks viimasel ajal Põhjamaade Saja-aastase sõjana tuntuks saanud sõdade jada Poola, Rootsi, Taani ja Venemaa vahel (1554-1661), Põhjasõda (1700-1721) ning Esimene maailmasõda (1914-1918). Kursus ei keskendu niivõrd sõjasündmustele Eesti-, Liivi- ja Kuramaal, vaid sõdivate riikide välispoliitikale ning laiemale rahvusvahelisele olukorrale. Loengutes ja seminarides arutleme muu hulgas põhjuste üle, miks siinne maa on aegade jooksul nii rohketest sõdadest räsitud ning käsitleme argumente, mida on kasutatud õigustamaks ülemvõimu Baltikumi üle.
kirjeldus_en: The history of Estonians and Latvians has been influenced by the power struggles of their neighboring countries to a great extent. Control over the Baltics reflected the power relations of the whole Baltic Sea region. The course focuses on three defining conflicts that took place in the region. These are, firstly, a series of wars between Poland, Sweden, Denmark and Russia that has been lately termed as the Nordic Hundred Years' War (1554-1661), The Great Northern War (1700-1721) and The First World War (1914-1918). With all the aforementioned wars the Baltics is placed into a wider international context and the role of the Baltics in causing these conflicts and the aims of the belligerents regarding the Baltics will be analyzed. The direct and indirect impacts of these wars on the local society will be discussed as a separate topic. The course consists of lectures and three seminars. Students are required to work through the assigned literature for the seminars.
